name: Acrisure Bounce House

parkingLots.name: Gold Zone – Kenneth G. Dixon Athletics Village
parkingLots.notes: Some garages and lots in this area require a permit; fans can park free in most other areas of campus

bagPolicyNotes: Clear bag policy in effect for UCF Football games at Acrisure Bounce House; a bag check service is no longer provided and metal detection is also in use.
venueAccessRestrictions: Premium seating areas within the stadium restrict concourse access to non-premium ticket holders; fans should know their gate before entering.

name: Acrisure Stadium

publicTransit.notes: Take the 'T' to Allegheny Station (Allegheny Ave & Reedsdale St) or North Side Station (base of West General Robinson Street Garage); North Shore parking is reserved and pre-sold, downtown parking encouraged.

accessibility: ADA-accessible venue; accessible seating via Accessibility Request Form; elevators, ramps, escalators, and loaner wheelchairs available; Guest Services rooms behind Sections 104/123/504/528; KultureCity sensory-inclusive; service dogs/miniature horses only; ADA drop-off at Art Rooney Ave & Reedsdale St (NE, by Gate B) and North Shore Dr (SW, across from Kamin Science Center).

tailgating.rules: Governed by Alco Parking's Tailgating Policy for the stadium/PNC Park lots.

outsideFoodRules: Food permitted only if carried in a clear plastic bag; factory-sealed non-alcoholic plastic bottles/containers 24 oz or less allowed; no cans, glass bottles, coolers, thermoses, or flasks.
food: Concessions operated by Aramark; local 'Pittsburgh Eats' vendors and Franco's Pizzeria on game days; in-seat/mobile beer and food ordering via the Steelers app; self-serve Drink Markets in Sections 117 & 525.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Acrisure Stadium's gates open two hours before kickoff for Pitt football games.
All gates (Gate A East, A West, B, C, and FedEx Great Hall) open two hours prior to kick-off.

name: Albertsons Stadium

parkingLots.name: East Stadium Lot
parkingLots.notes: Limited single-game reserved parking; may be used to tailgate; also an ADA-accessible parking location

parkingLots.name: Norco Lot
parkingLots.notes: Limited single-game reserved parking; may be used to tailgate

parkingLots.name: Lincoln Avenue Garage
parkingLots.notes: Day-of parking $20/space, first-come first-served; game-day shuttle pickup; ADA parking on west-side ground floor

parkingLots.name: Brady Street Garage
parkingLots.notes: Day-of parking $20/space, first-come first-served; game-day shuttle pickup; ADA parking on west-side ground floor

parkingLots.name: Grant East/West Lots
parkingLots.notes: Day-of parking $20/space, first-come first-served; golf-cart service to stadium for limited-mobility patrons

parkingLots.name: West Stadium Lot
parkingLots.notes: ADA-accessible parking location

parkingLots.name: Engineering and Technology (ET) Reserved Lot
parkingLots.notes: ADA-accessible parking location

rideshareDropoff: Stadium drop-off is on Bronco Lane/Bronco Circle at the stadium's southwest corner; due to police requests for increased security, non-ADA drop-offs are not allowed there.
accessibility: Accessible parking $20/space, first-come, first-served at East and West Stadium lots, the Engineering and Technology (ET) Reserved Lot, and the west-side ground floor of the Lincoln Avenue and Brady Street Garages (state-issued accessible plate/placard required, registrant must be an occupant; no in-and-out privileges). Free wheelchair-accessible shuttle from the Lincoln Avenue and Brady Street Garages, beginning three hours before kickoff until one hour after the game. Complimentary golf-cart service runs between Albertsons Stadium and the Grant lots (two hours before kickoff through the first quarter, and from the fourth quarter to end of game). ADA-accessible entrances at Entry Plaza 2 (Gates N, P) and Gate A (ADA entry only). ADA stadium drop-off on Bronco Lane/Bronco Circle at the southwest corner.
bagPolicyNotes: An exception will be made for diaper and medical bags.
venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Weapons, Animals, unless certified service animals, Chairs over 18” wide or with arms, Drones, Emotional support animals, Flags or banners, Glass or plastic bottles, Illegal substances, Large bags or backpacks, Long lens cameras, Noisemakers, Outside alcohol, Outside food/beverage, Signs or clothing with offensive content or images, Strollers or car seats, Tablets or laptops, Tripods, video or tape recorders, Umbrellas, or coolers. Re-entry is not permitted to fans who have entered and exited Albertsons Stadium. All Patrons subject to search. Refusal of search will result in non-admittance.
food: Albertsons Stadium has five full-service concession stands on the east side and seven on the west side, paired with local beer stations in the northeast and northwest corners. Six Mashgin self-checkout kiosks speed transactions near the east/west Locals Corner and Double R Ranch areas. Bronco Alley on the east side features food trucks, extra beverage stands and restrooms, opening four hours before kickoff through halftime. Bottled water is sold at every stand/kiosk plus complimentary water stations; alcohol sales require ID and a wristband.

name: Allegacy Federal Credit Union Stadium
rideshareDropoff: Rideshare drop off/pick up is on Shorefair Drive behind the indoor tennis center.
accessibility: ADA parking: reserved handicapped passes available seasonally in McCreary Tower/Gold/Red Lots (placard + Wake Forest parking pass required); Blue/Orange Lots have no reserved handicapped parking but offer courtesy shuttles to the entry gate; visiting-team/general-public disabled patrons enter via Deacon Blvd and park in the Red Lot with a valid placard (courtesy shuttle to Gate 1). Golf cart shuttles assist disabled, elderly or injured patrons from all lots (text/call 336-758-GAME). Medical stations at Sections 10 and 20; earplugs available at Guest Information Booths.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is only permitted in parking spaces you have purchased; to occupy more than one space you must purchase the extra spaces and show the same number of parking passes as spaces occupied. Kegs are permitted. No glass containers. No tents in parking spaces unless an additional pass is purchased; spiking/staking tents is prohibited. No music amplifiers, subwoofers or bass systems (Athletics may require excessive speakers be turned down/off/removed). Gasoline-powered generators are prohibited. Persons providing alcohol are responsible for preventing excessive/underage consumption.
tailgating.grillRules: Only propane grills may be used; charcoal grills are prohibited. Open flames (except propane grills) are prohibited.
tailgating.rvPolicy: All buses and RVs are charged for three (3) spaces at the game rate and are given three (3) ticket stubs.

venueAccessRestrictions: Metal detectors are in place at all gates at Allegacy Stadium.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverage is prohibited in Allegacy Stadium, with the exception of one (1) clear, plastic water bottle, which must be completely empty to be permitted.
food: Concessions provided by Proof of the Pudding; all concession stands are cashless. Wide selection across West and East concourses including Bojangles, burgers, Domino's Pizza, BBQ/smoked meats (Smoke Revival Co.), hot dogs (Mad Dog's), pretzels, walking tacos, beer & wine, craft beer (Lowe's Beer Den), and mixed drinks (DEACTOWN Brew Pub, Liquor Portable), plus a food-truck row behind Deacon Hill (Chick-fil-A Sweet Truck, Kona Ice, Dippin Dots, and more).

name: Allegiant Stadium

parkingLots.name: Lot A
parkingLots.notes: Onsite; tailgating permitted; EV charging

parkingLots.name: Lot B
parkingLots.notes: Onsite; tailgating permitted; ADA drop-off near Gate 2

parkingLots.notes: Onsite; tailgating permitted

parkingLots.notes: EV charging

parkingLots.notes: Onsite; tailgating permitted

parkingLots.notes: Onsite; tailgating permitted; EV charging

parkingLots.name: Lot G
parkingLots.notes: Onsite; tailgating permitted

parkingLots.name: Lot H
parkingLots.notes: Onsite (Ford Lot H); tailgating permitted

parkingLots.name: Lot J
parkingLots.notes: Onsite (Ford Lot J); tailgating permitted

parkingLots.name: Lot N
parkingLots.notes: Rideshare and general drop-off/pick-up, north of stadium on Dean Martin Dr

parkingLots.name: Lot S
parkingLots.notes: Offsite; tailgating permitted

parkingLots.name: Lot V
parkingLots.notes: Offsite; tailgating permitted

parkingLots.name: Lot W
parkingLots.notes: Offsite; tailgating permitted

parkingLots.name: Lot X
parkingLots.notes: Offsite; tailgating permitted

parkingLots.name: Dewey Lot
parkingLots.notes: Offsite; tailgating permitted

publicTransit.notes: Deuce runs 24/7 every 15 min along Las Vegas Blvd, closest stop near Hacienda Bridge at Mandalay Bay, $8 24-hour pass; Game Day Express provides direct Raiders-game service from 6 suburban casino locations.

rideshareDropoff: Rideshare pick-up/drop-off in Lot N (front half, 5285 Dean Martin Dr), north of stadium; general and taxi drop-off/pick-up at corner of Diablo Dr and Procyon St.
accessibility: All gates ADA accessible; accessible seating via Ticketmaster; ADA parking requires valid placard/plate plus a purchased parking pass; ADA drop-off in Lot B near Gate 2; courtesy shuttles; wheelchair escort service; assistive listening devices; ASL interpreters (concerts, 14-day notice); sensory room/nooks and KultureCity sensory kits; service animals permitted.
bagPolicyNotes: Bags must be clear plastic/vinyl/PVC not exceeding 12x6x12 in; one small clutch/purse/wallet up to 4.5x6.5x2 in also allowed; medical items exception subject to inspection; follows NFL All Clear policy. Bag check available at 3 locations (North in Lot B, West at 5455 Polaris Ave, East in Lot E) for $20 non-refundable per bag, cashless.

tailgating.rules: Approximately 6,000 tailgating spaces across multiple lots; check lot details before purchasing pass; tailgating only from end of vehicle to the red painted emergency line, not beyond or on walkways; excessive/underage alcohol and excessive amplified sound prohibited; lots under CCTV; Code of Conduct enforced.
tailgating.timeWindow: Parking lots open ~4 hours before kickoff; tailgating prohibited at the start, during, and after the event and must be broken down when the event begins; all lots cleared 1 hour after event ends; no overnight parking prior to gameday.
tailgating.grillRules: Charcoal-only waste bins provided throughout lots for charcoal disposal.
tailgating.rvPolicy: Oversized vehicles longer than 20 feet and trailers are not permitted; no overnight parking prior to gameday.

venueAccessRestrictions: No re-entry facility (stadium and parking lots); cashless venue (card/mobile payment only); all guests and belongings subject to security screening; smoke-free per Nevada Clean Indoor Air Act with designated smoking areas outside.
nearby: Adjacent to the Las Vegas Strip, directly west of I-15 between Russell Rd and Tropicana Ave; less than 3 miles from Harry Reid International Airport; walkable from Las Vegas Blvd via Hacienda Bridge (0.3-mi bridge, 10-15 min walk); near Mandalay Bay and Luxor resorts.
outsideFoodRules: All outside food and beverage prohibited; hard-sided bottles/cans/containers prohibited; empty soft-sided/collapsible water bottles permitted.
food: Silver & Black Hospitality concessions throughout; $2.99 gameday House Deals (hot dog, chips & cheese, soda, Frito Lays chips) at select stands; automated checkout-free markets; non-alcoholic beer available; mobile in-seat ordering in club sections during Raiders home games.

gatesOpen.ruleText: All gates open two (2) hours prior to kickoff.

tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Parking lots open ~4 hours before kickoff for Raiders games; tailgating ends at event start; lots cleared 1 hour after event.

name: Allianz Field

parkingLots.notes: Nearby lots reserved for Season Ticket Members with seats in Luxury Suites, the Field Club, or the Upper 90 Club
parkingLots.name: Reserved Matchday
Single-Game Lots
parkingLots.notes: Publicly available lots, each generally within a 5-10 minute walk of the stadium. Reserve on SeatGeek.com up to two hours before kickoff, or buy at the lot; lots generally open two and a half hours before kickoff. All transactions are cashless.

parkingLots.name: Easy-In Lots
parkingLots.notes: Publicly available lot that is generally easier to get in and out of on matchday; about a 15 minute walk. Reserve on SeatGeek.com up to two hours before kickoff, or buy at the lot; lots generally open two and a half hours before kickoff. All transactions are cashless.

parkingLots.name: Best Value Lots
parkingLots.notes: The most affordable publicly available lots; farthest from the stadium, about a 20 minute walk. Reserve on SeatGeek.com up to two hours before kickoff, or buy at the lot; lots generally open two and a half hours before kickoff. All transactions are cashless.

parkingLots.name: Cub Foods Lot
parkingLots.notes: Recommended for fans with accessibility needs

lines: Local Metro Transit bus routes along University and Snelling
publicTransit.notes: The Green Line Light Rail has a stop just outside the stadium. The A Line and local bus routes serve the University and Snelling corridors. A Metro Transit all-day pass is available. The City of Saint Paul also offers four downtown park-and-ride ramps (Smith, 7A, Lowertown, and Block 19) at a $5 matchday rate beginning two hours before kickoff, within walking distance of transit lines with direct routes to the stadium.

rideshareDropoff: Designated rideshare pick-up and drop-off point in the southeast corner of the stadium near the intersection of St Anthony and Pascal, serving Uber, Lyft, and taxis.
accessibility: The Allianz Field ADA drop-off is located on the east side of the stadium near Simpson Street and can be accessed from St. Anthony Avenue. Fans with accessibility needs are recommended to purchase a parking pass in the Cub Foods Lot. For assistance call 763.4SOCCER or email tickets@mnufc.com.
bagPolicyNotes: One clear bag up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches or a one-gallon clear freezer bag, plus a small clutch or purse up to 5 x 9 inches, with or without a strap. Diaper and medical bags are allowed at any size and are checked and tagged by security at entry. There is no bag check, so bags that are not allowed must go back to the car.
food: Allianz Field publishes a matchday food and beverage guide with concessions across the stadium. Delaware North is the exclusive food provider, with menus overseen by Executive Chef Adam Rietsma and his culinary team.

name: Alumni Stadium

parkingLots.name: Beacon St. Garage
parkingLots.notes: 7-foot clearance; on-campus football parking is for Flynn Fund donors; ADA-accessible parking on the 2nd level for season ticket holders with a state placard + BC permit (wait list); Gate F accessible via the top level; complimentary bag check for unapproved bags at the adjacent Fish Field House

parkingLots.name: Commonwealth Ave. Garage
parkingLots.notes: 6-foot clearance; guest services station at the base of the garage

parkingLots.name: Robsham Lot
parkingLots.notes: Eagle Walk passes through this lot; the team enters Alumni Stadium at Gate E

parkingLots.name: Shea Field
parkingLots.notes: Tailgating lot requiring a separate Shea Field Access Ticket in addition to the game ticket; enter/exit via Thomas More Road; no alcohol carried onto the field and no glass containers; closes at kickoff (pedestrian access suspended 30 minutes prior)

parkingLots.name: Upper Brighton Campus
parkingLots.notes: Flynn Fund tailgating lots; enter at the main entrance at 2121 Commonwealth Ave; game tickets required to enter the tailgating lots

parkingLots.name: Newton Campus
parkingLots.notes: Off-campus parking for season ticket members with a complimentary shuttle to main campus; arranged via the Ticket Office

parkingLots.name: 300 Hammond Pond Parkway
parkingLots.notes: Free ADA-accessible parking for non-season-ticket guests with a state ADA placard (no BC permit required); ADA shuttle to curbside outside Gate A; may reach capacity

parkingLots.name: Thomas More Apartments (2150 Comm Ave lot)
parkingLots.notes: Reserved lot; must park in the assigned spot designated on the parking pass; GPS 175 St. Thomas More Road, Chestnut Hill, MA 02467

publicTransit.notes: MBTA Green Line B (Boston College Station, 4-min walk), C (Cleveland Circle, 15-min walk) and D (Reservoir 15-min / Chestnut Hill 8-min walk) all stop within walking distance of Alumni Stadium. Riverside Station on the D line offers parking and access from the MetroWest region.

rideshareDropoff: Uber/Lyft rideshare and taxi pickup/drop-off zone is at Campion Gate off Beacon Street. Taxi stands are on Commonwealth Ave outside St. Thomas More Hall (eastbound) and across from St. Ignatius Church (westbound). Note: there is no general drop-off or pick-up area on campus.
accessibility: Accessible and companion seating available throughout; purchase/exchange via the Ticket Office at 617-552-GoBC. Season-ticket ADA parking on Beacon St. garage level 2 (state placard + BC permit, wait list). No single-game ADA parking on campus; free ADA parking with a state placard at 300 Hammond Pond Parkway with an ADA shuttle to curbside outside Gate A. Restrooms are fully ADA accessible with companion restrooms in the south end zone near the ADA seating; elevators serve the concourse levels (not the upper decks).
bagPolicyNotes: To expedite your entrance into the facility, we recommend not bringing bags into Alumni Stadium. Student Gold Pass holders are not permitted to bring any bags into Alumni Stadium. General guests may bring approved bags into the stadium but all bags will searched for prohibited items by stadium officials.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is permitted in designated Flynn Fund parking areas (Upper Brighton Campus, Shea Field, and Flynn Fund surface lots); game tickets are required to enter the tailgating lots. Shea Field requires a separate Shea Field Access Ticket; no alcohol may be carried onto Shea Field and no glass containers are allowed. Tailgating is prohibited in front of the Merkert Chemistry Building. Tailgating is not permitted while games are in progress; BCPD ends tailgating 30 minutes prior to kickoff and clears lots by kickoff. Temporary heat sources (e.g., propane heaters) are prohibited. Pop-up canopies are permitted; tents are not permitted anywhere on campus.
tailgating.timeWindow: Weekday games: parking lots open 3 hours before kickoff, no post-game tailgating. Weekend games: lots open 4 hours before kickoff; for games starting before 3 p.m. tailgating is permitted up to 1 hour after the game ends; for games starting at 3 p.m. or later there is no post-game tailgating.
tailgating.grillRules: Gas grills are permitted only in designated Flynn Fund surface-lot parking areas. Charcoal grills are prohibited on campus. No grilling or open flames are allowed in the parking garages.
tailgating.rvPolicy: RVs, campers, and limousines are not allowed on campus; Motor Home (RV) parking is prohibited on the BC campus and in all satellite parking lots.

venueAccessRestrictions: Re-entry is NOT permitted into Alumni Stadium or Conte Forum. All guests will pass through the Evolv weapons detection system upon entry into the stadium allowing for efficient fan security screening.
outsideFoodRules: No outside food and/or beverages are permitted inside Alumni Stadium; food and beverage are listed among the prohibited items.
food: Concession stands and carts throughout Alumni Stadium and Conte Forum; concessions partners include Kayem, Sal's Pizza, Frito Lay and Coca-Cola. Beer and wine are sold at designated locations (two-drink maximum per ID per transaction; IDs checked). All concession/merchandise locations are cashless (credit/debit only; reverse ATMs at sections A and O convert cash to prepaid cards). Food trucks (e.g., Jersey Mike's, Bertucci's, Anheuser-Busch) operate from when lots open through kickoff.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates to Alumni Stadium open 90 minutes prior to kickoff.

tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Weekday games: lots open 3 hours before kickoff, no post-game tailgating. Weekend games: lots open 4 hours before kickoff; games starting before 3 p.m. allow post-game tailgating up to 1 hour, games starting at 3 p.m. or later allow none.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Medically necessary bags/equipment too large for a clear bag are allowed with a letter of approval from facilities/operations (athoper@bc.edu); diaper bags are allowed if accompanied by a child.

name: American Airlines Center

parkingLots.name: Comerica Garage
parkingLots.notes: Located at 2503 Victory Ave. Opens 2-hours prior to any event starting. Only CC/Debit cards and pre-paid parking passes accepted.

parkingLots.name: Commons Garage
parkingLots.notes: Located at 2601 Victory Ave. Opens 2-hours prior to AAC events for credit card paying guests.

parkingLots.name: Lexus Garage
parkingLots.notes: Located at 2620 N. Houston St. (directly across from East Entrance). Clearance: 8'2". Opens at noon on event days.

parkingLots.name: D Garage
parkingLots.notes: 2400 Victory Ave (0.1 miles from South entrance). Clearance: 8'2".

parkingLots.name: Lot F
parkingLots.notes: 2721 North Houston Street (directly across from North entrance): ADA Parking Only. The F-Lot does not require a parking pass for entry; pay with a credit card upon arrival; first come, first serve; 105 spaces.

parkingLots.name: Lot K
parkingLots.notes: 2235 Victory Avenue (0.3 miles from NW Corner).

publicTransit.notes: DART's Green Line and Orange Line serve Victory Station at American Airlines Center seven days a week. Red and Blue Line riders transfer to a Green or Orange Line train at West End Station. Victory Station is also a regular stop on the Trinity Railway Express (TRE); there is no TRE service on Sundays.

rideshareDropoff: Located on the north side of the arena, with pick-up/drop-off often directed to Valor Place on the west side.
bagPolicyNotes: Wristlet, clutches or wallets allowed at all entrances. Purses no larger than 14''x14''x6'' will be allowed at designated X-ray entry points. No backpack or large totes allowed. Medical bags and parenting bags are permitted. All permitted bags are subject to search. 4.5” x 6.5” (wristlet, wallet, clutch) – permitted at all entrances.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Stars - Doors open to the public 90 minutes prior to puck drop.

name: American Family Field

parkingLots.name: Cooper Lot
parkingLots.notes: Motorcycle/scooter parking; General Parking rates apply. Two or more motorcycles/scooters may share one space; all must display a state-issued license.

parkingLots.name: American Family Lot
parkingLots.notes: Oversized vehicles may be directed here by parking staff.

parkingLots.name: Molitor Lot
parkingLots.notes: Rideshare Lot located on the south end; drop-off/pick-up accessed via Bluemound Road and Yount Drive.

parkingLots.name: Preferred Lots
parkingLots.notes: Advance rates $19 weekday / $21 weekend & all Cubs games.

parkingLots.name: General Lots
parkingLots.notes: Advance rates $14 weekday / $16 weekend & all Cubs games; accessible parking uses a general parking pass.

parkingLots.name: Bus/RV Lot
parkingLots.notes: For buses and RVs; advance rate $55 weekday / $70 weekend & Cubs games.

publicTransit.notes: Milwaukee County Transit System (MCTS) operates three bus routes within a 15-minute walk of American Family Field; bus fare is $2.75 per ride. Paratransit-eligible riders can schedule a Transit Plus van ride dropped off directly outside the stadium entrance.

rideshareDropoff: Uber and Lyft use the Rideshare Lot on the south end of the Molitor Lot, accessed via Bluemound Road and Yount Drive; fans reach it by exiting the Home Plate Gate and proceeding north to the Molitor Lot.
accessibility: Accessible parking requires only a general parking pass combined with a valid state-issued ADA permit; accessible spaces are first-come, first-served. Accessible drop-off is on the west side of the ballpark (southwest of the Home Plate Gate) at the 'Accessible Bus Drop-Off.' All restrooms are fully accessible; public elevators (left-field corner and Clock Tower), escalators, and wheelchair lifts serve all levels. Wheelchair transport, sensory bags/rooms (KultureCity partnership), captioning, and Guest Relations kiosks (Field Level near Section 116, Loge behind 221, Terrace behind 419) are available. Brewers Guest Relations: (414) 902-4900.
bagPolicyNotes: Single-compartment bag policy; multi-compartment bags are prohibited. Allowed: non-clear bags 9"x5"x2" or smaller, clear single-compartment bags 12"x12"x6" or smaller, and one-gallon clear resealable bags. One sealed non-alcoholic plastic bottle (32 oz or smaller) is permitted per person. Exceptions are made for diaper bags (max 16"x16"x8") and ADA/medically necessary items; all carry-in items are subject to inspection.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating activities must end 30 minutes after the game starts, at which point all fans must enter the ballpark or vacate the premises. Additional parking cannot be purchased for use as a tailgating space; custom tailgate grids are available through the Brewers Group Sales Department at (414) 902-4777. See brewers.com/Tailgating for full details.

venueAccessRestrictions: All carry-in items are subject to inspection during security screening; multi-compartment bags are prohibited under the single-compartment bag policy. See brewers.com/Security for permitted and prohibited items.
food: American Family Field is cashless at all concession stands, retail locations, and portable kiosks; accepted payments include credit/debit cards, Brewers Gift Cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and pre-paid cards. Concessions are operated by Delaware North.

name: America First Field

parkingLots.name: Jordan Commons
parkingLots.notes: New parking for RSL games; day-of sales $15 per car, card only. Follow the blue line to the stadium.

parkingLots.name: On-property stadium lots
parkingLots.notes: Require a parking permit; there is no gameday parking for sale available at the stadium.

parkingLots.name: West Lot
parkingLots.notes: Electric Vehicle parking available here on a first-come, first-served basis when lots open to guests.

publicTransit.notes: Take TRAX to Sandy Civic Center or Historic Sandy Station. A free shuttle also runs from a bus stop on Monroe Street adjacent to City Hall, with pick-up beginning two hours prior to event start and drop-off at the West curb at the stadium; shuttles run at least one hour post-event. Train schedules via rideuta.com.

rideshareDropoff: Rideshare drop-off and pick-up zone is located on the east shoulder of 145 West, stadium side. No loitering or parking is allowed.
accessibility: ADA parking is designated with signs, is first-come first-served and free of charge when parking lots open to guests; an ADA placard or license plate designation is required for access.
bagPolicyNotes: No bags or purses larger than 4 in x 6 in x 2 in are allowed inside the stadium, and bags do not have to be clear. Medical, cultural, and diaper bags (with child present) up to 14 in x 14 in x 6 in are permitted and subject to search.
venueAccessRestrictions: America First Field is private property and does not honor concealed weapons permits or off-duty carry.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food or beverages of any kind are prohibited, with the exception of water bottles up to 32 oz. Water bottles must be either factory-sealed or empty personal bottles, and personal water bottles must be proven empty upon entrance.
food: Concessions include local favorites such as J. Dawgs hot dogs, Sandy Co sandwiches and loaded mac n cheese, Santorini's Mediterranean, City Grill burgers, Little Caesars pizza, Chile Verde Mexican, Cup Bop Korean BBQ, R&R BBQ, and vegetarian/vegan options at Fresh Kicks. A Plaza food-truck area and multiple beer gardens are also available. Concession availability varies by event.

name: Amon G. Carter Stadium

parkingLots.name: Lot 1
parkingLots.notes: Tailgate dump station for coals/ashes available; shuttle load/unload for remote lots near Lots 1 and 2

parkingLots.name: Lot 3
parkingLots.notes: Tailgate dump station for coals/ashes available

parkingLots.name: Lot 5 Garage (LaDainian Tomlinson / LT Garage)
parkingLots.notes: Handicapped/ADA parking; reserved ADA parking available via season pre-purchase through the Frog Club

parkingLots.name: Lot 8
parkingLots.notes: Rideshare (Lyft/Uber) pick-up/drop-off adjacent at the corner of West Berry Street and Stadium Drive

rideshareDropoff: Car services (Lyft, Uber, etc.) are only allowed to pick up and drop off at the corner of West Berry Street and Stadium Drive, adjacent to Lot 8. Taxi cabs are only allowed to pick up and drop off at the corner of Stadium Drive and Bellaire Drive North.
accessibility: Handicapped/ADA parking is located in the Lot 5 Garage (LaDainian Tomlinson lot); reserved ADA parking available via season pre-purchase through the Frog Club. Accessible seating is located throughout the stadium (contact the ticket office). Guest services office near Section 102 provides assistive listening devices and golf-cart shuttles to adjacent lots. Elevators are on the north and south ends of the West concourse and on the East concourse by Gate 8; escalators near the middle of the West concourse. Family restrooms are on each level.
bagPolicyNotes: A small clutch purse approximately the size of a hand with or without a handle or strap. No larger than 4.5" x 6.5"

tailgating.rules: One parking pass, one parking spot. Tailgate behind your vehicle and keep tailgating items adjacent to the front or rear of your vehicle. No tailgating equipment or seating is permitted in parking lot driveways, roadways, pedestrian walkways, fire lanes, or University landscaped areas. The selling of alcohol or use of kegs is strictly prohibited (no kegs in parking lots; personal containers only, no glass). Secure all tailgate items, extinguish all flames, and unplug electrical outlets before entering the stadium. No display of advertising, banners, signs, commercially logoed vehicles, or distribution of promotional items. Drinking age in Texas is 21; TABC rules govern all alcohol usage; violations cited by FWPD or TCUPD.
tailgating.grillRules: Fire extinguishers (ABC) or a bucket of water MUST accompany any BBQ or pit. Extinguish all flames before entering the stadium. Dump stations are available in Lots 1 and 3 for coals and/or ashes.

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Smoking in all areas (TCU is now a tobacco-free campus), Throwing or kicking objects, Public Intoxication, Disorderly conduct, Abusive language toward coaches, student-athletes, officials or spectators, Fighting; standing/sitting in aisles, ramps/walkways, Outside food or drinks (except for one unopened bottle of water), Glass bottles or containers, Umbrellas, Outside Stadium Seat Cushions, Pets and Strollers, Video cameras, Bicycles, Laser pointers, Sticks, poles or similar objects that can be used as a weapon, Weapons of any kind including those carried with permit, Fireworks, Artificial noisemakers (air horns, thunderstix, musical instruments, cans filled with contents, or any other item used to make artificial noise), No kegs will be allowed in parking lots. Personal containers only, no glass please.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food or drinks are prohibited, except for one unopened plastic bottle of water per guest. Refillable water stations are located around the concourse.
food: Expanded concession options inside Amon G. Carter Stadium including local Fort Worth favorites. All concessions are cashless (major credit cards, Visa gift cards, and non-contact payment including Apple Pay and Google Pay; no cash accepted). Beer is sold at concessions beginning three hours before kickoff (starting in Frog Alley) and concludes at the start of the fourth quarter.

gatesOpen.ruleText: All gates open ninety (90) minutes prior to kickoff.

name: Angel Stadium

parkingLots.name: Angel Stadium parking lot (main lot)
parkingLots.notes: Three entrances: Douglass Road, State College Boulevard, and Orangewood Avenue. Opens two and a half hours prior to first pitch and closes one hour after the event. Regular-season day-of-game rates: $25 general in-person ($27 online), $35 preferred in-person ($37 online), $100 oversized vehicle/bus. Cashless; debit/credit and Apple/Android Pay accepted. Ticket is not valid for in/out parking; overnight parking prohibited.

parkingLots.name: Lexus Lot
parkingLots.notes: Located just west of the Home Plate Gate; reserved for Lexus vehicles, maximum capacity 100 on a first-come, first-served basis. Recommended entrance is State College Blvd.

parkingLots.name: Big A Lot
parkingLots.notes: The only lot in which tailgating is permitted.

parkingLots.name: Oversized vehicle/bus parking
parkingLots.notes: For vehicles greater than 20 feet in length; entrance located on Orangewood Avenue. Season ticket holders with prepaid parking should use the Express Entry Lane on Orangewood Avenue.

lines: ARTIC (Anaheim Regional Transportation Intermodal Center) - bus, train, taxi
publicTransit.notes: The Amtrak Pacific Surfliner train station is a short walk from Angel Stadium off South Douglass Road, with late-night and weekend service. ARTIC (2626 East Katella Avenue) is a bus/train/taxi hub adjacent to the Santa Ana River trail. The Orange County Transportation Authority runs bus service to the ballpark (714-636-RIDE).

rideshareDropoff: Pregame, rideshare/Uber drop-offs should enter through Gene Autry Way. Postgame, the rideshare pick-up zone is located in the parking lot near Gate 1 toward Left Field; look for the red rideshare light pole for reference.
accessibility: Accessible parking is available outside Gates 1-6 and the Home Plate Gate; cashiers and attendants direct fans with a valid state disability permit or plate to these areas. Wheelchair, semi-ambulatory, and companion accessible seating is available at all price levels throughout the ballpark. Two fan elevators (near Sections 134 and 101), five sets of access ramps, wheelchair escorts, service-animal access, and sensory/quiet rooms are available; see the Accessibility Guide.
bagPolicyNotes: Angel Stadium prohibits all bags and backpacks except, after inspection: purses or bags that are 12" x 12" with a single zipper closure/flap or smaller; clear plastic or vinyl bags with no obscured interior pockets not exceeding 12.75" x 6.5" x 12.75"; and medically necessary items, including diaper bags that accompany an infant. All other bags must be returned to the patron's vehicle; no backpacks.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is only permitted in the Big A Lot. Alcohol consumption in the parking lot is illegal (AMC 7.16.010). Outside catering is prohibited. Only approved gas/propane barbecue units with a fuel valve turn-off may be used (no charcoal). No vehicle may occupy more than one parking space.

venueAccessRestrictions: All guests are screened via metal detectors upon entry (MLB-mandated). Re-entry to Angel Stadium is not permitted. Entry is mobile-only via the MLB Ballpark app (screenshots are not accepted). Prohibited items include beach balls, drones, noisemakers and musical instruments (except team-issued Halo Sticks), walkie-talkies, aerosol spray sunscreen, and outside alcohol.
outsideFoodRules: Food must be contained in a clear plastic bag no larger than one gallon and in individual portions (not bulk quantities). Guests may bring one factory-sealed, clear plastic bottle of water or sports drink no larger than one liter; frozen water bottles are prohibited (may be allowed on warm days at the team's discretion). Outside food and beverage is prohibited in suites.
food: Angel Stadium offers a wide variety of food and beverage options with menus available in the MLB Ballpark app; premium dining includes the Lexus Diamond Club, the Don Julio Club, and Brewery X Restaurant.

gatesOpen.ruleText: All gates open 90 minutes prior to the scheduled first pitch; the only exception is 1pm starts, when gates open 60 minutes prior to first pitch. Gate times are subject to change without notice.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: For 1pm start times, gates open 60 minutes before first pitch instead of the usual 90. Gate times are subject to change without notice.
tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: The parking lot opens two and a half hours prior to first pitch and closes one hour after the event; tailgating is permitted only in the Big A Lot.

rideshareDropoff: Uber and Lyft drop-off/pick-up at the Missouri Welcome Center between Gates 1 and 2 on Blue Ridge Cutoff (4010 Blue Ridge Cutoff); follow the marked/paved path to the stadium
accessibility: Mobility carts transport guests to stadium gates, available 3 hours pre-event to 1.5 hours post-event (call 816-920-4237 pregame; postgame pickups outside all four spiral gates)
bagPolicyNotes: Permitted: clear bag/backpack no larger than 12x6x12 or one-gallon clear zip-seal bag, plus one small non-clear clutch up to 4.5x6.5 in; medically necessary items allowed after inspection

tailgating.rules: Permitted in all parking lots; total tailgate (including guests) limited to 8 ft behind each parking space; keep emergency vehicle lanes clear; parking spaces may not be used for tailgate equipment alone; no commercial setups; selling items prohibited
tailgating.timeWindow: No tailgating in the parking lots during the game
tailgating.grillRules: Only charcoal or LP gas grills; no wood or wood-burning fire pits; grills must be supervised by an adult 18+ and fully extinguished; dispose coals in designated hot-coal bins; glass prohibited in lots
tailgating.rvPolicy: Class A & C (25 ft or longer), buses and RVs require a Bus/RV pass and park at Dubiner Circle behind Kauffman Stadium first-come, first-served; vehicles longer than 40 ft not permitted in the Truman Sports Complex

venueAccessRestrictions: Access to the Truman Sports Complex is for ticketed event guests only; the club reserves the right to confirm guests have valid tickets at any time

parkingLots.notes: Bus parking and rideshare pickup location

rideshareDropoff: Rideshare pickup/dropoff in Lot 15; taxis staged at far west end of Miller Lite House off N Collins St & Cowboys Way
accessibility: Accessibility shuttles from all Cowboys lots to stadium (tents near Entries A, D, J, G); accessible parking spaces in all lots (state placard/plate required); two drop-off zones (Lot 1 north/Randol Mill Rd, Lot 6 south/Cowboys Way); wheelchair & companion seating on all levels; sensory rooms; mobile captioning & assistive listening devices; Guest Services (817) 892-4161
bagPolicyNotes: Approved: clear plastic/vinyl/PVC tote not exceeding 12x6x12 in; one-gallon clear resealable bag; small clutch no larger than 4.5x6.5 in. Prohibited: backpacks, purses larger than a small clutch, coolers, fanny packs, camera bags, seat cushions. Exception for medically necessary items after inspection at a designated gate

tailgating.rules: Permitted only in designated grass perimeter spaces (first come, first served) in Lots 4,5,6,7,10,11,12,13,14,15; each vehicle needs a valid parking permit; max tailgate area 9 ft wide x 12 ft deep, within 12 ft of rear of vehicle. Not permitted in Lot 3, portions of Lot 5, Lot 8, Lot 9. No saving spaces; no sale/advertising of products; no amplified sound at loud levels
tailgating.timeWindow: From lot opening until 2 hours after the game
tailgating.grillRules: Charcoal or gas cooking permitted; no open flames, no deep fryers or oil-based cooking; dispose of coals in designated coal containers only
tailgating.rvPolicy: RV/oversized parking in Silver Lot 14, $150; arrive as early as 8:00 AM day before, depart by 5:00 PM day after; overnight allowed most events; no electric/water hookups (dump station on site); spaces 20x40 ft; generators allowed within RV space; tailgating confined to RV occupant's space

venueAccessRestrictions: Cashless venue (major credit/debit and mobile pay only). Re-entry permitted for some events via a designated exit gate with ticket scanned out and a repeat security search; no re-entry if ticket not scanned out. 10 guest entrances (Entries E, F, K club & suite only)
nearby: Adjacent to the Texas Rangers ballpark; nearly 12,000 additional parking spaces in lettered lots around the ballpark usable on event days
outsideFoodRules: Outside food items prohibited; bottles, cans and beverage containers of any kind prohibited. Exceptions for medical requirements/special needs (e.g., diaper bags)
food: Concessionaire is Legends Global; all concessions cashless (major credit/debit and mobile pay). Two-alcoholic-beverage limit per transaction; alcohol sales end at start of the 4th quarter. Visa in-seat delivery available

gatesOpen.ruleText: Parking lots open ~4 hrs before kickoff, plazas/Miller Lite House ~3 hrs, stadium entrances ~2 hrs (e.g., noon kick: lots 8AM, plaza 9AM, entrances 10AM); concourses, clubs & suites open at least 2 hrs prior to kickoff

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Stadium opening times may be adjusted on an event-by-event basis
tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: From lot opening until 2 hours following Dallas Cowboys (and college football) games

name: Audi Field

parkingLots.name: GEICO Garage at Nationals Park
parkingLots.notes: Audi Field and D.C. United do not own or operate any parking lots; the GEICO Garage at Nationals Park is opened on a game-by-game basis for Audi Field events. Priced at $60, credit card only (no cash), no pre-sales. Opens to fans 2.5 hours before kickoff and closes 2.5 hours after the match ends. No overnight parking, no oversized vehicles, must be below 7ft 8in clearance, no storage in spots, and no tailgating.

rideshareDropoff: Due to high traffic around Audi Field on match days, rideshare arrivals are directed to arrive near Nationals Park before a match, and to head back toward Nationals Park before hailing a ride afterward. To reach the Rideshare Pickup Zone on Potomac Avenue, exit via Gate A and head right on Potomac Avenue toward Nationals Park. No pick-ups are allowed on South Capitol Street.
accessibility: Accessible seating is available throughout the stadium; purchase via ticketmaster.com using the accessibility filter, email ticketing@dcunited.com, or visit the Box Office on matchday. The Guest Services Booth is inside Gate A. All gates are ADA accessible (access Gate C via the ramp on R St. SW near the Club Shop). Two elevators at the premium lobby serve the east stands and premium areas; an elevator in the Heineken MVP Club serves suites 27-31 and the rooftop bar. All restrooms are handicap accessible; family restrooms at sections 102, 114, 123, and 131. Service animals are welcome. Wheelchair escort service is provided by the Guest Experience team. A free ADA courtesy shuttle runs from the south side of 55 M Street SE beginning two hours before the match and one hour after; post-match drop-off/pickup is at Potomac and R St. outside the Club Shop.
bagPolicyNotes: Fans are strongly encouraged not to bring bags; dedicated no-bag and bag lanes are set up at each gate. No bags larger than 14 by 14 by 6 inches. No backpacks are allowed, but cinch/drawstring bags and clear bags that fit the size restriction are permitted. Coolers, luggage, large purses, and other oversized bags are prohibited. Binbox lockers are available outside the gates to store non-compliant bags. Diapers and wipes can be carried in any compliant bag, but large diaper bags are not permitted. One-piece foam seat cushions with no cover are allowed if not exceeding 16 inches wide and without armrests or metal backs; blankets are permitted.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is prohibited at the GEICO Garage at Nationals Park (the game-by-game parking option for Audi Field events). No general tailgating is provided; Audi Field and D.C. United do not own or operate any parking lots.
tailgating.rvPolicy: No oversized vehicles and no overnight parking at the GEICO Garage.

venueAccessRestrictions: No re-entry: guests may not exit and re-enter the stadium at any time. Audi Field is a smoke-free venue; smoking (including e-cigarettes and vape devices) is prohibited in every area, including surrounding sidewalks and plaza spaces. All persons entering are searched and must pass through metal detection; guests declining a search are denied access.
nearby: Audi Field is located at 100 Potomac Ave SW, Washington, D.C. 20024, near Nationals Park. The Navy Yard area along the walk from the Navy Yard-Ballpark Metrorail station has restaurants and sidewalk space.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverage is prohibited at Audi Field. Certain medical exceptions and exceptions for children and infants are made on a case-by-case basis with prior approval from Audi Field management (contact guestexperience@dcunited.com). During a declared Heat Advisory, one sealed bottle of water per person, up to 20 oz, is allowed; water fountains are available for refills.
food: Levy Restaurants operates all Audi Field concessions throughout the stadium, serving a variety of food and beverage including specialty items inspired by ThinkFoodGroup, Chef Jose Andres, and the Restaurant Association of Metropolitan Washington (RAMW). Audi Field is a cashless venue.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates open 90 minutes prior to kickoff for all D.C. United home matches unless otherwise announced by D.C. United.

tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Diapers and wipes may be carried in any compliant bag, but large diaper bags are not permitted. Guests with medically necessary items that will not fit a 14 by 14 by 6 inch bag may use a separate entrance for screening; contact guest services (guestexperience@dcunited.com) in advance.

parkingLots.notes: Entry 5. Autzen Complex lot; all spaces are reserved and a parking pass is required for entry.

publicTransit.notes: The Autzen Express park-and-ride shuttles run to Autzen Stadium from four park-and-ride locations, listed on the page for 2025 as Valley River Center (Northwest parking lot), Lane Events Center (North parking lot), Pacific Source (555 International Way, Springfield) and Springfield Station (355 South A Street, Springfield), starting 3 hours before game time with buses every 10 to 20 minutes. Return trips run only at halftime and immediately after the game, continuing for 60 minutes after the game ends. Passes are $8 per person for the 2026 season when bought early or $12 on game day, sold online only; LTD Honored Rider passes are accepted for riders 65 and older, and cash is not accepted. Lane Transit District (LTD) is not running an Autzen shuttle this season, but fans can ride LTD to the University of Oregon campus and walk to the stadium.

accessibility: Accessible parking is available through Entry 5 off Leo Harris Parkway for $40, first come first served, and requires a DMV-issued placard and proof of placard ownership; once the Autzen ADA lot is full, the ADA-compliant shuttle system is the next option. Accessible seating for wheelchair users and a guest can be arranged through the Oregon Athletic Ticket Office at 1-800-WEBFOOT or at the ticket office in the Casanova Center. A tram carries disabled and senior patrons from the lower concourse into the stadium and runs 30 minutes to 1 hour after the game, an elevator inside the South Gate connects the lower and main concourses, and alternative listening devices can be checked out from Guest Services. For accommodation questions call the Duck Ticket Office at (541) 346-4461 or TTY (541) 346-5418.
bagPolicyNotes: Venue-wide University of Oregon Athletics clear bag policy applying to all athletic venues including football. Each ticketed guest may bring one clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bag not exceeding 12x6x12 inches OR one one-gallon clear resealable plastic storage bag, plus one small clutch up to 4.5x6.5 inches. Diaper bags are not exempt; diaper/baby supplies must be carried in an approved clear bag. Medically necessary items are permitted after additional screening. Prohibited bags include purses, backpacks, diaper bags, binocular/camera cases, solid fanny packs, luggage, zippered seat cushions, and any non-clear bag.

tailgating.rvPolicy: RV parking in the Autzen Stadium lot is available only with a reserved parking pass; there is no individual game parking in the Autzen lot. RV spaces are 18 by 40, and all tailgating must stay within that space.
tailgating.timeWindow: Lots open 6 hours before kickoff but never before 7:00 AM, and a reserved parking pass is required for entry.
tailgating.rules: All tailgating must stay within the dimensions of your reserved parking space: car spaces are 9 by 20 feet and RV spaces are 18 by 40 feet. Reserved car and RV parking is sold only as a season pass allocated by donor priority points, and a reserved parking pass is required to enter the lots.

venueAccessRestrictions: Re-entry is not permitted once you leave the stadium, and all tickets are mobile through the GoDucks gameday app. Outside alcohol is not permitted, open umbrellas are banned in seating and aisle areas, and glass or metal containers, vacuum bottles and other thermos-type insulated containers, open plastic beverage containers unless empty, weapons, fireworks, laser pointers, explosives and munitions are not allowed inside; ticket holders agree to inspection of any article that could conceal prohibited items. Seat cushions may be no larger than 17.5 inches wide by 13.5 inches deep with a seat back no taller than 19 inches and no thicker than 4 inches. Smoking is not permitted in or around Autzen Stadium, throwing footballs, frisbees or other objects is not allowed in seating, tunnel or ramp areas, and students with Student Section tickets enter through the South Gate.
nearby: Autzen Stadium sits on a 90-acre site next to the north bank area of Alton Baker Park, north of the Willamette River and about a quarter mile north of the main University of Oregon campus, which is reached on foot by the Autzen footbridge. The Moshofsky Center opens three hours before kickoff to anyone with a ticket to that day's game, with concessions, beer, wine, inflatables and yard games, and the team's March to Victory passes through it two hours and twenty minutes before kickoff. Secured bicycle parking at the Duck Pen, between the Science Factory and the Autzen Footbridge, costs $5 per bicycle and opens three hours before kickoff, closing one hour after the game.
outsideFoodRules: Single-serving outside food is on the approved items list; factory-sealed plastic water bottles, empty plastic water bottles, unopened soft-sided juice boxes, baby bottles, and medical liquids are also permitted.
food: Concession stands operate throughout Autzen Stadium, and beer and wine are sold at concession stands until the end of the third quarter; alcohol is not permitted in student seating areas. A concessions map is linked from the 2026 game day page.
