rideshareDropoff: Rideshare, taxi and limo pick-up and drop-off is available at the Ball Arena Rideshare lot, at the intersection entrance of 5th and Walnut Streets in the 4Runner West parking lot only.
bagPolicyNotes: Bags, purses, backpacks, briefcases, and luggage are prohibited. Clutches, wristlets & fanny packs 4in x 6in x 1.5in are permitted. Medical and diaper bags 14in x 14in x 6in or smaller are permitted; all guests entering with medical or diaper bags are subject to x-ray screening upon entry.

name: Bank of America Stadium
accessibility: ADA-accessible venue; no reserved handicap parking; game-day accessible shuttle for Panthers games only ($40/vehicle, boards at 720 E. Morehead St, begins ~2 hrs before kickoff); disability drop-off at corner of Mint & Morehead Sts; elevators at North, East, and South gates; ADA ramps outside each gate; wheelchair service and Guest Relations booths on 100/300/500 levels; all restrooms ADA-accessible; certified leashed service animals permitted; ADA wheelchair seating sections 105/118/125/138 (lower) and 522/525/531/534 (upper); ticket office 704-358-7800.
bagPolicyNotes: Clear plastic/vinyl/PVC bags no larger than 12"x6"x12" permitted after inspection; non-transparent purses/bags/clutches/fanny packs allowed only if no larger than 4.5"x6.5"; backpacks, coolers, and non-clear bags prohibited; medical/diabetic supply containers allowed with security approval.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverages prohibited except two (2) sealed plastic non-flavored water bottles per person; approved diabetic/medical special-food containers allowed with prior security approval.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Public Entry Time: 6:00 p.m. on matchday (stated on the Matchday Early Entry page). Season Ticket Members get early stadium access at 5:30 p.m. No minutes-before-kickoff figure is stated; the times are given as fixed clock times.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Season Ticket Members receive early stadium access on matchday: STM Entry Time 5:30 p.m. versus Public Entry Time 6:00 p.m.

name: Barclays Center
rideshareDropoff: Two designated Drop Off / Pick Up zones are located along Atlantic Avenue outside the VIP Entrance and the Atlantic Entrance, plus one additional zone along Flatbush Avenue outside the Main Entrance. The Atlantic Entrance is designated the Lyft Atlantic Entrance.
accessibility: Wheelchair assistance is available from the entries to seating sections on a first-come, first-serve basis. Assisted listening devices (Listen ALD system) are available free with valid ID at the Main Concourse Guest Services Center. All gender restrooms and baby changing tables are on every level. The Greyson Mathews Sensory Room is outside Section 17 on the Main Concourse. Captioning services and American Sign Language interpretation are available for select events with advance request. An Access-A-Ride bus stop is on Atlantic Avenue between Fort Greene Avenue and 6th Avenue, nearest the Qatar Airways VIP Entrance. All suites are wheelchair accessible. See the Disabled Services A-Z Guide for full details.
bagPolicyNotes: Any bags larger than 10 x 6 x 2 inches, or that are hard-sided, are not permitted inside Barclays Center. Guests are encouraged to travel light and leave bags at home; guests without bags can use Express Lanes for faster entry. Special consideration is made for guests with medical needs and those caring for infants. Baby bags, plastic bottles, and formula are permitted. No bag check service is offered. All bags are subject to thorough x-ray screening where available.
venueAccessRestrictions: Barclays Center has a No Re-Entry policy for all events. It is a non-smoking venue and property, and electronic smoking devices are also prohibited inside. All guests are subject to security screening, visual inspection, and bag inspection on entry.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverages are not permitted into Barclays Center. Exceptions are made for guests with medical requirements and special needs: medically required beverages, liquid prescription medication, or small amounts of sealed food required to take medication are allowed. Glass bottles and metal canisters are strictly prohibited. Guests with special dietary needs should contact Guest Services in advance at 917-618-6111 or guestservices@barclayscenter.com.
food: Barclays Center's exclusive concessionaire is Levy Restaurants. Many concession locations are cashless; guests can convert cash to a prepaid debit card free of charge at Ready Credit Cash-to-Card Kiosks. Gluten-free and kosher options are available. In-seat beverage service is available in Sections 7-9 and 23-25 (Rows 1-10) via QR codes.

gatesOpen.ruleText: For Brooklyn Nets games, doors open 90 minutes prior to the scheduled start time. Fans dining in Crown Club may enter two hours before tip-off.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Crown Club diners may enter two hours before tip-off.

gatesOpen.ruleText: For New York Liberty games, doors open 90 minutes prior to the scheduled start time. Fans dining in Crown Club may enter two hours before tip-off.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Crown Club diners may enter two hours before tip-off.

name: BC Place

parkingLots.name: Impark Lot 457
parkingLots.notes: Adjacent lot; all paid and unpaid guests requiring accessible parking should proceed here. It is at Gate C on Griffiths Way (Bike Valet location per the security-policy page).

publicTransit.notes: The stadium is in the heart of downtown Vancouver, directly next to Rogers Arena. Fans can reach it by SkyTrain, bus, SeaBus or West Coast Express train.

accessibility: All entrances except Gates F and G are fully accessible. A dedicated accessible drop-off and pick-up is located at section 147, reachable from street level on Pacific Boulevard (there is no parking at the drop-off). All concessions, seating levels and washrooms are accessible, and family and universal washrooms are on each concourse. Accessible seating platforms are integrated throughout the seating bowl, with one attendant ticket available per accessible ticket. Accessible parking is available at nearby lots serviced by Targetpark, EasyPark, Impark and Westpark; all guests requiring accessible parking should proceed to Impark Lot 457, the adjacent lot. BC Place provides a limited number of wheelchairs for guest use; contact BC Place at 604-661-3434 or guestservices@bcplace.com in advance.
bagPolicyNotes: For ease of entry, fans are encouraged not to bring a bag. Permitted bags must be clear plastic and smaller than 12in x 12in x 6in, or one small opaque bag no larger than 6.5in x 8.5in. Exceptions are made for diaper bags and medically necessary items that do not fit into a clear bag. Coolers are prohibited. Any bag that does not meet the requirements will be turned away at the gate. All permitted bags are inspected before entry. Bags that do not meet the guidelines can be checked at Gate C or Gate H on a first come, first served basis for a $10 charge; space is limited. Bicycles can be stored at the Bike Valet at Gate C.
venueAccessRestrictions: Re-entry is not permitted. All guests entering BC Place are subject to a mandatory screening procedure using hand-held (and walk-through) metal detectors, with bags inspected on arrival; secondary screening may include a pat down. BC Place is a cashless venue and a non-smoking facility.
nearby: BC Place is in the heart of downtown Vancouver, directly next to Rogers Arena, home of the Vancouver Canucks.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food or drink is not permitted into the stadium. Special considerations are made for infants (bottles and unopened baby food) and for medical reasons. Bottles or containers with capacity greater than 1 litre are not permitted, and glass bottles of any size are prohibited. Empty personal water bottles up to 1 litre (with or without lids) are permitted subject to inspection and can be filled at drinking fountains on the main concourse.
food: BC Place is a cashless venue; concessions accept mobile, debit and major credit cards, Google Pay and Apple Pay, and a Cash to Card kiosk is located at section 235. Sodexo Live is the food service provider, offering concession stands, lounges and suites. Club Seat guests can access two Club Lounges with items such as sushi, garden salads, hotdogs, and charcuterie and cheese plates.

name: Beaver Stadium

parkingLots.name: North Zone (Blue)
parkingLots.notes: Enter via Fox Hollow Road when the one-way traffic pattern is in effect

parkingLots.name: South Zone (Purple)
parkingLots.notes: Enter via Porter Road

parkingLots.name: East Zone (Orange)
parkingLots.notes: Enter via Park Ave from I-99

parkingLots.name: West Zone (Green)
parkingLots.notes: Enter via Park Ave from Atherton St.

parkingLots.name: Lot 25
parkingLots.notes: Day-of-game parking sales location (credit card); also single-game advance purchase

parkingLots.name: Lot 36
parkingLots.notes: Day-of-game parking sales location (credit card)

parkingLots.name: East Deck
parkingLots.notes: Single-game / day-of-game ADA parking; tailgating is prohibited in the East Deck

parkingLots.name: Overnight RV Lot (ORV)
parkingLots.notes: Overnight RV parking along Orchard Road

publicTransit.notes: Public transportation drop-off and pick-up zone is located at Pegula Ice Arena (off University Drive) or the North Transit Station (corner of Park Ave. and Fox Hollow Rd.).

rideshareDropoff: Rideshare drop-off and pick-up zone is located at Pegula Ice Arena (off University Drive) or the North Transit Station (corner of Park Ave. and Fox Hollow Rd.).
accessibility: ADA entrances at the Club/Letterman entrance (next to Gate A) and the All-Sports Museum entrance (near Gate B). Gate A has two elevators to the mid-level concourse, Mt. Nittany Club and South upper deck; Gate B has an accessible ramp and an escalator (pregame only). ADA shuttle service runs from designated ADA lots (Shields, Wagner, IM Building, Nittany Lion Softball Park) beginning 2.5 hours before kickoff (Katz 4 hours, East Deck 2 hours), dropping off on Curtin Road by Gate B. In-stadium transportation is available from Customer Assistance near Gate B starting 2 hours before kickoff (postgame requests must be made before kickoff). Accessible restrooms are located throughout; the stadium is certified Sensory Inclusive (Francis Family Sensory Room behind section SF). ADA parking is accessible via Atherton Street only. Purchase ADA passes in advance at 1-800-NITTANY.
bagPolicyNotes: Beaver Stadium permits a small clutch or wristlet, and guests with medical, dietary or childcare needs may bring one bag if arranged in advance through Penn State Athletics Game Operations or Emergency Management. Confirm the clutch and wristlet size limits with the venue before you travel.

tailgating.rules: Vehicle and ALL tailgate activities must fit within the 8.5' x 15' parking space provided. Tents/canopies over a vehicle tailgate are limited to 10' x 10' and may not occupy other spaces or travel lanes or be used to save spaces. A defined 'Emergency Access' lane must be maintained in the center of each aisle (no chairs, tables, canopies within it). No setup before the posted lot opening time; overnight parking is prohibited except in designated overnight lots. One parking pass per car — saving parking places is prohibited. Prohibited in the lots: consumption of alcohol while the game is in progress, kegs, glass bottles/containers in grass lots, amplified sound, and littering/dumping.
tailgating.timeWindow: Lots open on game day at 7 a.m. for noon kick times and 8 a.m. for all non-noon kick times; no tailgate setup is allowed before the posted lot opening time. Overnight (ORV) lots must be vacated by noon on Sunday after home games.
tailgating.grillRules: Charcoal or wood fires of any type are prohibited. Portable heaters with visible flames (open-flame heaters, fireplaces, fire pits) and tow-behind grills/smokers are prohibited in the parking areas.
tailgating.rvPolicy: Overnight RV parking is in the ORV Lot along Orchard Road. ORV operating hours: Thursdays before home games 6 p.m.–midnight; Fridays 6 a.m.–midnight; Saturday game days either 7 a.m. (noon games) or 8 a.m. (all other times); Sundays after home games must leave all lots by noon. Oversized vehicles must unhitch trailers to remain within the space.

nearby: Beaver Stadium Block Party on Curtin Road between University Drive and Porter Road each home game — live music, food trucks and free family activities (includes the Kids Zone). Team Arrival walk and pep rally starts 2 hours before kickoff at the Block Party, with the team dropped at the Curtin Road & Porter Road intersection and led to the South Tunnel by the Blue Band.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverages are not permitted inside West Shore Home Field at Beaver Stadium; food, containers (cans/bottles/coolers/flasks) and water bottles (opened or unopened) are on the prohibited-items list.
food: Concessions are available throughout the stadium (highlights include Caliente Pizza near sections EC & ED, Chickie & Pete's near EJ & NL, Panini's near EJ, Philly Pretzel Factory above Gate B, Scott's Roasting near NH, We Are Inn near NC, and Wing Kitchen near WF & WG). Alcohol is sold inside — maximum two alcoholic beverages per person at one time, ID required, sales end at the end of the third quarter. Most concessions, the ticket office and merchandise stands are cashless.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Public gates open 2 hours prior to kickoff and re-entry is not permitted.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Premium gates (Suites Entrance, Club/Letterman Entrance, Museum Entrance) open 3 hours prior to kickoff.
tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Lots open on game day at 7 a.m. for noon kicks and 8 a.m. for all other kick times; overnight (ORV) lots must be vacated by noon Sunday. No setup before the posted lot opening time.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Guests with medical, dietary or childcare needs may bring one bag if arranged in advance through Penn State Athletics Game Operations or Emergency Management, entering through the Gate B Police Station or the ADA gates at the Club/Letterman (near Gate A) and All-Sports Museum (near Gate B) entrances.

name: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium

parkingLots.name: Parking Lot 114
parkingLots.notes: Referenced as a Ben Hill Griffin Stadium football game-day parking lot near a parking garage (per a football-tailgate itinerary)

accessibility: Accessible restrooms located throughout the stadium; two accessible elevators reserved for guests with disabilities/mobility challenges (one in the North End Zone between Gates 7 & 8, one between Gates 1 & 18 in the SW corner); ADA Wheelchair Seating Level (WSL) entrance near Gate 3 on the west side; ADA service requests to info@gators.ufl.edu.
bagPolicyNotes: Small clutch bags no larger than 4.5"x6.5", approximately the size of a hand, with or without a handle or strap

tailgating.rules: May tailgate within your own space (in front of or behind your vehicle) or in any open grass area of a non-reserved lot; in reserved lots the adjacent grass is reserved for that assigned vehicle. Do not block roads/walkways; music must stay confined to your tailgate area; tents may not be used within a parking spot; golf carts, mopeds and scooters are not allowed in parking lots or surrounding streets on game day.

venueAccessRestrictions: Fans are not permitted to leave and re-enter Ben Hill Griffin Stadium once their game ticket has been scanned.
outsideFoodRules: No outside food or drink is permitted. Fans may bring one empty commercially branded (e.g., Aquafina) plastic water bottle no larger than 20 oz; water bottle filling stations are available inside.
food: Concessions provided by Sodexo Live!, located throughout the stadium; food and beverage sales are fully cashless (credit/debit/touchless mobile pay only). Cash can be converted to prepaid gift cards at Grab N' Go locations.

name: Bill Snyder Family Football Stadium

parkingLots.name: West Stadium Lot
parkingLots.notes: Reserved for Ahearn Fund members; requires a permit displayed at all times. Lots open five hours prior to kickoff.

parkingLots.name: East Stadium Lot
parkingLots.notes: Reserved for Ahearn Fund members; requires a permit displayed at all times. Lots open five hours prior to kickoff.

rideshareDropoff: Designated rideshare pickup/dropoff zones (Uber, Lyft, taxis, limos) along College and Kimball Avenues. Pregame dropoff at the College Ave. area outside Tointon Family Stadium (best serves the west side) and at the Kimball Ave. location outside the Vanier Football Complex on the north side (serves both east and west sides). Postgame pickups resume once exiting traffic clears, generally 45 minutes to 1 hour after the game.
accessibility: Accessible seating located in numerous sections (1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 13, 15, 17, 20, 22, 26, 28, 29, 420-430) and the North End Zone. Fans needing ADA or special accommodations on game day may request a ticket exchange at East Fan Accommodations beginning 2 hours prior to kickoff; guests seated in Sections 420-430 obtain an east elevator pass at East Fan Accommodations. Captioning is provided on the digital board atop the Vanier Football Complex and assisted listening devices are available at West Fan Accommodations.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is a traditional part of K-State game day. Guests must arrive together to park and tailgate together; saving stalls (including in VIP areas) is prohibited. Tailgates with excessive attendees interfering with adjacent tailgates may be asked to shut down. No objects (vehicles, canopies, tables, chairs, grills, etc.) may encroach on the Emergency Access Lane. Portable generators limited to quiet or soundproofed units; sound-system volume must not disturb neighboring tailgates. Long-toss ball/Frisbee games prohibited. Pop-up canopies may be erected immediately in front of or behind a vehicle in a reserved stall but may not be anchored into asphalt or to walls/barricades and should be taken down in windy conditions. Alcohol is for personal consumption only, from cups or cans (no glass), containers no larger than one gallon. Personal portable porta-potties are prohibited.
tailgating.grillRules: Open wood fires and campfires are prohibited. After use, coals should be extinguished and disposed of in the red "Hot Coals" barrels.
tailgating.rvPolicy: Overnight parking is restricted to reserved RV parking with a purchased overnight pass.

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited items include, but are not limited to: non-clear (including tinted) bags such as backpacks, briefcases, camera bags, cinch bags, computer bags, diaper bags, tote bags, luggage and coolers. Non-clear purses and non-clear fanny packs larger than a clutch, as well as non-approved seat cushions and chairbacks are also prohibited. Security screening required to comply with Kansas state law; fans are encouraged to enter the stadium as early as possible.
outsideFoodRules: No outside food may be brought into the stadium; concessions open when gates open two hours prior to kickoff. Guests may bring in one unopened or empty clear plastic commercial bottle of water, flavored water or sports drink no larger than 1 liter; frozen bottles are prohibited. Plastic baby bottles are permitted if the infant is with the guest, subject to inspection.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates open two (2) hours prior to kickoff.

name: BMO Field

parkingLots.name: Surface (Red P)
parkingLots.notes: Surface parking. Base $15.00; prices vary from $12 to $30 depending on other events. Toronto FC game day rate $30.00, Argonauts game day rate $25.00 (subject to change).

parkingLots.name: Underground (Yellow P)
parkingLots.notes: Underground garage. Base $15.00; prices vary from $12 to $30. Rates increase $3 on peak usage days; higher rates may apply for events and concerts. Toronto FC game day rate $30.00, Argonauts game day rate $25.00. Parking Services 416-263-3646.

parkingLots.name: Lot 852
parkingLots.notes: South of BMO Field. Green P Parking App exclusive area; no cash or credit card payment options. Download the Green P Parking App and set up an account in advance.

parkingLots.name: Lot 856
parkingLots.notes: West of BMO Field along British Columbia Road. Reduced parking rate available.

parkingLots.name: Exhibition Place Lot 2
parkingLots.notes: Accessible parking, located just south of Gate 3. For accessible parking information contact Exhibition Place Parking at 416-263-3646. (Detail sourced from the accessibility page, not the parking page.)

parkingLots.name: Lots 1, 2, 3 and 4 and indoor garage
parkingLots.notes: Contain 14 hybrid electric/gasoline vehicle spaces (Lots 1-4 and garage) and 5 parent-and-child spaces (garage, Lots 1 and 3), near accessible spaces. Regular parking rates apply. All Exhibition Place lots accept credit card, debit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay and Green P Parking App; there are no cash options.

rideshareDropoff: Fans being picked up or dropped off by private vehicle (or Wheel-Trans) may do so at Gate 1 near the Ticket Office, or at Gate 3 just off Princes' Blvd on the south side of the building. Note that for many events, access to these areas or sections of the Exhibition Place grounds may be closed to vehicular traffic.
accessibility: BMO Field offers barrier-free accessible seating sections marked with an 'A' after the section number (e.g. 105A); sections 124A, 321A and 325A enter through Gate 5. Accessible seats can be purchased through Ticketmaster (1-855-985-4625 for Toronto FC). Accessible parking is in Exhibition Place Lot 2 just south of Gate 3. BMO Field has six elevators (west side of North Plaza and south concourse, inside Gate 5 for Media Tribune/Rogers VIP Club/Suites/300 Level, plus three on the east side at Gate 2 and the southeast corner). Family washrooms are near sections 109, 116, 206, 210, 223 and 226. Service animals are welcome (seated in an accessible section). Oxygen tanks are permitted. A mobility shuttle operates from when gates open until 10 minutes after kick-off and for 30 minutes after the event, picking up at the southwest corner of Manitoba Drive and Nova Scotia Ave every 15 minutes. Sensory bags and a quiet room (Fan Services Trailer inside Gate 3) are available; wheelchair escorts can be arranged. Contact Fan Services at 416-815-5982 or Fanservices@mlse.com.
bagPolicyNotes: MLSE Restricted Bag Policy (effective July 2021). MLSE strongly encourages fans not to bring bags, but the following are permitted: clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags not exceeding 30.5cm x 16cm x 30.5cm (12 x 6 x 12 inches) with no buckles, grommets/hardware or decor concealing any part; a 3.8L (1 gallon) clear plastic freezer bag; or a small clutch bag smaller than 16.5cm x 11.5cm (6.5 x 4.5 inches), with or without a handle or strap. Bags not meeting the criteria will not be permitted entry. Bags required for medical or other reasons are permitted subject to contacting MLSE for security inspection. A limited bag check is available outside the venue at Gate 3 for $10.
food: Concessions include Food Junction (fried chicken sandwich, grilled beef burger, birria taquito, chicken tenders, hot dogs, nachos, popcorn; sections 105, 107, 116, 127, 208), Panini (carved-to-order Porchetta sandwich, braised beef grilled cheese, smoked meat sandwich, smoked turkey club, vegan mushroom focaccia; sections 107, 124, 206), Frites (poutine and house-cut fries; section 110), Pizza Pizza (sections 108, 109, 115, 121, 127, 209) and King Club craft beer bar (section 107). Beverages include Labatt products, Mill St. Brewery and Brickworks Ciderhouse canned beer/cider, Coca-Cola bottled beverages and Tim Hortons coffee; Nathan's all-beef hot dogs are served. A specialty food guide covers gluten friendly, vegetarian, vegan, halal and kosher offerings.

name: BMO Stadium

publicTransit.notes: Take the Metro E Line to Expo Park/USC Station; the stadium is about a 10-minute walk. The Metro J Line's 37th St/USC Station is also accessible: head west, turn left on South Figueroa Street and walk about 1,000 feet. The Metro A, B and D trains connect with the E Line in Downtown LA. Regular Metro fares are $1.75 one-way or $3.50 round-trip.

rideshareDropoff: LAFC provides a ride share drop-off and pick-up lot available for fans on matchdays, located right outside the Southeast Entrance.
bagPolicyNotes: BMO Stadium has a Clear Bag Only Policy. Permitted: one bag that is clear plastic, vinyl or PVC and does not exceed 12 x 6 x 12 inches, OR a one-gallon clear plastic storage bag (Ziploc or similar). Non-clear bags including small clutches are not allowed. Guests may openly carry a blanket or jacket, subject to search. Exceptions will be made for medically necessary items after proper inspection and Stadium Management approval.

name: Bobby Dodd Stadium

parkingLots.name: E40: Klaus Deck
parkingLots.notes: Closest parking to the venue that includes EV charging.

publicTransit.notes: Stadium is accessible via MARTA; exit at the North Avenue station and walk three blocks west on North Avenue to reach Bobby Dodd Stadium.

rideshareDropoff: All rideshare pickup and drop-off is at The Varsity parking lot on North Avenue; the venue is two blocks west of this location.
accessibility: ADA/accessible seating for wheelchair, scooter, and mobility-limited guests is located throughout the venue; contact the Ticket Office at 1-888-TECH-TIX to arrange accommodations. Exterior elevator accessible from outside at Gate 6; interior elevators at Sections 105 and 108. All restrooms are ADA accessible with baby-changing tables; family restrooms at Sections 108, 210, and CL3.

tailgating.rules: Full-service tailgate packages can be booked via RevelXP; a Tailgate Do's and Don'ts document governs conduct.

venueAccessRestrictions: In accordance with Georgia Tech security procedures, guests may not exit and re-enter the stadium using the same ticket. All guests will be subject to security screening prior to entry inside Bobby Dodd Stadium at Hyundai Field along with inspection of all approved clear bags and carry-in items. Security staff will utilize contactless metal detectors to screen all guests at security checkpoints.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverage items are not allowed into the stadium; fans must leave them in their vehicle or dispose of them at the security checkpoint. Exceptions: parents with small children may bring plastic bottles of formula or milk, and approved medically necessary snacks. Fans may bring one clear, plastic, empty water bottle up to a half-gallon to use the complimentary water-filling stations; all other beverage containers are prohibited.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates will open 90 minutes prior to kickoff for all football games.

name: Boone Pickens Stadium

parkingLots.name: POSSE passenger vehicle parking lots
parkingLots.notes: Open 8:00 a.m. for Saturday home football games; POSSE parking credentials required and scanned at entry. Lots subject to change due to campus construction.

parkingLots.name: RV lot #74 (Hall of Fame and Walnut)
parkingLots.notes: Reserved POSSE RV parking; a State Ranger permit is required.

parkingLots.name: RV lot #81 (McDonald, north of Hall of Fame)
parkingLots.notes: Reserved POSSE RV parking; a specific POSSE permit is required.

parkingLots.name: RV lots #84 and #112 (north of Hall of Fame, east of Willis)
parkingLots.notes: Limited parking for visitors and non-POSSE permitted RVs not requiring hook-ups; about 0.5 mile to the game-day shuttle service.

parkingLots.name: OSU parking garage on Monroe Street (ADA)
parkingLots.notes: ADA parking with shuttle service to the stadium; vehicle must display a valid state ADA placard.

parkingLots.name: Downtown Stillwater public parking (7th and Lewis)
parkingLots.notes: Free public parking with a complimentary courtesy stadium shuttle beginning 2 hours prior to kickoff.

publicTransit.notes: Courtesy shuttle service from downtown Stillwater (7th and Lewis) to the stadium (Hall of Fame and Knoblock) begins 3 hours prior to kickoff and runs until 30 minutes after kickoff, then resumes in the 3rd quarter and continues for a minimum of 30 minutes post-game, with pick-up/drop-off approximately every 15 minutes. ADA shuttle picks up/drops off at the OSU Multimodal Transportation Terminal south of the Monroe Street Parking Garage.

accessibility: ADA parking with shuttle service is located in the OSU parking garage on Monroe Street (valid state ADA placard required); shuttle service runs beginning 3 hours prior to game time with return trips beginning at the 4th quarter, with pick-up/drop-off at the OSU Multimodal Transportation Terminal directly south of the Monroe Street Parking Garage and West Endzone lot. Wheelchair/companion seating is available throughout the stadium; fans should contact the Ticket Office (877/255-4678) at least 24 hours prior and accessible tickets are marked "WC." Family/special needs restrooms and baby changing stations are available on the concourse and upper concourse levels; all restrooms are wheelchair accessible; elevators are available for mobility needs.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is a cherished tradition and an important part of the game day experience at Oklahoma State University. To ensure a safe, family-friendly atmosphere, tailgating is limited to designated areas on campus; consult Oklahoma State's tailgating maps for publicly available and prohibited areas and tailgating guidelines. Full-service tailgates can be booked through REVELxp.
tailgating.timeWindow: POSSE passenger-vehicle parking lots open 8:00 a.m. for Saturday home football games; all RV lots on University property open the evening prior to each home game at 5:30 p.m.
tailgating.rvPolicy: Reserved POSSE RV parking is in lot #74 (Hall of Fame and Walnut) with a State Ranger permit required, and in lot #81 (McDonald, north of Hall of Fame) with a specific POSSE permit required. Limited parking for visitors and non-POSSE permitted RVs not requiring hook-ups is available at lots #84 and #112 (north of Hall of Fame, east of Willis), about 0.5 mile to the game-day shuttle. All RV lots on University property open at 5:30 p.m. the evening prior to each home game. Additional visitor/non-POSSE RV parking info via visitstillwaterok.org or (800) 991-6717.

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: banners, signs or flags, umbrellas, car seats, baby strollers/carriers, artificial noisemakers, beach balls, explosives, weapons, firearms, drones, outside food or drink, ice chests, backpacks, video cameras, cameras with lens longer than 3 inches (detachable or non-detachable), tripods, monopods, laser pointers, selfie sticks, any item that may create a safety concern, disturbance or obstructs the view of other fans. Boone Pickens Stadium has a no re-entry policy. Once a guest leaves the stadium, they will not be permitted back in. You and your belongings may be searched upon entry into the stadium.
outsideFoodRules: Patrons may not bring outside food or beverages inside the stadium (including food or beverages purchased in the Hall of Fame Block Party area). Concession stands are located throughout the stadium.
food: Concession stands are located throughout the stadium on the concourse and upper concourse levels and open at the same time patrons are allowed to enter — 2 hours prior to kick-off for premium gates and 90 minutes for general gates.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Suite and Club ticket holders may enter the stadium (2) Hours prior to kick off. All general fans may enter the stadium 90 minutes prior to kickoff.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Suite and Club ticket holders enter 120 minutes before kickoff (via stair towers, Passgate 6B, and Gates 1, 2, 5 & 6); general admission enters 90 minutes before kickoff.

name: Bridgestone Arena

parkingLots.name: Parking at Bridgestone Arena
parkingLots.notes: Attached to Bridgestone Arena on the corner of 6th Avenue South and Demonbreun St. 501 Broadway, Nashville, Tennessee 37203.

parkingLots.name: Fifth + Broadway Garage
parkingLots.notes: Directly across the street from the arena on the corner of 6th Avenue South and Broadway. Parking can be purchased on entering the facility.

parkingLots.name: 222 2nd Ave Garage
parkingLots.notes: Available for all arena events and Predators games. Parking can be purchased on entering the facility or online.

parkingLots.name: Nashville Yards Garages
parkingLots.notes: On 10th Ave N between Broadway and Charlotte Ave. Parking can be purchased on entering the facility or online.

parkingLots.name: Pinnacle at Symphony Place Garage
parkingLots.notes: Near the corner of 3rd Ave South and Demonbreun St., two blocks from the arena. Spots can be purchased in advance.

parkingLots.name: Ragland Lot
parkingLots.notes: Between 2nd and 3rd Avenue South adjacent to Korean Veterans Blvd.

parkingLots.name: Music City Center Parking
parkingLots.notes: Adjacent to the arena; the MCC garage is within the Music City Center off 6th Avenue. Guaranteed parking for Season-Ticket Citizens is available for purchase through the Nashville Predators.

parkingLots.name: Nissan Stadium Parking
parkingLots.notes: Complimentary parking in Lot R across the river for Predators home games without a conflict at Nissan Stadium, with an optional two-way shuttle to the arena (5 to 7 minutes) or a 10 to 12 minute walk over the John Seigenthaler Pedestrian Bridge. Lot R and the shuttle open 2 hours before every Predators game and run every 15 to 20 minutes until 2 hours after; Lot R is locked after it closes.

publicTransit.notes: WeGo Route 18 runs between Nashville International Airport and downtown.

rideshareDropoff: Guest Drop-Off Point: eastbound curb lane of Broadway between 6th & 5thAves.
bagPolicyNotes: Guests are strongly discouraged from bringing bags. Backpacks of any size are prohibited, and bags larger than 12 x 12 x 6 in are not allowed. Clear 12 x 12 in bags are permitted following X-ray screening, and diaper bags and bags needed for medical reasons are allowed but subject to X-ray screening. The arena does not provide on-site storage. Confirm the current bag rules on the arena's bag policy page before you travel.

name: Busch Stadium

parkingLots.name: All-Star Lot
parkingLots.notes: 611 S. 8th Street; individual game-day parking sold directly by the Cardinals, delivered digitally via the MLB Ballpark app. ADA parking for the All-Star Lot is located underneath the I-64 bridge, first-come, first-served.

parkingLots.name: One Cardinal Way Garage
parkingLots.notes: 269 S. Broadway; individual game-day parking sold directly by the Cardinals via the MLB Ballpark app.

parkingLots.name: Bus/Oversized Vehicle Lot
parkingLots.notes: 1001 S. 6th Street; for buses and oversized vehicles, sold directly by the Cardinals via the MLB Ballpark app.

parkingLots.name: SP+ Parking Lot
parkingLots.notes: Near Gate 2; accessible parking. Public parking contact (877) 717-0004.

parkingLots.name: InterPark - Stadium West Parking Garage
parkingLots.notes: Near Gate 3; accessible parking. Public parking contact (314) 421-2613.

parkingLots.name: InterPark - Stadium East Parking Garage
parkingLots.notes: Near Gate 5; accessible parking. Public parking contact (314) 421-2613.

parkingLots.name: Lot C
parkingLots.notes: ADA parking located along 8th Street, first-come, first-served.

publicTransit.notes: The closest MetroLink station is next to the Westin on the 8th Street side of the stadium. MetroLink normally runs until midnight; if the Cardinals game runs past midnight, MetroLink continues running until the downtown platform is cleared. For MetroLink and MetroBus schedules call (314) 231-2345.

rideshareDropoff: Guests arriving via rideshare, taxi or personal vehicle can be dropped off on the west side of the building on 8th St. north of Gate 3, or on the east side of the building on Broadway just south of Clark St. Taxi and rideshare pickups are located on the east side of the stadium on Broadway just south of Clark Street.
accessibility: Busch Stadium is fully accessible: every gate is accessible and accessible seating is available on all levels and in all price categories. ADA parking is first-come, first-served at the All-Star Lot (underneath the I-64 bridge) and Lot C (along 8th Street) with a valid state-issued disability placard or plate; accessible public parking is available near Gates 2, 3 and 5. Wheelchair escorts and transportation carts (subject to availability) pick up guests at stadium entrances and escort them to and from their seats, and guests in wheelchairs or with medical devices are given alternative screening at metal detectors. Accessible ticket windows are on 8th Street just north of Gate 3.
bagPolicyNotes: In conjunction with a league-wide MLB policy, the Cardinals reserve the right to inspect all items entering the stadium. Guests may bring bags, purses and soft-sided coolers not exceeding 10" x 8" x 10". Bags larger than that are prohibited, though exceptions are made for medical bags and diaper bags with a child, and all bags are inspected upon entry.
venueAccessRestrictions: All guests pass through walk-through metal detectors at every entrance and must remove cell phones, cameras and other large metal objects; all bags are inspected prior to entry. Prohibited items include weapons and firearms, outside alcohol, hard-sided/Styrofoam coolers, aluminum cans and glass bottles, drones, noisemakers (cowbells, airhorns, Thunderstix), laser pointers, knives longer than 4 inches when unopened, and any costume/mask covering the head or face. To exit and re-enter, guests must obtain a hand stamp at Gate 1 or Gate 4 and may re-enter at any gate until 90 minutes after scheduled first pitch, subject to bag inspection and metal-detector screening.
nearby: Ballpark Village, a first-of-its-kind sports-anchored entertainment district with many dining, drink and entertainment options (including Cardinals Nation), is located just across Clark Street from Busch Stadium.
outsideFoodRules: Guests may bring their own food and drinks into Busch Stadium for all games. Most food items are permitted, but guests should consider the bag policy when deciding what to bring. Non-alcoholic beverages including water and soda are allowed in factory-sealed clear plastic containers no larger than 2 liters. Outside food and beverages are not permitted in the Cardinals Club, Luxury Suites, Party Suites or any other all-inclusive areas.
food: Food and beverage is provided by Delaware North Sportservice, the official provider at Busch Stadium since 1966. A Cardinals Value Menu of discounted concession items is available at stands 132, 162, 233 and 446, and the Coca-Cola Unlimited offering (bottomless Cokes and ballpark eats) is available to guests seated in Big Mac Land, redeemable at stand 264.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Busch Stadium gates open 1 1/2 hours before game time Monday-Thursday and 2 hours before game time Friday-Sunday (times subject to change).

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Gate opening varies by day of week: 2 hours before game time Friday-Sunday vs. 1 1/2 hours before game time Monday-Thursday.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Exceptions to the 10" x 8" x 10" bag size limit are made for medical bags and diaper bags with a child; all bags are inspected upon entry.

name: Caesars Superdome

parkingLots.name: Garage 1
parkingLots.notes: public parking garage

parkingLots.name: Garage 1A
parkingLots.notes: public parking garage

parkingLots.name: Garage 2
parkingLots.notes: public parking garage

parkingLots.name: Garage 2A

rideshareDropoff: Designated drop-off/pick-up zone on Poydras Street between Clara Street and Loyola Avenue; locations may vary by event
accessibility: Accessible parking on East/West sides of Sugar Bowl Drive and Level 1 of Garage 1A (first-come, first-served); accessible seating on Plaza Level; guest drop-off/pick-up at Gate A Ground; ADA Greeters at main entrances; wheelchairs, assisted listening devices, sensory bags and quiet rooms via Guest Relations Center at Gate F Plaza Level; ADA Facilitator (504) 587-3842
bagPolicyNotes: NFL Clear Bag Policy: only clear plastic/vinyl/PVC bags not exceeding 12x6x12, one-gallon clear Ziploc bags, or clutch bags no larger than 4.5x6.5; clear backpacks and clear fanny packs not permitted; walk-through metal detectors at all gates

tailgating.rules: Unauthorized tailgating strictly prohibited in complex parking facilities
tailgating.rvPolicy: Overnight parking prohibited

venueAccessRestrictions: No re-entry policy; re-entry and overnight parking prohibited in parking facilities
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverages are not allowed in the Superdome; Legends is the exclusive concessionaire
food: Concessions provided exclusively by Legends; cashless (credit/debit only); local New Orleans fare including po'boys, jambalaya, seafood, sausage and Little Caesars pizza across Plaza, Loge and Terrace levels

name: California Memorial Stadium
rideshareDropoff: Ubers or Lyfts are accessible at the corner of Dana Street and Bancroft Way following the game.
accessibility: California Memorial Stadium is fully accessible with ADA elevators, restrooms, concessions, water fountains and seating areas. Closed captioning is displayed at the bottom of the video board. ADA shuttle and golf cart services are available for guests with limited mobility, the elderly and pregnant women; shuttles run 1.5 hours prior to kickoff and up to 1 hour post game, with golf carts continuing during the game. Pregame shuttle pickup points: Upper Hearst Lot, Greek Theatre, Kleeberger, Prospect Ct, International House, Kroeber, Boalt Lot. Postgame pickup: Rimway Lot @ Centennial, Prospect Court Lot, Haas School of Business. For ADA ticket info contact the Athletic Ticket Office at (800) GO BEARS.
bagPolicyNotes: Backpacks, including clear backpacks, are prohibited. Clear bags larger than 12"x12"x6" and non-clear bags larger than 4.5"x6.5" are prohibited.

tailgating.rules: Oski's Village at Memorial Glade (adjacent to Doe Library) is the official pregame tailgate location for every home game, free admission for all fans, with a beer garden, concessions, Kids Zone and games. Outside alcohol, grills/BBQs, glass/metal bottles, cans, umbrellas and hard coolers are prohibited in Oski's Village. Tailgate parties are allowed in the 'BBQ Exclusion Zone' provided there are NO heat-producing appliances, fuel-fired equipment or open flames.
tailgating.timeWindow: Oski's Village opens three hours prior to kickoff. Open flame/cooking permits are issued for 4 hours prior to the football game through the duration of the game ONLY.
tailgating.grillRules: A UC Berkeley Fire Prevention Division Permit is required for all open flame/cooking appliances and fires (electric and any-fuel appliances producing open flames). Permits are NOT issued inside the 'BBQ Exclusion Zone' except in areas marked with a star. Electric food warmers (not electric cooking or open-flame appliances) are allowed without a permit only in star-designated areas. Permit applications emailed to Fireprevention@berkeley.edu.

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Backpacks, including clear backpacks, Clear bags larger than 12"x12"x6", Non-clear bags larger than 4.5"x6.5", Seat cushions larger than 18", Alcohol of any kind, Hard Plastic Bottles (Nalgene, bike water bottles, etc.), Animals, Banners / Signs, Balls or other projectiles, Weapons, Hard fruit or Vegetables (unless cut into small pieces), Glass or Metal Bottles, Cans, Open Containers, Sticks / Poles, Fireworks, Hard coolers, Umbrellas, Derogatory, profane, scantily clad, or offensive clothing, Artificial noise making devices, Video Cameras, Monos / Tripods, Professional Cameras (see policy below), Laser Pointers, Tobacco Products (including e-cigarettes), Skateboards / rollerblades / scooters / roller shoes, Balloons, Illegal drugs, Segways (ADA only), Bicycles, Tri-Bikes, Metal seatbacks. Re-entry into Memorial Stadium is not permitted. No "in and out" privileges are allowed. There are no exceptions to this policy.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverage is allowed for personal consumption only and must comply with the prohibited item policies. Food and fruit must be cut into pieces. Soft plastic bottles (bottled water, soft drinks, no alcohol) are permitted; hard plastic bottles, glass/metal bottles, cans and hard fruit/vegetables (unless cut into small pieces) are prohibited.

gatesOpen.ruleText: California Memorial Stadium gates open 2 hours prior to kickoff. Guests may enter the stadium at the gate of their choosing.

tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Oski's Village pregame tailgate on Memorial Glade opens three hours prior to kickoff.

publicTransit.notes: The Maryland Transit Administration (MTA) provides light rail, bus, MARC train, and subway service to Camden Yards on a daily basis.

rideshareDropoff: There are no pick-up/drop-off zones on the immediate streets surrounding Oriole Park. The closest pick-up/drop-off zone is located on Pratt St. near the Hilton Baltimore Inner Harbor.
accessibility: The Orioles accommodate guests with disabilities; see Orioles.com/Accessibility. Assisted listening devices are available at the Guest Experience Kiosk behind home plate on the Lower Level Concourse. Accessibility/Medical & Family entry gates are C, D, and H. Wheelchair service is available first-come, first-served at the Guest Services Kiosk behind home plate.
bagPolicyNotes: A clear bag policy is in effect for the 2026 season; one approved bag per person. Permitted: a clear plastic bag no larger than 12" x 6" x 12", a 1-gallon plastic freezer bag, or a fanny pack/clutch purse no larger than 5" x 7". Medical equipment/device bags and diaper bags are also allowed but must go through a designated search lane. All bags are subject to search.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is not permitted on Orioles' parking lots around the ballpark.

venueAccessRestrictions: Metal detectors are present at all entrances. Weapons of any kind (including plastic/toy), air horns, cowbells and other noisemakers, brooms, camera stands/tripods, and frozen water bottles/ice packs are prohibited. Laptops/tablets are permitted but must be carried in hand or in an approved clear bag (laptop bags not permitted). Once you enter, you may not leave and re-enter the facility.
outsideFoodRules: Guests may bring in food and non-alcoholic beverages, all contained in a single approved bag per the bag policy. Food items should resemble individual portions, not bulk quantities. One factory-sealed, plastic, non-alcoholic beverage no larger than 20 oz is allowed; cans and glass bottles are prohibited. Frozen water bottles and ice packs are prohibited.
food: Signature concessions include Boog's BBQ (behind the center field bleachers on Eutaw Street and at section 242 on the Club Level), Camden Franks locations throughout the park, and the Birdland Value Menu with 6 food and soda offerings for less than $5.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Mon-Thurs: 60 min before first pitch; Fri, Sat, Sun: 90 min before first pitch.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Gate times subject to change. Select games will open two hours prior to first pitch. For batting practice / early access games, gates open 2.5 hours before first pitch (entry only through Gate A and Gate H).
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Bags for medical equipment or devices and diaper bags are permitted but must go through a designated search lane.

name: Camp Randall Stadium

parkingLots.name: Lot 17
parkingLots.notes: Ramp north of Camp Randall Stadium (1525 Engineering Drive); accessible parking on levels 1-4 with elevator access; 8'2" clearance at both entrances; limited single-game accessible permits go on sale the Monday at 8:30 a.m. before each home game

parkingLots.name: Lot 34
parkingLots.notes: Alcohol free for football

parkingLots.name: Lot 64
parkingLots.notes: Bus/RV and oversized-vehicle parking ($50; 606 Walnut Street); advance permits via the Athletic Ticket Office, day-of sales based on availability

parkingLots.name: Lot 60
parkingLots.notes: Day-of-game parking only ($5 per vehicle; 801 Walnut Street); Bucky Shuttle pickup

parkingLots.name: Lot 76
parkingLots.notes: Day-of-game parking only ($5 per vehicle; 2501 University Bay Drive); Bucky Shuttle pickup

parkingLots.name: UW Credit Union
parkingLots.notes: Park only in the parking stalls; parking or tailgating prohibited off the asphalt

parkingLots.name: Regent West
parkingLots.notes: Park only in the lot at the entrance off Regent Street (1402 Regent Street); parking in the main or covered lot is subject to citation and/or tow

parkingLots.name: Friends Meetinghouse
parkingLots.notes: Parking begins three hours prior to kickoff

publicTransit.notes: Bucky Shuttle (operated by GO Riteway) runs on home football game days from Lots 60 (801 Walnut St), 64 (606 Walnut St) and 76 (2501 University Bay Dr) to Camp Randall Stadium; $10 per person round-trip; runs approximately every 15 minutes starting two hours prior to kickoff and up to one hour after the game; pre-game drop-off at the corner of Breese Terrace and University Avenue. Passes must be purchased in advance online and added to a mobile wallet. A metro bus stop is located on Observatory Drive across from Lot 64. Downtown loop discontinued as of 2023.

accessibility: Accessible seating is on the east side fifth-level concourse and in the south end zone. Accommodations include accessible parking (Lot 17), golf cart shuttles, wheelchair transportation and elevator access. Game-day Guest Services Center is in the south end zone concourse (game-day phone 608-265-8676; weekday phone 608-262-1866). Note: new LED lights use flashing lighting that may affect guests with photosensitive conditions or epilepsy.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is permissible only for football regular-season games (prohibited for all other UW events). Patrons who purchased a special-events parking permit and their guests may responsibly tailgate within the immediate area of their parking space and may not block a drive or fire lane. Lot 34 is alcohol free. Occupy only the number of stalls equal to the number of parking passes held. Pop-up tents are allowed in surface lots (must be weighed down per manufacturer requirements and taken down when unattended) but are not allowed on parking-structure roofs (Lots 17, 20, 36, 46, 67, 76). Weapons are prohibited in parking lots. Generator use is allowed in a fully vented space away from tailgaters with no on-site refueling.
tailgating.timeWindow: All campus parking lots open at 6 a.m. for 11 a.m. kickoffs and 7 a.m. for all other kickoff times; for Friday games lots open at 2 p.m. Friends Meetinghouse parking begins three hours prior to kickoff. Overnight parking is prohibited; all parking lots close at 1 a.m. the day after the game.
tailgating.grillRules: Grilling is permitted on the asphalt of surface parking lots provided the tailgate area is not within a drive or fire lane and grills are placed safely to prevent damage to cars. No open flame or wood fires. Propane and electric grills are prohibited within any parking ramp or garage. Used charcoals must be placed in metal buckets, doused with water and leave with the vehicle post-event; they may not be disposed of in lot dumpsters/trash receptacles or left in landscaping.
tailgating.rvPolicy: Parking for buses, RVs and other oversized vehicles is prohibited in all lots except Lot 64 ($50; 606 Walnut Street). Other oversized vehicles including limos, semis and trailers are prohibited in all lots. Overnight parking is prohibited. Lot 64 permits may be purchased in advance through the Athletic Ticket Office (advance sales end one week before each home game); any remaining day-of permits are $50 on a first-come, first-served basis.

venueAccessRestrictions: No re-entry. Once you leave the building during an event, you will not be permitted to return with that ticket.
nearby: Badger Bash, the official free pre-game tailgate party, is held across the street at Union South and begins 2.5 hours prior to kickoff (open to the public; features the UW Marching Band and Bucky Badger). A Bike Parking Corral operates on the Southwest Commuter Path behind the UW Credit Union on Monroe Street, open two hours before kickoff to one hour after the game.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food or beverages are listed among prohibited items, except for water in Wisconsin's games against Western Michigan and Alabama.
food: Concessions (operated by Levy Restaurants) are located throughout Camp Randall Stadium, plus in-bowl food and beverage vending. All concession stands are cashless (contactless and card payments only; no ATMs in the stadium). Gluten-free options (potato chips, popcorn, peanuts), pretzels and nachos are available in most locations; chicken wings in the SEZ and outside sections R and HH; vegetarian options include mac & cheese (sections E, DD) and cheese pizza. Beer, wine and pre-packaged alcoholic products are offered in general seating areas.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates for the General Public open 1.5 hours prior to scheduled kickoff time for all Badger home football games.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Premium-seating gates and the student gate (Gate 5) open two hours (120 min) before kickoff, 30 minutes earlier than the 1.5-hour (90 min) general-public opening.
tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Parking lots open 6 a.m. for 11 a.m. kickoffs, 7 a.m. for later kickoffs, and 2 p.m. for Friday games; tailgating permitted for football regular-season games only; all lots close at 1 a.m. the day after the game (no overnight parking).

name: Canada Life Centre
rideshareDropoff: Guests can use drop-off zones on Donald Street (both sides of curb lane between Portage and Graham Avenue, and south of Graham Avenue), Portage Avenue (eastbound between Carlton and Hargrave streets in front of Newport Center, eastbound between Donald and Smith streets in front of the Radisson, and westbound between Donald Street and Hargrave Street). Transit Plus is designated for the west side curb lane on Donald Street.
bagPolicyNotes: Bags must be 4 inches by 6 inches by 1.5 inches or smaller and will undergo contactless security screening. Exceptions are made for guests with medical and childcare or diaper bags and for media. Guests with exceptions must enter at Gate 1, Gate 3, or Gate 6 Cityplace Skywalk for mandatory X-ray screening. On-site bag check is not available. Individual tours and events may have more restrictive policies that will be communicated to ticket holders via email.

parkingLots.notes: Handicapped parking; $20 (cash) or free with a valid game parking pass; ADA shuttle drops off/picks up at Gate 11

parkingLots.name: On-grounds Carter-Finley lots
parkingLots.notes: All parking on the grounds of Carter-Finley Stadium is reserved and requires a valid permit; unauthorized vehicles (including golf carts, motorized scooters, unapproved promotional vehicles) prohibited; lots color-coded with updated ingress/egress routes

accessibility: Handicapped parking at the Westchase Handicap Lot: $20 (cash) or free with a valid game parking pass. ADA shuttle service begins at 4:00 PM and runs until 1 hour after the game ends, dropping off and picking up at Gate 11.
bagPolicyNotes: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" at Carter Finley Stadium, or any clear freezer bag 1 gallon or smaller; one clear bag per guest. A small purse or clutch bag up to 6.5" x 4.5", with or without handle or strap, may be brought in addition to an approved clear bag. Medically necessary items are permitted after proper inspection at the gate. Not approved: backpacks, large purses, camera bags, coolers or oversized bags. Diaper bags may be permitted when accompanied by an infant and are subject to inspection.

tailgating.rules: Set up in your space only; do not block the cars on either side with chairs, tents, etc.; do not block the roadway (emergency access must be maintained); leave trash in a bag in front of your car. Sustainability bag stations are located throughout the parking lots.
tailgating.timeWindow: Parking lots open at 1:00 PM per the posted game-day schedule (kickoff times vary)

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Umbrellas, Video cameras and GoPros, Emotional Support Animals, Large, non-collapsible strollers, Signs/banners/flags on sticks or poles. Pass outs available at all gates beginning with five (5) minutes remaining on the game clock in the second (2nd) quarter; the issuing of pass outs ends at the start of the third (3rd) quarter. Fans re-entering must be in possession of their ticket AND the pass out stub they received at the gate prior to exiting. Upon re-entry, all persons and belongings are subject to search by an event staff member.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Stadium entrance gates open 1.5 hours prior to kick-off for access to general seating areas. TowneBank Center patrons may enter 2 hours prior to the game through Gates 4, 8, and 14 only.

tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Parking lots open at 1:00 PM per the posted game-day schedule (kickoff times vary)
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Clear bag policy applies; exceptions to the clear-bag requirement include a small non-clear purse/clutch up to 6.5" x 4.5", a one-gallon or smaller clear freezer bag, diaper bags accompanied by an infant, and medically necessary items after inspection

name: Casino Del Sol Stadium

parkingLots.name: Cherry Garage
parkingLots.notes: Closest garage to the stadium; Levels 1 and 2 reserved for accessible parking; disabled Wildcat Club member and disabled parking available; credit only

parkingLots.name: A East
parkingLots.notes: Disabled Wildcat Club member parking available; credit only (Arizona Stadium surface lots are credit-only)

parkingLots.name: A West
parkingLots.notes: Disabled Wildcat Club member parking available; credit only (Arizona Stadium surface lots are credit-only)
