parkingLots.notes: Accessible/disabled parking available (permit or state-issued plate/placard)

parkingLots.name: Sixth Street Garage
parkingLots.notes: Accessible/disabled parking available (permit or state-issued plate/placard)

parkingLots.name: Park Avenue Garage
parkingLots.notes: Offers accessible Cat Tran transportation to the game

publicTransit.notes: Cat Cruiser round-trip bus program serves fans from Phoenix for every home football game (arrive ~2 hours before kickoff, depart 30 minutes after)

rideshareDropoff: Official rideshare (Lyft, Uber, etc.) drop-off is Lot 4063 at 840 N. Cherry Ave. Cherry Avenue closes 5 hours prior to kickoff; once closed, Lot 4063 is the furthest south fans can be dropped off
accessibility: Wheelchair seating available at all ticketed venues (contact McKale Ticket Office). Wheelchair stadium entry: North End Zone sections 27-35 via Gates 1, 2, or 8 (NE/NW elevators); East Side via Gates 1 or 2 (NE elevator) or ramps at Gates 2, 3, 6; South End Zone sections 11-13 via Gate 6; West Side via ramps at Gates 7 or 8 or NW elevator. Accessible parking in Cherry Garage (Levels 1-2 reserved), A East, and A West. Accessible restrooms throughout the concourses, including an all-gender/family restroom in the North End Zone. Realtime captions provided on screens by the main scoreboard and at ArizonaCaptions.com

tailgating.rules: Requires advanced purchase of a season or game-specific tailgate pass; all vehicles must display a pass or they will not be allowed onto the tailgate grounds. Enter tailgating grounds heading south on Cherry off Speedway. First-come, first-served, no reserved spaces; over-30' passes park on the center UA Mall (west to east), under-30' passes on McKale Lawn then Gittings Lawn. Alcohol: BYO beer and wine only (no hard alcohol), no kegs or common source/drinking apparatus, no glass containers, no alcohol sales; consumption only during the six hours prior to kickoff. No vulgar/offensive audio
tailgating.timeWindow: Tailgating area opens six (6) hours prior to kickoff; entrance to the tailgate grounds closes three (3) hours prior to kickoff. All tailgating activities cease at kickoff, and all tailgate areas must be cleared within one (1) hour after the conclusion of the game
tailgating.grillRules: Gas grills are allowed. Charcoal grills and wood fires are NOT permitted on tailgating grounds. Electric generators that emit no fumes and no noise are allowed; no gas generators permitted
tailgating.rvPolicy: Tailgate passes are sold as 'under 30 ft' and 'over 30 ft' based on vehicle length; a vehicle over 30' must purchase an over-30' pass (approx. 18'x45' space, 10 feet off one side and ~45 feet front to back). Slide-outs are not allowed

outsideFoodRules: No outside food or beverage containers permitted except sealed water (subject to inspection). Food/beverage containers, ice chests, bottles, cans, canteens, or bags of food must be disposed of at the gate or returned to the vehicle. Medically necessary items permitted after inspection
food: Concessions feature local Tucson vendors (eegees, BrushFire) plus items such as Hebrew National hot dogs, corn dogs, stuffed pretzels, mac-and-cheese/chicken-tender waffle cones, and vegetarian options. Beer and wine are sold to fans 21 and up throughout the stadium, beginning 90 minutes before kickoff and concluding before the end of the third quarter

gatesOpen.ruleText: 1.5 hours prior to kickoff: Casino del Sol Stadium gates open

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Gameday timeline times are subject to change depending on the game's start time
tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Tailgate lots open 6 hours prior to kickoff; entrance closes 3 hours prior; tailgating ceases at kickoff and all areas must be cleared within 1 hour after the game
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Exceptions for medically necessary items (oxygen tanks, diabetes kits, allergy pens) after inspection; a small hand-size clutch is permitted after being searched

name: Centre Bell

parkingLots.name: Centre Bell parking (1225 Saint-Antoine Street West)
parkingLots.notes: Open to the public. On event nights it opens at noon; on non-event weekdays it is open 5:30 a.m. to 7 p.m. at a $20 daily fixed rate. Pickup trucks are not accepted during hockey games and vehicles with studded tires are forbidden at all times. Prices are subject to change.

publicTransit.notes: By public transit: Bonaventure or Lucien-L'Allier.

bagPolicyNotes: Backpacks, coolers and sports bags are not allowed regardless of size. Hard-covered briefcases are also not allowed. As a general rule a bag must not exceed 15 cm x 10 cm x 4 cm; the venue encourages bags that fit easily under the seat. The bag policy can vary for certain events, so check the event page before you go.

name: Chase Center

publicTransit.notes: Chase Center is a transit-first destination. Your event ticket is your all-day complimentary Muni ticket. The T metro line serves Chase Center, with additional S trains on event days. The 78X bus runs between Chase Center and 16th St Mission BART station 2.5 hours before and 1 hour after events. Nearby BART stations are Powell St. and 16th St. Mission (transfer to Muni-T or 78X). Caltrain riders transfer to Muni at the San Francisco station or walk about 15-20 minutes from 4th and King. SF Bay Ferry runs event service to Pier 48 from Oakland/Alameda for all home games (about a 15-minute walk). The free Mission Bay Shuttle connects Mission Bay to BART and Salesforce Transit Center until 8pm weekdays.

rideshareDropoff: Lyft is the official rideshare partner. Enter "Chase Center" as the destination and use the dedicated Lyft pick-up/drop-off zone on the corner of Warriors Way and Terry Francois Boulevard, or follow exterior signage to the nearest rideshare pick-up location.
accessibility: Accessible parking is offered at the Chase Center Garage (150 Warriors Way Garage); notify attendants upon arrival for assistance. Helmets are not permitted inside Chase Center but can be checked free of charge at the Bike Valet.
bagPolicyNotes: Maximum bag size is 14" x 6" x 14", including all bags, purses, totes, fanny packs, diaper bags and medical bags. Bags do NOT need to be clear, but clear bags must still meet the size limit. Backpacks are prohibited except single-compartment drawstring bags and single-compartment fashion backpack-style purses. Bags larger than the size limit or prohibited bags may be checked at the Bike Valet on Terry A Francois Blvd or the Chase Center Bag Check near the East Entrance (corner of Terry A Francois Blvd and 16th Street) for a $10 donation to the Golden State/Warriors Community Foundation (subject to change). Bags smaller than 10" x 6" x 2" may be screened and enter at any entrance; larger bags up to the limit must be x-ray screened in the designated bag screening lanes.

tailgating.rules: Chase Center's concert General Admission line policy prohibits camping, tailgating, open flames, and barbecues on the property.
tailgating.grillRules: No open flames or barbecues (per General Admission line policy).

venueAccessRestrictions: Chase Center entry uses mobile tickets, managed in the Golden State mobile app, and tickets can be added to Apple or Google Wallet.
nearby: Thrive City, an adjacent community gathering space with restaurants, bars, and retail, sits next to Chase Center. The venue is within convenient walking distance of public transportation, restaurants, bars, and outdoor public amenities, including the Esplanade along the Bay.
food: Chase Center operates as a cashless venue. Five Cash-to-Card kiosks convert cash into a prepaid open-loop debit card accepted at all Chase Center eateries, all Warriors Shop locations, and the Box Office. Kiosk locations: Main Concourse (Portals 10 and 22), Upper Concourse (Portals 46 and 55), and by the Chase Center Box Office.

name: Chase Field

publicTransit.notes: Valley Metro light rail operates 365 days a year serving Phoenix, Mesa and Tempe. Trains run every 15-20 minutes and drop you off within walking distance of Chase Field.

rideshareDropoff: Rideshare pickup/drop-off locations are at 5th Street north of Washington, and Jackson Street east of 9th Street.
accessibility: ADA/disability information is available at dbacks.com/ada, with a Guide for Guests with Disabilities. A limited number of wheelchairs are available (first-come, first-served; capacity 250 lbs or less) to transport guests to and from their seats. Disability Services Manager: 602.462.6163.
bagPolicyNotes: Chase Field enforces a Clear Bag Policy. Each fan may carry one clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bag no larger than 12" x 6" x 12", or a one-gallon clear plastic freezer bag. Fans may also carry a small clutch purse no larger than 4.5" x 6.5" (with or without a handle/strap), subject to search. Backpacks and any bags or wallets exceeding the small-clutch size are prohibited.
venueAccessRestrictions: Major League Baseball requires that all fans walk through a metal detector. Prohibited items include weapons, alcohol, aerosol cans, drones, umbrellas, backpacks, and bags exceeding the small-clutch size. Re-entry is allowed only at designated gates (A, F, J, and K), where guests must show their ticket and be scanned out and back in.
outsideFoodRules: Food is permitted as long as it is brought in an approved clear plastic bag. Permitted beverages: only non-flavored/non-carbonated water in sealed plastic bottles, empty plastic water bottles, sealed single-serving juice boxes, and formula/baby food. The Diamondbacks reserve the right to inspect any items brought in.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates open 90 minutes before first pitch for Sunday-Friday games and 2 hours before first pitch for Saturday games.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Saturday games open 2 hours before first pitch versus 90 minutes Sunday-Friday. Advantage Members get 30-minute early entry on Fridays and Saturdays at Gates B & J (plus the Hall of Fame Museum Gate for 20-Year Club and Legacy Club Members).

name: Nu Stadium

parkingLots.name: Yellow Lot
parkingLots.notes: Reserved, pre-purchased passes only; described as the closest match parking to the stadium. Accessible only from the North via Cypress Creek Blvd and the NW 10th Terrace entrance. Single-match parking passes are only available on the Yellow Lot. Free shuttles run from the Yellow Lot (south of Commercial Blvd) to the Fan Zone. License plate enforcement is strictly enforced.

parkingLots.name: Yellow Lot Overflow
parkingLots.notes: Event day parking only. Accessible from East or West on Commercial Blvd and NW 21st Avenue (north to South Perimeter Road). Additional overflow lot located at 1110 W Commercial Blvd. Overflow lots open as other lots become unavailable.

parkingLots.name: Audi Blue Lot
parkingLots.notes: Reserved, pre-purchased passes only. Accessible from the South side via Commercial Blvd and NW 15th Avenue, or from the North via Cypress Creek Blvd and NW 10th Avenue.

parkingLots.name: Green Lot
parkingLots.notes: Reserved, pre-purchased passes only. Accessible from the North side (Cypress Creek Blvd and NW 10th Avenue); South entry available only if coming east on Commercial.

parkingLots.name: Audi Black Lot
parkingLots.notes: Season parking included for Platinum Level, Audi Executive Level, and ERGO Next Field Level suite members. Sold out for single-match purchase.

parkingLots.name: Red Lot
parkingLots.notes: Season parking included or priority-purchase for Loge Boxes, East Pitchside seats, and select East/West Club members. Sold out for single-match purchase.

publicTransit.notes: Club promotes transit apps for reaching the stadium: SoFloGo, GO Miami-Dade Transit, and MetroConnect Miami-Dade (each linked to App Store and Google Play). No specific rail/bus line names are given on the scraped pages.

accessibility: ADA guests have ADA parking locations on site, subject to availability. Guests should head to their designated lot and will be directed to their parking location.
bagPolicyNotes: Clear bag policy. Permitted after screening: one bag that is clear plastic, vinyl or PVC not exceeding 12 x 6 x 12 inches, or a one-gallon clear plastic freezer bag; plus one small clutch (no larger than 4.5 x 6.5 inches) with or without a handle/strap. Medically necessary items must be pre-approved by stadium management via guestservices@intermiamicf.com. Diapers and wipes may be carried in a clear bag, and each family member including children may carry an approved clear bag. There is no bag check at the gates; prohibited items must be returned to vehicles or discarded. Bags or purses exceeding 12 x 6 x 12 inches are prohibited.
venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited items include coolers, outside food and beverage, cans, flasks and bottles; weapons; aerosols/pressurized containers; drones; laptops, iPads and tablets; umbrellas; strollers and infant carriers; noisemakers (whistles, horns, thunder sticks, vuvuzelas, megaphones); scooters, skateboards, hoverboards and bikes; and smoking of any kind including cigarettes, e-cigarettes and vaping. Banners, signs or flags larger than 2' x 3' and poles/sticks are not allowed. Cameras with detachable lenses or longer than 6 inches when extended are prohibited. Animals other than service animals are prohibited.
outsideFoodRules: Coolers and outside food and beverage (including cans, flasks and bottles) are listed as prohibited items and are not permitted into the stadium.

name: Children's Mercy Park

parkingLots.name: Orange Lot
parkingLots.notes: Free for all non-Season Ticket Members who don't have a parking pass; overflow lot for oversized vehicles is located near it (enter off State Avenue and 110th).

parkingLots.name: White Lot
parkingLots.notes: Complimentary parking for all Season Ticket Members; ADA parking available.

parkingLots.name: Blue Lot 1
parkingLots.notes: Available to Huhtamaki Shield Club and Premium Terrace Table Season Ticket Members; limited public purchase as space allows via SeatGeek; ADA parking available.

parkingLots.name: Blue Lot 2
parkingLots.notes: Available to purchase via SeatGeek, open to anyone, and to Season Ticket Members; ADA parking available.

parkingLots.name: NFM Lot 1
parkingLots.notes: Nebraska Furniture Mart lot north of the stadium plaza; UMB Field Club Season Ticket Members and Suite purchasers; primary ADA lot with accessible shuttle to the North Premium entrance.

parkingLots.name: NFM Lot 2
parkingLots.notes: Purchase via SeatGeek, open to anyone; $20 upgrade for closest single-match parking, MLS Regular Season matches only; ADA parking available.

parkingLots.name: Red Lot
parkingLots.notes: Media and Premium Season Ticket Members; ADA parking available; vehicles left in other lots after close are towed here.

parkingLots.name: Hollywood Casino at Kansas Speedway
parkingLots.notes: Free parking garage with expedited shuttle to and from the stadium operating 2 hours before kickoff to 1 hour after the final whistle; must be 21+ to enter casino; surface lot available for families/under-21.

rideshareDropoff: Designated rideshare pickup and drop-off point is the cutout outside of Budweiser Brew House on Village West Parkway. Hours of operation begin three hours prior to the event and end two hours post-event.
accessibility: Sporting Park is fully accessible. ADA parking is available in Red Lot, NFM Lots 1 and 2, Blue Lots 1 and 2, and White Lot for all events, with a wheelchair-accessible shuttle running continuously between NFM Lot 1 and the stadium's North Premium entrance beginning 2 hours before kickoff; proof of ADA tag/placard or plate required. ADA seating is on all levels, reachable via elevators, ramps and walkways near the entrances. There are 32 ADA-accessible public restrooms with baby-changing stations, and family restrooms with adult changing tables (sections 101, 114, 121, 127, 133). Wheelchairs can be provided on request at Fan Service kiosks behind sections 101 and 132. Guide, signal and service dogs are permitted (comfort/emotional-support animals are not). Eight hearing-impaired headphone sets are at Guest Services (sections 101 and 132), communication boards are at both First Aid stations, and closed captioning is available via the Sporting KC app and the videoboard above section 134. A Variety KC Sensory Room (east side) and check-out sensory kits are available. Questions: fanservices@sportingkc.com.
bagPolicyNotes: If you bring a bag it must be clear. Only clear bags measuring 12" x 12" x 6" or smaller are permitted after inspection. Small clutch purses measuring 4.5" x 6.5" or smaller are also permitted after inspection. Backpacks (including purse backpacks, clear backpacks, and drawstring/cinch bags of any kind or size) are not permitted. Medical bags and diaper bags (when accompanied by a baby or small child) are subject to the same inspection and will be searched and tagged. All bags are subject to search as a condition of entry. Fans are encouraged not to bring bags at all.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is encouraged, but each vehicle can only occupy one parking space. Failure to park in a designated area may result in towing.
tailgating.rvPolicy: Trailers, campers, buses, RVs or any vehicle too large to occupy a single parking space are not permitted in any lot and are directed to an overflow lot near the Orange Lot (enter off State Avenue and 110th).
tailgating.timeWindow: All parking lots open 3 hours prior to game time and close 2 hours after the game (vehicles remaining after close are towed to the Red Lot).

venueAccessRestrictions: No re-entry: fans may not exit and re-enter using the same ticket, with no exceptions. All fans are subject to a security screening prior to entry, which may include AI weapons detection, wanding, and/or pat-downs. Smoking, e-cigarettes and smokeless tobacco are not allowed anywhere at Sporting Park. Firearms (including concealed-carry) and other weapons are prohibited on the property.
nearby: Hollywood Casino at Kansas Speedway (park, eat and play, with free garage parking and shuttle) and Nebraska Furniture Mart are adjacent to the stadium; Cabela's is nearby off France Family Drive.
outsideFoodRules: Fans may not bring any food or beverage items into Sporting Park (leave them in the vehicle or dispose at the security checkpoint). Fans may bring one empty soft plastic water bottle up to 20 ounces OR one factory-sealed filled water bottle up to 20 ounces; water filling stations are throughout the stadium. No cans, thermoses, glass, aluminum, or hard plastic bottles. Parents with small children may bring soft-sided plastic bottles of formula, milk or juice when accompanied by the child. All bottles are subject to inspection, and caps may be required to be removed based on the match risk assessment.

gatesOpen.ruleText: General-admission Plaza Entrances (Sporting Way and State Ave Gates) open 90 minutes before kickoff for Sporting Kansas City matches; the Sporting Plaza also opens 90 minutes prior. Premium/club entries (UMB Field Club and Budweiser Brew House) open 120 minutes before kickoff, and Huhtamaki Shield Club, Buffalo Funds Executive Level and GFI Digital Argyle Club open 90 minutes before.

tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Lots open 3 hours before game time and close 2 hours after the game; tailgating encouraged with one parking space per vehicle.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Medical bags and diaper bags (when accompanied by a baby or small child) are exempt from the clear-bag rule and will be searched and tagged by security after screening.

name: Citi Field

parkingLots.name: Orange Reserved
parkingLots.notes: Primary lot within the fence line; designated Season Ticket Members with Orange Reserved Access

parkingLots.name: Lot F
parkingLots.notes: Primary lot within the fence line; General Parking, General Pre-Paid

parkingLots.name: Lot G
parkingLots.notes: Primary lot within the fence line; front office staff and visitors, VIP Guests and Premium Suite Pass Holders ONLY (not honored for general pre-paid passes)

parkingLots.name: Southfield/Commuter Lot
parkingLots.notes: Remote lot on Roosevelt Avenue between Seaver Way and Shea Road; commuter parking plus general guest parking. Commuter parking $6.00, open 3:30 a.m.-5:00 p.m. Mon-Fri

parkingLots.name: Stadium View West
parkingLots.notes: Remote lot north of Citi Field beneath the Whitestone Parkway overpass

parkingLots.name: Marina West
parkingLots.notes: Remote lot north of Citi Field along the marina; only available for special events

parkingLots.name: Bus Lot ("Pork Chop Hill")
parkingLots.notes: North of Citi Field on the west side of the Shea Road intersection; opens 2.5 hours prior. Bus parking $80.00

lines: Local Bus Q90 (formerly Q48, running along Seaver Way as of June 29, 2025)
publicTransit.notes: As MTA facilities, guests are directed to mta.info/guides/stadiums/citi-field-queens. The 7-Train Mets-Willets Point station has a game-day-only accessible exit from the Flushing-bound platform; the Manhattan-bound platform and the LIRR Mets-Willets Point station are not accessible (use Woodside for an accessible LIRR trip).

rideshareDropoff: Uber/Lyft/rideshare pick-up is in the Stadium View East parking lot underneath the highway just north of the Shea Road and Boat Basin Place intersection; exit on the third base side via the Left Field Gate, Stengel or Seaver VIP gates, or the Rotunda main exit and follow the app. Pregame drop-offs may be made along Seaver Way or Roosevelt Avenue. The rideshare zone is just north of the Left Field Gate near the Shea Road/Boat Basin Place intersection. Mobility-challenged guests (Access-A-Ride / accessible dispatch / rideshare) are best dropped off and picked up at the Bullpen Gate on Seaver Way.
accessibility: All entry points at Citi Field are ADA accessible; guests with accessibility needs may enter through the designated accessible Hodges, Seaver, or Stengel VIP entrances even without VIP tickets. The ballpark has 11 guest elevators, the Left Field Ramp providing access to all levels (behind sections 129/329/429), accessible/companion seating (over 800 locations), wheelchair entry service, and accessible parking spaces (for guests displaying a valid disability permit with a matching parking purchase). Accessibility Map PDF: https://mktg.mlbstatic.com/mets/downloads/2024_Mets_Accessibility_Map.pdf. Accessibility Services: 718-565-4360.
bagPolicyNotes: Backpacks are not permitted at Citi Field. Other bags are permitted, including purses, non-backpack-style diaper bags, tote, drawstring, fully clear backpack-style bags (no obscured inner pockets), and messenger-style bags, along with small soft-sided coolers. All bags and hand-carried items are searched prior to entry. Items can be no larger than 16"x16"x8". There are no bag check facilities inside Citi Field.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating in any form is not permitted in Lot G/Official Lot or Orange Reserved, and no organized/catered/pre-sold tailgates are permitted in the campus lot, Bus Lot, or Southfield Lot. Small personal gatherings are permitted in other lots only if: the vehicle is parked within one parking-space boundary (setup only in front of or behind the vehicle, never in a space); no saving spaces (all parties arrive together for consecutive spaces); tents/coolers/tables/grills fit within one space boundary; no open flames of any type; no consumption of alcohol; groups may combine spaces only equal to the number of vehicles, parked consecutively; tailgates must yield to traffic flow; and guests must bag their own trash (no trash bins in lots). Failure to comply may result in an NYPD summons and/or removal.

venueAccessRestrictions: All bags and hand-carried items are searched prior to entry. Glass bottles, all metal cans and containers, and hard-sided coolers are prohibited (exceptions: empty reusable metal water bottles and hollow can coolers). Guests may bring one factory-sealed plastic water bottle of 20 oz or less and one sealed soft-sided child's juice box per child (not frozen). Alcohol and controlled/illegal substances are prohibited. Other prohibited items include commercial audio/visual equipment, laser pointers, noisemaking devices, fireworks, animals (except service animals), pepper spray/mace, lighters, weapons, and drones (banned in the ballpark and parking lots). Smoking/vaping/smokeless tobacco is prohibited with no designated areas. Re-entry is not allowed: guests who exit will not be readmitted (limited exceptions require prior supervisor approval).
nearby: Willets Point Brewery (formerly EBBS) is on Seaver Way adjacent to the Right Field Gate, open on game days from when parking lots open until 60 minutes postgame; it can only be accessed by fully exiting the ballpark, and the ballpark's no-re-entry policy applies.
outsideFoodRules: Small soft-sided coolers are permitted. Unopened soft plastic bottles or juice boxes and wrapped food (or food contained in soft plastic, with no metal silverware) are permitted, subject to security search. Guests may bring one factory-sealed plastic water bottle of 20 oz or less and one sealed soft-sided child's juice box per child; water bottles and juice boxes may not be frozen. Glass bottles, metal cans/containers, and hard-sided coolers are prohibited.
food: Concessions include classic ballpark fare plus Kosher foods (hot dogs, knishes, pretzels; near Fan Fest and at sections 408 and 119), a gluten-friendly stand in the World's Fare Market (chicken fingers, fries, hamburgers, hot dogs) with gluten-free beer, Kids' Meals served in a souvenir Mets helmet, and the rotating Taste of Queens and Coca-Cola Corner food truck featuring local Queens-area restaurants. Premium clubs include Pat LaFrieda's Chop House, Hudson Whiskey NY Club, and the Metropolitan Market food hall.

gatesOpen.ruleText: All gates and ticket windows will open 90 minutes prior to the start of each game so that guests may arrive early to enjoy the amenities.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Gate opening times may vary for doubleheaders, concerts, and special pre-game ceremony game dates or highly attended games (Opening Day, Subway Series, Number Retirements, etc.); guests are advised to check the ticket in the MLB Ballpark app. Season Ticket Members receive early entry (30 minutes prior to regular gate opening) on promotional giveaway days only, at the Jackie Robinson Rotunda.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Exceptions to the bag policy can be made for bags used for ADA/medical reasons by the Security Supervisor at each entry gate.

name: Citizens Bank Park

parkingLots.name: Lot T (Uber RideShare Lot)
parkingLots.notes: Designated Uber RideShare lot for all Citizens Bank Park and Wells Fargo Center events. Fans exit the Third Base Gate and walk along Pattison Avenue toward Broad Street to enter the lot; it includes an Uber-branded lounge with seating and a charging station. On event days this is the only location to drop off and receive an Uber and other rideshare pickups.

parkingLots.name: Lots M and N
parkingLots.notes: Bus parking ($60); groups can prepay for bus parking here.

parkingLots.name: Lots V and R
parkingLots.notes: Limited (non-tailgating) bus parking available in between Lot V and R.

parkingLots.name: Lots A-H, M, N & O
parkingLots.notes: Tailgating permitted in these lots; tailgating lots open five hours prior to the scheduled start time.

parkingLots.name: Live! casino lots (North 10th Street)
parkingLots.notes: Preferred and Pre-Paid parking passes will not be accepted in the Live! casino lots; fans are encouraged to park in Phillies designated lots instead.

rideshareDropoff: Lot T is the designated Uber RideShare lot and, on event days, the only location to drop off and receive an Uber and other rideshare pickups. Fans exit the Third Base Gate and walk along Pattison Avenue toward Broad Street to enter the lot and request a vehicle. Drivers must be online and actively accepting trips to enter/remain in the zone; no parking or idling is permitted and unattended vehicles are subject to towing.
accessibility: Designed with an Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) consultant to be universally accessible. All guests enter on the Main Concourse at street level, and there are wheelchair-accessible gates at every bank of turnstiles. The ballpark is equipped with 15 elevators, escalators, ramps and stairways to service guests with disabilities; wheelchair and companion seating is available (Field, Pavilion/Arcade, Scoreboard Porch and Terrace levels); and wheelchair service can be requested at any entry gate.
bagPolicyNotes: Non-clear bags, including backpacks and drawstring bags, are prohibited. Clutch purses and fanny packs no larger than 5 x 7 inches, medical bags, and diaper bags are permitted alongside clear bags. Prohibited bags can be stored in lockers at the First Base Gate, the West Suite and Club Entrance, or the Left Field Gate for a 10 dollar cashless fee. All bags are subject to inspection upon entry.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is permitted in Lots A-H, M, N & O. Tailgating is not permitted in parking lots west of Darien Street and north of Pattison Avenue. Tailgating lots open five hours prior to the scheduled start time; non-tailgating lots open three hours prior. There is no advertising, selling, or vending of any kind in any Citizens Bank Park parking lot, including tailgates with an unapproved sponsor attached.

venueAccessRestrictions: There is a no re-entry policy in effect at Citizens Bank Park; tickets do not entitle the holder to reenter the ballpark after leaving the ticketed area. Citizens Bank Park is a smoke-free facility. Certified service dogs (or service dogs in training) for guests with special needs are welcome; all other animals are prohibited. Umbrellas are permitted. Prohibited items and security screening are governed by the Guest Code of Conduct.
food: A wide variety of food and beverages, from traditional ballpark fare to foods with Philadelphia flavor, plus healthier and gluten-free options; the park is rated among the top vegetarian ballparks in the country. Signature spots include Chickie's & Pete's Crabfries, Freddy's steakburgers, Bull's BBQ, Tony Luke's and Campo's. The concessionaire is a joint venture involving Aramark Sports + Entertainment, the Phillies and GM Concessions.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Regular season: Monday-Friday the Third Base Gate and Left Field Gate partially open 2 hours prior to first pitch (Pass & Stow, New Era Phillies Team Store, Coca-Cola Corner, Ashburn Alley, GHOST Energy Deck, The Yard and select seating); Saturday and Sunday those gates partially open 2 1/2 hours prior. The remaining gates and the entire ballpark open 90 minutes prior to first pitch. Times are subject to change.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: The Third Base Gate and Left Field Gate open earlier for partial access (2 hours before first pitch Monday-Friday; 2 1/2 hours before first pitch Saturday and Sunday), while all remaining gates and the full ballpark open 90 minutes before first pitch.
tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Tailgating lots open five hours prior to the scheduled start time; non-tailgating lots open three hours prior to the scheduled start time.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Clutch purses and fanny packs no larger than 5 x 7 inches, plus medical bags and diaper bags, are permitted without being clear.

name: Climate Pledge Arena

parkingLots.name: Arena Garage
parkingLots.notes: Climate Pledge Arena operated, accessed via underground, has complimentary EV charging stations; one of the closest ADA parking options. Pre-purchase for events via the venue or Kraken + CPA Mobile App.

parkingLots.name: 1st Ave N Garage
parkingLots.notes: Climate Pledge Arena operated, located across Lenny Wilkens Way south of the Arena; one of the closest ADA parking options. Contains Bike Link bicycle lockers.

parkingLots.name: 5th Ave Garage
parkingLots.notes: Seattle Center operated, located on the east side of campus.

publicTransit.notes: All guests receive a free King County public transit pass alongside their ticket for every publicly ticketed event, usable from two hours before doors open to two hours after the event, and also valid on the Seattle Center Monorail. The Monorail is a 90-second ride from downtown Seattle to Seattle Center, a short walk from the arena. Bus and Light Rail service the arena and Seattle Center; use the King County trip planner to plan a ride.

rideshareDropoff: Lyft is the official rideshare partner. Pre-event: rideshare vehicles are prohibited from dropping off on 1st Ave N; best drop-off locations are Republican St & Warren Ave N, MoPOP turnaround, Mercer St (McCaw Hall Drop Off Zone), and Denny Way (Pacific Science Center Drop Off Zone). Post-event: for 45 minutes rideshare pickup is prohibited on 1st Ave N; the two pickup locations are the MoPOP Museum and the Space Needle (Broad St).
accessibility: All parking garages on campus have ADA accessible parking spaces (closest ADA parking is in the Arena Garage and 1st Ave N Garage); spaces cannot be reserved. Wheelchair and low-mobility (semi-ambulatory) seating is available on all levels, purchasable on Ticketmaster. Limited-mobility drop-off locations are along 1st Ave N (running the length of the building and half a block past Harrison Street) and at Republican and Warren Street at the north end of the Seattle Center campus. Ten elevators serve ticket holders and guests with disabilities, plus elevators in the arena garage. Accessible entries: one lane at each of Alaska Airlines Entry 1 and Entry 8 is designated for guests with disabilities, and Entry 3 (NW side) for American Express Hall. Complimentary assistive listening devices, closed captioning, ASL interpreting (10 business days notice), sensory bags and a Sensory Room, wheelchair assistance, and service animals (ADA) are available. All public restrooms are wheelchair accessible.
bagPolicyNotes: Guests are encouraged not to bring a bag if possible. Permitted bags: ONE bag (clear or other) no larger than 14 in x 14 in x 6 in, 2 pockets maximum, OR one small clutch/purse/wallet no larger than 4 in x 6 in x 1.5 in. All bags larger than a clutch (including medical, diaper/parenting, and clear bags) must go through X-ray screening at designated bag lines located at primary entries. Exceptions are made for medically necessary items and diaper/parenting bags. Binocular cases must be no larger than 4 in x 6 in x 1.5 in. Security reserves the right to inspect all bags prior to entry.
venueAccessRestrictions: Exit and re-entry is not permitted at Climate Pledge Arena. The venue is a cashless facility (Apple Pay, Google Pay, and major credit cards accepted; a reverse ATM converts cash to a VISA card). The arena is a smoke-free, vape-free venue. Camping and the use of tents on the arena plaza is prohibited.
nearby: Located on the Seattle Center campus, convenient to Seattle Center and the Uptown neighborhood. Nearby landmarks include the Space Needle, MoPOP, Pacific Science Center, McCaw Hall, and the Seattle Center Monorail station.
outsideFoodRules: Outside alcohol, food, and beverage are prohibited (listed as prohibited items). Reusable non-glass water bottles up to 32 oz are permitted and must be empty upon entry.
food: The food and beverage program at Climate Pledge Arena (branded the Climate Collective) is run with partner Delaware North and offers marketplaces, clubs, and lounges with Pacific Northwest sourced, sustainability-focused menus. Availability varies by event. The arena participates in a Liquor & Cannabis Board pilot allowing guests to move freely around the arena with mixed drinks.

gatesOpen.ruleText: For Seattle Storm games, all doors will open 60 minutes prior to tipoff.

name: Coca-Cola Coliseum

parkingLots.name: Lot 2
parkingLots.notes: Surface lot off Princes' Blvd (on the left-hand side when approaching from the west); operated by Exhibition Place

parkingLots.name: Lot 3
parkingLots.notes: Surface lot off Princes' Blvd (on the right-hand side when approaching from the west); operated by Exhibition Place

parkingLots.name: Enercare Centre underground/indoor lot
parkingLots.notes: Formerly the Direct Energy Centre; accessed via Canada Boulevard. No direct elevator access to Coca-Cola Coliseum from this underground parking. Operated by Exhibition Place

accessibility: In accordance with the AODA, Coca-Cola Coliseum is committed to identifying, removing and preventing barriers for people with disabilities (see MLSE Accessibility Policy). Elevators are located inside the main entrance by the Fan Services Desk for access to upper-level bowl seating, accessible seating and suite levels. Patrons requiring accessible parking should park in a surface lot directly outside the facility; there is no direct elevator access to the Coliseum from the Enercare Centre underground parking.
bagPolicyNotes: MLSE strongly encourages fans not to bring any bags. Permitted item: a small purse/clutch-type bag smaller than 16.5cm x 11.5cm (6.5" x 4.5"), with or without a handle or strap. All bags are subject to security search. Bags that do not meet the criteria will not be permitted entry. For medical or other reasons, a bag outside the policy is permitted subject to contacting MLSE for security inspection of the bag and contents. Policy subject to change without notice based on league, promoter or other requirements.
venueAccessRestrictions: Fully cashless venue: only debit and credit cards accepted, including major contactless and mobile payment methods; no cash accepted. Tickets are mobile-only, delivered digitally and scanned from fans' mobile devices via the Ticketmaster app. Dedicated entrance gates: the entry/gate number is listed on the mobile ticket above the barcode and fans must enter through the specified gate.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Doors open 75 minutes prior to tip-off.

name: College Park Center

parkingLots.name: Three adjacent parking garages just north of College Park Center
parkingLots.notes: Parking is available in three adjacent parking garages just north of the Center. Parking rates vary by event; see the specific event details page for rate information.

rideshareDropoff: College Park Center typically offers drop-off and pick-up areas at Gate 1, at the intersection of Spaniolo Drive and Third Street, and at Moritz Plaza, at the intersection of Spaniolo Drive and Second Street. Buses and cars may drop off and pick up near Arlington Hall, but vehicles are not permitted to park there. Drop-off locations occasionally change due to road closures.
accessibility: College Park Center meets or exceeds ADA requirements with at-grade entries, 71 wheelchair positions at the concourse level with 71 adjacent companion seats, assisted listening devices, and three passenger elevators. ADA accessible seating and companion seating is available on the main concourse level in sections 101, 103, 104 and 107. Guest Services (behind section 103) offers wheelchair escorts, assisted listening device checkout, and lost and found; it opens 30 minutes before scheduled door time. One elevator is inside Gate 1 and two are on the main concourse near sections 104-105 and 110. Service animals are permitted in accordance with ADA regulations. Sign language interpretation can be requested at least 45 days prior. ADA accessible parking spaces are offered in all on-site garages and lots open for the event. The venue is KultureCity Sensory Inclusive Certified with sensory bags and quiet areas (First Aid room by section 105 and Nancy Best Terrace by section 109). Family restrooms are near sections 106 and 114, and a nursing room is near section 108. Contact 817-272-5584 or cpc@uta.edu.
bagPolicyNotes: A clear bag policy is in full effect for all events at College Park Center. Bags are subject to inspection before entry and metal detectors may be used for some events. Approved bags: clear plastic storage bag (one gallon re-sealable); clear tote bag (plastic, vinyl, or PVC) not exceeding 12" x 6" x 12"; small clutch purse no larger than 4.5" x 8.5" with or without a handle or strap; and medically necessary items including small diaper bags (with accompanying infant/child) after inspection at a designated gate. Prohibited bags: backpacks, large bags, fanny packs, purses, binocular cases (may be worn on neck), briefcases, camera or computer bags, cinch bags, coolers, large diaper bags, seat cushions, and luggage of any kind.
venueAccessRestrictions: All patrons are required to submit to security screening before entry, including bag check, hand-wanding, and walk-through magnetometers. College Park Center reserves the right to deny entry or eject any guest who declines to be searched or who breaches venue policies or brings prohibited items. Prohibited items include outside food, beverage and alcohol, weapons of any kind, glass containers, laser pointers, artificial noisemakers, helium balloons, tripods/monopods, glitter/confetti/streamers, and large signs or flags larger than 11x17" or with poles or sticks. The University of Texas at Arlington is a tobacco-free campus; use of tobacco products and e-cigs is prohibited inside or outside the arena.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food or beverage are not allowed in College Park Center. Guests may dispose of or return to their vehicles any unauthorized items prior to entering; items will not be stored, secured, or kept for return. For special dietary needs, infant needs, and medical concerns, contact Guest Services or call 817-272-5584. Policies may vary for concerts and special events.
food: Concession stands and kiosks on the main concourse offer fan favorites such as barbecue, hot dogs, nachos, pizza, popcorn, soda, and beer. Cash and credit cards are accepted at concessions; kiosks are cash only. All concessions are provided by an exclusive in-house food vendor. Alcohol sales vary by event type; guests must be 21 with valid ID, and beer sales are limited to two per customer per purchase.

name: Comerica Park

parkingLots.name: 61 E. Elizabeth lot
parkingLots.notes: Olympia Parking facility with ADA-compliant accessible spaces; one of the closest accessible parking areas to Comerica Park

parkingLots.name: McLaren Garage
parkingLots.notes: Has the closest accessible parking spaces to Comerica Park

parkingLots.name: Tiger Garage
parkingLots.notes: Suite access via pedestrian bridge and elevators at that entrance

publicTransit.notes: Detroit Department of Transportation (DDOT) bus service; Detroit People Mover; QLINE streetcar service; Windsor Tunnel Bus; private car services (Metro Cars, Checker Cab).

rideshareDropoff: Witherell and Adams Street at Rocket Entry (designated drop-off / pick-up area).
accessibility: Comerica Park meets ADA requirements. Accessible and companion seating throughout the ballpark with unobstructed views (limited screened seats behind home plate, sections 125-130). All Olympia Parking facilities have ADA-compliant spaces (61 E. Elizabeth lot and McLaren Garage closest); accessible drop-off at Adams Ave and Witherell St. Access via ramps (Montcalm at 125/325, Brush St at 140/340, plus 119/141 in the lower bowl), elevators behind sections 109 and 130, and upward-only escalators at section 121. Accessible and companion/family restrooms, braille signage, service animals allowed, and free KultureCity sensory bags available at Guest Services (Section 130).
bagPolicyNotes: Single-compartment bags, wallets and clutches smaller than 4" x 6" x 1.5" (with or without a handle or strap) are permitted; bags, purses and clutches larger than 4" x 6" x 1.5" are prohibited, including bags for laptops, tablets, iPads, cameras and binoculars. Clear bags are permitted but not required. Authorized diaper/parenting and medical-necessity bags up to 16" x 16" x 8" are allowed via the ADA lane. All bags are inspected upon entry.
venueAccessRestrictions: Upon entry, permitted bags are searched and guests must pass through a walk-through metal detector; guests may opt out but are then subject to handheld metal-detector or alternative screening. No re-entry once tickets are scanned. There is no ballpark access from the Beer Hall. No knives or weapons of any kind, plus an extensive prohibited-items list (alcohol, outside food/beverage, coolers, aerosols, noisemakers, drones, laser pointers, professional cameras, etc.).
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverage of any kind is prohibited except for religious, dietary or medical necessity. Guests may bring a single bottle of water in a clear, factory-sealed plastic container 20 oz or less, or a single crushable empty plastic water bottle 20 oz or less. Single-serving food is permitted for religious, dietary or medical necessity.

name: Coors Field

parkingLots.name: Lot A
parkingLots.notes: Official main lot immediately adjacent to Coors Field, just outside Gate A in right field; paved, lit and fenced; day-of-game price $23-$28; credit cards only, no cash; accessible parking located here; walk time 1-10 minutes to Gate A.

parkingLots.name: Lot B
parkingLots.notes: Adjacent to Coors Field, just beyond Lot A between Blake Street and the railroad tracks; day-of-game price $18-$23; includes a covered parking garage with 950 spaces, accessible parking and four EV charging stations; complimentary shuttle to Gate A; walk time 10-20 minutes. Limited day-of-game parking may be available here if advance passes are sold out.

parkingLots.name: VIP Parking Lot
parkingLots.notes: At the corner of 22nd and Blake; site of valet service ($40-$45), which starts two hours before games and closes one hour after.

publicTransit.notes: RTD offers bus and Light Rail service throughout Metro Denver. Three Light Rail stations are convenient to the ballpark; the most convenient is Denver Union Station, reached via the A, B, C, E, G or W Lines and a short walk to the stadium.

rideshareDropoff: There are two Uber pick-up and drop-off areas at Coors Field (current locations posted on the Rockies transportation page).
accessibility: Approximately 1,000 accessible and companion seats throughout the ballpark (available on all levels). Accessible parking is in Lot A adjacent to Gate A on a first-come, first-served basis. Accessible/disabled drop-off is across from Gate B at 22nd and Blake Streets. Two ADA-compliant access ramps on the east (Gate A) and west (Gate E) sides. Wheelchair service is available, plus closed captioning via the MLB Ballpark app.
bagPolicyNotes: Only soft-sided, single-pocket bags and containers 16"x16"x8" or smaller are permitted. Backpacks and other multi-pocket bags, including multi-pocket purses, are prohibited, as are hard-sided coolers and containers of any size. All permitted bags are subject to search upon entry and within the ballpark; larger or prohibited items may be claim-checked at the tent outside Gate E.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is not permitted in any Rockies-operated parking lot. Alcohol consumption is prohibited in the parking lots, including inside vehicles.

venueAccessRestrictions: All guests entering Coors Field are searched for prohibited items at the five entry gates, with a thorough inspection of jackets, bags, purses and containers; guests are also subject to metal detection screening. No re-entry: during games guests are not permitted to leave the ballpark and return. Prohibited items include firearms and weapons, knives, hard-sided coolers/containers, backpacks and multi-pocket bags, outside alcohol, marijuana in any form, glass bottles, aluminum/metal cans, drones and laser pointers.
nearby: Located in Lower Downtown (LoDo). The adjacent McGregor Square plaza, the walkable Dairy Block microdistrict, the National Ballpark Museum (one block away), Denver Union Station, and numerous LoDo restaurants and bars (Tom's Watch Bar, ViewHouse Ballpark, Jackson's LoDo, Wynkoop Brewing Company, The Cruise Room) are within walking distance.
outsideFoodRules: Fans may bring their own food in individual portions packaged in soft-sided bags or containers. Factory-sealed plastic water bottles or empty plastic/aluminum water bottles (to fill at the stadium) are permitted. Fruits or vegetables larger than a grapefruit must be sliced.
food: Coors Field offers classic stadium fare plus local specialties including the famous Helton Burger, Rocky Mountain Oysters, Polidori Sausage, and craft beer brewed on-site at SandLot Brewery (the first brewery inside a major league ballpark and birthplace of Blue Moon).

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates A and E open 2 hours before first pitch (for batting-practice viewing in the outfield Pavilion and Rooftop); Gates B, C and D open 1.5 hours (90 minutes) before first pitch.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Staggered gate openings: Gates A and E open 2 hours before first pitch, Gates B, C and D open 90 minutes before. Gate opening times may vary if a game is rescheduled.

parkingLots.notes: North and northwest of the stadium, off Nimitz and Washington

parkingLots.notes: Inside Gates 5 and 6 on Robert B Cullum Blvd, the main entrance gates

parkingLots.name: Lot 15A
parkingLots.notes: Outermost east lot off S Haskell Ave; the walk-in lot for RV-area guests

publicTransit.notes: The DART Green Line is the only rail line serving Fair Park. MLK, Jr. Station (1412 S. Trunk Ave.) is the shortest walk to the stadium via Gate 6 and has about 200 free spaces at the adjacent J.B. Jackson, Jr. Transit Center, so it doubles as a park and ride. Fair Park Station (3710 Parry Ave.) serves the main Parry Avenue entrance and has no public parking. From downtown, transfer to the Green Line at Pearl/Arts District or Akard; Orange Line riders from DFW Airport transfer at Bachman.

bagPolicyNotes: Clear bag policy in effect for all events at Cotton Bowl Stadium. Approved: one clear plastic bag or tote up to 12 by 6 by 12 inches, a one-gallon clear resealable storage bag, or a non-clear clutch or purse no larger than 4.5 by 6.5 inches. Medical device bags are permitted and are searched at the gate. Prohibited: backpacks, coolers, hard-sided bags, cans, plastic bottles and thermoses. Note the surrounding State Fair grounds allow a larger 9 by 10 by 12 inch clear bag and soft-shell coolers, so a bag that clears the fairgrounds gate can still be turned away at the stadium gate. The stadium policy is the stricter one.
nearby: Inside Fair Park. The 2026 Red River Rivalry on October 10 falls inside the State Fair of Texas (September 25 to October 18), so fairtime paid parking applies on game day rather than the free non-event-day rate, and parking gates open at 9:30 a.m.

name: Crypto.com Arena

parkingLots.notes: 900 Chick Hearn Court. Clearance 7 ft 0 in. Opens 2.5 hours prior to an event. Passes not valid for limos, buses, sprinter vans, and oversized vehicles; oversized vehicles not accepted in Lot 1.

parkingLots.name: Southwest VIP (SW VIP)
parkingLots.notes: 900 Chick Hearn Court. Clearance 7 ft 0 in. Passes not valid for limos, buses, sprinter vans, and oversized vehicles.

parkingLots.name: Lot W (West Garage) - Gate B
parkingLots.notes: 1005 Chick Hearn Court. Clearance 8 ft 2 in. Recommended for events 3.5 hours or longer; flat rate $10-$50 plus city parking tax depending on event; Gate B opens 3.5 hours prior to event. Includes designated disabled parking spaces.

parkingLots.name: Lot W (West Garage) - Gate D
parkingLots.notes: 1015 Chick Hearn Court. Clearance 8 ft 2 in. Passes not valid for limos, buses, sprinter vans, and oversized vehicles.

parkingLots.name: Lot W (West Garage) - Gate E & F
parkingLots.notes: 1015 Georgia Street. Clearance 8 ft 2 in. Open 6 AM-2 AM daily (holiday hours may vary). Timed parking: $10 first 2 hours, $15 each additional half hour ($40 daily max), $40 event parking. Includes EV charging stations.

parkingLots.name: Lot E (East Garage)
parkingLots.notes: 888 West Olympic Boulevard. Clearance 8 ft 2 in. Open 6 AM-2 AM daily. Timed parking, $40 max. Includes designated disabled parking and EV charging stations.

parkingLots.name: Lot 12
parkingLots.notes: 832 Francisco Street, Los Angeles, CA 90017. Opens 90 minutes prior to an event.

publicTransit.notes: Crypto.com Arena is blocks from the Metro A and B Lines. Nearest Metro Rail stop is Pico Station (A and E Lines); 7th St/Metro Center Station is also nearby for transfers. Metro Bus lines 28, 30, 81, 460 and the J Line stop near L.A. LIVE. DASH Bus Route F has several stops on Figueroa St. adjacent to L.A. LIVE, though from August 5 to November 5, 2026, southbound buses are on detour between 6 a.m. and 5 p.m. and skip the stop at Figueroa St. and Pico Blvd., with the nearest listed alternative at Figueroa St. and 12th St. Metrolink and Amtrak connect to Downtown LA where riders transfer to Metro Rail.

rideshareDropoff: Designated ride share / taxi pick-up and drop-off areas are the white zone on Chick Hearn Ct. (Eastbound) between L.A. Live Way and Georgia St., and the white zone on Figueroa St. (Southbound) between 12th St and Pico. Obey posted signs; LAPD enforces No Stopping signs throughout the district.
accessibility: Designated accessible parking, including van-accessible spaces, is available for vehicles displaying a current state-issued disability placard or license plate, on a first come first served basis (Parking Services (213) 765-6815). Complimentary wheelchair escorts are available from Guest Services at any entrance, or by calling (213) 742-7326 on arrival.
bagPolicyNotes: Bags, backpacks, purses, totes, clear bags, fanny packs, and camera bags are not allowed. Small clutches and wallets smaller than 5 in x 9 in x 1 in are permitted and subject to security inspection. Medical and parental bags smaller than 14 in x 14 in x 6 in are permitted but must go through X-Ray screening. Guests with larger bags can rent a Binbox Locker adjacent to the Kobe Bryant Entrance next to the LA Kings Monument.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is prohibited in any of the L.A. LIVE and Crypto.com Arena parking lots.
tailgating.rvPolicy: Space for oversized vehicles (limousines, buses, RVs) is very limited; arrangements should be made 10 days prior to the event by calling (213) 765-6815 for a prepaid pass. Oversized vehicles are not accepted in Lot 1. No overnight parking or in-and-out privileges are permitted.

venueAccessRestrictions: Re-entry is permitted: guests leaving must have their ticket scanned by a Guest Services team member and repeat security screening and ticket scanning to re-enter. Crypto.com Arena is a smoke-free venue; smoking is not permitted anywhere, including all outdoor patios and terraces. Children 3 years and older require a ticket to enter.
nearby: Crypto.com Arena is adjacent to the L.A. LIVE sports and entertainment district. A full list of nearby restaurants and entertainment options is available at lalive.com.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverages are not permitted inside the arena. Unopened plastic water bottles, one liter or smaller, are permitted (one per person).
food: Crypto.com Arena offers Kosher and Gluten-free food options inside the arena.

parkingLots.notes: Closest official parking option, divided into north and south lots. Handicap accessible parking available. Starting at $10.

parkingLots.name: Lot B
parkingLots.notes: Accessible from St. Emanuel Street or Charters Street. Must walk under 59 to access Daikin Park. Starting at $10.

parkingLots.name: Lot D
parkingLots.notes: Located at Congress and Crawford. Only accessible from Congress Street. Starting at $10.

parkingLots.name: Lot E
parkingLots.notes: Located at Crawford and Preston Street (accessible from both). Starting at $30.

parkingLots.name: 314 La Branch Street Lot
parkingLots.notes: 0.1 mi from Daikin Park. Starting at $50.

parkingLots.name: Avenida North Garage
parkingLots.notes: 0.4 mi from Daikin Park. Connected to the north end of George R. Brown Convention Center. Starting at $35.

parkingLots.name: Christ Church Garage (511 San Jacinto Street)
parkingLots.notes: 0.4 mi from Daikin Park. $20.

parkingLots.name: Star Garage (703 Fannin Street)
parkingLots.notes: 0.5 mi from Daikin Park. $10.

parkingLots.name: 803 Fannin Street Garage
parkingLots.notes: 0.5 mi from Daikin Park. $15.

parkingLots.name: 1001 McKinney Street Garage
parkingLots.notes: 0.7 mi from Daikin Park. $10.

rideshareDropoff: RideShare pick-up and drop-off is located just outside the Center Field Gate on Crawford Street between Preston Street and Congress Avenue.
accessibility: Daikin Park meets and exceeds all requirements of the Americans with Disabilities Act. Wheelchair seating is available throughout the ballpark, and courtesy wheelchair service is offered at all home games. An elevator on the first base side near Section 128 is designated for guests with mobility limitations. Assistive Listening Devices, a captioning board, TDD text telephones, and braille/tactile signage are available. Approximately 25,000 parking spaces within a half-mile radius include many ADA spaces.
bagPolicyNotes: Bags larger than 16” x 16” x 8” are prohibited. Backpacks are prohibited, with possible exceptions for diaper bags, single-compartment drawstring bags, and other bags used for medical reasons if within the MLB bag size (16” x 16” x 8”). Soft-sided coolers within the MLB bag size are allowed; hard-sided and Styrofoam coolers are prohibited. All bags are checked at all gates prior to entry.

tailgating.rules: Tailgate parties will not be allowed on any of the facility parking lots. The Houston Police Department strictly enforces open container laws in Downtown Houston.

venueAccessRestrictions: Both handheld and walk-through metal detectors are used at all gates. There is no re-entry into the ballpark once fans are scanned in. Prohibited items include aerosol cans, alcohol, weapons, drones, coolers (hard-sided/Styrofoam), poles or sticks, noise makers, laser pointers, and cameras with lenses larger than 8 inches, among others.
outsideFoodRules: Guests may bring food into Daikin Park for Astros games contained in a clear plastic bag no larger than one gallon in size, one bag per guest. Guests may also bring in a factory-sealed, clear plastic bottle of water no larger than one liter, one bottle per guest. This policy is specific to Astros game-related events and does not apply to special events such as concerts or corporate events.
food: Concessions are provided by ARAMARK, with a variety of food and beverage available at concession stands and portable carts throughout the ballpark. Signature offerings include Whataburger favorites (#1, #2, and #3 burgers, fries, onion rings, and shakes) in center field on the main concourse, plus Shake Shack.

gatesOpen.ruleText: The gates of Daikin Park open two hours prior to game time unless otherwise stated. Full ballpark access is available when gates open.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Gate times are subject to change.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Backpacks are prohibited, with possible exceptions for diaper bags, single-compartment drawstring bags, and other bags used for medical reasons if they are within the MLB bag size requirement not to exceed 16” x 16” x 8”.

name: Darrell K Royal–Texas Memorial Stadium

parkingLots.name: East Campus Garage
parkingLots.notes: Individual/day-of-game parking passes available here when purchased by midnight before a game; also used for ADA/special-accommodation parking ($30 per vehicle)

parkingLots.name: Lot 118
parkingLots.notes: ADA shuttles to/from DKR-Texas Memorial Stadium are provided from Lot 118

parkingLots.name: Lot 40
parkingLots.notes: REVELxp reserved tailgate parking permits, based on availability

rideshareDropoff: Rideshare Dropoff Zone located on Dean Keeton between Robert Dedman Drive and Red River Street (north of the stadium)
accessibility: Certified service dogs (leash/harness) welcome; no other animals. Ramp access at Gates 7, 14, 16, and 27. ADA seating accessed via elevators: West side Bellmont Hall Gate 7, Red McCombs Red Zone (north end zone) Gate 14, East side Gate 27; interior single-story elevator inside Gate 7 connects sides. Accessible stalls in all restrooms; closed captioning on the Freddie Steinmark Scoreboard. Fan Services golf-cart shuttles transport mobility, hearing, or visually impaired fans closer to the gates. ADA-compliant parking spaces plus 'special accommodation' spaces closer to the venue or at Lot 118, with ADA shuttles provided to/from the stadium.

tailgating.rules: Open tailgating permitted in any of the yellow-marked spaces on the tailgating map; fans with parking permits in the purple-marked surface lots may tailgate in those lots. REVELxp reserved tailgates are the only way to tailgate in the red areas of the gameday map. Fans asked to throw away trash and recycle aluminum/plastic/glass in the provided blue recyclable bags.
tailgating.timeWindow: Tents and tailgate setups are allowed beginning at 7 a.m. on gamedays
tailgating.grillRules: Dispose of any remaining charcoal and ashes in the containers provided; REVELxp reserved tailgate spaces do NOT permit fire cooking and/or grilling

venueAccessRestrictions: No re-entry permitted for Texas Football games at Darrell K Royal-Texas Memorial Stadium. Guests and their belongings may be searched on entry; entering the stadium constitutes consent to search, and declining a search means being denied entry.
outsideFoodRules: No outside food or drink is permitted inside the stadium. Snacks needed for medical purposes are allowed. One sealed (soft plastic) bottle of water up to one liter is permitted; no other outside beverages or beverage containers are permitted (including Yeti or similar products). Free water fountains are available to refill.
food: Concession stands offer a variety of food and beverages. All concessions and merchandise transactions are contactless and cashless (credit, debit, and prepaid gift cards only). Cash-to-Card kiosks (Hall of Fame and Gate 7) let fans exchange cash for Visa gift cards.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates open 2 hours prior to kickoff (3 hours for UT students who are Big Ticket holders with Football at ShopBack Gate (formerly Gate 25)). Gate entry will be listed on the ticket.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: UT student Big Ticket holders may enter 3 hours prior to kickoff at Gate 25
tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Tents and tailgate setups allowed beginning at 7 a.m. on gamedays (parking lots open 7 a.m., or 6 a.m. for 11 a.m. kickoffs); no overnight parking
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Clutch bags, purses, or wallets smaller than 4.5" x 6.5" do not have to be clear; medically necessary items permitted after inspection at designated areas; items normally carried in a diaper bag must be placed in a clear bag

name: David Booth Kansas Memorial Stadium

parkingLots.name: Lot 11
parkingLots.notes: No Williams Fund permit needed; sold first come, first served for $35, credit card only.

parkingLots.name: Lot 72
parkingLots.notes: No Williams Fund permit needed; sold first come, first served for $35, credit card only; 13 accessible spaces near the game shuttle.

parkingLots.name: Allen Fieldhouse Garage
parkingLots.notes: No Williams Fund permit needed; sold first come, first served for $35, credit card only; game shuttle pickup outside the garage (stop 216).

parkingLots.name: Lot 90
parkingLots.notes: Discounted parking near Capital Federal Hall, $10 per stall; the only RV parking; game shuttle pickup at Naismith & Schwegler (stop 257) at the NW corner of the lot.

parkingLots.name: Mississippi Street Garage
parkingLots.notes: Williams Fund game permit required; 17 accessible spaces sold at $35 first come, first served, credit card only.

parkingLots.name: Lot 59
parkingLots.notes: Williams Fund game permit required; 14 accessible spaces sold at $35 first come, first served, credit card only.

parkingLots.name: Lot 54
parkingLots.notes: Williams Fund game permit required; 3 accessible spaces near the game shuttle.

publicTransit.notes: Complimentary KU game shuttles run to the stadium from Economy Lot 90, with a pickup on Naismith Drive, and from Irving Hill Road at Lot 54 for reserved season parking pass holders and Allen Fieldhouse Parking Garage guests. Shuttle service begins three hours before kickoff, operates continuously until kickoff, resumes at the start of the fourth quarter and continues until 30 minutes after the game; paratransit-equipped buses operate from both Lot 54 and Lot 90. Golf cart courtesy shuttles carry fans between the surrounding lots and the stadium gates, with the east shuttle serving lots 91 and the Mississippi Street bus stop and the west shuttle serving lots 56, 57 and 60, from three hours before the game until 15 minutes into the first quarter, again as needed after halftime, and for 30 minutes after the game; call (785) 429-4295 on game day with specific needs.

rideshareDropoff: The preferred rideshare drop-off and pickup location is one block east of the stadium near the intersection of 11th and Indiana streets, in the four northernmost metered spots in front of the HERE apartment complex.
accessibility: Accessible parking is sold on site by KU Transportation Services for $35 per vehicle on a first-come, first-served basis in Lot 59 (12 spaces) and Lot 91 (5 spaces); a state-issued accessible license plate or hang tag must be displayed, and Williams Education Fund season parking passes are not valid in accessible spaces. If those lots are full, paratransit-equipped shuttle buses run to and from the stadium from Lot 54 (6 accessible spaces, enter from Irving Hill Road), the Allen Fieldhouse Parking Garage (12 spaces) and Lot 90; additional accessible spaces, listed without shuttle service or an accessible path to the stadium, are in Lot 52 (8), Lots 36/39 (9) and the Mississippi Street Parking Garage (17). Wheelchair seating holds one person plus up to three companions if space is available and is reached by elevators on the east and west sides; limited mobility seating is on the third level near the elevators, and fans should contact the Athletics Ticket Office at (785) 864-3141 as early as possible to trade tickets for those seats. Golf cart courtesy shuttles carry fans needing assistance from the surrounding lots to the stadium gates starting three hours before the game; call (785) 429-4295 on game day with specific needs. Walk-through metal detector lanes are not accessible for wheelchairs and other assistive devices, and hand-held metal detectors are used for guests who cannot use them; guests with medical devices should notify Event Staff to be assisted through screening. A sensory room is on the main concourse outside sections 118 and 312.
bagPolicyNotes: Purses larger than a clutch bag (5.5" x 8.5" max) are prohibited, as are fanny packs, diaper bags, mesh bags and tinted plastic totes; a clear plastic bag may not be greater than 12" x 6" x 12". Camera and binocular cases and chairbacks are also prohibited.
venueAccessRestrictions: Patrons are subject to inspection of their person, bags, and clothing capable of concealing prohibited items. Patrons may refuse inspections but management reserves the right to refuse entry.
nearby: Three official pregame areas around the stadium open three hours before kickoff. Gameday Boulevard is a closed stretch of 11th Street from Maine to Illinois with food, beer and beverages from Tap That KC, game-day activities and music; Gameday on the Hill is a free-to-enter tailgate area at the base of The Hill with music, high-top and picnic tables, tailgating games, food trucks, and beverages and beer from Tap That KC; and the Family Fun Zone on the practice fields adjacent to The Hill has tailgating games, inflatables and other activities for kids. Reserved full-service tailgate packages on Campanile Hill are sold through REVELxp at revelxp.com/kansas or (785) 727-4122.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food is not permitted in the stadium. Each ticket holder may bring one unopened 20 oz. plastic bottle of water and one empty plastic refillable water bottle up to 32 oz.; metal bottles, cans, other liquid containers and coolers are prohibited, and no alcohol, including non-alcoholic beer and wine, may be brought in.
food: General concessions open in all areas when the gates open and are located throughout the west-side concourses. The student-only Hawks Huddle stand, with student pricing, is under section 132 at the south end of the stadium, and food trucks set up at the southeast corner starting 30 minutes before kickoff to serve the east and south seating. Bottle filling stations and water fountains are on the main and view level concourses on the west and north sides and at the bottom of sections 17 and 26 on the east side.
