parkingLots.notes: Public ADA pass purchased online during game week (sales close Friday 11 p.m.); ADA hang tag/plate required; not sold day-of

accessibility: ADA seating: West side Sections 1, 6 & 7; East side Sections 24 & 25 (contact MSU ticket office in advance to request). ADA public parking at Research Park (North, off Hwy 182), Animal & Dairy Science Building (South, off Hailstate Blvd), and online-purchase ADA Lot D; state ADA placard/plate required. ADA transit service begins 4 hours before kickoff (North lot to Old Main Academic Center; South lot to Newell-Grissom) and runs until 2 hours after the game; disability carts connect the ADA transit terminals to Gate L (Old Main) and Gate F (Newell-Grissom). Elevators near Sections 1/8, 10, and 18/23. Accessible accommodations in all public restrooms; family restrooms near Gates E and G1 and the Gridiron/Scoreboard Clubs. A limited number of wheelchairs are available at the First Aid Station (none for rent).

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is permitted only in areas where traffic or parking is not obstructed, and tailgaters must follow picnic-zone regulations. Small tents are permitted with stakes no larger than 1/4 inch in diameter and no longer than 6 inches, and no ropes; larger tents must be rented from Southern Tradition Tailgating (any service charging to set up more than 10 tailgate setups is not allowed on campus). Personal tents or supplies may not be placed to hold tailgating spots until 5 a.m. the day before home games. Connection to university utilities is strictly prohibited. Pets/animals are prohibited in tailgating areas on gameday (service animals excepted; pets banned campus-wide from noon the day before). Center-campus roads close 4 hours before kickoff.
tailgating.timeWindow: Tailgate tents may be dropped off in designated areas starting 5 a.m. Friday. All picnic areas open at 4 p.m. the day before the game and close at midnight daily; areas must be cleared/vacated by 7 a.m. the day after the game.
tailgating.grillRules: Charcoal grills are allowed, but charcoal must be fully extinguished and disposed of responsibly; fire pits are not allowed. Generators are allowed but battery inverters are preferred. No wheeled vehicles or trailers (e.g., large grills pulled by a vehicle) are permitted in tailgating areas. Cooking-size propane containers are prohibited inside the stadium.
tailgating.rvPolicy: Public RV parking is at the Mississippi Horse Park south of campus (reservations 662-325-9350); transit is provided with drop-off at Newell-Grissom. Reserved RV hook-up lots 26, 34, and 38 open at 6 p.m. Thursday for football weekends (no unauthorized vehicles admitted after 3 p.m.; those remaining after 5 p.m. relocated). For a Thursday night game, RVs may enter reserved lots Wednesday at 6 p.m. and must vacate by 7 a.m. Monday. RV lot 29 at the Scales Building opens 10 a.m. Friday before gameday.

outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverages are not permitted, other than one clear, colorless, full or empty water bottle per person (permitted for all games). Non-clear, color-tinted, stainless steel, or other non-clear containers are not permitted. Free water-bottle refill stations are available inside the stadium.

name: Dick's Sporting Goods Park

parkingLots.name: Lot A / Lot AA
parkingLots.notes: East side of the stadium, directly outside Gate A. General Public and Permit Holders; reserved for Season Ticket Members during Colorado Rapids games.

parkingLots.name: Lot B / Lot BB
parkingLots.notes: East side of the stadium, directly outside Gates B and C. General Public.

parkingLots.name: Lots C, D, E
parkingLots.notes: Southeast side of the stadium. General Public.

parkingLots.name: Lot F
parkingLots.notes: Southwest side of the stadium, outside Gate F. General Public and Permit Holders. Centennial 38 supporters tailgate here.

parkingLots.name: Lots G and H
parkingLots.notes: West side of the stadium. General Public.

parkingLots.name: VIP Lots
parkingLots.notes: South side of the stadium, directly outside Gates D and E. Permit Holders; VIP West is reserved for Supporter Lot pass holders during Rapids games.

parkingLots.name: 15 Minute Parking Zone
parkingLots.notes: West side of the stadium outside Gate G; drop-off/pick-up zone.

rideshareDropoff: Designated rideshare, passenger pick-up/drop-off, and taxi service is located in Victory North on the west side of the stadium outside Gate G. On Rapids gamedays the Rapids Rideshare Lot is located next to Lot H on E 60th Ave.
accessibility: Accessible seating is available on both the concourse and field level (call Box Office at 303-727-3535). Accessible parking is first come, first served with a state-issued permit, mainly in Lots A, B and F plus additional spaces in Lots G and H (more than 100 total spaces). A 15 Minute drop-off/pick-up zone is on the west side outside Gate G. Wheelchair escort service is provided by Guest Relations (303.727.3748). Complimentary closed captioning for Rapids games via DSGP.VZPDigital.COM or a borrowable device at Guest Relations (Section 129). Service dogs welcome; all other animals prohibited.
bagPolicyNotes: Soft-sided personal-size bags no larger than 14 x 14 x 6 inches are permitted. Medical and diaper bags 14 x 14 x 6 inches or smaller are also permitted. Prohibited bags include large purses, coolers, briefcases, backpacks, luggage of any kind, computer bags, camera bags, or any bag larger than the permissible size. All permitted bags are subject to search on entry and within the stadium. There are no check-in areas or lockers. Walk-through metal detectors (Evolv Express) are used at all gates for all events.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is allowed in all stadium lots. Respect fellow fans by occupying only one parking space. Tailgating should take place directly behind your vehicle or in adjacent landscape areas only. You may not block other parking spaces, walkways, or aisle ways with tents, trailers, chairs, coolers, or barbeques.
tailgating.grillRules: All barbeques must use a controlled flame. Open fires using logs, charcoal, or wood barbeque grills of any kind are strictly prohibited. Propane tanks must be less than 20 lbs.
tailgating.rvPolicy: Bus and RV parking is allowed in any open parking lot. Buses and RVs may not stay on-site overnight.

venueAccessRestrictions: No re-entry policy: any guest who exits for any reason will not be permitted back into the stadium. All guests must pass through walk-through metal detector security screening (Evolv Express); guests who refuse screening are denied entry. Gates B through G are open for most events; after halftime or intermission, guests must enter through Gates C or F only, as all other gates are egress only.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverage of any kind may not be brought into the stadium, along with glass bottles and aluminum/metal cans. Exceptions: empty clear plastic bottles 32 oz or less (fillable at water fountains) and one clear plastic factory-sealed water bottle per guest with the label removed.
food: Concessions offer gluten-friendly and vegetarian options; visit the Guest Relations Kiosk at Section 129 for food guides, ingredient lists, and allergy/dietary information. Concessions are cashless except two locations that accept cash (Sections 113 and 122). The Dale's Bar (south end of the concourse between Gates D and E) has food and drink all night, including postgame.

gatesOpen.ruleText: All Gates Open at 6:30 p.m. for a 7:30 p.m. kickoff (roughly 60 minutes before kickoff). Gates B through G open for most events; after halftime entry is via Gates C or F only.

name: Dignity Health Sports Park

parkingLots.name: Gold Lot (Lots 12 and 13)
parkingLots.notes: Season Ticket Members can purchase a season-long prepaid parking pass at $25 a game, valid for the 19 games in the membership. Non-members can buy at axs.com or pay the matchday parking fee at the stadium.

rideshareDropoff: Riders may be dropped off and picked up at Gate A, located on Avalon Blvd and 184th Street.
accessibility: Designated parking is available for guests with disabilities, including van accessible spaces, reserved for vehicles displaying a current state-issued disability placard or license plate. For ADA parking access, use Gates A, B or D.
bagPolicyNotes: Permitted: bags that are clear plastic or clear vinyl and do not exceed 12 x 6 x 12 inches, OR a one-gallon clear plastic freezer bag; a small clutch bag no larger than 4.5 x 6.5 inches (with or without handle or strap) can also be brought in along with one of the clear bags. Exceptions are made for medically necessary items after inspection at a designated gate. Prohibited items include purses larger than a clutch, coolers, briefcases, backpacks, fanny packs, cinch bags, luggage of any kind, computer bags and camera bags, or any bag larger than the permissible size. Applies to all events at Dignity Health Sports Park venues.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is permitted for LA Galaxy games. Tailgating rules are posted at dignityhealthsportspark.com/galaxy-parking.
tailgating.rvPolicy: RV and Bus parking is not permitted on site. Drop-off for buses is currently the only option. Limousines and other oversized vehicles taking up more than one space will be charged for additional spots.

name: Dodger Stadium

parkingLots.name: General Parking
parkingLots.notes: $40 per vehicle in advance for automobiles and motorcycles; $45 once parking gates open (approximately 2.5 hours to game time). No cash accepted at gates, no in-and-out privileges, no refunds.

parkingLots.name: Exterior Parking (Lots 13 & 14)
parkingLots.notes: $5 for specific home events; first-come, first-serve; located offsite on Stadium Way between Vin Scully Avenue and the 110 Freeway; uphill walk of approximately 10-15 minutes; free shuttle available for fans with disabilities.

parkingLots.name: Oversize Vehicle Parking (Lot 12)
parkingLots.notes: Buses, motor homes, limousines and other oversized vehicles (any vehicle taking up more than one stall) are $65 in advance and $70 at the gate; all oversize vehicles directed to Lot 12; recommended entrance is Sunset Gate A on Vin Scully Ave.

parkingLots.name: Accessible Parking (Lots B, D, G, I, L, N & P)
parkingLots.notes: Accessible spaces reserved for valid state-issued disabled parking placard or license plate holders; first-come, first-served; parking cashiers and attendants direct eligible vehicles.

rideshareDropoff: Uber (the preferred ride of the Dodgers) may enter any autogate to drop off; all other car services drop off at Gate B in Lot 1. After the game, Uber and car service vehicles enter via Gate B to pick up in Lot 1. Taxis drop off and pick up on the first base side of Lot I.
accessibility: Accessible seating is available on every level (866-DODGERS ext. 8). Accessible parking is in Lots B, D, G, I, L, N & P for valid disabled placard/plate holders (first-come, first-served). A courtesy shuttle (up to 4 guests) runs from the parking lots to the entry gates; call the Dodger Hotline at 323-224-2611. Assistive listening devices, closed captioning via the MLB Ballpark app, wheelchair assistance/escorts, sensory bags and a sensory room in the Right Field Pavilion are available. Service animals are welcome; emotional support animals are prohibited.
bagPolicyNotes: Bags, backpacks, beach bags, hard/soft coolers, and large purses are not permitted. Only permitted (subject to search): clear plastic bags no larger than 12"x12"x6", non-clear wristlets/clutches no larger than 5"x8"x2", and adult or infant diaper bags.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is prohibited on stadium property, defined as consuming food and alcoholic beverages and/or congregating anywhere on stadium property (e.g. in any of the parking lots) before, during, or after an event.

venueAccessRestrictions: Re-entry is not permitted. All bags and persons are subject to search, and video/audio surveillance is in use. Prohibited items include large bags/backpacks/suitcases, weapons and explosives, cannabis, chewing tobacco, alcoholic beverages, umbrellas, glass bottles, metal cans, fireworks/slingshots/airsoft-toy guns/laser pointers, professional camera/video equipment (tripods, monopods, lenses over 6"), drones, noise-making devices, and beach balls/inflatables/frisbees/skateboards. The stadium is smoke-free, including e-cigarettes/vapes and smokeless tobacco.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food is permitted if carried in a clear bag no larger than 12"x12"x6" and not in glass bottles, cans, coolers, glass containers, or thermoses. Outside factory-sealed plastic bottles of non-alcoholic beverages of 1 liter or less are permitted; refillable water bottles must be empty, non-glass, and 1 liter or less. No outside food or beverage may be brought into stadium suites.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Stadium gates open approximately 2 hours prior to first pitch; parking gates open approximately 2.5 hours prior to the start of the game.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Gate times may vary; call 866-DODGERS for information. My Dodgers Members may enter 3 hours prior to game time via the Left Field, Field Level entry, except there is no early entry for any game beginning before 1:30 PM.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Adult and infant diaper bags, and non-clear wristlets/clutches no larger than 5"x8"x2", are permitted despite the clear-bag requirement (subject to search).

name: Donald W. Reynolds Razorback Stadium

parkingLots.name: Harmon Avenue Parking Garage
parkingLots.notes: Public pay parking located north of Center Street on Harmon Avenue; spaces first-come, first-served

parkingLots.name: Spring St. Parking Garage
parkingLots.notes: Public parking at the corner of West Ave. and Dickson St.; $5 all-day parking, includes a free shuttle ride from the Walton Arts Center

parkingLots.name: Baum-Walker East Lot
parkingLots.notes: Very limited free public parking off Razorback Road about one mile south of the stadium; shuttle service provided beginning 4 hours before kickoff

parkingLots.name: Lot 56
parkingLots.notes: ADA/disability parking with a valid state-issued hang tag; Gold Route shuttle originates here

parkingLots.name: Road Hog Park
parkingLots.notes: RV park approximately one mile south of the stadium on 15th Street (east of Baum Stadium); (479) 409-8178

parkingLots.name: Priority/reserved lots (Razorback Foundation)
parkingLots.notes: Reserved on game days for Razorback Foundation members who are season ticket holders; passes available through the Razorback Foundation

rideshareDropoff: Uber/Lyft, taxi and limo drop-off and pick-up is at the Union Mall, accessible from Dickson St.
accessibility: ADA parking is available in Lot 56 and Baum East with a valid state-issued hang tag; disability shuttles run from both (Gold Route from Lot 56, Silver Route from Baum East) beginning 4 hours before kickoff. Disabled guests should enter at Gates 1, 15 or 16. ADA/wheelchair and companion seating is available; wheelchair assistance is offered at Guest Services (Gates 1, 16 and Level 1 of the North End Zone). The stadium has 16 public elevators plus ramps and stair towers throughout.
bagPolicyNotes: Permitted: one clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bag not exceeding 12" x 6" x 12", or a one-gallon clear plastic freezer (Ziploc-style) bag, plus one small clutch purse no larger than 4.5" x 6.5" (with or without a handle or strap). Childcare items, including diapers, must be carried in an approved clear bag (diaper bags do NOT qualify as a medical exemption). Individuals carrying required medical supplies or devices are exempt from the clear bag policy but must go through the bag-check line at their entry gate for screening; medical exception bags are tagged once cleared. All bags are searched at the gates.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating for personal entertainment and non-commercial purposes is permitted throughout campus on game day (advance approval from the University Facilities Management Department is required in some cases). Priority parking permit holders may tailgate in the areas surrounding their assigned lot; a priority permit does not allow parking in UA lots before 5 p.m. Friday. Fans may tailgate outside their vehicle as long as nothing obstructs the street or driveway. Public parking and tailgating is permitted in the Baum-Walker Stadium East lot without approval. Corporate/commercial tailgates require prior University approval. Food and beverages are for personal consumption only; sales are prohibited. Tents max 10' x 10' without advance written permission, must be secured with anchor weights (no stakes). No smoking or tobacco use anywhere on campus (fines up to $500). Each party must dispose of its own trash and charcoal.
tailgating.timeWindow: Tents, awnings and similar equipment may be set up starting at 5 p.m. Friday before a game and must be taken down and removed by 12 noon the day immediately following game day. Parking lots open 8 hours before game time (or 6 a.m. at the earliest).
tailgating.grillRules: Propane gas and charcoal grills with covers are permitted; the operator is responsible for safe operation and proper cleanup of ashes. Hot coals may not be placed on the ground and ashes may not be left or dumped on campus property. Depending on environmental and fire-risk conditions, the University may prohibit all grilling. Grilling and open flames are prohibited in all University of Arkansas parking garages.
tailgating.rvPolicy: RV parking is not allowed in any campus parking lot. Road Hog Park is an RV park located approximately one mile south of the stadium on 15th Street (east of Baum Stadium); (479) 409-8178. Free, non-reservable bus parking is available at Baum-Walker Stadium behind the Tyson Indoor Track and Field Complex.

venueAccessRestrictions: No re-entry: once a guest leaves the stadium they will not be permitted back in (University of Arkansas and SEC policy). Metal detectors are in place at every stadium gate (fans do not need to empty their pockets). All persons, regardless of age, must have a ticket. All bags are searched at the gates.
outsideFoodRules: Clear, plastic, empty water bottles may be brought into the stadium; water refill stations are located around the stadium on Level 1.
food: No outside food or beverages are permitted; concessions are available throughout the stadium (hospitality/dining partner Levy) with vendors including Gusano's Pizza, Slim Chickens, Wright's BBQ, Shakes, CJ's Butcher Boy, Walking Taco, Newk's and Razor Fan-Fare, plus a beer garden/beer zones. Concession and merchandise stands are credit-card only (no cash).

gatesOpen.ruleText: All gates open 90 minutes (1.5 hours) prior to kickoff for general fans; suite holders may enter 2 hours prior to kickoff.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Suite holders enter 2 hours before kickoff (Gates 1, 6, 12, 14 and 15 open 2 hours before kickoff for suite holders only). Stadium box offices at Gate 1 and Gate 16 open 2 hours before kickoff.
tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Tent/awning setup may begin at 5 p.m. Friday before a game and must be removed by 12 noon the day after game day. Parking lots open 8 hours before game time (or 6 a.m. at the earliest).

rideshareDropoff: Drop-off at the NE corner of the stadium near Gate 5 on Mile High Stadium Circle; rideshare pickup at 5th and Walnut St. at the Ball Arena Rideshare Lot, ~15-minute walk east of the stadium.
accessibility: First-come ADA parking (valid state placard/registration required) in Lot L or the ADA sections of Lots D/G; 12 public elevators and 15 escalators serve all levels; shuttle carts run from parking to gates during Broncos home games (begin 3 hours pre-event); wheelchair assistance at gates; KultureCity sensory bags and sensory rooms (Gate 6 lower concourse and Suite 233); open captioning on LED ribbon boards; trained service animals permitted; ADA Hotline 720-258-3337.
bagPolicyNotes: NFL clear bag policy enforced. Clear bag no larger than 12" x 6" x 12" (clear backpack, gallon zip-lock, clear carry/cinch bag) allowed; OR any bag no larger than 4.5" x 6.5" with or without strap (includes fanny packs, crossbody). Each ticket holder, including children, may carry one approved clear bag plus a clutch. Prohibited bags may be stored in paid lockers outside Gate 8; no item check at gates.

tailgating.rules: One permit equals one parking space, for vehicle usage only; tailgating must not occupy adjacent spaces or block drive lanes/walkways; prohibited in the B-Valet and the Lot A carpool section on Broncos game days; follow posted tailgating rules and regulations.

venueAccessRestrictions: No re-entry: a previously scanned ticket cannot be used to re-enter. All patrons subject to security screening including metal detectors and bag inspection. Guests age 2 and older require a ticket.
nearby: Off-site parking near the stadium (~15,000 spaces): Ball Arena, Auraria Campus, Denver Aquarium, Riverside Church (2401 Alcott St). Off-site lots open ~4 hours before kickoff and are not controlled by the stadium.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food permitted only if contained in an approved clear bag and for individual consumption. Outside alcohol of any kind is prohibited (immediate ejection). Clear/transparent water bottles no larger than 1 L / 34 oz are allowed but must be empty at screening.
food: Concessions operated by Aramark; venue is cashless (reverse ATM cash-to-card kiosks available); gluten-friendly, vegan, and dietary-accommodation options available.

gatesOpen.ruleText: General gates open 2 hours prior to kickoff; United Club and Ent Credit Union Suite Level gates open 3 hours prior to kickoff; recommended arrival at your gate 1 hour prior to kickoff.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: United Club and Ent Credit Union Suite Level ticket holders may enter 3 hours prior to kickoff (vs. 2 hours for general admission).
tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Lot C (early tailgating) opens 6 hours before kickoff (e.g., 8AM for 2:05/2:25PM kickoffs, 12PM for 6:15/6:20PM kickoffs); all other lots open 4.5 hours before kickoff. Broncos VIP Tailgate in Lot J opens 3 hours before kickoff and closes at kickoff.

name: Energizer Park
rideshareDropoff: Fans can use a rideshare app for easy drop-off and pick-up on matchday.
bagPolicyNotes: Energizer Park is a clear bag venue and fans are strongly encouraged not to bring bags. Clear bags smaller than 14 x 14 x 6 inches are allowed. Non-clear bags smaller than 5 x 7 x 2 inches are permitted and subject to inspection. Coolers, luggage, large purses, and non-clear bags over 5 x 7 x 2 inches are not allowed. Guests with medical conditions and diaper bags are granted a bag exemption on a case-by-case basis. Guests may enter with a team store shopping bag after a search. All bags are subject to search.
venueAccessRestrictions: Entry uses Evolv Technology advanced screening. Energizer Park is a clear bag venue and all bags are subject to search, including diaper bags, medical bags and shopping bags.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverage is listed as a prohibited item at Energizer Park.
food: Energizer Park is a cashless venue. Through the CITY App, fans can use mobile order ahead, CITY Go markets and more, using a stored payment method.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates open at 6:00PM for St. Louis CITY SC vs Sporting Kansas City on Thursday, July 16 (kickoff 7:30PM); Block Party on Lou Fusz Plaza at 4:30PM.

name: CareFirst Arena

parkingLots.name: Green Lot
parkingLots.notes: Enter through Malcolm X Ave. SE and 8th Street SE (2915 8th Street SE). Parking is $20 per car on event day. Cash and credit accepted.

parkingLots.name: Parking garage behind the Arena
parkingLots.notes: Enter at Cypress Avenue and follow until it intersects with Pecan St. SE. Paid parking available on event days. Cash and credit accepted.

parkingLots.name: On-street parking (St. Elizabeths campus)
parkingLots.notes: Available on a first-come, first-served basis.

accessibility: CareFirst Arena offers a variety of wheelchair and companion seating locations; seating locations vary by event, and guests should indicate accessible seating needs when buying tickets. Wheelchair escorts are available to assist guests to and from their seats. Baby changing stations are located in most restrooms; a Family Restroom and nursing accommodations are available on the event floor level.
bagPolicyNotes: No bags, backpacks, purses, or luggage are permitted. Wallet-size clutches no larger than 5 by 7 inches are permitted. Medical bags or parenting/diaper bags no larger than 14 by 14 by 6 inches are permitted (child must be present for parenting bags) and are subject to security screening. There are no bag checks or bag storage locations available to the public. Camera bags are not permitted.
venueAccessRestrictions: No re-entry policy during events. Guests who need to exit and re-enter due to a personal emergency must first contact a Guest Services representative to make arrangements. All individuals two years of age or older must possess a valid ticket for entry.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverages are prohibited. Guests are allowed one empty plastic or metallic bottle for use at arena water fountains and bottle refilling stations.
food: Concessions are operated by Events DC's concessionaire, Aramark. Alcohol is limited to two drinks per person, per transaction, and all alcohol sales stop 60 minutes before the end of the event.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Washington Mystics - Doors open one hour prior to game time.

rideshareDropoff: Postgame rideshare pickup on west side by Beaver St and A. Philip Randolph Blvd near Lot Z; exit via Gate 1 / Gallagher West Club Gate
accessibility: Accessible parking sold season-only; designated drop-off/pick-up on east (Lot C) and west (Lot M via Georgia/Adams) sides; accessibility shuttle in Sports Complex lots; postgame golf-cart shuttle near Lots M/N; wheelchair escort at all perimeter gates; details at everbankstadium.com/accessibility
bagPolicyNotes: NFL Clear Bag policy; clear bag up to 12x6x12 in or one-gallon clear plastic bag, plus non-clear clutch/wallet/bag no larger than 4.5x6.5 in; fans encouraged to avoid bags; no bag check at gates; insulated non-clear bag needs medical exception submitted 48h before kickoff

tailgating.rules: Directed parking, one car = one space; tailgating limited to the lined space and area directly in front of/behind the vehicle, plus medians; drive lanes and fire lanes kept clear; tents/canopies max 8x8 ft; sound systems not excessive; no tailgating in parking garages; all tailgating in stadium-controlled lots prohibited during the game
tailgating.timeWindow: Lots open 4 hours before kickoff, close 2 hours after game end
tailgating.rvPolicy: Vehicles more than 18 ft long and/or 8 ft wide may not park in a lined parking space

venueAccessRestrictions: Strict no re-entry; leaving perimeter gates forfeits re-entry. Cashless venue (ATMs removed). All guests and belongings subject to security screening including magnetometers/wanding/pat-down
nearby: Cash lots within walking distance: Tailgaters Parking Lot, Old Cypress Parking, Sports Complex Garage, Arena Garage, Yates Garage; St. Johns River Taxi also available
outsideFoodRules: Outside food permitted if unwrapped and in a one-gallon clear plastic bag no larger than 11x11 in; subject to visual inspection; all other outside liquids prohibited; medically-necessary exceptions pre-approved no later than 48h before kickoff
food: Delaware North Sportservice is the food and beverage provider; cashless venue; full concessions guide at jaguars.com/stadium/concessions

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gate 4 (presented by Hyundai) and the Fan Entertainment Zone open 3 hours before kickoff; Gate 1, Gate 2, Gate 3, the Gallagher East and West Club entrances and the entire seating bowl open 2 hours before kickoff; re-entry prohibited

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Gate 4 and the Fan Entertainment Zone open earlier, 3 hours (180 min) before kickoff, versus 2 hours for all other gates
tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Parking lots open 4 hours before kickoff and close 2 hours after the game ends

name: Inter&Co Stadium

parkingLots.name: Exchange Lot Parking
parkingLots.notes: $15. 25 W South St., Orlando, FL 32801. Orlando City & Orlando Pride.

parkingLots.name: Lot H Parking
parkingLots.notes: $25. 520 W Pine St., Orlando, FL 32805. Orlando City & Orlando Pride.

parkingLots.name: N Tailgate Lot
parkingLots.notes: $35. 22 S Terry Ave., Orlando, FL 32805. Orlando City & Orlando Pride. Day-of tailgate availability is subject to availability.

accessibility: Accessible parking is reserved in advance via ParkWhiz (Ticketmaster on a first-served basis is also referenced). Wheelchair-accessible and semi-ambulatory seats are located on the field and 100 level; a maximum of three companions/escorts may accompany a guest with disabilities. Wheelchair escorts are provided from any stadium entrance to the guest's seat. Braille and tactile signs are at all restroom entrances and elevators. Family and wheelchair-accessible restrooms are located at Sections 4, 13, 17, 21, 27, 33, and 37 per the ADA Info page (section numbering differs on the A-Z Guide). Sensory items are available at Guest Services behind Section 2, and Kulture City sensory bags can be checked out from the Guest Services Booth on the SE Main Concourse across from Section 1. A dedicated accessible drop-off/pick-up zone is at the corner of Glenn Lane and Church Street during all Orlando City and Pride matches. Accessibility questions: 1-855-ORL-CITY.
bagPolicyNotes: Fans are encouraged not to bring a bag. Small bags no larger than 4.5in high and 6.5in wide are acceptable (only a larger bag must be a clear tote, so small bags need not be clear). The A-Z Guide gives the clear tote max as 14in x 14in x 6in, while the Arrival and Plan Your Visit pages state 12in x 12in x 6in. Backpacks and camera bags/cases are prohibited.

tailgating.rules: Orlando City and Orlando Pride fans can secure a spot at the Mane Street Tailgate presented by Publix, located right outside Gate B and C. A dedicated N Tailgate Lot ($35) is at 22 S Terry Ave.; day-of tailgate availability is subject to availability. (Reservation link orlandocitysc.com/tailgate appears on the Arrival/Plan Your Visit pages.)
tailgating.timeWindow: The Fan Zone (Mane Street Plaza presented by Publix), on the corner of W Pine Street and S Terry Avenue, opens three hours prior to kickoff (opening time subject to change).

venueAccessRestrictions: On match day a number of local roads around the stadium perimeter close and do not reopen until roughly 45 minutes to 1 hour after the final whistle. Central Boulevard (Westmoreland Drive to Glenn Lane), Church Street (Westmoreland to Glenn Lane, and S. Terry Ave to S. Division Ave), and Glenn Lane close beginning 2.5 hours before kickoff; the Church Street segment from Glenn Lane to S. Terry Avenue closes 5 hours prior. (A strict no re-entry policy is stated on the A-Z Guide.)
outsideFoodRules: Outside food or drink is prohibited among the venue's prohibited items, with medical and infant exceptions.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates will open 60 minutes prior to kickoff, unless otherwise stated.

tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Mane Street Plaza / Fan Zone (presented by Publix) opens three hours prior to kickoff.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Promotional giveaway cups from Orlando City SC are accepted. Recognized Supporter Groups have prohibited-item exemptions including flags, tifos, drums/instruments, and controlled smoke.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating permitted; turnkey premium tailgates offered by RevelXP (season-long and single-game); Tailgate Guys tailgate information also linked. All persons/belongings subject to search.
tailgating.timeWindow: Setup/start no earlier than 4 hours prior to kickoff; tailgating ends promptly 2 hours after the game

outsideFoodRules: Outside food permitted only inside a transparent one-gallon zip-lock bag (one bag per ticket holder). Only clear factory-sealed soft-sided water bottles 24 oz or less permitted; fans may bring empty clear soft-sided bottles (24 oz or less) for refill. Alcohol, soda, glass, cans, hard-sided plastic bottles and open containers prohibited. Certain food and beverage exceptions made for medical conditions and infants.
food: Concessions by Falcon Hospitality; specialty items include Bomber Nachos with carnitas, Nighthawk Dog, Supersonic Burger, Airstrike PB&J and the Squadron Slice

name: Faurot Field

parkingLots.name: Lot M-ADA
parkingLots.notes: Single-game accessible parking; opens when parking lots open, no advance passes; golf cart shuttle runs from M-ADA to Gate 2E

parkingLots.name: Truman's Landing
parkingLots.notes: Oversized-vehicle parking for RVs and buses (parking pass required); see RV/Bus Parking Rules & Regulations

parkingLots.name: PS7 Garage
parkingLots.notes: Pre-pay game day parking available online

accessibility: Single-game accessible parking available in Lot M-ADA when parking lots open (no passes given in advance); a golf cart shuttle runs from M-ADA to Gate 2E. Requires a disabled placard/plate with the individual to whom it was issued present in the vehicle and a validated application receipt; van-accessible access aisles available on request.
bagPolicyNotes: Clear bag policy in effect at Memorial Stadium and all Mizzou venues. Permitted: a clear plastic/vinyl/PVC bag not exceeding 12"x6"x12" OR a one-gallon clear Ziploc-style freezer bag, plus one small clutch (with or without handle/strap) not exceeding 4.5"x6.5" per person; an approved logo up to 4.5"x3.4" may appear on one side. Non-compliant bags may not be nested inside a clear bag. Diaper/child items must be carried in a clear bag. Medically necessary bags that do not meet specs are allowed via special screening (call (573) 882-6501). No bag storage at or around the stadium; bags left at gates are disposed of.

tailgating.rules: Responsible tailgating permitted in parking lots (and adjacent grass) only for those holding a parking pass in that lot; tents/canopies may not exceed 10'x10', must be secured by sandbags (staking prohibited) and be an extension of your vehicle; furniture, grills, generators and other amenities may not obstruct sidewalks, drive lanes or walkways; priority tailgating areas are reserved for Tiger Scholarship Fund (TSF) members; alcohol allowed only on the day of the event in the general proximity of the event, must be 21+, kegs/bulk alcohol prohibited on University property; motorized recreational vehicles (four-wheelers, golf carts, scooters) prohibited; drones prohibited; pets must be leashed and not left unattended; portable toilets prohibited; saving of spaces not permitted; RevelXP is the official turnkey tailgate vendor around Faurot Field.
tailgating.timeWindow: Site setup may begin no earlier than 8 a.m. on game day; tailgating sites open at 8:00 a.m. (subject to change) and must be cleared and cleaned by midnight or 3 hours after the game, whichever is later; no overnight occupancy.
tailgating.grillRules: Grills (propane or otherwise) must be attended at all times; hot coals must be doused and disposed in designated Hot Coal Bins; grills on trailers may not be driven onto green spaces; grills prohibited in all campus parking garages; fires built on the ground, open fire pit devices, and fire pits are prohibited.
tailgating.rvPolicy: Oversized vehicles such as an RV or bus must purchase a parking pass for Truman's Landing (see RV/Bus Parking Rules & Regulations).

venueAccessRestrictions: Fans must enter the stadium on the side where their seats are located (ticket scanners will not allow access on the incorrect side): east side (Sections 101-110, Tiger Deck 301-315, and the student section) via Gates 2E-6E; west side (Sections 116-125) via Gates 2W-6W; south end zone (Sections 126-132) via any gate. Due to the Memorial Stadium Centennial Project construction, Gate 1 and the north concourse no longer exist. Entering the playing surface at any time risks expulsion and penalties.

gatesOpen.ruleText: All gates open two hours prior to kickoff.

tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Permit and tailgate parking lots open 7 a.m. on game day; tailgate site setup begins no earlier than 8 a.m.; sites must be cleared and cleaned by midnight or 3 hours after the game, whichever is later.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Medical-exception bags that do not meet clear-bag specifications must go through special screening at Gate 2W or 2E for football; call (573) 882-6501 in advance to qualify.

name: FedExForum

parkingLots.name: FedExForum Gossett Motors Parking Garage
parkingLots.notes: Five-level attached parking garage with 1,500 parking spaces. Two entrances on Dr. M.L. King Jr. Avenue between B.B. King Boulevard and Fourth Street. Parking sold on season basis for Memphis Grizzlies and Memphis Tigers games; first-come, first-served for non-basketball events. Rates vary by event type.

rideshareDropoff: Guest, limo, taxi, and express shuttle bus drop off is located at the east end of the arena on Fourth Street between Beale and Dr. M.L. King Jr. Avenue. Vehicles dropping off or picking up guests are not allowed to sit or park.
bagPolicyNotes: Clear bags must be made of plastic, vinyl, or PVC and cannot have all-over prints or decorations blocking contents. Metal or chain straps are prohibited but other straps are permitted. Wallets sized to fit in front or back pockets and one-quart or smaller clear plastic storage bags are also allowed. Medically necessary bags and diaper bags (with child present) are possible exceptions and must enter through the Grand Lobby. All bags are inspected upon entry and screened by X-ray.

name: Fenway Park

lines: MBTA Commuter Rail — Lansdowne Station (across from Fenway Park)
MBTA Green Line — Kenmore and Fenway stations
MBTA bus lines (stop in various nearby locations)
publicTransit.notes: The MBTA provides numerous ways to reach Fenway Park; the Red Sox strongly encourage all fans to take public transportation to the game.

rideshareDropoff: The best gates for pick up and drop off are Gate B (corner of Van Ness and Ipswich Street) and Gate D (corner of Van Ness and Jersey Street).
accessibility: All five entry/exit gates are handicap-accessible and fans may enter any gate with any ticket. Gate D has three elevators, Gates B and E have one elevator each, a wide ramp near Gate D services all levels, and a limited number of designated accessible street parking spaces are located near the park (near 73 Brookline Ave, 55 Jersey St, 189 and 203 Ipswich St). Accessible seating, ALDs, sensory kits, and Mobility Assistance are available; contact Accessible Services at 617-226-6197.
bagPolicyNotes: Bags must be single-compartment and no larger than 12"x12"x6". Backpacks, backpack-style purses, duffel bags, and other multi-compartment bags are NOT permitted. Clear single-compartment bags (also max 12"x12"x6") are encouraged to speed entry but are not required; clear backpacks are not allowed. Hard-sided coolers and glass containers are not allowed. Fans arriving with a non-permitted bag can store it for a fee with a third-party locker truck on top of the Lansdowne Garage across from Gate E.
venueAccessRestrictions: All fans are subject to screening via metal detectors or, on occasion, a physical search; all persons, bags, and personal items are subject to inspection, and failure to consent results in denial of entry. Absolutely no re-entry is allowed — once fans exit for any reason they cannot return. Prohibited items include firearms/ammunition, knives and box cutters, marijuana, pepper spray/mace, hard-sided coolers, cans/bottles/glass (except one sealed 16oz plastic water bottle), noise-making devices, and professional audio/visual equipment.
outsideFoodRules: Guests are allowed to bring in special dietary food/beverage to the ballpark; alcohol in any form is not allowed. Guests are encouraged to ask for the security supervisor at any gate before entering.

gatesOpen.ruleText: All Fenway Park gates open 90 minutes prior to scheduled start time of every game.

tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Exceptions to the bag policy are made for diaper bags and bags containing essential medical equipment.

name: FirstBank Stadium

parkingLots.name: Lots 1-4
parkingLots.notes: Paid and ADA-accessible; advance sales plus drive-up sales based on unsold inventory; cashless (Apple Pay/credit/debit only)

parkingLots.name: 25th Ave. Garage
parkingLots.notes: Paid and ADA-accessible; advance sales available; cashless; does not accommodate oversized/high-clearance vehicles

parkingLots.name: West Garage
parkingLots.notes: Paid and ADA-accessible; day-of-game only (no advance sale)

parkingLots.name: Children's Way Field
parkingLots.notes: Paid; day-of-game only (no advance sale)

rideshareDropoff: Two designated rideshare/taxi (Uber/Lyft) locations: West pick-up and drop-off at the Chipotle parking lot (2825 West End Avenue); East pick-up and drop-off off Garland Avenue near 2402 Garland Avenue.
accessibility: ADA drive-up parking available on game day in the 25th Ave. Garage (near elevators/corners) and West Garage (both open 4 p.m.); Lots 1, 2, 4 and 72C plus Kensington Garage require an advance ADA permit from the ticket office. Assistance drop-off points: Garland Avenue from 25th Avenue (Sections P-V/North End Zone) and the corner of 28th Avenue and Vanderbilt Place across from the Frist Family Gate (Sections A-G/South End Zone). Wheelchair and companion seating throughout; call (615) 322-4653. Fans encouraged to enter through the gate closest to their seating area.
bagPolicyNotes: A small clutch purse not to exceed 4.5" x 6.5" is also allowed. Medically necessary items must be screened at gates, and medical exception bags will be tagged once cleared by security. Diaper bags are not considered medically necessary and will not be permitted; all diaper bag supplies should be carried in a clear bag that meets regulations. Approved clear bags may be purchased at the Vanderbilt Bookstore (2525 West End Avenue). Fans who bring bags that are not permitted may pay to store them at game day bag storage locations.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is limited to parking spaces and may not encroach on sidewalks, roads, or bike lanes; the drive lane must remain clear for emergency-vehicle access. Tailgate setup may not exceed 5 ft past the end of the lane line. You must have a parking pass for every spot occupied (no space saving). Maximum pop-up tent size 10'x10', secured with weights (stakes prohibited), free of corporate logos, and fully broken down before entering the stadium. Music at a reasonable level with speakers facing your own space. Prohibited items/activities: trailers, motorized vehicles (scooters/hoverboards/golf carts), drones, smoking/vaping, fire pits, kegs, unauthorized food sales/vendors, and live bands/DJs. Tailgating is prohibited in parking garages.
tailgating.timeWindow: Tailgating lots open when parking opens on game day; setup may not begin until lots open. Lots close immediately upon conclusion of the game; overnight parking is not permitted.
tailgating.grillRules: No cooking in parking structures, under tents, or within 25 ft of a campus building. Grills must be set away from or protected from pedestrian traffic and flammable/combustible materials, monitored at all times, and never left unattended while in use; extinguish all flames before leaving. Vanderbilt does not provide charcoal disposal - operators are responsible for cleanup of ashes/coals, which may not be placed in VU receptacles or on the grounds. Propane grills shall not exceed 20 lbs; charcoal grills must have a cover. VU Public Safety may prohibit grilling depending on weather. Fire pits and kegs are prohibited.
tailgating.rvPolicy: Overnight parking is not permitted; parking garages do not accommodate oversized/high-clearance vehicles.

venueAccessRestrictions: All clear bags and clutch purses are subject to search at the gates. Separately: medically necessary items must be screened at gates, and medical exception bags are tagged once cleared by security.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverage containers are prohibited; fans may not bring in any outside food or beverage. Outside alcohol is also prohibited. Exception: when the anticipated temperature at kickoff is above 90 degrees, guests may bring in one 20 oz (or smaller) unopened, disposable bottle of water.

gatesOpen.ruleText: All gates open 2 hours prior to kickoff.

name: Fiserv Forum

parkingLots.name: 5th Street Parking Structure
parkingLots.notes: Located on 1215 N. 5th St., Milwaukee. The structure can only be accessed from McKinley Avenue.

parkingLots.name: Highland Structure
parkingLots.notes: Located at 1030 N. 6th St., Milwaukee.

parkingLots.name: Isaac's Garage
parkingLots.notes: 330 W Wells St

parkingLots.name: Brewery Structure
parkingLots.notes: 1213 N 9th Street

rideshareDropoff: Lyft, other rideshare services, and taxi cabs drop off and pick up passengers at the intersection of Highland and Vel R. Phillips Avenues near the Bucks Pro Shop.
bagPolicyNotes: Medical accommodation bags and infant/childcare bags are subject to additional screening and must use designated bag screening lanes for entry. The bag policy is subject to change. Additional restrictions may apply for specific events.

name: Folsom Field

parkingLots.name: Main campus public lots
parkingLots.notes: $35 Text to Pay after you park; first-come, first-served; main campus public parking is very limited and will fill each game

parkingLots.name: East campus (off Colorado Avenue & Discovery Drive)
parkingLots.notes: $20 Text to Pay; free shuttle to/from the stadium begins three hours prior to kickoff and runs one hour after the game

parkingLots.name: Lot 204 (18th Street and Euclid Avenue)
parkingLots.notes: Accessible/ADA parking; state ADA placard or license plate required; $35 Text to Pay; wheelchair-accessible shuttle to Southwest Entrance

parkingLots.name: Lot 544 (east campus)
parkingLots.notes: RV parking; $120 (credit card) paid on game day; not available for pre-purchase; overnight parking not allowed on campus

parkingLots.name: Lot 391 (Ford/Indoor Practice Facility garage)
parkingLots.notes: Franklin Field Tailgate Zone season parking permit; entrance off Folsom Avenue at NE corner of IPF; Level P1 first-come, first-served beginning six hours prior to kickoff, no earlier than 8AM

publicTransit.notes: Buff Buses shuttle from East Campus begins 3 hours prior to gates opening and ends about 1 hour post game (issues: 303-492-7152 or text for assistance 720-812-1769)

accessibility: Accessible parking in Lot 204 (18th Street & Euclid Avenue); state ADA placard or license plate required; $35 Text to Pay. A wheelchair-accessible shuttle runs continuously between Lot 204 and the Southwest Entrance for three hours before and one hour after the game. Additional accessible parking arrangements: call Parking Services Events Parking at 303-735-PARK (7275). ADA seating at top of sections 103, 104, 114 (any entrance). Wheelchairs available from Guest Relations. Kulture City sensory-inclusive certified; sensory bags checked out at the Gate 5 Guest Services kiosk.

tailgating.rules: Designated tailgate zones at Folsom Field: Fan Fest Tailgate and Chip's Kids Club at Duane Field, Franklin Field Tailgate Zone at Franklin Field, and Benson Tailgate Zone at Benson Field. The Franklin Field Tailgate Zone is an 'Aluminum Only' zone (no glass beverage containers allowed); fans may bring and prepare their own food and beverages, with approximately 110 pre-reserved spaces around Franklin Field, each defined by a 10ft x 10ft CU tent.
tailgating.timeWindow: Franklin Field Tailgate Zone parking on Level P1 of Lot 391 is first-come, first-served beginning six (6) hours prior to kickoff, but no earlier than 8AM (subject to change for non-Saturday home games).
tailgating.grillRules: Fans may bring and prepare their own food; if using a grill for food preparation, SevenSouth coordinates the best arrangement for transportation and storage.
tailgating.rvPolicy: RV parking available in Lot 544 (east campus); $120 (credit card) paid on game day; not available for pre-purchase; overnight parking not allowed on campus.

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Bags or containers larger than 12” x 6” x 12”, Hard & soft sided coolers of any size or style, Firearms or weapons of any type; including handguns carried in accordance w/ the Colorado Conceal & Carry Act., Parts of weapons of any kind (including actual, simulated, toy, or replica weapons, firearms, ammunition, self-defense sprays, fireworks or incendiary devices, explosives, fuel, knives (of any size), stun guns/tasers, sticks, bats, poles & any object with a blade), Hazardous items including, but not limited to, fuels, torches, lighter fluid, chemicals, paint, batteries, or aerosols, Selfie/GoPro sticks, flags on poles, other types of sticks, poles or similar objects that can be used as a weapon, Drones (UAS-Unmanned Aircraft Systems) or model aircraft, Non-factory sealed beverages or filled liquid containers including but not limited all thermoses/metal water bottles/Hydro Flask & Stanleys, Alcoholic beverages or illegal drugs (including medical marijuana, vape pens, cartridges or any other smoking paraphernalia), Glass, metal bottles or cans, Full size strollers and car seat carrier, Umbrellas of any size, Artificial noise makers such as whistles, air horns, thunderstix or any other item used to make artificial noise, Laser pointing devices, flashlights, or glowsticks, Any unapproved signs or banners, Professional grade video or camera equipment (e.g. telephoto lenses), tripods, or monopods., Footballs, frisbees, inflatable balls, Bikes, scooters, skateboards or skates, Pets / animals (with the exception of service animals), Electric or battery-operated apparel with AA, C or D cell batteries are NOT allowed., Laptops, iPads, GoPros or any other consumer electronics, Any item(s) deemed dangerous or unacceptable by security. All patrons are subject to security screening prior to entering the stadium gates, which may include walk-through metal detectors, electronic wanding and inspection of bags or other personal items.
food: Concessions areas are located in Balch Fieldhouse, the Southwest plaza, the East concourse, the Rooftop and premium seating areas. Concession stands open two hours prior to kickoff until 10 minutes left in the fourth quarter. All concessions at Folsom Field are cashless. Alcohol can be purchased at designated vendor locations throughout the stadium. A Folsom Field Food & Beverage Guide is available.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Entrances to Folsom Field open 2hrs prior to kickoff.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: CU Students enter via the Student Entrance (south side, Colorado Avenue) which opens 2.5 hours prior to kickoff; general public and premium club areas open 2 hours prior to kickoff.
tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Parking lots open for football game parking five (5) hours prior to kickoff, and no earlier than 8:00 a.m.

name: Mortgage Matchup Center

parkingLots.name: Mortgage Matchup Center Garage
parkingLots.notes: Attached on-site garage; entrance at 1st St. and Madison. Accessible parking spaces available on all floors, first-come first-served. Bike racks on level one. Sold as general parking (does not reserve accessible spaces). The venue offers more than 700 on-site parking spaces total; no in-and-out privileges.

parkingLots.name: Jefferson Street Garage
parkingLots.notes: Entrance from the south on Jackson St. Accessible parking spaces on floors 1-5 near elevators, first-come first-served. Bike racks on Level One on the West side along 3rd Street. Valet available on the 2nd floor via the 4th Street entrance for select ticketed guests.

publicTransit.notes: Valley Metro Rail (light rail) serves the venue. Southbound from Metro Parkway: exit at Downtown Phoenix Hub - 1st Ave platform and walk about 0.3 mile, or transfer at the Jefferson St platform and exit at 3rd St/Jefferson. Northbound from Baseline/Central Ave: exit at Downtown Phoenix Hub - Central Ave platform and walk about 0.3 mile, or transfer and exit at 3rd St/Jefferson. Westbound from Gilbert Rd/Main St: exit at 3rd St/Washington. Eastbound: board at Jefferson St platform, exit at 3rd St/Jefferson. Bus stops and light rail stations are all on accessible routes to and from the venue.

rideshareDropoff: Lyft drop-off locations: 1st Street/Jefferson (Mortgage Matchup Center Plaza); S 2nd Street (The Ryan); S 3rd Street (Phoenix Convention Center); E Jefferson Street (Hotel Palomar/Arrogant Butcher). Lyft pick-up: S 3rd Street & E Jefferson Street (Phoenix Convention Center).
accessibility: Located in downtown Phoenix; light rail and bus stops are all on accessible routes. Event drop-off is on 3rd St. just south of Jefferson at the green curb; will-call/ticket-office drop-off is on 1st St. just north of Madison (no parking or leaving vehicles unattended in drop-off zones). Accessible parking spaces available first-come first-served in the Mortgage Matchup Center Garage (all floors) and Jefferson Garage (floors 1-5). Service animals welcome (emotional support/therapy/comfort animals not permitted). Certified sensory-inclusive venue (Kulture City partner) with a sensory room in the Guest Services Office in the Pavilion and checkout sensory bags. OneCourt haptic feedback devices for blind/low-vision guests, Assistive Listening Devices, ASL interpreting (request at least two weeks ahead), and captioning at all Suns and Mercury games (streamable via app or nba.com/suns/cc). Wheelchair accessible seating at all price points first-come first-served (call 602-379-7800); wheelchair escorts available from any entrance or the Guest Services Office. All restrooms on all levels are accessible, with gender-neutral/family restrooms on all levels and an adult-sized changing station in the pavilion family restroom. Questions: accessibility@suns.com or (602)379-7800.
bagPolicyNotes: Fans are strongly encouraged to arrive without bags. Small clutches, crossbody bags, and clear bags are permitted. Purses, medical bags, and diaper bags are allowed provided they comply with arena bag-size guidelines of 14" x 14" x 6" and are subject to additional screening. Standard backpacks are not permitted, with the exception of single-compartment drawstring bags that meet NBA and/or arena size requirements (and media backpacks screened at the media entrance). Guests without bags or with clutches smaller than 4" x 6" are encouraged to use the Evolv express entry lanes. Certain concerts and special events may operate under modified item restrictions.
venueAccessRestrictions: Re-entry is not permitted for any games, concerts, or events. Mortgage Matchup Center is a fully cashless environment (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, or Discover; reverse ATMs available). Children thirty-six months of age and older require a valid ticket; children under thirty-six months may be admitted without a ticket if seated on a parent or guardian's lap (certain events may require a ticket for all ages). Smoke-free facility. All tickets are mobile only via the Ticketmaster app or the official Suns-Mercury-Arena app.
nearby: A variety of hotels are located near the venue and throughout the downtown Phoenix area (see dtphx.org). Bike sharing is available near the south doors of the venue and along the sidewalk at 3rd Street & Jefferson.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverages, including coolers, bottles, and cans, are not permitted inside Mortgage Matchup Center. For Phoenix Suns and Mercury home games, each guest may bring one sealed plastic water bottle. Items necessary for the care of children, including baby bottles and formula, are permitted.
food: Fully cashless venue with a wide range of permanent concession locations plus additional portable stands during Phoenix Suns and Mercury home games. Options include 623 Grill, 480 Grill, 520 Grill, 602 Grill, Gorilla Grill, Spinato's Pizzeria, Big Chicken (Shaquille O'Neal), Cold Beer and Cheeseburgers, Benihana, Los Soles Taqueria, Hornitos Tequila Taco Bar, Tostitos Cantina, Wetzel's Pretzels, Shazam Sweets, and numerous bars and grab-and-go stands. A $2 Value Menu (seven items for $14) is offered only at Suns and Mercury games. Mobile ordering and Grab & Go available via the official Suns-Mercury-Arena app.

name: Ford Field

parkingLots.name: Lot 4
parkingLots.notes: North of Ford Field, east of Brush, south of Montcalm; enter from Montcalm; game-day ADA/disabled overflow parking, first come first serve

parkingLots.name: Ford Field Parking Deck
parkingLots.notes: East of Ford Field on St Antoine; ADA disabled parking available

accessibility: All Ford Field parking facilities are ADA compliant; reserved disabled spaces require a valid disabled permit and state-issued plate/placard; additional game-day disabled parking in Lot 4 and the Ford Field Parking Deck, first come first serve
bagPolicyNotes: NFL bag policy: clear plastic/vinyl/PVC bags up to 12x6x12 in, or a one-gallon clear freezer bag; a small clutch bag approximately the size of a hand also allowed

tailgating.rules: Tailgating and re-entry prohibited in parking facilities adjacent to Ford Field

venueAccessRestrictions: Smoke-free facility (including e-cigarettes/vapes); smoking only in designated outdoor areas during games: Gate D Level 1 Section 128/129 and Gate E Section 225
nearby: Pride Plaza (free official Detroit Lions tailgate presented by Bud Light) on Brush Street adjacent to Ford Field; no game ticket required
outsideFoodRules: Outside food, beverages, and liquids (cans, bottles, boxes, flasks, etc.) are prohibited

name: Gainbridge Fieldhouse

parkingLots.name: Virginia Avenue Parking Garage
parkingLots.notes: On the northeast corner of the building; the closest covered parking option, connected to the Fieldhouse via covered sky bridge on the third floor. Entrance is off Maryland Street. Referenced elsewhere on the site (a-z-guide Box Office) as the Virginia Ave. Parking Garage at 155 Delaware St.

parkingLots.name: Denison-managed downtown facilities
parkingLots.notes: Denison Parking manages a number of parking facilities within walking distance in the downtown area; for bus parking near the Fieldhouse contact Denison Parking at (317) 916-1760.

parkingLots.name: Street parking
parkingLots.notes: From garages to street parking, there are several parking options throughout downtown Indianapolis within walking distance of the Fieldhouse.

publicTransit.notes: IndyGo bus services run to and from Gainbridge Fieldhouse; schedules vary by route. Contact IndyGo at (317) 635-3344 or IndyGo.net, including Open Door service for guests with disabilities. No specific route/line numbers are given on the page.

rideshareDropoff: Guests using a rideshare service such as Lyft can drop off on several streets surrounding Gainbridge Fieldhouse, and may request a ride from the venue on surrounding streets.
accessibility: Accessible parking spaces are available in the parking facilities surrounding the Fieldhouse; the Virginia Avenue Garage connects via pedestrian bridge (third floor) giving access to all seating. Drivers dropping off guests with limited mobility may use the designated drop-off on Pennsylvania Street directly in front of the Fieldhouse (one-way southbound). Wheelchair escort assistance is available from the Ascension St. Vincent Entry Pavilion to seating (limited availability, transport only). Elevators are in the northeast area on all levels; escalators serve Main Concourse and Balcony levels plus the pedestrian bridge. All restrooms are accessible; gender-neutral restrooms are on all levels (KeyBank Suite Level near Suite 1, Main Concourse by Section 2, Krieg DeVault Level by Section 109, Balcony Level by Sections 204 and 216). Assistive Listening Devices are free on request (pick up at Guest Services, Main Concourse near Section 2). Captioning boards are above Sections 1/20, 7, and 14 during Pacers and Fever games; ASL interpreters can be requested at least two weeks prior; live captioning via the Pacers and Fever apps. Audio Description offered for select events. Braille signage throughout. Sensory accommodations via KultureCity: sensory bags and weighted lap pads (free, leave an ID) at Guest Services desks, and a Sensory Room on the Krieg DeVault Level at Section 119. Accessible seating (wheelchair locations and modified aisle seats) is available through Ticketmaster or the Box Office. Service animals are welcome.
bagPolicyNotes: Backpacks, hard-sided bags, and any bag larger than 6"x10"x2" are not allowed; there is no clear-bag requirement stated. An exception is made for medical equipment you must have with you (the bag should be no larger than necessary to hold the device). Baby bags, plastic bottles, and formula are permitted, though an oversized baby bag may be asked to be checked. Oversized bags may be stored for a fee, subject to availability, at the Hyatt Place Indianapolis Downtown Valet Bell Services Desk (130 S. Pennsylvania St.). All guests are subject to security screening including bag inspection, metal detection, and x-ray.
venueAccessRestrictions: No re-entry: all exits past the ticket point are final and guests may not leave an event and re-enter the same event. For Pacers and Fever games, once a child reaches 24 months old a ticket is required for admission; some events require all guests to have a ticket regardless of age.
nearby: A large number of downtown Indianapolis hotels (local and national brands) are within walking distance; Visit Indy is suggested for a hotel list. The Hyatt Place Indianapolis Downtown is across the street at 130 S. Pennsylvania St. (offers valet bell services bag storage).
outsideFoodRules: Outside food or drinks are prohibited. Guests may bring in one empty plastic refillable bottle 32 oz or less in size to refill while visiting the Fieldhouse.
food: Levy manages all food and beverage at Gainbridge Fieldhouse. Concessions with fan favorites and local fare are located throughout the concourses; a full offerings-and-locations list is provided in the Dining at the Fieldhouse PDF. Levy also provides suite food and beverage service and private-event catering.

gatesOpen.ruleText: For Fever games only, doors will open 90 minutes prior to tip off, unless otherwise noted. To verify doors for a specific event, call (317) 917-2500.

name: Gaylord Family Oklahoma Memorial Stadium
accessibility: Game-day ADA/wheelchair ticket-exchange window at the Athletics Ticket Office on the plaza level of the Asp Ave. Parking Facility immediately west of the stadium (limited, first-come; also call (800) 456-GoOU). ADA seating with ramp/elevator pathways provided via Gates 1, 2, 3, 11, 12 and 15/16; dedicated ADA/premium routes to Level 2/3/4 concourses. Express lanes at all gates for patrons carrying no items.
bagPolicyNotes: Stadium policies will allow non-transparent clutch wallets that are no larger than 4.5 inches by 6.5 inches, clear fanny packs and clear crossbody bags. Bags that are necessary for medical equipment will be searched at marked medical lanes at each gate. No other bags or purses including diaper bags will be permitted and the limit on bags is one per person.
venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Alcohol (in all forms), Baby seats, Baby strollers, Bags, backpacks, fanny packs & hard binocular cases, Banners/signs, Beach balls, footballs, balls or other sporting equipment, Cameras with lenses longer than 6 inches, Chair backs with frames, armrests and/or wider than 16 inches, Coolers, containers or ice chests, Explosives, firearms or weapons, Folding chairs or stools, Food or drink, Laptops, Laser pointers, Noisemakers of any type (i.e. air horns, plastic horns, whistles, etc.), Personal heaters, Pets (with the exception of registered service dogs), Selfie sticks, bi-pods, monopods, etc., Umbrellas, Video cameras.
outsideFoodRules: No outside food or beverages are permitted. Fans may bring a clear, EMPTY plastic water bottle less than 17 oz.; water filling stations are located throughout the concourses. No outside alcohol may be brought in and alcohol may not leave the stadium gates.
food: Concession stands are located throughout the stadium; all concession and retail stands are cashless (credit or debit card). Beer and other ready-to-drink alcoholic beverages are sold stadium-wide at portable stands from gate opening until the end of the 3rd quarter (21+, valid ID, two-drink limit per transaction).

name: Geodis Park

parkingLots.name: Lot 1
parkingLots.notes: 401 Wingrove St, Nashville, TN 37203; 0.5 mi from stadium, 9-min walk to Gates A/B/C; partially covered and paved, off Nolensville Pike; tailgating allowed; no bus parking

parkingLots.name: Lot 2

publicTransit.notes: WeGo Public Transit stops within walking distance: Bus 52 at Fairgrounds Station (Nolensville Pike & Wingrove Street) and Bus 77 (Benton Ave & Bransford Ave). WeGo also runs an express bus to GEODIS Park for Nashville SC regular season matches. Fare-free service on routes 52 and 77 to regular season home games is stated on the 2026 matchday guide page (not on the cited A-Z Guide page).

rideshareDropoff: Designated rideshare drop-off and pickup is on Craighead Street, relocated for the 2026 season to accommodate more rideshare vehicles. Limousines and buses may also use this designated pickup and drop-off area (limo/bus detail from the A-Z Guide page).
accessibility: All stadium entrances are ADA accessible. Wheelchair and companion seating is provided throughout the stadium (event-day relocations limited, first-come first-served). ADA parking availability can be secured by calling Membership Services at 615-750-8800. KultureCity Sensory Kits are available at the Guest Services Window behind Section 113, and a Sensory Room is on the South Concourse across from Section 127. Wheelchair escort service is available on a first-come first-served basis upon entry. Family restrooms are at Sections 103, 105, 111, 113, 118, 124, 127 and 134; accessible facilities are available in all restrooms.
bagPolicyNotes: Clear Bag Policy is in effect for all GEODIS Park events. Bags must be clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC and not exceed 12 in x 12 in x 6 in. Non-transparent bags, wallets, and cases must not exceed 4.5 in x 6.5 in and remain subject to inspection. Non-clear diaper bags are permitted when accompanying a child, and small non-clear bags for medical or elder care needs are allowed upon inspection; all other bags must comply with the clear bag policy. Guests with non-complying bags can store items for a nominal fee at a bag check location on the North side on Benton Avenue between Gates B and C, operated by The Mobile Locker Company.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is allowed in designated lots (Lots 1, 2, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, and 11) and is prohibited in Lot 3, the Nashville PBS Lot, Lot 12 Garage, and the Chestnut Lot. Full tailgating policies are on the GEODIS Park website (geodispark.com/stadium-info/tailgating-policies/), which was not part of the scraped pages.

venueAccessRestrictions: No re-entry: guests may not exit and re-enter the stadium using the same ticket; once you exit you cannot return. All guests are subject to entry procedures including metal detection, bag search, and the clear bag policy (Evolv inspection units, walk-through magnetometers). GEODIS Park is a non-smoking, non-vaping, and tobacco-free campus, with tobacco products, e-cigarettes, and vaporizers prohibited inside the stadium and within the immediate gate plazas.
nearby: Located just minutes from downtown Nashville in the Wedgewood-Houston neighborhood; billed as the largest soccer-specific stadium in the United States.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverage may not be brought into GEODIS Park, including items purchased on the immediate exterior of the stadium or in an outside Fan Fest area. The only exceptions are parents with small children bringing plastic bottles of non-frozen formula or milk and small snacks, and medically necessary food items inspected and approved by security at the gate.
food: GEODIS Park is cashless, accepting card and mobile payment only (including Apple Pay and Google Pay); guests preferring cash can obtain a Reloadable Card at the Guest Service Window. Concession cuisine options are listed on the venue Concessions page (not among the scraped pages).

gatesOpen.ruleText: GEODIS Park entrances open 1.5 hours prior to kickoff for all Nashville SC home games (only Club and Suite Level tickets are permitted entry through the Club entrances). Corroborating example on the 2026 matchday guide: gates opened at 5:30 p.m. for a 7 p.m. kickoff on Jul. 17, 2026.

tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: On-campus lots open three hours before the scheduled event start or kickoff; tailgating is permitted in designated lots once they open. Matchday-guide example: on-campus lots opened at 4 p.m. for the 7 p.m. kickoff on Jul. 17, 2026.

name: Gerald J. Ford Stadium
accessibility: ADA seating is located at the top row of the lower level. ADA parking spaces are in each cash and credential lot. ADA drop-off is permitted at Gate 2. Golf cart shuttles can be arranged via the nearest parking attendant or by calling 214-768-1111.
venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Purses that exceed 12 x 6 x 12 inches, Coolers, Briefcases, Backpacks, Computer and Camera Bags, Cinch Bags, Diaper Bags, Fanny Packs, Luggage of any kind, Seat cushions that have zippers, pockets, or compartments, Outside food or drink (one sealed bottle of water permitted), Umbrellas, Laser pointers, Noise makers, Footballs or objects that can be used as projectiles, Radios (except pocket size with headsets), Animals (except service animals), Firearms, weapons, or knives of any kind. No re-entry. Exceptions will be handled on a case-by-case basis at Guest Services, located behind section 117. Fans entering Ford Stadium are subject to bag checks and security screenings before entering the stadium.
nearby: A Barnes & Noble in the shopping center to the southeast of the stadium sells a larger variety of SMU gear.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food or drink is prohibited; one sealed, unopened bottle of water is permitted per fan.
food: Concessions open 90 minutes before kickoff; all concession stands are cashless (card and mobile pay only).

parkingLots.notes: Suite owner assigned parking (one pass per suite); cars-only lot

accessibility: Complete Accessible Services information is available on the Illinois Athletics Accessible Services page. A lactation pod is located in the East Great Hall (serves one individual at a time, with outlets/USB ports and seating), and baby changing stations are located in men's and women's restrooms in the Horseshoe and in the Great East and West Halls.

tailgating.rules: Grange Grove is the designated tailgating area. Prohibited within Grange Grove: smoking of any kind; using rope, tape, or other obstructions to mark a tailgate spot; tailgating on sidewalks or walkways (including the center aisle of the south side); non-approved advertising and solicitation; picketing and political campaigning; disorderly conduct; and any activities, performances, music, or sounds that may interfere with scheduled entertainment, vendors, or other tailgates. DIA reserves the right to remove any tailgate/tailgater who violates this policy.
tailgating.grillRules: All fires and hot coals must be contained within grills or other designated containers, must be attended at all times, and should be set up at least 25 feet away from pedestrian traffic, buildings, tents, and flammable materials. Fires built on the ground are prohibited; never add flammable liquids to an active fire. Extinguish fires thoroughly with water before leaving them unattended and place extinguished charcoal in designated containers, removing it from campus for disposal (do not dump on the ground or in dumpsters). A fire extinguisher must be readily available at tailgates with an active fire or hot coals, and at least one person present must be trained in its use. Campus is smoke-free.

outsideFoodRules: Food items contained in the approved CLEAR bags may be carried into the stadium. Sealed plastic water bottles (20 oz. and smaller), as well as empty water bottles or tumblers, may also be carried in. Coolers and containers are not permitted, including cans, glass bottles, thermos bottles, wine skins, bota bags, and glass of any kind. Alcoholic beverages are strictly prohibited from being carried into and out of the stadium.
food: Concession stands located throughout Gies Memorial Stadium serve a wide variety of options and all selling points are cashless. Concessions stands begin closing at the end of the third quarter, with two stands on the east and west sides remaining open until there are 5 minutes left in the game, and stop selling alcohol at the start of the fourth quarter.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Entrances open 90 minutes prior to the scheduled kick-off time for the general public and two hours before kickoff for premium seating ticket holders.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Premium seating ticket holders may enter two hours before kickoff; all suites and club areas open two (2) hours prior to kickoff and close one (1) hour after the conclusion of the game.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Exceptions to the clear-bag policy are made for diaper bags (with child) and approved medical needs after proper inspection.

accessibility: Free ADA parking for Patriots home games, no pass required; licensed placard spaces in Lot 4A (arriving from north) and Lot 22 (from south); overflow ADA parking in Lot 3A (north) and Lot 20B (south)

tailgating.rules: Permitted in general parking lots once lots open unless directed otherwise. Prohibited in lots: kegs, outside catering, professional tailgates, 5th-wheel/tow-behind trailers, 18-wheeler/tractor cabs, box trucks, branded vehicles, non-stadium portable toilets
tailgating.timeWindow: Begins when lots open to general parking
tailgating.grillRules: No open fires; fires must be contained in a suitable, movable fire-burning device; fire pits with open flames not allowed; grills/fires must not be left unattended; used charcoal must be disposed of properly and not left on the parking surface
tailgating.rvPolicy: Oversize vehicles park in Lot 52 via P10 North/South; for Revolution games, if P10 is not open, back of Lot 20 (from south) or Lot 3C (from north). Overnight parking not allowed. Limos/town cars must park on site (limo spots $150)

venueAccessRestrictions: All occupants of a vehicle must possess a valid ticket to that day's game or event to access the parking lots; oversized vehicles restricted from stadium-side lots and must fit a 9'x18' space
nearby: Patriot Place shopping and dining complex adjacent to the stadium (North and South Marketplaces); Bass Pro Shops adjacent to Lot 15
outsideFoodRules: Food and beverages prohibited inside the stadium, along with coolers, containers, cans, bottles, and kegs; medically necessary/dietary items admitted after screening or via teamops@gillettestadium.com exception request

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates open at 6:30 p.m. (6:15 p.m. for Season Members) for a 7:30 p.m. kickoff, per the Timeline to Kickoff on the Revs matchday guides.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Season Members enter early: gates open at 6:15 p.m. for Season Members versus 6:30 p.m. general admission (15 minutes earlier).

Prohibited items must be returned to cars or disposed of before entering the stadium; there are no provisions to check in items at the gate, and authorities hold the right to inspect any item at any time.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food or drink, coolers, bottles, cans and thermoses are listed among items prohibited inside the Glass Bowl.

rideshareDropoff: Uber and Lyft are available in the rideshare pick-up zone located at the Chatman Cutoff (marked on the parking map). After Globe Life Field events, pickups are not allowed on Randoll Mill.
accessibility: ADA parking is available in all general admission lots on a first-come, first-served basis (no option to select ADA parking when pre-purchasing online); ADA carts are available from each lot on request. A complimentary accessible shuttle runs from the parking lots to the gates (available ~30 minutes before gates open through ~30 minutes after the game), and complimentary wheelchair escort service is offered between gates and ticketed seats. Accessible seating is available throughout the ballpark, along with assistive listening devices, closed captioning, a Sensory Room and KultureCity sensory bags, noise-cancelling headphones, family restrooms, Mother's Rooms, and service animals are welcome.
bagPolicyNotes: Each guest may bring up to two soft-sided bags no larger than 16 x 8 x 16 inches, and bags do not need to be clear. All backpacks are prohibited, including clear backpacks and smaller children's backpacks, with exceptions for diaper, medical, and Jr. Rangers branded backpacks that meet the size limit. Single-compartment drawstring bags are allowed, and all items are subject to search.
nearby: Texas Live! (adjacent Arlington Entertainment District) is open 11 AM–Midnight (Sunday–Thursday) and 11 AM–2 AM (Friday & Saturday).
outsideFoodRules: Outside food is allowed inside Globe Life Field as long as it is in a sealed clear quart-sized (or less) plastic bag. Guests may also bring one sealed non-flavored water (plastic bottle up to 1 liter). One bag of food and one bottle of water per ticket are permitted. Additional exceptions are made for dietary concerns and infants.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Night games: entries open 2 hours before game time (lots open 2.5 hours before). Day games: entries open 1.5 hours before game time (lots open 2 hours before).

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Entries open 2 hours before game time for night games vs. 1.5 hours before game time for day games.

name: Great American Ball Park

parkingLots.name: Central Riverfront Garage
parkingLots.notes: Formerly the Great American Ball Park Parking Garage. Managed by ACE Parking; lots open 5 hours before game time. Day-of-game parking: eastern side $30 ($33 weekends), western side $25 ($30 weekends). Pay-upon-entry, credit card ONLY. Accessible parking is available in the East section. Passes can be purchased in advance via reds.com/parking or (513) 765-7400.

parkingLots.name: East Garage
parkingLots.notes: Day-of-game parking $17 ($25 weekends); accessible parking $16-$17. Pay-upon-entry, credit card only.
