parkingLots.name: Lot E
parkingLots.notes: Day-of-game parking $17. Pay-upon-entry, credit card only.

publicTransit.notes: The Connector streetcar runs a 3.6-mile loop connecting The Banks, Downtown and Over-the-Rhine; it is free to ride and Station 1 at The Banks is just steps from the ballpark. Cincinnati Metro buses serve Hamilton County; the Transit Authority of Northern Kentucky (TANK) provides bus service to and from Northern Kentucky; ACCESS provides transportation for guests with disabilities.

accessibility: Great American Ball Park is a fully accessible facility. Accessible seating areas are equipped with electrical outlets for recharging at no cost. Accessible parking is offered in the East section of the Central Riverfront Garage and in the East Garage (pay-upon-entry, credit card only). Accessible pickup/drop-off zones are located on Joe Nuxhall Way (between Mehring Way and Freedom Way) and at the corner of Broadway and Mehring Way; vehicles displaying a valid accessible placard or plate may enter starting 1/2 hour before gates open until about 1 hour after the game. Assisted Listening Devices and dedicated captioning boards are available.
bagPolicyNotes: Bags cannot exceed 16" x 16" x 8". Backpacks (multi-pocketed bags worn on the back) are prohibited unless specifically designed for medical or infant care. Permitted items include soft-sided coolers containing food and/or non-alcoholic drinks in sealed plastic bottles, small purses, food bags, and unopened sealed non-alcoholic plastic bottles; hard-sided coolers of any size are prohibited. All carry-in items are subject to inspection at entry and any time inside, and cannot be left unattended.
venueAccessRestrictions: All fans and staff must undergo a metal detector scan (wallets, keys and phones may stay in pockets or be held above the head); all carry-in items are inspected at entry and are subject to search at any time inside. Guests who refuse metal detection or item inspection are refused entry or asked to leave. Prohibited items include weapons/firearms (including valid CCW), hard-sided coolers, backpacks/multi-pocket bags, bags larger than 16x16x8, glass bottles, cans, alcoholic beverages, aerosols (spray sunscreen and bug spray permitted), drones, and noisemakers. Limited re-entry is permitted only through the designated Gapper's Alley gate, subject to metal detection, with no carry-in items allowed through the re-entry gate.
outsideFoodRules: Guests may bring food in soft-sided coolers not exceeding 16" x 16" x 8" containing food and/or non-alcoholic drinks in sealed plastic bottles, plus food bags. Hard-sided coolers of any size are prohibited, as are glass bottles, cans, and alcoholic beverages. Unopened non-alcoholic drinks are permitted only in clear plastic bottles with an unbroken safety seal.
food: Delaware North (Sportservice) operates all food and beverage stands, which are cashless-only (Cash-to-Card kiosks available). Local signature offerings include Skyline Chili, LaRosa's Pizza, Montgomery Inn BBQ, Graeter's ice cream, Big Red (Smokey) and Mr. Red's Smokehouse, alongside Chick-fil-A, Penn Station, and an All-You-Can-Eat stand.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates open 60 minutes prior to the start of the game Monday–Thursday and 90 minutes prior Friday–Sunday. Opening Day (3/26) gates open 2 hours prior. The Season Ticket Member gate on Crosley Terrace opens 30 minutes before normal gate opening.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Gate opening varies by day of week: 60 minutes before first pitch Mon–Thu, 90 minutes Fri–Sun. 2026 exceptions: Opening Day (3/26) 2 hours prior; Kids Opening Day (3/28) shortly after the player parade; April 25 gates at 5:30 p.m. (Hall of Fame Induction); June 24 2 hours prior; Sept 14, 15, 16 each 90 minutes prior. The Reds reserve the right to alter entry times in coordination with the City of Cincinnati.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Backpacks (multi-pocketed bags worn on the back) are prohibited unless specifically designed for medical or infant care.

name: Rate Field

parkingLots.name: Lot A
parkingLots.notes: Located at 35th and Wentworth; holds all group buses (prepaid passes via group sales). Also the designated Rideshare Lot on the Wentworth Avenue side for pick-up/drop-off, open until one hour after games.

parkingLots.name: Premium Lot B
parkingLots.notes: Designated ADA parking for vehicles with state-issued disability placards/plates. Fans needing assistance may be dropped off/picked up in Lot B; access to Lot B and Gate C via 33rd Street.

parkingLots.notes: Designated ADA parking. Northwest corner of 35th & Shields hosts the independent bag-checking facility.

parkingLots.name: Lot E

lines: Metra Rock Island Line (35th Street / Bronzeville station)
publicTransit.notes: Rate Field is just off the Sox-35th station of the CTA Red Line (wheelchair accessible) and served by a number of bus routes. The Metra stop is at 35th Street just east of the Dan Ryan Expressway on the Rock Island Line; the Bronzeville station is accessible.

rideshareDropoff: Fans are encouraged to use rideshare. The Rideshare Lot is located in Lot A on the Wentworth Avenue side for pick-up and drop-off, open until one hour after the conclusion of home games. Rideshare arrivals should enter and exit through Gate 5.
accessibility: Designated ADA parking is available in Lot C, Lot E and Premium Lot B for vehicles with disability placards/plates, with drop-off/pick-up allowed in Lot B. Sightline-accessible and wheelchair seating is located on all levels, reached via elevators at Gate 5 and behind home plate and escalators at Gates 3 and 5; every washroom is wheelchair-equipped, service animals are welcome, and wheelchair escorts are available at the gates.
bagPolicyNotes: Permitted bags are clear plastic/vinyl/PVC bags not exceeding 12" x 12" x 6", or small non-clear clutch bags measuring 9" x 5" x 2" or smaller. Diaper bags (when a child is present) and medically necessary bags are allowed, subject to additional search. Prohibited: any non-clear bag larger than 9" x 5" x 2", backpacks (including clear backpacks), soft/hard coolers and ice chests, drawstring bags, luggage, and computer bags.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is permitted in the parking lots until the scheduled start of the game and is not permitted after the game. Tents or other obstructions in the main pathways are not allowed; fans must set up in their own parking space and keep pathways clear for emergency personnel and traffic.

venueAccessRestrictions: Rate Field uses walk-through metal detectors at each entry gate, and all bags are subject to search or will not be allowed in. Once a guest exits the ballpark they may not return (no re-entry). Prohibited items include weapons, backpacks of any kind, hard-sided bags/containers, glass/metal/aluminum containers, bottles or cans, outside alcohol, noisemakers, drones, aerosol cans, and selfie sticks/tripods.
outsideFoodRules: Single-serving food items may be brought in if contained in one of the approved bags under the bag policy or carried in your hands so they can be safely screened by security; guests may also carry food in a small, clear see-through plastic bag. One factory-sealed or empty plastic bottle no larger than one liter is permitted. Guests needing an exception to the carry-in policy should enter Gate 5 and ask for a security supervisor.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates to the ballpark normally open 90 minutes prior to first pitch (with the exception of the home opener).

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Gate times differ for the home opener; any other changes to gate times are announced via press release and the team's social media channels. 35th Street closes 90 minutes prior to the scheduled first pitch.
tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Parking lots open two hours before the start of every game (except the home opener); tailgating is permitted until the scheduled start of the game and is not permitted afterward.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Exceptions to the bag/carry-in policy are made for diaper bags (when a child is present) and medically necessary bags, subject to additional search. Guests needing an exception should enter Gate 5 and ask for a security supervisor.

Accessible seating via the Ticketmaster Ticket Office (440) 891-5050 or Tickets@ClevelandBrowns.com; limited event-day ADA relocations at Guest Services locations.
bagPolicyNotes: Clear bag policy (NFL): clear plastic/vinyl/PVC bags up to 12" x 12" x 6", official NFL team logo clear totes to the same size, or a one-gallon clear freezer bag. Small non-clear bags up to 4.5" x 6.5" (any style, incl. fanny pack or cross-body) are permitted; each family member may carry one approved clear bag plus a clutch. Diaper, nursing and medical bags allowed after inspection at the Southwest or Southeast Canada Dry City Club medical exception entrances. Non-approved bags may be stored at the Bag Check Tent (southwest corner, near the Meijer Gate), $20 per bag, credit card only; drop off when gates open, pick up within 30 minutes after the event.
outsideFoodRules: Small food items for personal consumption are welcome; all food must be carried in either a factory-sealed bag or a gallon-sized clear bag. Outside beverages are not permitted inside the stadium.
food: Concessions throughout (C-Town Eats, Mabel's BBQ, NEO Pizza, Symon's Burger Joint and more; non-alcoholic beverages at all stands). Select stands offer Express Access, presented by Bud Light, letting fans 21+ skip the line at designated Express lanes; available at all Browns games.

name: Huntington Bank Stadium

parkingLots.name: Oak Street Ramp
parkingLots.notes: Day-of-game single game parking $30 (credit card only, first come first served); No Tailgating. Second alternate for single-game ADA parking.

parkingLots.name: Church Street Garage
parkingLots.notes: Day-of-game single game parking $30 (credit card only, first come first served); No Tailgating.

parkingLots.name: Washington Avenue Ramp
parkingLots.notes: Day-of-game single game parking $30 (credit card only, first come first served); No Tailgating.

parkingLots.name: East River Road Garage
parkingLots.notes: Day-of-game single game parking $15 (credit card only, first come first served); No Tailgating.

parkingLots.name: State Fairgrounds Lot S108 (St. Paul)
parkingLots.notes: Day-of-game parking $15 (vehicle) / $60 (RV); Tailgating Permitted. St. Paul Gopher Football Shuttle runs from here to the stadium starting 3 hours before the game.

parkingLots.name: Victory Lot
parkingLots.notes: Overnight RV parking near Huntington Bank Stadium available to season pass holders only; each RV stall = 6 adjacent standard vehicle spaces.

parkingLots.name: University Avenue Ramp
parkingLots.notes: Recommended for single-game ADA parking; if sold out, alternatives are 4th Street Ramp then Oak Street Ramp.

publicTransit.notes: Metro Transit provides maps and schedules at metrotransit.org/gopher-sports; Minnesota Valley Transit Authority (mvta.com) serves the south metro; Lorenz Bus Service offers group charter buses. St. Paul Gopher Football Shuttle transports fans from Lot S108 (St. Paul fairgrounds lot) to the stadium and back, running continuously starting 3 hours before the game and every 10 minutes during the game.

accessibility: ADA parking is available in each parking facility surrounding the stadium; requires a gameday parking pass plus a government-issued ADA placard. University Avenue Ramp is recommended for single-game ADA parking (then 4th Street Ramp, then Oak Street Ramp). A designated ADA dropoff location is off University Ave. on the southwest corner of the stadium near Gate E. Courtesy shuttles operate from surrounding lots; paratransit service operates pre-game, during, and one hour post-game from Lot S108. Elevators are available at all major gates (priority for guests requiring extra assistance). ADA and handicap accessible seats are available throughout; contact Gopher Fan Relations at 1-800-U-GOPHER or GopherSports@umn.edu. Complimentary bag check is located in the University Ave. Lobby of Williams Arena. Live captioning is provided on the main and auxiliary video boards and concourse TVs. M Health Fairview Mamava lactation pods are on the main concourse near Gate A and the 4th floor loge level, plus near Club Cambria.

tailgating.rules: Prohibited: kegs, drinking game accessories, large-quantity/common-source alcohol containers, glass containers of any kind, disruptive music/noise, couches or large furniture, unauthorized promotional/marketing activity, unauthorized sale of products/food/beverages, and blocking travel aisles. Permitted: consumption of alcohol by legal-age persons in compliance with laws, portable outdoor furniture, portable generators, and tents/awnings that do not block adjacent spaces or drive aisles and require no stakes (all items set up behind the white fire line). Vehicles parking together must arrive together; saving spaces is not permitted; all spaces require a parking pass. Standard portable restrooms and trash/recycling bags are provided.
tailgating.timeWindow: Weekends: lots open 6 hours prior to game time but no earlier than 7 a.m. Weekdays: lots open 6 hours prior to game time but no earlier than 2 p.m. Lots close 4 hours after the game ends or midnight, whichever is earlier.
tailgating.grillRules: Gas grills with a maximum propane cylinder of 20 pounds are permitted. Open fires fueled by charcoal, wood, or other combustible materials are prohibited.
tailgating.rvPolicy: Overnight RV parking is available in the Victory Lot to season pass holders only and only for Saturday football games. Each RV stall comprises 6 adjacent standard vehicle spaces; the RV and one vehicle must fit within the assigned stall. Entry times: Friday 6 p.m.-10 p.m., Saturday 7 a.m.-10 p.m.; RVs must vacate by 12 p.m. Sunday. RV tailgaters must adhere to Minneapolis quiet hours (10 p.m.-7 a.m.). RVs must be self-sufficient (no power/water hookups). Single-game RV parking is available at State Fairgrounds Lot S108 for $60.

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Animals (except service animals), Backpacks, luggage, grocery, duffle bags, large bags, large purses, cinch bags, computer bags, briefcases, and any other bag that does not meet the bag policy, Balloons, Balls (beach balls, footballs, baseballs, etc.), Banners or signs exceeding 24" x 36", Boxes, wrapped gifts or items, Camcorders and tripods, Cameras with lenses over six inches long, Cans, bottles, and thermoses (exception: fans may bring an empty clear plastic bottle into the venue. Water fountains are available within the facility)., Chairbacks with structural metal frames or that attach to benches, soft seat cushions less than 2" thick without framing are permitted, Coolers of any kind, including small soft packs, Externally-Powered Heated Blankets, Fireworks, Illegal drugs, Laptops, iPads, tablets, video cameras, or any large electronic devices, Laser pointers, Markers (permanent) and/or paint, Noisemaking devices, Oars, Objects that can be used as a missile or projectile, Offensive or profane signage, Outside food and drinks, Pepper spray or mace (aerosol or gel), Smoking devices (vape pens, e-cigars, tank systems, etc.), Sticks, selfie sticks, and flag poles, Strollers, Tobacco products, Umbrellas, Weapons, All other items deemed prohibited at the discretion of stadium management. No re-entry. All patrons and staff will be subject to metal-detection/screening upon entry
outsideFoodRules: No outside food or beverage is allowed in Huntington Bank Stadium. Exception: fans may bring an empty clear plastic bottle into the venue (water fountains are available within the facility). All concession stands are cashless.
food: Concessions are available throughout the stadium and all concession stands are cashless. Beer, wine, hard seltzer, ready-to-drink (RTD) cans, and batch cocktails are sold throughout; full-service bars in premium areas. Alcohol sales start 1.5 hours prior to kickoff and end at the end of the 3rd quarter, with a 2-drink maximum per valid ID per transaction (must be 21+). Concessions map, concessions glossary, and alternative dietary items guides are available.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Public Gates (open 1.5 hours prior to game time)

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Huntington Bank Stadium ticket office opens 3 hours prior to kick-off. Auxiliary/credential entrances open at varying times: Cook County (football recruits) 2 hours prior, Dodge County (media/credentials) 5 hours prior but no earlier than 7 a.m., Murray County (concessionaire/food service) 6 hours prior, and Lincoln County (security/custodial, S-A ticket pickup) 7 hours prior. Tailgate lots open 6 hours prior to kick-off.
tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Tailgate lots open 6 hours prior to kick-off (no earlier than 7 a.m. on weekends / 2 p.m. on weekdays) and close 4 hours after the game ends or midnight, whichever is earlier.

name: Husky Stadium

parkingLots.name: E12
parkingLots.notes: Football tailgating lot; recycling and compost bins provided in the lot on gameday

parkingLots.name: Padelford
parkingLots.notes: Football tailgating/parking area near the stadium

rideshareDropoff: Lyft and Uber rideshare services can be used to reach the game (no dedicated drop-off location specified).
accessibility: ADA-accessible, easy-access and wheelchair seating available on a season or single-game basis; arranged through the Husky Ticket Office at (206) 543-2200 or tickets@uw.edu.
bagPolicyNotes: Each person is allowed one (1) clear bag and one (1) small clutch. The clear bag must be no larger than 12" x 6" x 12", made of clear PVC vinyl, or a one-gallon Ziploc bag.
venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: purses, backpacks, diaper bags, binocular cases, camera cases, fanny packs, luggage, seat cushions with a zipper, any bag larger than the permissible size, any bag that is not clear. All guests and items are subject to search.
outsideFoodRules: Single servings of food are permitted, along with empty or factory-sealed plastic water bottles, thermoses, unopened soft-sided juice boxes and baby bottles, and medically necessary food/liquids; items must comply with the clear bag policy.
food: Husky Stadium concessions are cashless (card-only transactions at concession stands and the ticket office).

name: Jack Trice Stadium

parkingLots.name: Donor Parking Lots
parkingLots.notes: Cyclone Club donor lots; open 6:00 a.m. for 11:00/11:30 a.m. kickoffs, six hours before kickoff for noon-4:00 p.m. kickoffs, and 10:00 a.m. for kickoffs after 4:00 p.m.

parkingLots.name: Public Grass Parking Lots
parkingLots.notes: General public, first-come first-served; open 6:00 a.m. for 11:00/11:30 a.m. kickoffs and six hours before kickoff for noon or later. Pre-sale single-game passes sold online, ending Noon the Friday before each game or when sold out.

parkingLots.name: RV Village
parkingLots.notes: For Cyclone Club members issued RV permits; numbered spaces.

parkingLots.name: ISU Research Park
parkingLots.notes: RV and free parking about one mile south of the stadium; tailgating prohibited; available from Fridays at 5:00 PM.

parkingLots.name: ISU central campus
parkingLots.notes: Free parking within one mile of the stadium; tailgating not permitted.

rideshareDropoff: Uber, Lyft, taxis and similar services are directed to drop off and pick up around Stephens Auditorium; rideshare vehicles are not permitted inside the parking lots or to stop in traffic.
accessibility: A Fan Services and Accessibility Guide covers accessible parking, elevators, shuttles, courtesy carts, restrooms, first aid and other amenities; a lactation room is on the east concourse at the north end of Jack Trice Club.
bagPolicyNotes: Small clutch bags no larger than 6x9 inches are permitted; exceptions will be made for bags containing items required for medical, family, or child care.

tailgating.rules: Limit tailgating to your one parking space (one space per pass, strictly enforced); tents no larger than 10'x10'; keep travel lanes clear; no glass bottles, kegs or open fires; no tailgating from elevated surfaces (vehicle beds, roofs, trailers); no professional sound/DJ equipment or amplifier-connected/standalone speakers without approval (small boom boxes OK, sound must stay within your area, 70 decibels); clean up before leaving. Beer and wine allowed in parking areas; hard liquor prohibited on public property; under-21 may not use alcohol on university property.
tailgating.grillRules: LP (propane) and charcoal grills and LP heaters permitted when temperature warrants; LP limited to one 20-lb cylinder per device with no spares; open wood fires and portable fire pits not permitted; dispose of used charcoal/ash properly (not in trash cans, under trees, or left in the lots).
tailgating.rvPolicy: Cyclone Club members with RV permits park in the numbered RV Village; additional RV parking at ISU Research Park about one mile south (tailgating prohibited there), available from Fridays at 5:00 PM.

venueAccessRestrictions: Re-entry is allowed at all gates: tickets must be scanned out on exit and scanned again on re-entry. Re-entry is not allowed before kickoff or after the start of the 4th quarter.

gatesOpen.ruleText: All gates will open 90 minutes prior to game time.

name: JMA Wireless Dome

parkingLots.name: Comstock Parking Lot
parkingLots.notes: Game-day shuttle bus to College Place departs from here

parkingLots.name: Colvin Parking Lot
parkingLots.notes: Game-day shuttle bus to College Place departs from here

parkingLots.name: Skytop Office Building lot (South Campus)
parkingLots.notes: Game-day shuttle bus to College Place departs from the front of the Skytop Office Building

publicTransit.notes: Game-day shuttle buses depart from the Skytop Office Building (South Campus), Comstock Parking Lot, and Colvin Parking Lot and drop off at College Place; during events the shuttle runs every 15 minutes from College Place back to the parking lots.

rideshareDropoff: Designated rideshare pick-up/drop-off at the Waverly Avenue & South Crouse Avenue intersection (the 'Newhouse Loop'), next to the SI Newhouse School; exit the Dome at Gates M & N. A secondary rideshare location is on the Waverly Avenue side of Bird Library.
accessibility: For accessible services, parking, seating, and accommodations at the JMA Dome, see the Accessibility Services page. Assistive listening devices are available free at Guest Services (Section 107). All restrooms are handicap accessible; family/gender-neutral restrooms are near Sections 104, 117, 122, 123, 124. A Quiet Room / sensory-friendly space is at Section 119, and KultureCity sensory-inclusive bags are available at Guest Services.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is permitted only within the lined parking space directly behind or in front of your parked vehicle; other parking spaces cannot be used for tailgating or other purposes. Excessive consumption of alcohol on University property is prohibited and impaired patrons may be denied entry. Smoking and tobacco use are prohibited on all Syracuse University property, including parking lots and garages.
tailgating.grillRules: Safety regulations prohibit any open flame (propane, charcoal, etc.) in Syracuse University parking garages, and this is strictly enforced on all levels of the garages.

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Alcohol of any kind, Coolers – including small soft sided coolers, Open Bottled Water, Food or Beverage – excluding items needed for health/special reasons, Weapons – including pocket knives, Back Packs or Large Purses, Baby Strollers, Skateboards or Recreational Scooters, Balloons, Animals – excluding certified service animals, Balls, Bats, Frisbees, Sticks, Noise Makers or Air Horns, Banners or Signs on Poles, Camcorders, Cameras with 6” or larger zoom lens, Video Recording Equipment, including GoPro Cameras, Sticks and Tripods, Laptops, iPads or similar tablet devices, Laser Pointers, Confetti, Body and Face Paint, Umbrellas - Small personal umbrellas are permitted to be carried into the JMA Dome. Large umbrellas with a plastic or metal tip are not permitted. All bags are subject to search upon entry and subject to additional search within the stadium.
outsideFoodRules: Guests may bring one sealed bottle of water; all other outside food and beverage is prohibited. Exceptions are made for health/special conditions.
food: The JMA Dome is a cashless venue: major credit/debit cards and mobile payment (Apple Pay, Google Pay) are accepted at all concession and merchandise stands; cash is not accepted and there are no ATMs. Two cash-to-card (reverse ATM) machines are available at Gate B and Gate C. Beer is limited to two per purchase and sales close at the end of halftime, except the 'Cuse Chicken stand (Sec 106), the Loud House Grill (Sec 111), and Miron Victory Court, which serve alcohol through the end of the 3rd quarter.

name: Joan C. Edwards Stadium
accessibility: Wheelchair and accessible seating is reserved in row 21 of sections 104, 122, 105, 128, and 130; advance reservations are encouraged through the ticket office and guests must provide their own wheelchair. On a single-game basis, patrons may use the handicap drop-off zone in 4 1/2 Alley next to the stadium (season handicap parking sold through the ticket office). Elevators to the Big Green Room, Press Box, and Sky Suites are near Gate B in the west concourse; ADA elevator passes to the Big Green Room can be arranged via the Big Green at 304-696-4661.
venueAccessRestrictions: No re-entry permitted. Marshall reserves the right to examine the contents of any container brought into the venue
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverages are listed among prohibited items and are not permitted; ice chests are also prohibited.
food: Beer is available for purchase along the West and East concourses inside the gates; beer, wine, and malt beverages are available in the Big Green Room. Alcohol sales conclude at the end of the 3rd quarter, and alcoholic beverages may not be brought into the stadium.

gatesOpen.ruleText: The gates open one and one-half hours (90 minutes) before game time unless otherwise advertised.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Gate B for suite holders opens two hours before game time unless otherwise advertised.

name: Jones Stadium

parkingLots.name: USA Auto (single game)
parkingLots.notes: Paid single-game lot; passes available in advance or day of game when entering the lot (day-of sales credit/debit only). Serviced by gameday buses (USA Auto Red), beginning 3 hours before kickoff until 1 hour after the game.

parkingLots.name: S-1 (single game)
parkingLots.notes: Paid single-game lot; passes available in advance or day of game when entering. S-1 Area Reserved Spaces are unassigned. Serviced by gameday buses.

parkingLots.name: Raider Park Parking Garage
parkingLots.notes: Not available for day-of-game purchase when entering the lot.

parkingLots.name: Free Public Parking
parkingLots.notes: Free fan parking northwest of the Health Sciences Center at Texas Tech Parkway & 5th Street; served by the Citibus park-and-ride shuttle.

parkingLots.name: Season-long Red Raider Club lots (incl. C-1, C-2, R-24, DLE)
parkingLots.notes: Season-long lots; most require a minimum Red Raider Club membership level and permit fee. C-1, C-2, R-24 and DLE are assigned-space lots.

accessibility: ADA elevator access on the west side via Gate 1B (Media/ADA Entrance) to the mezzanine level. ADA/wheelchair seating available game-by-game (reserved ADA seats in row 34 of sections 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 18); contact the ticket office at 806-742-TECH; standing not allowed in the ADA seating area. ADA public parking is north of the TTU Health Sciences Center (off 5th Street and Joliet) with a valid ADA placard; the ADA shuttle drops off and picks up at Gate 3 ($6, cashless via GoPass).
bagPolicyNotes: Guests will be able to carry the following style and size bag, package or container into the venue: bags that are clear plastic, vinyl or PVC and do not exceed 12" x 6" x 12."; one-gallon clear plastic freezer bag (Ziploc bag or similar); small clutch bags, approximately the size of a hand, with or without a handle or strap can be taken into the venue with one of the clear plastic bags. An exception will be made for medically necessary items after proper inspection.

tailgating.rules: Tents may not exceed 10'x10' and, if in a parking space, must fit within one space. Food and beverages purchased in Raider Alley may not be brought into the stadium. General tailgating info via the Red Raider Club (806-742-1196); large/corporate/private tailgates via REVELxp (TGE), the official fan experience partner.
tailgating.timeWindow: Game-day reserved/paid lots open 7:30 AM; RV lots open Friday at 5:30 PM (no exit required until 10 AM Sunday). Raider Alley (Engineering Key) opens to the public 4 hours before kickoff.
tailgating.rvPolicy: RV lots open Friday evenings at 5:30 PM and do not have to exit until 10 AM Sunday. RVs must park in their assigned space, except S-1 Area Reserved Spaces, which are unassigned. Be considerate of neighbors when using generators. RV info via the Texas Tech Ticket Office (806-742-TECH) or Red Raider Club (806-742-1196).

venueAccessRestrictions: No Re-Entry is allowed at Galaxy Stadium without a new ticket.
nearby: Raider Alley, presented by Bud Light (benefiting the Red Raider Club), is the pre-game and tailgating hub at Texas Tech's historic Engineering Key in the heart of campus; opens 4 hours before kickoff with live music (Raider Alley Concert Series), kids' activities (face painting, balloon artist, rock-climbing wall), a pep rally with the Goin' Band, food, soft drinks, and beer/wine for purchase, plus outdoor LED TVs.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverages are not allowed in the stadium. Exception: one unopened 20 oz (or less) bottle of water (not frozen) or one empty beverage container may be brought in (outdoor athletics events only). Cans, glass, bottles, and coolers/ice chests are prohibited. Food and beverages purchased in Raider Alley may not be brought into the stadium.
food: Concessions operated by Oak View Group. 17 permanent concession stands (Stand 1 by Gate 1 around to Stand 17, Big Chicken, in the southeast corner of the South End Zone) plus six portable stands on the west and east concourses. Five Grab & Go self-checkout marketplaces: Let's Go (near Gate 1), Matador (west-side mezzanine), 4th & Go (near Gate 3), Take 3 (near Gate 4), and Touchdown Tavern (premium/south end zone). Beer and wine are sold along the concourse. The venue is fully cashless (credit/debit, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay).

name: Jordan–Hare Stadium

parkingLots.name: VCOM Lot
parkingLots.notes: 910 South Donahue Drive; complimentary accessible parking on gameday (state-issued ADA hang tag or license plate required; the individual issued the tag must be present)

parkingLots.name: Gogue Performing Arts Center Lot
parkingLots.notes: Woodfield Drive; pre-purchased accessible parking

parkingLots.name: District Energy Lot
parkingLots.notes: Wire Road; pre-purchased accessible parking; ADA shuttles available from this lot

accessibility: Complimentary accessible parking on gameday at the VCOM Lot (910 South Donahue Dr); pre-purchased accessible parking at the Gogue Performing Arts Center Lot (Woodfield Dr) and District Energy Lot (Wire Road), state-issued ADA hang tag or plate required. ADA shuttles run from the white medical tent at War Eagle Way & Donahue to Gate 14 (west) and Gate 1 (east) beginning three hours prior to kickoff (Gate 14 only after kickoff until the fourth quarter), plus shuttles from the District Energy Lot. Assistive listening devices available at guest service tables outside Gate 1C and Gate 14. Sensory-inclusive venue partnered with KultureCity: sensory bags and the SOUND mobile sensory room at the Gate 1 Guest Services Hub. SNASY/Tiger Babies air-conditioned pod outside Gate 1 with changing station and supplies. Stroller check at the Gate 1C Guest Services Hub and inside Gate 14.
bagPolicyNotes: A clear bag policy is in effect at Jordan-Hare Stadium. Non-compliant / non-clear bags may be checked free of charge outside the west ticket booth between Gates 13 and 14 and outside Gate 1C (Guest Services Hub); medical bags may also be checked at Gate 14. Walk-through metal detectors are in place at all gates on football gamedays.
venueAccessRestrictions: No pass-outs are given for any reason; if you leave the stadium you must purchase another ticket to re-enter, and re-entry is not allowed if tickets are unavailable. An emergency or medical-need pass can be obtained at the First Aid Station at Section 46. Walk-through metal detectors are implemented at all gates on football gamedays.
outsideFoodRules: Fans are allowed to bring in one empty clear water bottle for use at the complimentary water refill stations and one unopened factory-sealed bottle of water (up to 1 liter in size).

name: Kaseya Center

parkingLots.name: P2 Parking Garage
parkingLots.notes: Parking for ADA guests is available on a first-come, first-serve basis with spaces adjacent to Elevators 1&2, 3&4, and 7&8.

parkingLots.name: P1 Garage
parkingLots.notes: Overheight parking for vans is available on a first-come, first-serve basis.

rideshareDropoff: Uber/RideShare drop-off is located at the corner of Bayshore Drive & HEAT Blvd, using Gate 6 for entry.

name: Kauffman Stadium

parkingLots.name: Lot A
parkingLots.notes: Cabs and all rideshare services are available in the middle of Lot A after first pitch; post-game rideshare uses a designated Traffic Row in the middle of Lot A.

parkingLots.name: Lot B
parkingLots.notes: Bikes may be locked on the media fence in Lot B near designated signage; parking fees are waived for those who bike to the stadium.

parkingLots.name: Lot L
parkingLots.notes: Accessible parking spaces are available in all parking lots except Lot L and Lot N.

parkingLots.name: Lot N
parkingLots.notes: No accessible parking spaces; larger tailgating groups could be asked to move to Lot N depending on group size.

publicTransit.notes: The 47 Martin Luther King Jr. serves Kauffman Stadium 7 days a week to Royals games and back; schedules at ridekc.org or 816-221-0660.

rideshareDropoff: Rideshare services (Uber, Lyft, taxi) are available at Kauffman Stadium. Pre-Game East Side: enter through Toll Gate 3, drop off in front of Blue KC Gate D (first base), then exit west through Gate 7. Pre-Game West Side: enter through Toll Gate 5, drop off in front of Price Chopper Gate B (third base), exit west at Gate 7. Post-Game: enter through Gate 1 and look for the designated Traffic Row in the middle of Lot A. Cabs and rideshare pick up in the middle of Lot A after first pitch / after each game.
accessibility: More than 500 reserved accessible parking spaces are available to properly licensed or tagged vehicles in all lots except Lot L and Lot N, with wheelchair ramps in all lots and a limited number of van-accessible spaces. There is a designated accessible entrance at each gate, all restrooms are accessible, and elevators serve all levels (100-level access via the UMB Diamond Club or Royals Hall of Fame lobby). Guest Ambassadors provide wheelchair escorts inside each gate and golf-cart shuttle service to/from the parking lots; accessible drop-off is available at Gates B and D.
bagPolicyNotes: The only bags approved for entry are a clear bag no larger than 12" x 12" x 6" (with items easily visible) or a one-gallon clear zip-seal bag; a small clutch not exceeding 9" x 5" (with or without a strap) may also be carried in along with one clear bag option. An exception may be made for medical-reason bags or manufactured diaper bags accompanying infants and young children after proper inspection.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is allowed, but guests must only use the tailgate area behind their vehicle. Guests will be asked to enter the game or leave the complex beginning in the 2nd inning (tailgating throughout the game is prohibited). Saving spaces, buying additional parking spaces to tailgate, and tailgating in a parking space are all prohibited; do not block the roadway; outdoor camping toilets are prohibited. Parking lots close one hour after the event ends. Larger tailgating groups could be asked to move to Lot N.

venueAccessRestrictions: Per MLB Security Standards, all guests must comply with metal-detection screening (or accept a physical pat-down) to enter Kauffman Stadium. There is a no re-entry policy: once a guest exits through the stadium gates they may not re-enter, except in an emergency or with an approved re-entry wristband from the Plaza-level Guest Services office. Prohibited items include weapons/fireworks (guns and pocket knives), coolers of any kind, drinks other than one sealed 1-liter-or-smaller water/sports-drink bottle per person, cameras with 12"+ lenses, noisemakers (bullhorns/airhorns/cowbells), lasers, aerosol cans, drones, baseball bats, beach balls, and wrapped gifts.
outsideFoodRules: Guests may bring individual-portion food in a clear plastic bag no larger than 1 gallon. Hard-sided coolers, alcoholic beverages, and other non-clear liquid containers are not permitted. Unfrozen water is allowed in a sealed/unopened plastic 1-liter-or-smaller bottle (one per person); frozen bottles of any liquid are prohibited. Soft-sided single juice or milk containers or ADA-required liquids may also be allowed.
food: Signature dining and social spaces include Rivals Sports Bar beyond right field, Boulevard Brewing Craft & Draft on the Loge Level (20+ beers on tap plus a quick-fire artisan pizzeria), Joe's KC Bar-B-Que, Belfonte Ice Cream, and the Miller Lite Fountain Bar in the Outfield Experience; a Dining Guide highlights fan-favorite restaurants along with vegetarian and gluten-free options.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Friday–Sunday games: all gates open 1.5 hours prior to game time. Monday–Thursday games: all gates open 1 hour prior to game time. CommunityAmerica Gate C opens 2 hours prior for CommunityAmerica Crown Club ticket holders (Sections 1–6) only. The Outfield Experience and Boulevard Brewing Craft & Draft open 1.5 hours before all games through Gates A & E. On giveaway days all gates open 1.5 hours prior.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Gates open 90 minutes before Friday–Sunday (and giveaway-day) games but only 60 minutes before Monday–Thursday games. CommunityAmerica Gate C opens 2 hours early for Crown Club ticket holders (Sections 1–6); the Outfield Experience and Craft & Draft open 1.5 hours before all games via Gates A & E.
tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Tailgating ends at the start of the 2nd inning, when guests are asked to enter the game or leave the complex; parking lots close one hour after the event ends.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: An exception may be made for medical-reason bags or manufactured diaper bags that accompany infants and young children after proper inspection.

parkingLots.notes: General ($25) and pre-paid online ($20 + convenience fee) available

parkingLots.notes: General ($25) and pre-paid online ($20 + convenience fee) available

parkingLots.name: Ambulatory Care Center Lot (ACC)
parkingLots.notes: ADA/accessible parking $25 (card only) off Mason Farm Road; requires valid state disability plate, placard or permit; game-day shuttle to Gates 2 and 6

rideshareDropoff: Taxi, Uber and Lyft may drop off and pick up passengers along the South Columbia bus lane between Manning Drive and South Road.
accessibility: ADA parking is in the Ambulatory Care Center Lot (ACC) off Mason Farm Road, $25 (card only), and must be accompanied by a valid state disability plate, placard or permit. Wheelchair-accessible vans/buses shuttle to Gate 2 (north side) and Gate 6 (south side) beginning 3 hours prior to the game and operating until 10 minutes after kickoff. Accessible seating is in sections 100, 112-119, and 131. Parking permits are not valid before 8:00 a.m. Accommodation requests via the Accessibility Request Form, adatickets@unc.edu, or 919-962-2296.
bagPolicyNotes: Small clutch purses no larger than 4.5" x 6.5" are allowed. Necessary medical items are allowed following inspection at entry gates. Up to two unopened 20 ounce or smaller bottles of water per person, plus empty drink containers that can be filled at drinking fountains. Exceptions: camera bags, binocular cases, seat cushions with pockets, and clear backpacks if they are not larger than the dimensions. All prohibited items must be returned to your vehicles or discarded at the gates.

tailgating.rules: REVELxp offers reserved turnkey tailgates in premium locations including the Bell Tower and the amphitheater outside the Kenan Football Center, plus other spots surrounding Kenan Stadium (reserve via unc@revelxp.com or 919-869-5486). Rameses Recycles tailgate recycling accepts recyclables in paper bags only (no longer in plastic bags); fans are asked to tailgate responsibly and leave their space clean.

venueAccessRestrictions: Re-entry is not permitted.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverage is prohibited from being brought into Kenan Stadium; up to two unopened water bottles (20 oz or less) per person are allowed.
food: Food and drink concession stands are located throughout Kenan Stadium and are cashless (Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, Apple Pay). Beer and wine are sold at multiple locations; fans are limited to two alcoholic beverages per transaction, with alcohol sales starting when gates open and ending at the start of the fourth quarter.

gatesOpen.ruleText: The gates to Kenan Stadium will open 90 minutes prior to kickoff.

name: Kia Center

parkingLots.name: ThreatLocker Garage
parkingLots.notes: Adjacent to Kia Center with pedestrian bridge access to Terrace Level via 5th floor, elevators provide access to all floors.

rideshareDropoff: Guests are encouraged to be dropped off and picked up at the corner of Hughey and Pine Street, just a short walk from the arena.

name: Kidd Brewer Stadium

parkingLots.name: Watauga County Parking Deck
parkingLots.notes: Single-game parking for fans without a Yosef Club pass, $50, near the courthouse at 140 N. Water Street.

parkingLots.name: Levine College of Health Sciences
parkingLots.notes: Free, 75 first-come first-serve spaces, with the AppalCART route to campus.

parkingLots.name: Hill Street ADA parking
parkingLots.notes: AppalCART shuttle to Kidd Brewer Stadium.

parkingLots.name: Yosef Club parking lots
parkingLots.notes: Passholders only; lots open at 8 a.m. for 2:30 or 3:30 p.m. kickoffs, subject to change.

publicTransit.notes: AppalCART runs four extra routes and two shuttles on Saturdays when there is a football game. The Purple, Express, Orange and Gray routes begin four hours before kickoff and stop two hours after the game has ended. Two paratransit-equipped buses shuttle between the stadium and the Hill Street parking lots behind the Convocation Center, beginning four hours before the game and running until the fourth quarter; from the start of the fourth quarter, paratransit shuttles run from the Stadium East Gate to the Hill Street parking lot for approximately two hours, and a 30-minute traffic delay is expected at the end of the game. On home game days a shuttle also connects the Poplar Grove Connector parking lot and the Peacock Traffic Circle. If a game is on a weekday, the normal bus schedule runs until 10 p.m. and the game day schedules run after that. All scheduled times depend on traffic.

accessibility: AppalCART provides a shuttle from Hill Street ADA parking to Kidd Brewer Stadium. For information on parking and seating for guests with disabilities, contact the Athletics Ticket Office at 828-262-7733 or visit the customer service booths outside the North End Zone on game day.
bagPolicyNotes: Approved bags are clear plastic bags no larger than 12 by 6 by 12 inches and small clutch purses no larger than 4.5 by 6.5 inches. Diaper bags, backpacks, binocular cases, camera cases, tinted or printed pattern plastic bags, fanny packs, oversized tote bags, mesh bags and purses larger than 4.5 by 6.5 inches are not approved. Yosef's Locker and the North End Zone plaza merchandise tent sell approved clear bags. Foam seat cushions without back supports or storage features are allowed, as are seatbacks up to 18 inches wide without armrests, bleacher clamps or storage features; all items are subject to security inspection at entry. Exceptions are made for medically necessary items after inspection at the stadium entrances.

tailgating.timeWindow: Yosef Club parking lots open to passholders for tailgating at 8 a.m. for games with 2:30 or 3:30 p.m. kickoffs, subject to change. Tailgating times change with kickoff times as they are announced.
tailgating.rules: Malt beverages and unfortified wine may be consumed in designated tailgating locations by fans of legal drinking age, and anyone drinking must be able to show a valid driver's license or photo ID on request. Liquor, kegs, common containers and glass containers are not permitted in any tailgating location, and no outside alcohol is permitted inside Kidd Brewer Stadium. Portable toilets are provided in the parking and tailgate areas, and staff hand out recycling and trash bags in all tailgate lots. Student tailgating information is on the Office of Campus Activities web page.

venueAccessRestrictions: Fans who exit Kidd Brewer Stadium during the game may not re-enter. Walk-through metal detectors at all five entrances to Kidd Brewer Stadium; fans will not be asked to remove keys, phones or other common items before passing through the metal detector.
outsideFoodRules: No outside food or drink is allowed into Kidd Brewer Stadium, except one unopened standard-size bottle of water per patron. Outside alcohol, outside food and beverages, and coolers or containers are on the prohibited items list.
food: Concession stands accept cash and card, with one dedicated cash-only lane at each main concession stand on the East and West concourses. Beer is sold at locations throughout the stadium through the end of the third quarter at $10 to $14 per can, with a limit of two alcoholic beverages per valid ID per transaction, and alcohol bought inside cannot be taken out of the stadium. Yosef's Sweet Shack in the West concourse serves frozen alcoholic slushies and other drinks, Grab & Go snack stations are on the West and East concourses, food trucks operate throughout the stadium, and shelled peanuts are sold at concession areas. Pizza is available to fans with west side club level tickets.

name: Kinnick Stadium
accessibility: ADA accessible seating and companion seating available at Kinnick Stadium, purchased through the UI Athletics Ticket Office; each accessible order eligible for up to three attendant seats subject to availability. North end zone ADA seats are reached via two street-level entrances with elevators off Evashevski Drive; all other accessible seats are on the concourse level and reachable from any gate. ADA parking and shuttle information is on the football parking page. Service animals permitted; pets prohibited. Certified Sensory Inclusive by KultureCity with sensory bags at Fans First stands near Gates B, H, I, and M. Assistive listening devices available at Guest Services (south concourse near Section 213) and UI Police HQ near Section 123.

tailgating.rules: Gameday alcohol and tailgate policies for areas outside Kinnick Stadium are published on the football parking page (Tailgate/Alcohol Policy). The Fan Code of Conduct is enforced in all stadium parking and tailgate areas; violations may result in loss of parking privileges.
tailgating.timeWindow: Official Hawkeye Tailgate in Krause Family Plaza (south side of the stadium) opens to all fans 3 hours prior to kickoff.

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Alcoholic beverages, Backpacks, purses, handbags and/or cinch bags, Banners and signs, Coolers, kegs, glass containers, CamelBak or other backpack style hydration systems, or refillable water bottles over 1 gallon, Footballs, Large lens cameras (6" or more) or tripods, Noisemakers, horns, bugles or any disruptive devices, Non-service animals, Personal chairbacks, Strollers and car seats, Tobacco of any kind (including e-cigarettes), Umbrellas, Video cameras, Weapons of any kind. Patrons will not be permitted to exit & re-enter Kinnick Stadium, including stadium exits from Krause Family Plaza and premium areas.
nearby: Melrose Avenue is lined with food and merchandise vendors on gameday. Krause Family Plaza on the south side outside Gate A hosts vendors and pregame activities.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food is permitted if carried in a clear storage bag (Ziploc or similar) no larger than one gallon. One factory-sealed or empty refillable water bottle is allowed, no larger than one gallon. Coolers, glass containers, and refillable bottles over one gallon are prohibited.
food: About twenty concession stands are located throughout the concourse, with additional food vendors in Krause Family Plaza (south end near Gate A). All concession and merchandise stands are cashless (credit/debit only). Free hydration stations are at Sections 102 and 120, with water fountains throughout the concourse.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Kinnick Stadium gates open 90 minutes prior to kickoff. Premium Club doors open two hours prior to kickoff.

tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Official Hawkeye Tailgate in Krause Family Plaza opens to all fans 3 hours prior to kickoff.

name: Kroger Field

parkingLots.name: Blue Lot (incl. Blue Disabled, Blue VIP)
parkingLots.notes: Permit reserved lot; tailgating lines are in place in the Blue Lot; access via Alumni Drive/Tates Creek per posted traffic signs

parkingLots.name: Green Lot
parkingLots.notes: Permit reserved lot; tailgating lines guide tent placement; access via Cooper Drive to Jerry Claiborne Way

parkingLots.name: Red Lot (incl. Red Disabled, Red VIP)
parkingLots.notes: Permit reserved lot next to the stadium; access via University Drive

parkingLots.name: Orange Lot
parkingLots.notes: Permit reserved lot; tailgating lines in place; access via Alumni Drive/University Drive

parkingLots.name: Purple Lot / Arboretum
parkingLots.notes: Permit reserved lot; access via Alumni Drive/Wildcat Court into the Arboretum

parkingLots.name: Yellow Lot (Parking Structure #1)
parkingLots.notes: Permit lot; access via University Drive to Hospital Drive to Veteran's Drive / PS#1 ramp (Hospital Drive closed to non-ER traffic on game day)

parkingLots.name: Yellow/Red Lot
parkingLots.notes: Permit lot off Cooper Drive prior to University Drive

parkingLots.name: White/Green Lot
parkingLots.notes: Permit lot off Sports Center Drive

parkingLots.name: Black/Green Lot (Parking Structure #7)
parkingLots.notes: Permit lot; access via Sports Center Drive

parkingLots.name: Library Lots (Single Game Reserved Parking)
parkingLots.notes: Corner of Woodland Avenue and Columbia Avenue near William T. Young Library; 206-vehicle capacity; disabled parking with valid state hang tag is $50 per vehicle, card payment only; first-come, first-served

parkingLots.name: Main RV Lot / Gluck RV Lot
parkingLots.notes: Permit RV lots (assigned numbered stalls); open to permits at 8 p.m. Friday; must be removed by noon Sunday

parkingLots.name: Cooper Drive (non-permit / visitor tailgating)
parkingLots.notes: First-come, first-served; setups and parking may begin no earlier than noon on Fridays before game day; two vehicles may parallel park along the painted 6' restraining line per designated tailgate area

parkingLots.name: Parking Structure #2
parkingLots.notes: Non-permit parking; accessible from University Drive near the WT Young Library

parkingLots.name: Parking Structure #6
parkingLots.notes: Non-permit parking; corner of Virginia Avenue and Press Avenue

parkingLots.name: Visitor RV Lot
parkingLots.notes: No-permit RVs park at corner of Virginia and Press Avenue (primary) with overflow near Press and Transcript Avenue; opens 6 p.m. Friday; free; no hookups; first-come, first-served

lines: UK Football Express – Virginia Ave. Shuttle (Lextran)
publicTransit.notes: $1 per person each way, paid onboard (exact change appreciated). Virginia Ave. Shuttle begins 2 hours before kickoff; Downtown Route begins 3 hours before kickoff; both are suspended 30 minutes after kickoff and resume post-game from the start of the 4th quarter until 1 hour after the game. Provided by Lextran.

accessibility: With a valid state-issued handicap hang tag, fans may park in the single-game reserved lots at the corner of Woodland Ave and Columbia Ave near William T. Young Library (206-vehicle capacity, $50 per vehicle, card payment only); once full, guests are directed to Parking Structures 2 or 6. A shuttle runs from the reserved lots to Gate 6 beginning 3 hours before kickoff, with return shuttles from the end of the 3rd/4th quarter until 30-60 minutes after the game. A limited-mobility guest golf-cart shuttle runs from Gate 6 to any other stadium gate. Guests with medically necessary equipment (wheelchairs, canes, breastfeeding equipment, epi-pens, etc.) enter through Gates 1.5, 3.5 or 9.5 where bags are searched and tagged. Guest Services booths are outside Gates 1, 4, 9 & 12 and on the concourses. Contact the UK ticket office (859-257-1818) for accessible seating.
bagPolicyNotes: One large clear bag per fan, either a one-gallon Ziploc-style bag or a 12″ x 6″ x 12″ clear bag, plus a small clutch that does not exceed 4.5″ x 6.5″. Backpacks, including drawstring bags, are not permitted even when clear. Non-clear bags left unattended at the gates will be evaluated and disposed of.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is permitted in the parking lots. Only pop-up tents are allowed; any tent/structure requiring stakes more than 4 inches deep is not permitted on UK grounds and permanent tailgating structures are prohibited. Tailgate at the back of your vehicle. Tailgating lines are in place in the Green, Blue, and Orange Lots. Tents on green space may be no larger than 10'x10' unless approved. All tents/trailers must be tagged with Name, Phone Number, and Email Address (tags available at Kroger Field Gate 1 starting July 21, or use your own); untagged items are subject to removal. 'Call Before You Stake' – stakes deeper than 4 inches require UK Athletics approval (859-218-3716); do not stake near tree roots; do not block parking spaces or drive lanes. No parking on green space between the Green, Red, and Blue lots. Portable generators must be UK-approved and rated 60DB or less. Music must be confined to your tailgate area; live bands/DJs require UK approval. Caterers need proper parking permits. Pop-up/portable restrooms brought by tailgaters are prohibited. Golf carts, motorized scooters, coolers, and mopeds are prohibited throughout the complex.
tailgating.timeWindow: Parking lots open at 8 a.m. on game day. Season-long tailgate setup window begins Saturday, August 9 at 8 a.m. (2026 date TBA); Cooper Drive tailgate setup occurs separately on the Fridays before game day at noon. Non-permit Cooper Drive setups/parking may begin no earlier than noon on Fridays.
tailgating.grillRules: Large industrial-size cookers must be approved by UK Athletics prior to game day. Open flames are not permitted without prior authorization from the University Fire Marshal's office; at least one 5-pound all-purpose ABC fire extinguisher must be provided. Cooking is not permitted within a tent without Fire Marshal authorization. Charcoal and other flammables must be properly extinguished and disposed of and cannot be placed in any dumpster or trash can (per the University of Kentucky Open Flame Policy).
tailgating.rvPolicy: Permitted RVs may enter the Main RV and Gluck RV lots beginning 8 p.m. Friday and must remain in their reserved (assigned, numbered) stall through game-day Saturday; stalls are not first-come. Personal vehicles are not permitted inside the RV lots (must unhitch), except trucks pulling a 5th wheel/trailer or one vehicle with a valid RV permit in place of the RV (an Orange permit is required for a car in tow without a valid permit). All football-permitted vehicles must be removed by noon Sunday. Visitor RVs without permits park at the corner of Virginia and Press Avenue (primary) with overflow near Press and Transcript Avenue; these open 6 p.m. Friday, are free, first-come, and have no hookups.

venueAccessRestrictions: Outside food and drinks including alcoholic beverages; outside food and drink containers including hard-shell koozies; all weapons including firearms, concealed or open; portable heaters and combustibles; glass, aluminum containers and ice chests; artificial noisemakers, irritants and laser pointers; all illegal substances, tobacco products and electronic cigarettes; large bags; drawstring bags, even those that are clear; pets; unmanned aircraft; inflatables; poles, extensions or selfie sticks; backpacks, even those that are clear; purses larger than a clutch that are not clear.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and drinks (including alcoholic beverages) and outside food/drink containers (including hard-shell koozies) are prohibited inside Kroger Field. Fans may bring one unopened bottle of water smaller than one liter; empty plastic water bottles smaller than a liter are permitted and may be refilled inside (empty glass, aluminum, or hard-shell containers are not permitted). Complimentary water is available on the concourses. Food and drink purchased from the food trucks outside Gate 4 cannot be brought into the stadium.
food: Concession stands throughout Kroger Field offer specialty and Kentucky Proud items; credit cards are accepted at most stands and Kroger Field is not a cashless venue. Alcohol (beer and seltzer) is sold with a limit of 2 per transaction and ID checks; football alcohol sales end at the end of the 3rd quarter. Food trucks are located outside Gate 4 in Chevy Park (their items may not be brought inside). Complimentary water tanks are available on both the lower and upper concourse.

gatesOpen.ruleText: All public gates open 1.5 hours (90 minutes) prior to kickoff; Gates 4, 9, 12 and the suites open two (2) hours prior to kickoff.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Gates 4, 9, 12 and suites open 2 hours (120 min) before kickoff; all other public gates open 1.5 hours (90 min) before. Gate 1 is dedicated to student entry only (valid UK student ID + mobile ticket). Medically necessary entry is via Gates 1.5, 3.5 or 9.5.
tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Parking lots open at 8 a.m. on game day; tailgate at the back of your vehicle. Season-long setup begins Saturday, August 9 at 8 a.m. (2026 date TBA); Cooper Drive setup occurs on the Fridays before game day at noon.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Small clutch up to 4.5"x6.5" is allowed alongside the clear bag; diaper/baby items must be carried in a clear bag; medically necessary bags must be clear, may not exceed 12"x6"x12", and enter via Gates 1.5, 3.5, and 9.5; credentialed media/staff bags are searched and tagged.

name: Kyle Field

parkingLots.name: Parking Area 88
parkingLots.notes: Accessible/disability parking; shuttle buses take guests to the Joe Routt (front) entrance of Kyle Field

parkingLots.name: University Center Garage
parkingLots.notes: Accessible/disability parking option (referenced elsewhere as Lot D)

publicTransit.notes: A free Bryan gameday shuttle (gameday.bryantx.gov) plus on-campus and off-campus gameday shuttles operate on football gamedays via Transportation Services.

rideshareDropoff: Designated rideshare pickup and dropoff locations are provided for football gamedays (see the Transportation Services football rideshare map).
accessibility: Texas A&M University recognizes and strives to accommodate the needs of guests with disabilities, as defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA).
bagPolicyNotes: A clear bag policy is enforced at all Texas A&M Athletics venues, which are also cashless. Approved bag styles/sizes are shown only in the clear-bag graphic image (see pdfSources); no bag dimensions are given in text.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating on campus is a privilege governed by general rules plus site-specific rules. Open-access sites (outside 15 ft of parking lots) are first-come, first-served and need no reservation; Aggie Park and West Campus areas use a Virtual Land Rush online reservation system. No overnight occupancy/camping. Tents/canopies must be secured with stakes penetrating no more than 12 inches. Only recreational generators (max 80 decibels) are allowed. Motorized recreational vehicles (golf carts, ATVs, scooters, etc.) are prohibited. Pets must be leashed; livestock is not permitted. Amplified bands/loud music are not permitted. Trash must be bagged and hot coals doused in designated receptacles. Greenspace within 15 ft of a lot is reserved for fans parked in that lot.
tailgating.timeWindow: On game day, tailgating begins at 7:00 AM and all sites must be cleared and cleaned by midnight. Setup on West Campus begins at noon the day before the game; setup in Aggie Park begins at 7:00 AM on game day. No overnight camping.
tailgating.grillRules: All BBQ grills (propane or otherwise) must be attended at all times; fires built on the ground and open fire pits are prohibited, and all devices must have a cover. Hot coals must be doused and disposed of in designated coal receptacles. In Aggie Park, grills must be propane or electric (no coals or wood) and trailer-mounted grills are not permitted; trailer-mounted grills/smokers are allowed in West Campus/Reed Arena greenspaces.
tailgating.rvPolicy: Oversized vehicle sites near Lot 95 accommodate buses, vans and trailers used for tailgating that do not meet RV-lot requirements; these spaces are reserved through Transportation Services (979-862-7943). No parking accommodation is provided at these sites — guests must separately purchase a public parking space.

venueAccessRestrictions: All tickets and parking are fully digital and must be loaded into a mobile wallet before arriving; printed tickets and screenshots are not accepted. Kyle Field is cashless — cash is not accepted for concessions or merchandise and there are no ATMs inside the stadium.
outsideFoodRules: No outside food or beverages are permitted inside Kyle Field, with the exception of one clear, unopened plastic water bottle (refill stations are available inside). No outside beverage containers are otherwise allowed.
food: Concessions are cashless. Alcohol (liquor, beer, wine and ready-to-drink cocktails) is available throughout most of Kyle Field; each transaction requires a valid driver's license with no exceptions, and no more than two alcoholic beverages may be purchased per transaction. Draft beer and wine are not served at the 350 level (Level 3) on the East side that services the student section second deck.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Kyle Field gates open 90 minutes prior to Texas A&M games; everyone, including infants, must have a ticket for admission.

name: Lambeau Field

parkingLots.name: Lot 4
parkingLots.notes: Off Lombardi Avenue; non-reserved accessible parking for guests with disabilities, first-come first-served

parkingLots.name: Lot 7
parkingLots.notes: Off Valley View Road; non-reserved accessible parking for guests with disabilities, first-come first-served

parkingLots.name: Lot 15
parkingLots.notes: In Titletown; limited individual-game passes available for pre-purchase; tailgating not permitted; digital/mobile passes only

lines: Green Bay Metro gameday bus routes (4 free routes)
publicTransit.notes: Four free Green Bay Metro gameday bus routes for all home games; routes begin five hours before kickoff and run ~3 hours after the game, leaving Lambeau Field every 30 minutes. Route details at GreenBayWI.gov. Lamers offers fee-based service from several areas in Greater Green Bay and other cities in Wisconsin and Michigan's Upper Peninsula.

rideshareDropoff: Driver meets you at the corner of Mike McCarthy Way and Holmgren Way; exit one of the main gates on the east and south side (American Family, Oneida Nation, Potawatomi Sportsbook)
accessibility: ADA-compliant; all gates, Atrium businesses, concourses, restrooms and non-seating areas fully wheelchair accessible; non-reserved $50 cashless accessible parking in Lot 4 and Lot 7, first-come first-served; courtesy shuttle carts for guests with limited mobility in main stadium lots 1,3,4,5,6,7, operating 3 hrs before kickoff until ~45 min after game; Special Exceptions Gate on northeast side near Ticket Office for private/discreet screening; wheelchair transport and storage at Fan Assistance booths (Sec 109/353); sensory bags and noise-canceling headphones available for check-out; Wheelchair/Companion tickets via Packers Ticket Office (920) 569-7501
bagPolicyNotes: NFL clear-bag policy: clear plastic/vinyl/PVC bags not exceeding 12x6x12 in (includes clear backpacks, fanny packs, cinch bags); or one-gallon clear freezer bag; plus one small non-clear bag not exceeding 4.5x6.5 in. No buckles/hardware/decor concealing the bag; logo on one side only. Coolers, strollers, wagons, umbrellas prohibited. All fans pass through walk-through metal detectors.

tailgating.rules: Permitted in Lambeau Field-operated lots only, not in Titletown lots (e.g. Lot 15). Setup must be contained within a 9x6-foot space directly behind your parked vehicle. Setup must be broken down before leaving your vehicle. Fan Code of Conduct applies.
tailgating.timeWindow: Ends at kickoff in all stadium-controlled lots
tailgating.grillRules: Charcoal or propane grill cooking permitted; no recreational/wood fires and no turkey fryers; grills must be supervised by a responsible adult and fully extinguished before being left unattended; separate containers provided for hot coals, recyclables, and trash
tailgating.rvPolicy: Vehicles in any Lambeau Field-operated lot must fit a 9x18 stall; PMI offers bus and RV parking in nearby locations (contact PMI 800-895-0071)

venueAccessRestrictions: Walk-through metal detectors at all gates; no weapons or firearms anywhere on property including the parking lot (Wisconsin concealed-carry not honored); no outside food, beverages, or coolers
nearby: Adjacent Titletown district with dining/entertainment (Lodge Kohler, 46 Below, Homefield Pub + Social, Ariens Hill, BelAir Cantina, Hinterland); Lambeau Field Atrium houses Packers Hall of Fame, Packers Pro Shop, and 1919 Kitchen & Tap
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverages are strictly prohibited, as are coolers.
food: A wide variety of refreshments from concession stands, portables and vendors throughout the stadium; most locations staffed by volunteers raising money for local non-profits; all concession/merchandise locations cashless. Miller Lite Endzone Market & Bar behind seating section 100 (north side). Dining includes Brew Pub Pizza, Meat Packing Company, and 1919 Kitchen & Tap. Beer limited to two per customer per purchase; alcohol sales cease at end of third quarter.

gatesOpen.ruleText: All stadium gates open two hours prior to kickoff

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: The Atrium is open to ticketed guests six hours prior to kickoff, accessed before seating areas open via the American Family Insurance Gate on the east side; all other gates open 2 hours prior to kickoff

name: Lane Stadium

parkingLots.name: Public Parking (Prices Fork Garage, North End Center Garage, Ag Quad, Squires)
parkingLots.notes: $30 on game day; all campus public lots are cashless, pay via ParkMobile app

parkingLots.name: Hokie Club Donor Lots
parkingLots.notes: Reserved for Hokie Club members with a valid season parking pass (assigned by Point Priority System); pass must be displayed on mirror; tailgating permitted

parkingLots.name: Oak Lane ADA/Accessible Lot
parkingLots.notes: Accessible parking diagonally across from Sigma Phi Epsilon house; $30 via ParkMobile; ADA bus service pass issued at lot

parkingLots.name: RV/Camper Parking (Donor Lots 3 & 16; Public: Duck Pond Overflow, Smoot Drive remote lot)
parkingLots.notes: Donor RV passes purchased in advance; Parking Services RV lots start at $200/weekend, first-come first-served; VT/Montgomery Executive Airport also offers RV parking

accessibility: Accessible parking is in the Oak Lane lot (across from Sigma Phi Epsilon house) for $30 via ParkMobile; VT staff issue a pass required to board the ADA bus. ADA bus pickup is at the stop sign outside the NW corner of the lot; drop-off and postgame pickup are near the entrance to Gate 3. Family/Special Needs restrooms are located behind sections 127, 205, 509, 115 and 107. Fans needing special accommodations should notify the ticket office in advance (540-231-6731).
bagPolicyNotes: Small clutch bags that are 4.5" x 1" x 6.5" without a handle or strap may be carried into the stadium along with one of the clear bag options. An exception will be made for medically necessary items after proper inspection at a gate designated for this purpose.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating must stay in the area immediately behind your vehicle; do not block roadways or sidewalks. Prohibited in lots: throwing objects (footballs, frisbees), placing tables/chairs/cornhole boards into the roadway, sound systems or noise amplification (bands, DJ equipment), cutting/removing/destroying boundary ropes or signs, destroying landscaping or fencing, and underage drinking. Corporate/professional tailgates are not allowed without prior written approval from the Department of Athletics (and Virginia Tech Sports Properties).
tailgating.timeWindow: Donor/public parking lots open 7 a.m. Saturday for Saturday games (after 3 p.m. game day for non-Saturday games). Tents and tailgate canopies may not be set up before the day of the game and must be removed by noon the day following the game.
tailgating.rvPolicy: Hokie Club members with RV passes park in Lot 3 or 16 (purchased in advance). Public RV parking at Duck Pond Overflow and the Smoot Drive student remote lot. Parking Services RV lots start at $200/weekend, first-come first-served, purchased online in advance. RV lot arrival: Donor Lot 16 from 12:01 a.m. Friday, other donor lots from 5 p.m. Friday, public Duck Pond after 5 p.m. Friday; depart by noon Sunday.

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Coolers/Containers/Bags/Purses (unless medical supplies and prior approved), Water bottles (with the exception of clear and empty bottles), Fireworks / Explosive / Weapons, Illegal drugs; follows State and campus guidelines, Laser pointers, Noisemakers (horns, whistles, cow bells, turkey calls, etc.), Outside food or beverage, Pets (except service animals), Signs, flags, banners, posters, Projectiles (frisbees, beach balls, footballs, etc.), Smoking cigarettes, using smokeless cigarettes, e-cigarettes, Strollers or umbrellas (exception of premium indoor areas), Unmanned aircraft (drones). There is NO re-entry at Lane Stadium. Search and screening protocols are in place for the public, fans, employees, teams, artists and contractors entering Lane Stadium. Lane Stadium security personnel and management reserve the right to confiscate items that may cause damage to the facility, endanger guests or disrupt the event, and guests who violate the policy or decline to be searched may be denied entry or ejected from the stadium.
outsideFoodRules: No outside food or beverage is permitted; coolers, containers and bags are prohibited unless they hold medical supplies.
food: A variety of concession stands are open. All concessions are cashless (credit/debit, Apple Pay, Google Pay only). Alcohol is sold at designated stands with a two-drink maximum per ID per transaction and valid ID required; alcohol sales end at the end of the third quarter.

gatesOpen.ruleText: All gates open two hours prior to kickoff.

tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Parking lots (donor/public) open 7 a.m. Saturday for Saturday games (after 3 p.m. game day for non-Saturday games); RV lots open as early as 12:01 a.m. Friday (Lot 16); tents/canopies not permitted before game day and must be removed by noon the day after the game
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Exceptions for medically necessary items in clear bags after proper inspection at a designated gate; diapers may be carried in a clear bag; a small clutch 4.5x1x6.5 in without handle or strap is allowed alongside one clear bag

name: LaVell Edwards Stadium
accessibility: Wheelchair seating on the upper and lower concourses of the West Stands and the lower concourse of the East Stands; wheelchair-section tickets required for ticketed events with up to three companion tickets. Limited-mobility seats available for purchase. Assisted listening devices available at the Stadium Management Office just inside Gate 3 (driver's license held as collateral). Wheelchairs to borrow for transport available at the Stadium Management Office inside Gate 3; wheelchair checks under the North and South Stands and stroller checks by Gates 3 and 10. Three elevators in the West Stands just inside Gates 2 and 4 (loge/press-box access; patrons in tops of sections 101-109 may request use with an escort); no elevators in East, North, or South Stands and upper West wheelchair sections are ramp-accessible only. All restrooms disability accessible; family disability restroom under the West Stands and by the North and South Endzone restrooms; sign-language interpretation available with at least one week notice.
venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Weapons of any type, Bags of any size, Whiteboards (regardless of size), Signs or banners larger than 24"x36", Other large items, Food or drink (including bottled water), Umbrellas (ponchos recommended), Fireworks, Glass bottles, cans, or coolers, Battery operated megaphones, Artificial noisemakers, Sticks or poles, Laster pointers, Video cameras, Any other items deemed dangerous by management. Exit or re-entry into the Stadium is available. Guests must have their ticket or ROC pass "exit scanned" upon leaving the venue to be eligible to re-enter. Exit scanning is available at all gates. LaVell Edwards Stadium reserves the right to inspect all items brought into the facility. By using a ticket to enter the stadium, each guest consents to such a search and waives any related claims against BYU. Guests who refuse to consent to these searches will be denied entry into the stadium.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food or drink, including bottled water, is not permitted inside the stadium. Water bottle refill stations are located on the lower concourse of the North and South Endzones and the south end of the East Stands.

gatesOpen.ruleText: For BYU Football games and for Stadium of Fire, all gates will open 120 minutes prior to the published start time.

venueAccessRestrictions: All guests and belongings subject to security inspection; walk-through weapons detection deployed at points of stadium entry.
outsideFoodRules: Food must be wrapped in clear plastic; permitted after inspection.

parkingLots.name: West Lot 3

rideshareDropoff: A dedicated rideshare lot is no longer available at loanDepot park; rideshare services are now a short distance and walk from the ballpark. Fans using a ride-sharing service, including Brightline shuttles, must be picked up at East Lot 1 located at 1380 NW 6th Street, Miami, FL 33125. Rideshare apps geofence to this area and direct riders appropriately; heavy usage and long wait times should be anticipated.
accessibility: Accessible parking is available in all four parking garages and two surface lots (East Lot 2 & East Lot 3) on a first-come, first-served basis; a hanging placard or disability license plate is required and event rates apply. Wheelchair-accessible and semi-ambulatory seats with operable armrests are located on all ballpark levels, with one companion/escort permitted. Amenities include Braille and tactile signs, closed captioning on the Legends Level, electrical outlets for recharging wheelchairs/medical equipment, and wheelchair transportation/assistance (request at any entrance or text 305-480-4999). Guests needing accommodations should contact Guest Experience at 305-480-1300 or text 305-480-4999. Miami-Dade Paratransit (STS) uses the designated drop-off/pick-up at the corner of NW 6th Street & NW 16th Avenue.
bagPolicyNotes: Clear bags are permitted, cannot exceed 16"x16"x8" in size, and must be plastic, vinyl, or PVC material. Exceptions are made for small clutches no larger than 6"x8" and bags for medical or infant purposes. All approved bags are subject to inspection prior to entry. Bag locker rentals are available on the north side of the ballpark (Medium 18"x15"x14" for $15+tax; Large 18"x32"x14" for $18+tax).
venueAccessRestrictions: Guests and their belongings are inspected before entering the ballpark. Prohibited items include weapons of any kind (regardless of permit), aerosol cans, hard-sided coolers/containers, glass/metal/aluminum containers, outside alcoholic beverages, soft/sports/energy drinks, drones, selfie sticks and full-sized sticks/poles, laser pointers, and amplified noise-making devices. Re-entry is not permitted on the same ticket, except in an emergency or to patronize the New Era Team Store (see a Guest Experience Team Member before exiting). loanDepot park is a cashless ballpark - only electronic payment is accepted (reverse cash-to-card ATMs are available at Section 3).
outsideFoodRules: Fans may bring one (1) single-serving food item per person packaged in a clear plastic bag (fruit must be sliced) and one (1) clear, soft-sided factory-sealed bottle of unflavored water, 20 ounces or smaller, per person. Any approved beverage that has been opened or partially consumed prior to entry will not be permitted. Outside alcoholic beverages and soft/sports/energy drinks (e.g., Gatorade, juice, flavored waters) are prohibited.
food: Concessions lean heavily into South Florida and Latin flavors: highlights include Classics Con Sazon (the two-foot Machete, pan con lechon, frita smash, masita dog), Cuban sandwiches at Pan Con Beisbol and The Press Box, Oppo Taco Tex-Mex, SuViche Japanese-Peruvian sushi and ceviche, and local Miami bites through Pepsi's Local Eats program. Budget-friendly $3/$5 (3o5) value-menu items are offered at several stands, and the Blue Moon Brew Hall pours a lineup of local craft beers.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates generally open to the public 90 minutes prior to first pitch. Guests in premium areas such as PNC Club and suite levels are granted earlier admission, two hours prior to first pitch. Marlins Members are allowed early admission through East Plaza Gate 11 for Friday and Saturday home games, two and a half hours prior to first pitch.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Premium seating (PNC Club and suite levels) opens 2 hours before first pitch; Marlins Members enter via East Plaza Gate 11 two and a half hours before first pitch on Friday and Saturday home games. Doors open 90 minutes prior for general fans to watch batting practice.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Exceptions to the clear-bag requirement are made for small clutches no larger than 6"x8" and bags for medical or infant purposes.

Factory sealed plastic bottles of water 17 oz. or less are allowed; limit 2 per person., Illegal drugs and weapons including firearms, knives, explosives, and fireworks., Pets, excluding service animals., Banners, sticks, poles, inflatables, frisbees, balls, and unsliced fruits or vegetables, Professional cameras (lenses longer than 3") and camera equipment, selfie-sticks, tripods, and video or audio recording equipment., Umbrellas, balloons, skateboards, and folding or beach chairs, Strollers, Drones, Laser pointers.
