publicTransit.notes: Take COTA public transit; a COTA bus stop map (PDF) is provided. A pedestrian bridge over the Olentangy River connects the Olentangy Trail to Astor Park for cycling access from the west or east via W. Nationwide Blvd. Franklinton Cycle Works offers free bike valet east of the pedestrian bridge, beginning four hours before kickoff.

rideshareDropoff: Rideshare (Lyft/Uber) drop-off and pick-up is located on Hanover Street, just south of Nationwide Boulevard. The A-Z guide adds that fans may use the Hanover Street / Huntington Park Lane shoulders as drop-off and pick-up zones.
accessibility: ScottsMiracle-Gro Field is ADA compliant. Accessible parking is reserved in advance via arenadistrict.parkmobile.io, with accessible shuttles running from the Front Street Garage to the AEP Gate. An ADA shuttle picks up at Marconi Blvd near the Front Street Garage and drops off at Hocking St. and Nationwide Blvd. at the stadium; it runs from five hours before kickoff until three hours after the match. Complimentary wheelchair escorts are available at any entry point without advance arrangement. All restrooms are accessible, with family/unisex restrooms on the 100 and 200 levels. The Chase Sensory Suite provides two sensory rooms and Sensory Inclusion Packs are available at the Koorsen Guest Services Center.
bagPolicyNotes: Non-clear clutch bags smaller than 5 x 8 x 1 inches, diaper bags, and medical bags are permitted following inspection (the A-Z guide adds a required bag tag). All bags are subject to inspection and may be refused. Guests with medical or childcare needs may carry a single bag; notify a security supervisor at the gate. Prohibited bags must be returned to the vehicle or left at the bag check tent outside the Northwest Gate on the northwest corner of the stadium.

tailgating.rules: Generally, tailgating is not permitted around ScottsMiracle-Gro Field. Parking lots around the stadium are owned and operated independently, so tailgating policies may vary by lot; follow posted signs and parking lot information.

venueAccessRestrictions: No re-entry is permitted for any ScottsMiracle-Gro Field event unless in the case of a medical emergency; once you exit the secured area you cannot re-enter. All guests are subject to security screening; failure to submit may result in denial of entry. Tickets are required for all individuals aged 3 and older. The venue is a tobacco-free facility (smoking, vaping, and marijuana/THC prohibited inside).
nearby: The Arena District Designated Outdoor Refreshment Area (DORA) is activated three hours before every Crew home match and extends down Nationwide Boulevard into Astor Park until midnight, offering additional downtown matchday experiences. DORA is not active inside the stadium gates.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverage is a prohibited item. Cups, souvenir cups, and empty bottles may not be brought into the stadium, and outside cans and bottles (including water bottles) are prohibited. Exception: during National Weather Service Heat Advisories on matchday, empty plastic water bottles under 20 oz are permitted through security.
food: ScottsMiracle-Gro Field is a fully cashless venue. Cash2Card machines that convert cash to a prepaid debit card are located at the Crew Shop and Section 108 on the Main Concourse.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates open 1.5 hours prior to kickoff (standard gate opening is 1.5 hours prior to posted kickoff time for all stadium gates and the west lobby).

tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Diaper bags and medical bags are permitted. Guests with medical or childcare needs will be permitted to carry a single bag into ScottsMiracle-Gro Field; notify a security supervisor as you arrive at the gate.

venueAccessRestrictions: No re-entry during Colts home games once a patron exits the gated perimeter; pass-outs may be allowed for other events at the promoter's discretion.
nearby: Connected to the Indiana Convention Center via an indoor pedestrian connector on the Event Level.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverage prohibited except for guests with special medical or dietary needs; bottles, cans, liquid containers and coolers not permitted.
food: Sodexo Live! operates 160+ permanent and portable concession stands throughout the stadium; all cashless, accepting major credit cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay. Allergen menu available.

Public elevators are located near Gates B & C; code-compliant ramps are on the east side of the stadium starting at Gate D. Wheelchair and companion seating with enhanced sight lines is available on every level, with day-of-game accessible relocation handled at Guest Services (behind Sections 114 & 214). Assistive listening devices are available at Guest Services with photo ID.
bagPolicyNotes: We encourage fans to avoid carrying a bag, when possible, for faster entry.

tailgating.rules: REVELxp is Baylor's official tailgating partner; season and single-game tailgating packages are available for purchase (contact 254-870-0950).
tailgating.rvPolicy: RV season passes are sold through the Baylor Athletics Ticket Office. Two lots: one by Clyde Hart Track & Field Stadium (exclusive to season pass holders) and one by the Ferrell Center. Very limited single-game passes are first-come, first-served in the Ferrell Center lot.

outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverage are prohibited. Fans may bring one clear, empty water bottle no larger than 1 liter per person; glass containers and backpack-style hydration systems are not allowed.
food: Concessions are provided by Sodexo, featuring local partners including Rudy's BBQ, Bush's Chicken, Sonic Drive-In, Pardon My Cheesesteak and Andy's Frozen Custard.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Most stadium gate entrances open 1 hour and 30 minutes prior to kickoff; Suite, Loge & Club entrances open 1 hour and 45 minutes prior; recruit pass list entrance opens 2 hours prior.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Premium gates (Suite/Loge/Club) open 15 minutes earlier than general gates; recruit pass list entrance opens 2 hours prior to kickoff.

lines: CATbus Red Route (home football games, drop-off and pickup on Cherry Rd and Bryan Circle)

accessibility: ADA entrances at gates 1, 5, 6 and 13; ADA lot entrance is off Hwy 93 on Calhoun Drive near Tillman Hall and Sikes Hall; golf-cart shuttles run across the athletic district starting 4 hours before kickoff and drop guests at their assigned gate or the ticket office (pickup points marked by tall white-and-blue poles); wheelchair and companion seating available through Guest Services; ADA seating in sections H AA and H KK (east side) and T, J, WC1-WC4 (west side); McCarter Family IPTAY center by Gate 9 opens 3 hours before kickoff and resolution centers at gates 1, 5 and 13 open 2 hours prior.
bagPolicyNotes: One-gallon clear plastic freezer bag (Ziploc bag or similar) is permitted. Small clutch bags no larger than 4.5" x 6.5" can be taken into the Memorial Stadium. An exception to the Clear Bag Policy will be made for medically necessary items after security screening. Binoculars, cameras and smart phones are allowed but their carrying cases will NOT be allowed.

tailgating.rules: Reserved lots require placards; towing of unauthorized vehicles begins at midnight the night before game day.
tailgating.timeWindow: Parking lots open at 6 a.m. for kickoffs before 3:30 p.m., or at 8 a.m. for kickoffs at 3:30 p.m. or later.

venueAccessRestrictions: Fans may leave and re-enter Memorial Stadium only when presenting a re-entry voucher obtained at stadium gates and a valid mobile ticket. Walkthrough metal detectors are at all stadium entrances. Fans with a relevant medical condition or who do not feel comfortable walking through the metal detectors can notify event staff and participate in an alternative screening process.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverage is prohibited, but each fan may bring one clear, unopened bottle of water; sunscreen is permitted.
food: Concession stands open 2 hours before kickoff and stay open through the end of the fourth quarter; operated by Aramark; bottled water sold for $3; a concessions location map is available. Concession locations accept debit and credit cards (no ATMs in the stadium).

gatesOpen.ruleText: Memorial Stadium will open to the public 2-hours prior to kickoff.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: The Oculus gate, which serves the WEZ Club, does not open with the general gates; it opens at the conclusion of Tiger Walk.

tailgating.rules: B-Town Boulevard on the south lawn of Memorial Stadium opens two-and-one-half hours prior to kickoff with a festival-like pregame atmosphere (concert stage for live bands, food trucks, outdoor bar, and family-friendly games and attractions) and closes just prior to kickoff; all-inclusive B-Town Boulevard tailgate packages and customizable group tailgate tents are available.
tailgating.timeWindow: Parking lots open a minimum of five hours prior to kickoff for each home game.

rideshareDropoff: General fan drop-offs can be conducted at a bus cutout located directly northwest of Memorial Stadium (northwest of Lot 8) off eastbound Salt Creek Roadway. Drop-off attempts in restricted areas are prohibited.
accessibility: Season accessible permits available in donor lots 5, 8 and 9 (for state-issued handicapped permits/plates). Single-game accessible parking is available on campus first-come, first-served; Lot 9 is the primary option and the Lot 9 parking garage (14th & Avery Ave.) is $25 per game; free public disabled parking at meter spots on 14th and Vine. Donor lots 5 and 9 have free shuttle cart service for persons with limited mobility. Mobility-impaired entrances: Gates 3, 7, 11, 16A, 18, 19, 20, 21, 23, 23A & 24 (no elevators inside gates 3, 23A or 24). Assistive Listening System equipment inside Gate 18 (Guest Relations/Security Office) and the West Stadium Lobby. Elevator passes (2 people per pass) issued for East and West Stadiums. Service animals permitted (harnessed, leashed or tethered); assistance/emotional-support/therapy animals are prohibited. ADA ticket questions: 402-472-3111.
bagPolicyNotes: One small hand-size bag, no larger than 4.5" x 6.5", may be carried in addition to the clear bag.

tailgating.rules: The University of Nebraska promotes responsible tailgating. Game-day parking for all lots directly surrounding Memorial Stadium is reserved for Huskers Athletic Fund donors; one vehicle per parking space and vehicles must fit within a single stall. Tailgating should only extend to available areas directly in front of and/or behind your parking stall, if available, without impeding neighboring stalls. Portable restrooms are provided by the Athletic Department; no other units are allowed. Intoxication can lead to denied entry into Memorial Stadium.
tailgating.timeWindow: Donor lots open at 6 a.m. for kickoffs before 6 p.m. and at 11 a.m. for kickoffs after 6 p.m. (exceptions: Lots 19, 20 and 21 open at 6 a.m. for 11 a.m. kickoffs and 8 a.m. for all other kickoffs). No overnight parking is allowed in the donor lots.
tailgating.grillRules: Open flames such as fire pits are prohibited on UNL property. Portable heater systems that plug into an electrical source are permissible. No open fires and no electricity provided in the parking garages.
tailgating.rvPolicy: Lot 11 is reserved for RVs presold to donors on a season basis only; the rest of Lot 11 is for donors with regular vehicles. Additional RV parking without a Lot 11 permit is available next to the Bob Devaney Sports Center off 14th and Military Road, sold first-come, first-served (pricing/questions: UNL Parking Services 402-472-8436).

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Outside alcoholic beverages, Controlled substances, Bags not conforming to the clear bag policy, Coolers, Chairbacks, Noise makers, Glass bottles or cans, Video cameras, Banners/flags on poles, Open umbrellas, Lawn chairs.
outsideFoodRules: No outside food and beverages are allowed inside Memorial Stadium, including food/beverages from outside vendors and sponsorship sample giveaways. Personal empty water bottles are allowed for refilling at fountains inside. Certain situations (e.g., extreme heat) may initiate exceptions, communicated by the University/Athletic Department. Medical food/beverage exemptions allowed if items meet the individual's medical need; notify the Event Management Office and items will be inspected and tagged upon entry.
food: Concessions available throughout the stadium (100% cashless). Named stands include 402 Snacks (Sec 601), 1923 Cheesesteaks (Sec 28), Blackshirt Barbecue (Sec 7, 16, 26, 38), Chick N Coop (Sec 17), Cob & Co (Sec 5), Colby Ridge (Sec 4, 17, 27, 323), Cornhusker Crunch (Sec 32, 34), Dippin Dots (Sec 3, 34), Herbie's Burger Co (Sec 23, 39), GBR Classics, Tunnel Walk Tacos (Sec 2, 34, 339, 604) and Walk Thru Bru. Alcohol is sold (valid ID required, 2-drink limit per transaction, service ends at the end of the 3rd quarter).

gatesOpen.ruleText: Stadium gates open 90 minutes prior to kickoff. Student gates open 2.5 hours before kickoff.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: All premium/club entry points open 2 hours before kickoff; student gates open 2.5 hours before kickoff to expedite early arrivals; the band marches to the stadium and enters Gates 3 & 11 at 45 minutes before kickoff. Gates 1, 6, 8, 17, 18, 19 and 21 close shortly after kickoff.
tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Donor lots open at 6 a.m. for kickoffs before 6 p.m. and at 11 a.m. for kickoffs after 6 p.m. (Lots 19, 20 and 21 open at 6 a.m. for 11 a.m. kickoffs and 8 a.m. for all other kickoffs). No overnight parking in donor lots.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Exceptions are made for approved medical-needs items after proper inspection and tagging, handled at any gate entry point. Standard diaper/baby bags are not allowed and must meet the clear-bag policy guidelines.

accessibility: ADA pick-up/drop-off zone on Northside Dr between the pedestrian bridge and Home Depot Backyard entrance; nearest gate is Gate 1 with a Guest Services Office (wheelchair assistance, ADA seat relocation, sensory resources); recommended ADA parking by proximity: HDBY, Silver Deck, Red Deck, Orange Deck.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating in The Home Depot Backyard is for event-day ticket holders only; one 10'x10' tent per space (must be weighted, no staking); tailgating limited to directly in front of or behind the vehicle; no glass single-serving bottles; small electric generators (6500W or less) allowed on plywood base; no reserved or roped-off areas; sale of food/beverage prohibited.
tailgating.timeWindow: Lots open 4.5 hours before the event; tailgating permitted until 30 minutes after event start; lots close 2 hours after the event (evening events must end by midnight); no overnight parking.
tailgating.grillRules: Natural gas or propane grills only; no charcoal grills, wood stoves, oil fryers, large boiling pots, or open pit fires.
tailgating.rvPolicy: RVs, buses, trailers, and other oversized vehicles are not allowed in The Home Depot Backyard.

venueAccessRestrictions: Enter via any gate; premium suite/club ticket holders may also use the North Club Entrance; floor-seat ticket holders must enter at the designated floor-entry line near Gate 1 by the soccer ball sculpture.
nearby: The Home Depot Backyard; Georgia World Congress Center; Atlantic Station (Fetii park-and-ride shuttle for Falcons games).
outsideFoodRules: No outside food or beverage may be brought into the stadium, including items purchased on the immediate exterior or in exterior Fan Fest areas.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates open 90 minutes before kickoff (11:30 AM for a 1:00 PM kickoff).

Box Gates Open 90 minutes before kickoff for Atlanta United home matches. Corroborated by the /matchday timeline showing Gates open 6 p.m. for a 7:30 p.m. kickoff, and distinct from Parking Lots Opens at 5 hours before kickoff.

tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: The Official Supporters Tailgate (Lot 17) begins 4 hours prior to kickoff for each weekend home match.

Oversized bags may be checked at a Bag Check outside each open gate: complimentary for NFL events ($5 for non-NFL). Medically necessary items exception after inspection.

tailgating.rules: Permitted in all Sports Complex parking lots except where otherwise designated; one car = one lined space; saving spaces not allowed; tents/canopies over 8'x8' footprint not permitted in a lined space; keep drive lanes and fire lanes clear; sound systems capped at 65 decibels; selling tailgate access and commercial/vending activity prohibited
tailgating.grillRules: Grills allowed at a safe distance from vehicles; no grills/heating devices in parking decks; open fires, deep fryers and oil-based cooking prohibited; dispose of hot coals only in orange hot-coal bins; a 2A-10B:C fire extinguisher recommended
tailgating.rvPolicy: Vehicles over 18' long and/or 8' wide not permitted in a lined parking space; trucks, trailers and oversized vehicles (excluding buses) directed to park along the curbs

venueAccessRestrictions: On NFL game days a pre-paid parking permit is required for all vehicles entering the Sports Complex; drones, model aircraft, kites and other remote-controlled/tethered flying objects prohibited on the complex
nearby: Pre-game activity plazas (food, games, entertainment) adjacent to the stadium; Bud Light Beer Garden in Lot F for Giants and Jets games
outsideFoodRules: Outside catering companies not permitted on the Sports Complex; Delaware North is the official caterer; organized/illegal food and beverage sales prohibited

food: Pre and post game dining at Slice of Vegas and Hussong's Mexican Cantina, both inside the Shoppes at Mandalay Place within Mandalay Bay Resort & Casino, steps from the arena.

name: Milan Puskar Stadium

parkingLots.name: Gold Lot
parkingLots.notes: Area 72, adjacent to the Facilities Management Building in front of ERC/Towers; available for single-game sales; buses and RVs not permitted.

lines: MountainLine Transit stadium shuttle (from Mountaineer Mall)
publicTransit.notes: MountainLine stadium shuttle service begins two hours before kickoff and runs at least one hour after the game; cost is $3.00 round trip and children 5 and under ride free. The PRT runs on game days from 9:30 a.m. to 5 p.m., plus one hour after any game that ends past 5 p.m., and costs 50 cents for visitors.

rideshareDropoff: A dedicated rideshare/taxi pick-up and drop-off point is located at United Bank Suncrest, 990 Elmer Prince Drive, Morgantown, WV 26505.
accessibility: ADA-accessible gates: North, Northwest, Northeast, Southeast and Southwest. ADA/disabled single-game parking ($45) is available on a limited basis in the Brown Lot (WVU Law School) and in the Green Lot/garage, with complimentary accessible-van shuttle service to the SE/SW gates; all ADA spaces in the Blue Lot are self-accommodating with no shuttle. ADA golf-cart courtesy shuttles (the Gold and Blue shuttles) run two hours before kickoff until the middle of the first quarter and again from the start of the fourth quarter for about an hour, linking all corners of the stadium.
bagPolicyNotes: Milan Puskar Stadium permits a 12" x 6" x 12" clear tote bag or a one-gallon freezer bag, plus a small clutch purse with or without a handle or strap. Confirm the clutch size limit with the venue before you travel.

tailgating.rules: Small tents may be erected in designated areas only and may not be larger than 10' x 10'; a parking permit for the designated lot is required and the vehicle must be parked adjacent to the tent. Tents may only be erected after 7 a.m. on game day (excluding weekday games). Games involving the consumption of alcohol are prohibited. Smoking is permitted in the University parking lots on game day.
tailgating.timeWindow: University parking lots open at 7 a.m. on game day (Saturday) unless otherwise noted, and tents may be erected after 7 a.m. The adjacent Almost Heaven Village fan area is open from 3 1/2 hours before kickoff until 30 minutes before kickoff.
tailgating.grillRules: Open fires are prohibited in the University-operated parking lots.
tailgating.rvPolicy: RVs (vehicles 20 feet or longer) are permitted in University-operated lots with a special RV permit, including the Coliseum lots. Trailers are permitted only in the Green, Red and Coliseum lots. Overnight parking is allowed but a permit must be visible at all times. Front Row RVs must be parked before lots open at 7 a.m. on game day; general RVs must be parked two hours prior to kickoff. RVs must be clear of the lots by 12 p.m. (noon) the day following the game; 12"x12"x1.5" planks must be placed beneath all jacks (jacks may not be placed directly on the pavement) and pass holders may not damage the lot surface.

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: coolers, laser pointers, alcoholic beverages, artificial noisemakers, aerosol and spray cans, mace and pepper sprays, selfie sticks, umbrellas, weapons. Stadium re-entry is not permitted.
nearby: Almost Heaven Village, a fan-experience area between the Light Blue and Teal parking lots on the east side of the stadium, is open from 3 1/2 hours before kickoff until 30 minutes before kickoff and features food trucks, inflatables, a DJ, yard games, photo opportunities, sponsor activations and WVU Spirit Squad appearances. REVELxp operates all-inclusive, turn-key full-service tailgate tents outside the north gate that fans can rent.
outsideFoodRules: No coolers of any kind (soft-sided, metal or glass containers) are allowed in the stadium. Sealed plastic containers of soft drinks, water and non-alcoholic beverages are permitted; no hard containers or umbrellas are allowed inside.
food: Concession stands and portable food carts line each concourse and are all cashless (accepting Visa, MasterCard, American Express and Discover). Fan First discounted items include $3 popcorn, $3 fountain drink and a $3.50 pepperoni roll. Beer and wine sales are available along the concourses inside the gates; alcohol may not be brought into the stadium.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates open 90 minutes (1 1/2 hours) before game time unless otherwise advertised.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Standard opening is 90 minutes before kickoff (suite gates two hours before), subject to change 'unless otherwise advertised.'
tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: All parking lots open at 7 a.m. on game day (Saturday) unless otherwise noted; tents may be erected after 7 a.m.

parkingLots.notes: 92 total spaces including 3 ADA accessible spaces; oversized vehicles and buses are directed here at $40 per event (this lot is sometimes reserved and not available).

parkingLots.name: Off-Site Parking lots (Lloyd District)
parkingLots.notes: Over 1700 spaces located five blocks away at NE 7th and Multnomah; offered only during Blazer home games, with MAX trains about every 5 minutes from NE 7th and Holladay, dropping off at the Rose Quarter Transit Station.

rideshareDropoff: Lyft is the Official Rideshare Partner of Moda Center. Rideshare pick-up and drop-off locations are along NE Multnomah St. and NE Wheeler Ave., right outside the east entry.
accessibility: The Rose Quarter campus has four parking garages each with ADA accessible parking on most levels; the dedicated ADA entrance is on P3 in the Garden Garage on the north end of Moda Center. Convenient drop-off and pick-up areas for guests, taxis and limousines are located along Wheeler Ave and Multnomah Street. Wheelchair accessible seating is available on all levels at Moda Center (seats indicated with a 'WC' next to the section number), with up to 3 companion seats per accessible seat and limited-mobility seats also available; identify the need at time of purchase. Complimentary wheelchair escorts can be arranged via a Guest Information Booth or by calling 503-797-9750 (Moda Center). Assisted Listening Devices are provided free of charge with a valid ID from Guest Information Booths. Only ADA-defined service animals are permitted. Sign language interpreters (ASL) must be requested in writing at least 2 weeks before the event via the Box Office (503-797-9619). All restrooms are accessible with changing tables. Sensory Inclusive venue (KultureCity) with sensory bags and a Sensory Room at Moda Center. OneCourt haptic devices for blind, low-vision and sensory-need guests are available first-come first-served at Moda Center information booths (North A7, South A23, 300 Level C33).
bagPolicyNotes: Bag size limit depends on event type. Basketball events (NBA, WNBA): bags up to 10" x 6" x 2", aligned to the NBA and WNBA bag policy. Non-basketball events: bags up to 14" x 14" x 6". Medical and childcare exceptions are permitted and screened via x-ray; medical and childcare bags cannot exceed 14" x 14" x 6". Bag check is available. Hard-sided bags and coolers are prohibited. Policy is subject to change by event; guests should check the Know Before You Go email.
venueAccessRestrictions: No re-entry is permitted for events at the Rose Quarter. Moda Center is a cash-free venue accepting credit, debit, prepaid cards and Apple Pay only (reverse ATMs and cash-to-card kiosks available). The Rose Quarter is a smoke-free and vape-free campus. Everyone entering is subject to security screening (Evolv Express technology at select entrances) and may be sent to secondary screening. Guests may line up on campus beginning at 8:00 AM on the day of the event; overnight camping is prohibited.
outsideFoodRules: All outside food and beverages are prohibited from Moda Center and Veterans Memorial Coliseum, with exceptions for medical and children's needs (child bags, bottles and specific foods must enter through a bag line and go through search/x-ray). Empty non-glass water bottles up to 32 oz are allowed inside except on General Admission floors.
food: The Rose Quarter offers a wide variety of local food options at events (not every option is available for every event). Vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free options are available; see the Concessions Guide. All Moda Center concession stands accept debit and credit cards (cash-free venue).

gatesOpen.ruleText: General doors for regular-season Trail Blazers games will open 75 minutes prior to tip-off. Dr. Jack's will open 3 hours prior to tip-off.

tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: For basketball (NBA) games, bags are limited to 10" x 6" x 2", smaller than the 14" x 14" x 6" non-basketball limit. Medical and childcare bags up to 14" x 14" x 6" are permitted and screened via x-ray.

name: Mohegan Sun Arena

parkingLots.name: Mohegan Sun on-site guest parking
parkingLots.notes: Over 13,000 on-site guest parking spaces, free of charge.

lines: Shore Line East (New Haven to New London)
publicTransit.notes: Nearest rail station is New London, about 20 minutes from Mohegan Sun, served by Amtrak. Metro-North runs into New Haven, where Shore Line East provides connector service onward to New London. Local SEAT bus service (Norwich, CT) and Yellow Cab taxi also serve the area.

bagPolicyNotes: The following bags are not permitted in the Arena: backpacks, string bags, diaper bags, shopping bags, messenger bags, briefcases, and rolling style bags. Coolers and strollers or baby seats are also prohibited. Anyone entering the Arena is subject to a reasonable search, including bags, purses, coats and hats. Prohibited items may be returned to a vehicle or disposed of, or at management discretion left at the bag checks at either Arena entrance.
venueAccessRestrictions: Re-entry is not permitted after the event is determined to be over (except for approved after-show events on a case-by-case basis). Guests who leave before the event ends and plan to return must have their tickets scanned out by an usher at the entry doors, or they will be denied re-entry. A valid ticket is required for all guests entering the Arena; children under 24 months may sit on a guardian's lap without a ticket. Mohegan Sun Arena is a smoke-free venue.
outsideFoodRules: Food and/or beverages of any kind may not be brought into the Arena, except for certain medical conditions. Outside food, outside non-Mohegan purchased alcohol, and water or beverage containers are listed as prohibited items.
food: A selection of food and beverages is available at concession stands located throughout the Arena concourse and may be enjoyed at your seat during the performance.

rideshareDropoff: Fan drop-off is near the South Packard Drive Parking Structure (Structure 7): guests without parking passes with extenuating circumstances (ADA guests or limited mobility) may be dropped off there and proceed to the cart service area for pick-up.
accessibility: Disability parking (state-issued placard/plate) available first-come, first-served in the disabled lot, first level South Packard Drive Structure 7, or Stadium Structure 5. 662 ADA seats in fourteen areas of the stadium. Accessible seating, restrooms, ATMs and concession counters; captioning on all three video boards and via smartphone. Courtesy cart service for limited-mobility/disabled fans (plus one companion and service animal) runs from the two accessible lots to the SE, NE and NW entrances, available two hours prior to kickoff until ~one hour after the game; inside cart service at the NW entrance to main concourse. Elevator access on north side (NE corner of Student-Athlete Facility) and inside the SW gate. Sensory room in Carson Student-Athlete Center (Hall of Fame Lobby), open 90 minutes prior to kickoff until end of game. Service animals welcome. Ticket office 480-727-0000; Game Day ADA line call/text 480-965-3482.
bagPolicyNotes: Small clutch bags no larger than 4.5" x 6.5", with or without a handle or strap, are allowed. Medical bags are permitted and subject to a thorough inspection. There is no check-in location for prohibited bags or items.

tailgating.rules: Fans may plan their own tailgate or attend official pregame events. Official tailgates: Sparky's Touchdown Tailgate (free, family-friendly, at College Ave & 6th St, steps from the stadium; food trucks, beer garden, live entertainment, games, kids activities); Dos Equis Pitchfork Pregame (free, indoor/outdoor with A/C, on the north side of Desert Financial Arena near the SE entrance; $4 Dos Equis beers and Bar-S hotdogs); Coors Light Sun Devil Tailgate (paid, in the Desert Arboretum on the east side of the stadium; requires $2,500 giving level, $500 per two people); Sol Devils booster tailgate (outside the SW entrance to the stadium; food, music, full bar). REVELxp offers premium reserved tailgating on the Desert Financial Arena lawn near the stadium (book at revelxp.com/arizona-state or 480-518-2203).
tailgating.timeWindow: Sparky's Touchdown Tailgate begins 2.5 hours before every home game. Coors Light Sun Devil Tailgate opens 3 hours prior to scheduled kickoff and closes 30 minutes prior to kickoff. General-admission parking lots open 5.5 hours before kickoff; pass-holder lots open 7 hours before kickoff.
tailgating.grillRules: No open flames or charcoal grills are allowed; only propane gas grills may be used in the lots. In parking structures, grilling is allowed only on the top level (roof). Green Game sustainability guidance additionally recommends using an electric starter or a natural gas grill instead of charcoal.

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Soft or hard-sided coolers, ice chests, Glass, ceramic or metal containers, including metal and glass water bottles (plastic water bottles are allowed), Outside beverages, Tortillas, Balloons, inflated/deflated beach balls, Use of tobacco products, including e-cigarettes and smokeless cigarettes/tobacco, Cameras with detachable lenses greater than 6" or video cameras, Tripods, monopods or selfie sticks for cameras/phones, Full-size strollers, Backpacks, bags and other similar bags larger than 8" X 5" X 1", Bikes, skateboards, scooters, hoverboards, longboards, Large golf umbrellas, Pitchforks (metal, wood, plastic), Sticks, poles or similar objects that can be used as a weapon, Weapons of any kind, Fireworks, drones or laser pointers, Artificial noisemakers (example: air horns, thunderstix, musical instruments, cans filled with contents, whistles, cow bells or any other item used to make artificial noise, Pets/animals, Clothing deemed obscene, indecent and/or offensive, Chairs or stools, Banners or signs, singular or connecting, larger than 3' X 2' with a non-sport message, Dry-erase boards.
food: Multiple concession stands on all levels; all stands are cashless. Specialty concessions on the Coca-Cola Sun Deck include Fork'em BBQ, Chick-fil-A, Cold Beers and Cheeseburgers, and Someburros (additional Someburros behind section 33). Alcohol sales end at the end of the 3rd quarter throughout the stadium. Clear or plastic water bottles allowed (no metal, glass or ceramic); water fountains on every concourse and level.

gatesOpen.ruleText: The Mountain America Stadium gates open 90 minutes prior to kickoff. All areas in Mountain America Stadium can be accessed from any gate.

tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Sparky's Touchdown Tailgate begins 2.5 hours before every home game; Coors Light Sun Devil Tailgate opens 3 hours prior to kickoff and closes 30 minutes prior; GA parking lots open 5.5 hours before kickoff, pass-holder lots 7 hours before kickoff.

name: M&T Bank Stadium

parkingLots.notes: disabled parking available (first come, first served)

parkingLots.name: Lot C
parkingLots.notes: disabled parking available (first come, first served)

parkingLots.name: Lot R
parkingLots.notes: under Russell Street bridge; disabled parking (first come, first served)

parkingLots.name: Horseshoe Casino Garage
parkingLots.notes: PSL owners only; reserved (levels 3-6) or valet/premium (levels 1-2); no tailgating

accessibility: Disabled parking in Lots B, C & R, first come first served, no advance permits; state-issued disabled placard/plate required and registered owner must be in vehicle.

tailgating.rules: No tailgating permitted in the Horseshoe Casino Garage.

name: Nationals Park

parkingLots.name: Garage B
parkingLots.notes: Accessed on N Street SE; select additional accessible parking spaces made available first come, first served for accessible season ticket parking permit holders

parkingLots.name: Garage C
parkingLots.notes: Accessed on First Street SE (corner of N & 1st Street SE); location of complimentary bike valet; select additional accessible parking spaces available first come, first served

publicTransit.notes: The Green Line serves the Navy Yard/Southwest Waterfront area near the ballpark. Guests can also take the Orange/Blue/Silver Line to Capitol South Metro and walk to Nationals Park along New Jersey Ave to M Street, or exit at the Eastern Market station near Barracks Row.

rideshareDropoff: Ride-hailing pick-up/drop-off is not permitted on South Capitol Street (a busy highway). Suggested pick-up locations near the ballpark are N St SE & New Jersey Ave SE, L St SE between First St SE & New Jersey Ave SE, and M St SE & Half St SE.
accessibility: Accommodations for guests with disabilities include ADA seating, wheelchair-accessible entrances, elevators, ramps, accessible restrooms, drinking fountains, and ATMs. Accessible parking spaces are available in all lots (call 202.675.NATS). Prior to each home game the Metropolitan Police Department allows ADA drop-off along First Street SE near the grand staircase at Potomac Avenue & First Street SE. ADA-accessible entrance gates: Centerfield Gate, 1st Base ADA (corner of 1st St SE & Potomac Ave), Home Plate Gate, Media & Suites, and Left Field Gate.
bagPolicyNotes: Any bag larger than a 5" x 7" x 0.75" clutch must be clear plastic, vinyl or PVC and may not exceed 16" x 16" x 8". Small non-clear clutch bags 5" x 7" x 0.75" or smaller are permitted along with a clear bag. Backpacks (including clear backpacks), soft-sided and hard coolers, luggage, computer bags and camera bags are prohibited; non-clear bags/backpacks purchased inside the stadium complex during the game may be tagged and permitted that day only.
venueAccessRestrictions: All persons entering must walk through a metal detector or be screened with hand-held metal detectors, and all jackets, coats, packages, bags, purses and other containers are subject to inspection. No re-entry: guests may not exit and re-enter Nationals Park using the same ticket. Prohibited items include weapons/firearms and pocket knives, coolers and hard-sided containers, outside alcohol, drones, laser pointers, beach balls and inflatables, and noisemakers.
nearby: The revitalized Navy Yard and Southwest Waterfront areas feature several restaurants within walking distance of the ballpark; Barracks Row along 8th Street SE (near the Eastern Market Metro station) offers additional restaurant and retail options.
outsideFoodRules: Single-serving food items may be brought in as long as they are contained in one of the approved bags under the current bag policy or carried in your hands so they can be safely screened by security. Metal or glass containers are prohibited except clear, factory-sealed or empty plastic water bottles no larger than one liter, juice boxes, insulin containers, and baby food; only one water bottle per person and no frozen water bottles.
food: The Change-Up Food Hall (formerly the Budweiser Brew House) in Center Field Plaza features rotational vendors, guest chefs, and food specialties like Player Pick 'Em.

gatesOpen.ruleText: All gates open 80 minutes prior to first pitch (75 minutes for 6:45 p.m. games).

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Gates open 75 minutes before first pitch for 6:45 p.m. games; 80 minutes for all other games.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Exceptions may be made for diaper bags and other bags used for medical reasons; fans with diaper or medical bags may use ADA/Family lanes.

name: Nationwide Arena

parkingLots.name: McConnell garage
parkingLots.notes: Offers accessible spaces; North entrance suggested for accessible parking at heavily attended events.

parkingLots.name: Front Street garage
parkingLots.notes: Offers accessible spaces; North-east entrance suggested for accessible parking at heavily attended events.

rideshareDropoff: Please use West Street for guest drop off or pick-up.
bagPolicyNotes: Bags are generally not permitted. Medical bags, diaper bags, and clutches no larger than 8 inches by 5 inches by 1 inch are exceptions and will be X-rayed via dedicated screening lines at each entry. All other bags, including clear bags, backpacks, fanny packs, and crossbody bags, are prohibited.

name: Neyland Stadium

parkingLots.name: Lots surrounding Neyland Stadium
parkingLots.notes: Game day parking for all lots surrounding Neyland Stadium is reserved for parking pass holders/donors

parkingLots.name: Volunteer Boulevard (ParkMobile)
parkingLots.notes: Limited paid public parking on campus along Volunteer Boulevard between Todd Helton Drive and Cumberland Avenue; $60 via ParkMobile

parkingLots.name: Ag Campus (UT Institute of Agriculture)
parkingLots.notes: Free accessible/overflow parking, first-come first-served; free shuttle to Student Union loading dock begins three hours before kickoff

parkingLots.name: Civic Coliseum
parkingLots.notes: Overflow accessible parking (500 Howard Baker Jr Ave); no parking fee, $10 shuttle to campus

rideshareDropoff: Taxis/Uber/ridesharing pick-up and drop-off at Circle Drive on the Hill; vehicles enter from Cumberland Ave and proceed up the Hill. The ride-share area is opened by police during the 4th quarter and is limited in the number of vehicles.
accessibility: ADA elevator entrances at Gates 4, 21 and 26 (begin operating two hours before kickoff). Limited free ADA/accessible parking on the UT Institute of Agriculture campus, first-come first-served (valid accessible placard/plate required). A free, fully accessible shuttle to the Student Union loading dock begins three hours before kickoff and runs one hour post-game, picking up at the Business Incubator Building (2450 E.J. Chapman Dr). Once UT accessible parking is full, guests are referred to the Civic Coliseum (no parking fee; $10 shuttle). Contact Event Management at 865-974-1205 with accessible entry questions.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating activities and equipment are permitted in designated areas of campus.
tailgating.timeWindow: Before, during, and after games; not permitted overnight
tailgating.rvPolicy: RV parking on campus is reserved for University donors and requires a permit; there is no general public RV parking on campus.

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Non-clear bags of any size, Diaper bags, Backpacks (of any size), Alcoholic beverages, Cans, bottles, coolers, Outside food, snacks, beverages (unless needed for medical purposes), Radios without headsets, Umbrellas, Selfie sticks, Video cameras, Professional cameras or cameras with detachable lenses, Unmanned aircraft, Stadium seats with arms and/or pockets, Large bags or parcels, including backpacks and purses, Weapons, including pocket knives, Hoverboards, Segways, Artificial noisemakers, Smoking - including e-cigarettes - is prohibited inside the venue at all times, Strollers, Posters/signs larger than 8 1/2 x 11, Flags. No re-entry. Per Southeastern Conference policy, no pass-out checks (re-entry) are allowed; if the stadium is cleared due to inclement weather, fans may reenter with their digital ticket and will again be subject to search. All items, including clear bags and clutch purses, are subject to search at the gates; no items can be left or stored at the gates.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food, snacks or beverage needed for a medical purpose must be searched and verified at any open stadium gate. Diaper bags are not a medically necessary item; all diaper-bag supplies must be carried in a clear bag.
food: Cashless concession stands are located throughout each concourse inside Neyland Stadium (see the Neyland Stadium Concessions webpage for specialty stands). Food vendors are located in Toyota Volunteer Village across from Circle Park, and Student Union dining facilities are open on game days. Truly's Tailgate (with Texas Roadhouse) outside Gate 9 offers food and drinks pregame and throughout the game.

parkingLots.notes: Season parking garage; 40 W. University Avenue; also site of Rooftop Tailgating

parkingLots.name: Varsity Village Garage
parkingLots.notes: Season parking garage; 200 Varsity Village Drive

parkingLots.name: Eden Garage
parkingLots.notes: Single-game prepaid and gameday credit/debit-card parking; 3223 Eden Avenue; $25/game on gameday, valid until 4 a.m.

parkingLots.name: Clifton Lots
parkingLots.notes: Single-game prepaid parking; 2915 Clifton Avenue

parkingLots.name: Woodside Garage
parkingLots.notes: Single-game prepaid parking; 2913 Woodside Drive; portion designated accessible parking at $25 with state-issued handicap placard/plate

publicTransit.notes: Gameday bus shuttles run from Eden Garage before, during and after the game (starting 4 hours before kickoff through 1 hour post-game), dropping off at the corner of Commons Way and Daniels Street. Golf cart shuttles run from Woodside Garage to a drop-off point near the stadium.

accessibility: Accessible parking is available in Woodside Garage for $25 (credit/debit card only); a state-issued handicap pass is required and a golf cart shuttle runs from Woodside Garage to a drop-off point near the stadium. Bus shuttles from Eden Garage are ADA accessible. Patrons with disabilities should contact the UC Athletics Ticket Office; for more information call (513) 556-2283. UC offers captioning at football games, open captions on pre-recorded videoboard content, and live captioning via smartphones (Nippert Streamtext). ASL interpreters can be requested via the online ASL/CART request form; other accommodations via AccessResources@uc.edu. Nippert follows UC's Service Animal and Emotional Support Animal Policy.

tailgating.rules: Multiple tailgate areas: The Grid on Campus Green offers 125+ tailgating zones, a DJ stage and food trucks and uses REVELxp for turnkey tailgating (the Catwalk proceeds through The Grid 2.5 hours prior to kickoff). The Commons (Bearcats Commons in front of the College of Arts and Sciences) is a premium REVELxp turnkey tailgate with equipment setup/breakdown and bellhop/catering service. Rooftop Tailgating atop the University Avenue Garage is a traditional tailgate out of your vehicle with a separate parking spot for the vehicle and for tailgating, sold on a season-long basis.

venueAccessRestrictions: Re-entry is not permitted at any Nippert Stadium event. In case of emergency, guests can contact the ticket taker and/or security supervisor at the nearest gate.
outsideFoodRules: Food and beverages are prohibited except two unopened water bottles per fan. Coolers are prohibited. Fans may bring up to two unopened water bottles into the stadium.
food: Concession stands, including local vendor locations, are available on the east and west concourses of Nippert Stadium. All concession stands are cashless and accept credit and debit cards only.

gatesOpen.ruleText: All gates open two hours prior to the game start

name: Nissan Stadium

parkingLots.name: Lot T
parkingLots.notes: ADA drop-off/pick-up; bike racks nearby; on-site lots sold out for Titans games and must be bought in advance via PMC

parkingLots.name: Lot M
parkingLots.notes: Named lot referenced on Woodland St (scooter drop-off nearby)

lines: The Titans Express train (Lebanon to downtown Nashville, via Donelson)
publicTransit.notes: WeGo public transit serves Titans games; bus stop on Woodland St at S. 1st St; park & ride from Elizabeth Duff Transit Center; details at wegotransit.com/community/nissan-stadium. Paid Gray Line Tennessee Gameday Shuttle also available ($20 roundtrip, starts 90 min before kickoff).

rideshareDropoff: Designated rideshare zones; two closest are Crutcher St (south end) and Gay St (north end, across Woodland St Bridge); 12+ additional zones on downtown side of the river.
accessibility: Accessible seating on all levels (buy via SeatGeek); accessible parking in stadium lots with a pass (advance purchase, first-come); ADA drop-off/pick-up in Lot T (stadium-issued ADA Lane Pass required at roadblocks); complimentary assistive listening devices (Sec 124); KultureCity sensory kits and Sensory Room (Sec 101); Quiet Areas at Mother's Lounges (Sec 310, 337); service animals welcome; wheelchair pick-up/drop-off assistance; adult changing table (family restroom Sec 105); Braille signage; elevators for club/suite and 300 levels.
bagPolicyNotes: NFL league-wide clear bag policy in effect for all events. Clear bags must be 12x12x6 in or smaller; non-transparent bags/wallets/cases must not exceed 4.5x6.5 in (still subject to inspection). Medically necessary items permitted at any gate after inspection. Storage lockers for oversized/prohibited items at Gates 3 and 9 (from $10). Only clear, soft-sided empty water bottles allowed; strollers, umbrellas, coolers, and standalone chairs prohibited.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating permitted only directly behind your vehicle and may not extend into another space; do not save spaces or block access/roadways; use designated trash cans; TVs/radios permitted in/behind your space (mind volume); tents must be weighted, not staked into ground; management may limit or restrict.
tailgating.timeWindow: All tailgating in stadium/club-controlled lots must cease at kickoff; lots must be cleared of tailgating within 45 minutes after kickoff.
tailgating.grillRules: Hot coals must be extinguished and disposed in the coal bins/dumpsters in the lots; propane grills are not permitted.

venueAccessRestrictions: All guests subject to Evolv Express security screening, metal detection, and bag search at gates. Cashless facility (credit card/mobile payment only); reverse ATM for cash conversion behind Sec 124. Smoke-free and vape-free; no re-entry.
nearby: Located across the Cumberland River from downtown Nashville; connected by pedestrian bridges: Woodland Street Bridge (fastest access), Korean Veterans Blvd Bridge, and John Seigenthaler Pedestrian Bridge. Walking access also from East Nashville (Woodland St & Shelby Ave) and N. 1st Street.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food/beverages are prohibited. Exceptions: empty clear soft-sided water bottles; for children, clear plastic bottles/sippy cups with liquid and baby food/snacks/formula in plastic containers (no glass).
food: Cashless concessions featuring local and national food brands. Alcohol sales end at the conclusion of the 3rd quarter for Titans games (30 min before end for other events); must be 21+ to purchase/consume.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Nissan Stadium entrances open two (2) hours prior to kickoff for Titans home games.

name: Northwest Stadium
bagPolicyNotes: Clear plastic/vinyl/PVC bags up to 12x6x12 in, or a one-gallon clear freezer bag; plus one hand-sized clutch (with or without strap) permitted.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverages prohibited; special-dietary-needs exception (religious or severe food allergies) available via request form submitted at least 48 hours in advance.

name: Notre Dame Stadium

parkingLots.name: Blue Lot
parkingLots.notes: General, $50 per game; off Douglas Road; free for faculty/staff and football season ticket holders with valid ID; shuttle to/from Hesburgh Library; opens 8:00 am

parkingLots.name: Gold Lot
parkingLots.notes: General, $50 per game; off Douglas Road; opens 10:00 am for 3:30 pm games and 1:00 pm for 7:30 pm games; shuttle to/from Hesburgh Library

parkingLots.name: Bulla Lot
parkingLots.notes: Accessible, $50 per game; state-issued ADA placard or plate required; free shuttle to/from Joyce Center Gate 4; opens 8:00 am

parkingLots.name: Burke North / Burke South / Dorr
parkingLots.notes: General, $50 per game; all vehicles must exit 2 hours post-game

parkingLots.name: Saint Mary's College
parkingLots.notes: RV $80 / cars $40; off SR 933 south of Douglas Road; opens 8:00 am day games, 10:00 am night games, shuttles from 3 pm

parkingLots.name: Holy Cross College
parkingLots.notes: Bus or RV $250 / cars $40 / campers $100; off SR 933 north of Angela Blvd; opens 8:00 am day games, 10:00 am night games

parkingLots.name: Notre Dame Federal Credit Union
parkingLots.notes: Bus only (limited capacity) $300; NW corner of St. Joseph Dr & Moreau Dr; advance purchase via ticket office

parkingLots.name: Party Zone Parking Lot
parkingLots.notes: Bus or RV $425 / cars $150; car parking at Twyckenham and Angela Blvd; advance purchase via GameDay Your Way

publicTransit.notes: Free public route on every home football Saturday; runs 3 hours pre-game (last departure from downtown South Bend 1 hour before kickoff) and 2 hours post-game, stopping at Aloft Hotel, Century Center/Courtyard by Marriott, DoubleTree, and McKenna Hall. Campus parking shuttles begin at 8:00 am and run at least 2 hours post-game.

rideshareDropoff: Pre-game rideshare drop-off points: Compton Family Ice Arena, Rugby Lot (off Wilson Drive), and Lake Lot (near WNDU on Dorr Road). Post-game pickup at the Trader Joe's parking lot south of campus, 1140 Howard St, South Bend, IN 46617.
accessibility: Accessible/ADA parking in the Bulla Lot ($50) with a state-issued ADA placard or plate plus a University parking pass, with a free shuttle to Joyce Center Gate 4; ADA parking also available in the Joyce and Stadium reserved lots. The University offers assisted wheelchair transport to/from seats (wheelchairs cannot remain with guests); reserved wheelchair/companion seating is located throughout the stadium (contact ticket office 574-631-7356). Stadium elevators are near Sections 10/11 (east) and 29/30 (west). Guest Service Team members at each gate assist larger wheelchairs through security.
bagPolicyNotes: Clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags may not exceed 12 x 6 x 12 in (logo on one side only, max 4.5 x 3.4 in). Exceptions permitted: a clutch bag or wallet (with or without handle/strap) not exceeding 4.5 x 6.5 in, and one-gallon clear plastic bags (Ziploc/Hefty). Diaper and baby items must be carried in a permissible clear tote no larger than 12 x 6 x 12 in. Medical bags/equipment and pumps for nursing mothers are allowed subject to additional screening. Camera bags are not permitted. Bags and containers that do not meet the policy are prohibited.

tailgating.rules: Permitted in all gameday fan parking lots before and after the game; prohibited during the game in any campus lot or green space unless University-approved. Tents/canopies 10'x10' or smaller are allowed; larger tents and all tent stakes are prohibited. Tents, tables, and chairs cannot protrude past the hash marks into driving lanes. Guests may not hold parking spaces; parking is one space per pass. Kegs and excessive alcohol, large parties, drinking games, live bands or DJs, and stand-alone/amplified speakers are prohibited. Overnight parking is prohibited (vehicles towed beginning 6 am). Golf carts and custom motorized vehicles require NDPD authorization; drones require University and FAA approval.
tailgating.timeWindow: Lots and gates open 8:00 am ET for all home games regardless of kickoff time; zipper parking starts 9:00 am. All lots close 3 hours after the end of the game, except the Burke Golf Course which closes 2 hours post-game.
tailgating.grillRules: Propane grills are permitted but propane tanks must be under 20 lbs. Charcoal grills, fire pits, open flames, propane heaters, and deep-frying (e.g. turkeys) are prohibited.
tailgating.rvPolicy: RVs, buses, and campers must use designated lots: Saint Mary's ($80 RV), Holy Cross ($250 bus/RV, $100 camper), Notre Dame Federal Credit Union ($300 bus), and Party Zone ($425 bus/RV). Vehicles larger than 7.5 ft wide or 20 ft long, box trucks, and vehicles with trailers/tow-ins are not permitted in standard lots and must pay and park in the RV or Bus lots.

venueAccessRestrictions: No re-entry: the stadium does not permit pass-outs, and anyone leaving must have a new/unused ticket to return. Metal detectors are used at all entrances; guests pass through after bag check, then have tickets scanned. A ticket is required for entry regardless of age.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food or beverage is prohibited (exceptions can be made for dietary restrictions upon approval). Empty non-glass water vessels (personal water bottle, Yeti cup) are permitted, but bottles of water and outside alcohol/alcohol containers are prohibited.
food: Concession stands throughout the stadium; beer, wine, and seltzer are sold at general concession stands (21+, valid ID, 2-drink limit, service ends after the 3rd quarter). The stadium is cashless (credit/debit, Apple Pay, Android Pay; a cash-to-Visa-gift-card kiosk is at Gate D). Signature items include the Rockne Brat and an exclusive YETI tumbler.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Stadium Gates A, B, C, D, and E open 90 minutes prior to kickoff each game day; premium doors (Doors 3, 4, 10, 14, and 17) and Duncan Student Center, Corbett Family Hall, and O'Neill Hall hospitality doors open 2 hours prior to kickoff.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: General stadium gates open 90 minutes before kickoff; premium and hospitality doors open 2 hours (120 minutes) before kickoff.
tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Lots open 8:00 am ET regardless of kickoff time; tailgating before and after the game (prohibited during the game unless approved); lots close 3 hours after the game ends, Burke Golf Course 2 hours post-game.

name: NRG Stadium

publicTransit.notes: Exit at Stadium Park / Astrodome Station off Fannin and enter Gate 2. From IAH airport take METRO 500 Downtown Direct to downtown then transfer to Red Line. METRO info 713-225-0119; 100% accessible with METROLift paratransit.

accessibility: ADA parking first-come first-served in designated sections (Orange, Maroon, Red, Blue lots) with valid placard/plate plus paid pass; accessible seating on all levels; dedicated mobility assistance team plus venue wheelchairs; accessible elevators at NRG Stadium NE/SE/SW/NW lobbies; sensory room and KultureCity sensory bags at Section 133; service dogs permitted (no emotional-support animals); ADA mobility drop-off at Blue Lot 19 (Gate 9); contact 832-667-1810 / ADAAccommodations@nrgpark.com.
bagPolicyNotes: When clear bag policy is in effect: one clear plastic/vinyl/PVC bag max 12x6x12 in, or a one-gallon clear ziploc, or a clutch max 4.5x6.5 in. General events: no backpacks or large bags exceeding 11x17 in. Diaper and medical bags subject to inspection. All Houston Texans games and NFL contracted events follow the NFL Clear Bag Policy.

tailgating.rules: Allowed in all NRG Park lots for Houston Texans games (other events at management discretion). Limited to your parking spot and the space directly in front of or behind the vehicle, not blocking the drive lane or beyond the blue lines; no saving or blocking spaces (fans tailgating together must arrive together); tents and chairs must be stowed before kickoff; golf carts, bikes and scooters prohibited; music kept to a minimum; each parking receipt is one 8x16 ft spot; one extra spot may be purchased for added tailgate area.
tailgating.timeWindow: Parking lots open 4 hours before kickoff for Texans games; other events at management discretion.
tailgating.grillRules: Open flames allowed but must be extinguished before entering the stadium. Charcoal must be match-light/quick-light (no lighter fluid), with a metal pan under the pit and coals deposited in orange containers. Propane connections must be tight. Fire extinguisher minimum rating 2-A:10-B:C required and charged. Generators allowed with fuel stored in UL-approved metal safety cans.
tailgating.rvPolicy: RVs must purchase a minimum of two parking spots and park in designated RV areas in each lot; additional spaces required for canopies. BBQs in tow require an additional space.

venueAccessRestrictions: No re-entry policy: once you exit a facility you may not return unless otherwise posted. Restricted areas require an official credential or ticket.
nearby: Numerous nearby businesses, restaurants and hotels in the Harris County cultural hub near NRG Park; see the NRG Park Nearby Businesses Map.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverage not permitted; exceptions made for medical reasons and children.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates to NRG Stadium open 2 hours before kickoff

tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Parking lots open 4 hours before kickoff
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Houston Texans games and NFL contracted events follow the NFL Clear Bag Policy (clear bag max 12x6x12 in)

parkingLots.notes: Premier Day of Game location, $60

parkingLots.notes: Premier Day of Game location, $60

parkingLots.notes: Proximity Day of Game location, $40

parkingLots.notes: Proximity Day of Game location, $40

parkingLots.notes: Advance single-game parking (also VIP Buckeye Experience lot)

parkingLots.name: Fawcett Center
parkingLots.notes: Advance single-game parking

parkingLots.name: Gray Lots
parkingLots.notes: RV parking near the Schottenstein Center; RV permit required

parkingLots.name: Buckeye Lots
parkingLots.notes: RV parking near the Schottenstein Center; RV permit required

publicTransit.notes: A complimentary West Campus shuttle runs from Mount Hall Loop (west campus parking lots) to the Transit Hub near the RPAC, from six hours before kickoff until one hour after the game.

rideshareDropoff: Taxi and rideshare pickup/dropoff are located along Borror Drive near the Schottenstein Center and at the intersection of 17th and Neil Avenue; on event days the rideshare app directs riders to those pickup locations. Drivers cannot pick up near Ohio Stadium on event days due to traffic patterns and security checkpoints.
accessibility: Elevators on the west side between Gates 17-23 provide access to the Club Levels and D-Deck; one elevator in the south stadium near Gate 39 serves south stadium A and B levels. Accessible restrooms are located throughout the stadium and mobility devices are permitted through any gate. An ADA wheelchair-accessible shuttle runs from the disability parking lot (adjacent to the ROTC building) to the east side near Gate 22, from six hours before kickoff until one hour after the game. Complimentary in-stadium wheelchair escort is available. Ohio Stadium is certified Sensory Inclusive by KultureCity, with sensory bags at Guest Services locations. Accessible seating and services are requested via the Disability Needs Request Form.

tailgating.rules: Vehicles and all tailgate activities/equipment must fit within the 8.5'x15' space provided in surface lots and garages; vehicles larger than the space must purchase an RV permit. There are no in-and-out privileges (one entrance per permit), saving of parking spaces is not permitted, and spaces are first-come, first-served. Tailgate equipment (trailers, tents, porta-johns, food & beverage, etc.) may not occupy vacant spaces, crosswalks, pedestrian thoroughfares, or drive lanes, or interfere with traffic flow. Freestanding signs must be no larger than 4x4 feet; ground-penetrating signs are not allowed without approval; canvassing, solicitation, and product sales are prohibited.
tailgating.timeWindow: Tents may be set up no earlier than 5:00pm on the Thursday before a home game in grass areas, and may not be erected inside parking lots until after 5:00am on gameday; all tents must be removed by noon the Sunday after the game. Personal port-a-johns may be delivered no sooner than Thursday 4:00pm. On game day, football parking lots and garages open at 5 a.m.
tailgating.grillRules: Charcoal grilling is NOT permitted anywhere on the Ohio State campus (including tailgating lots, garages, and grass areas). Liquid propane grills ARE permitted following OSU fire-prevention safety protocols, and must be placed at least 10 feet from any structure. Open burning (fire pits, fire rings, stoves, or chimneys) is not allowed.
tailgating.rvPolicy: RV parking is available in the Gray Lots and Buckeye Lots near the Schottenstein Center and requires an RV permit (generally sold on a season basis, with some single-game permits possibly available). RVs plus tailgate equipment and any towing/towed vehicles must fit within an assigned space of approximately 40'x60'; no in-and-out privileges. RVs must exit the parking facilities no later than 10:00am the Sunday following a game day.

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: All Bags (including but not limited to backpacks, fanny packs, purses, string or ‘cinch’ bags, messenger bags, crossbody bags, camera bags, briefcases, grocery bags, roll bags, binocular cases, duffle bags or any other bags), Alcohol, Animals (except service dogs for guests with disabilities), Audio or Video Recording Equipment, Banners, Flags and Signs, Bicycles, Cameras with a lens greater than 100mm (along with Monopods, Dual Pods and Tripods), Chairs including Folding Chairs, Portable Chairs, Stools, Lawn Chairs, Clothing with profane, inappropriate or abusive language, Containers (common examples include but are not limited to hard sided coolers, soft pack coolers, ice chests, picnic baskets, cans, heavy plastic or glass bottles, thermoses), Confetti, streamers, glitter, balloons, Drones, Firearms, Fireworks, Food or beverages, Illegal Drugs, Inflatables (balls, balloons, etc.), Laptops and computers, Laser pointers, Markers (permanent) and/or paint, Noisemaking devices, Seat cushions that have back supports, zippers, or storage slots, Sticks, Poles, Pipes or Selfie sticks, Strollers and car-seat type baby carriers, Signs, Sports Equipment, Televisions or video monitors, Weapons or items that mimic weapons, Wrapped gifts, packages or items. Re-entering the facility is not permitted. All items and persons entering our facilities are subject to security screening and inspection via a walk through metal detector and/or a hand wand metal detector or visual search.
outsideFoodRules: Food or beverages may not be brought into Ohio Stadium (listed among prohibited items). Guests with medical or dietary needs may carry one bag through the Band Center entrance (between Gates 10 & 12) or the Press Entrance (near Gate 23) after inspection.

name: Oracle Park

parkingLots.name: Lot A
parkingLots.notes: Primary Giants parking lot, connected to the ballpark via the Lefty O'Doul Bridge; charter bus parking is adjacent on the eastern edge along Terry Francois Blvd. Slated to be replaced by a structured garage as part of the Mission Rock development.

parkingLots.name: Lot C
parkingLots.notes: Giants parking lot; informal tailgating allowed in the area immediately around one's vehicle.

parkingLots.name: Pier 48
parkingLots.notes: Parking area served by the free Accessibility Shuttle (Lot A/Pier 48 to Oracle Park); tailgating not permitted.

parkingLots.name: Pier 30/32
parkingLots.notes: Parking area; tailgating not permitted.

parkingLots.name: One Bryant
parkingLots.notes: Parking area; tailgating not permitted.

publicTransit.notes: Muni, BART, and Caltrain serve the ballpark, with accessibility services available through each agency and SFMTA Paratransit.

rideshareDropoff: There is a guest drop-off zone on Third Street between the O'Doul Gate and the Giants Dugout Store. Uber and Lyft ride-hail services are available, including accessible ride programs.
accessibility: All fans, including those with ADA placards, must have a SpotHero reservation to park in Giants-controlled facilities; valid ADA placard holders with a reservation receive priority parking spaces on a first-come, first-served basis. A free Accessibility Shuttle runs between Lot A/Pier 48 and the ballpark's O'Doul Gate, beginning three hours before first pitch and ending 45 minutes after the last out.
bagPolicyNotes: Backpacks (including clear backpacks) are NOT permitted, though accommodations are made for diaper bags, medical bags, and guests with accessible needs. Other bags not exceeding 16" x 16" x 8" are permitted, including paper and plastic grocery bags, purses, fanny packs, lunch bags, briefcases, diaper bags, soft-sided coolers, and handbags. Hard-sided coolers are not permitted. Bags do not need to be clear. All bags are subject to inspection. On-site bag storage is available for rent at the Marina Gate.

tailgating.rules: Informal tailgating is allowed in Lots A & C within the area immediately around one's vehicle. Tailgating must not interfere with other parking spaces or drive aisles, and is not permitted in Pier 48, Pier 30/32, or One Bryant.

venueAccessRestrictions: Guests pass through walk-through magnetometer screening at entry, and all bags are subject to inspection. Re-entry to Oracle Park is not permitted, though exceptions for medical or ADA needs are allowed subject to re-screening. Prohibited items include backpacks (even clear ones), bags larger than 16x16x8, hard-sided coolers, weapons and knives of any kind, drones, aerosol cans, laser pointers, noisemakers, glass or aluminum containers, and outside alcohol.
outsideFoodRules: Soft-sided coolers and lunch bags within the 16x16x8 bag limit are permitted for entry, and sealed plastic bottles and soft-sided juice containers are allowed. Outside alcohol (including non-alcoholic beer and wine) is not permitted, and glass bottles and aluminum cans are prohibited. Outside food and beverage is not permitted on the Oracle Suite Level.
food: Diamond 58 (Aramark Sports + Entertainment) is the exclusive concessionaire. Signature menu items include the Crazy Crab Sandwich, Orlando's Cha-Cha Bowl, and Garlic Fries, plus special cultural food offerings on heritage days. Oracle Park is cashless (Visa preferred), with fee-free cash-to-card machines available.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Main gates (Willie Mays, Lefty O'Doul, 2nd & King, Marina) open 90 minutes before game time for Monday-Friday games and 2 hours before game time for Saturday & Sunday games. Times can vary for games with promotional giveaways or pregame ceremonies.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Weekend (Saturday/Sunday) main gates open 2 hours before first pitch versus 90 minutes on weekdays. Special-ticket early-entry gates open earlier: The 415/STM Early Entry Gate opens 2 hours (weekday) or 2.5 hours (weekend) before game time, and The Gotham Club & Triples Alley open 2.5 hours before. Gate times can vary for promotional giveaways or pregame ceremonies.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Backpacks (including clear backpacks) are prohibited, but accommodations are made for diaper bags, medical bags, and guests with accessible needs.

accessibility: Every parking lot provides handicap parking spaces for season ticket holders with passes for that lot. ADA drop-off at the Central Ave curb cut-out (West Gate) and at Race St and Freedom Way (East Gate).
bagPolicyNotes: Approved bags are clear plastic, vinyl or PVC and must not exceed 12" x 6" x 12" (includes clear backpacks, clear fanny packs and clear cinch bags). Medically necessary items are allowed after inspection at the gate.

name: PayPal Park

parkingLots.name: Parking Structure 1 (PS1)
parkingLots.notes: $55; max vehicle height 7 feet

parkingLots.name: Parking Structure 2 (PS2)
parkingLots.notes: $36; max vehicle height 7 feet

parkingLots.name: Ford Tailgate Lot
parkingLots.notes: $30; tailgating permitted

parkingLots.name: ADA
parkingLots.notes: $30 ADA parking

publicTransit.notes: Caltrain: ride to the Santa Clara station, then head east under the pedestrian tunnel onto Brokaw Ave and turn right on Coleman Ave to PayPal Park. BART: take BART to the Millbrae Transit Station and transfer to Caltrain heading southbound toward San Jose. VTA: take VTA Bus Route 60 to Coleman Ave and Earthquakes Way, which drops off directly in front of PayPal Park near the main entrance.

rideshareDropoff: Uber/rideshare drop-off and pickup is at the south end of Aviation Avenue (#7 on the parking map). The parking tips section also directs drop-off and pickup to the designated area on Newhall Drive (#7 on the map). Buses are not permitted to park on site and use the same designated pick-up and drop-off location #7.
accessibility: ADA parking is available at PayPal Park; an ADA parking pass is $30.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is defined as the use of any item (tables, chairs, free-standing canopies or umbrellas, awnings attached to RVs, coolers, barbeques, grills, games, generators, television, sound system, food or drink, or preparation/serving equipment) for an outdoor gathering before, during, or after a scheduled event. Tailgating is permitted in the Ford Tailgate Lot. Tailgating cannot impede vehicle or foot traffic, is limited to the area directly in front of or behind your vehicle only, and empty spaces may not be reserved or used for tailgating.
tailgating.timeWindow: PayPal Park parking lots open 3 hours prior to kickoff for MLS matches and close 1 hour post match; tailgating is permitted in the Ford Tailgate Lot.

venueAccessRestrictions: Maximum vehicle height for each parking garage is 7 feet. Event parking is only authorized in the onsite parking lots; event parking is prohibited in surrounding lots and violators may be ticketed and/or towed. Buses are not permitted to park on site and should use the designated pick-up and drop-off location #7.
food: Concessions at PayPal Park are provided by OVG. Matchday food trucks have included TacoMania, 3 Hermanos Grill, Old Greenwood BBQ, Ivan's Baked Potatoes, Crazy Empanadas, Scratch Cookery, and Akita Sushi.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates open at 5:30 PM (matchday kickoff 7:30 PM)

tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Audi Lot and Ford Tailgate Lot open 4:30 PM on matchday (PS4 5:30 PM, PS1 and PS2 6:30 PM); lots open 3 hours before kickoff and close 1 hour after the match.

name: Petco Park

parkingLots.name: Padres Parkade
parkingLots.notes: Padres contracted/controlled cashless parking lot; served by complimentary shuttle to Petco Park.

parkingLots.name: Lexus Premier Lot
parkingLots.notes: Padres contracted cashless parking lot; Lock & Go lockers located across from the Home Plate Gate entrance.

parkingLots.name: Tailgate Lot (Tailgate Park)
parkingLots.notes: Padres contracted cashless parking lot; served by complimentary shuttle to Petco Park.

parkingLots.name: MTS Garage
parkingLots.notes: Served by complimentary shuttle to Petco Park.

parkingLots.name: Hilton Bayfront
parkingLots.notes: Off-site cashless parking garage/lot not controlled by the Padres.

parkingLots.name: San Diego Convention Center
parkingLots.notes: Off-site cashless parking garage/lot not controlled by the Padres.

publicTransit.notes: Parking is extremely limited and public transportation and/or rideshare is encouraged; guests are urged to arrive early. Complimentary shuttle service runs between the Padres Parkade, Tailgate Park, the MTS Garage and Petco Park, available two hours prior to a scheduled game through about a half hour after the game.

rideshareDropoff: A designated rideshare (Lyft, Uber, taxi) loading zone is located across the street from the Bayfront Hilton Hotel (next to the Convention Center) on Harbor Drive and Park Boulevard; fans are encouraged to be dropped off and picked up there and take the pedestrian sky bridge toward Petco Park.
accessibility: All parking lots and structures provide accessible parking spaces at the current parking rate, first come first served. Designated accessible seating includes wheelchair, semi-ambulatory (extra leg room), and transfer (armless aisle) seats, with companion seats in most cases. The Padres offer complimentary Assistive Listening Devices at the Section 108 Guest Service Center, closed captioning of PA announcements via the MLB Ballpark app, complimentary courtesy shuttles and wheelchair escorts, priority elevator access, wheelchair storage at Guest Service Centers (Sections 108, 131, 303 and Gallagher Square), ADA power stations for wheelchair charging, and family/all-gender restrooms at Sections 109, 202, 219, 310 and 311. See the Padres accessibility guide.
bagPolicyNotes: Bags are prohibited except single-compartment clear plastic bags not exceeding 12" x 6" x 12" and infant and medical bags. Clutches and purses no larger than 5" x 7" are also permitted.
venueAccessRestrictions: All items are subject to search prior to entry, and security officers at every gate may inspect packages, bags, and purses. An extensive prohibited-items list applies, including alcoholic beverages, firearms and weapons, knives, hard-sided coolers, glass containers, drones, laser pointers, noise-making devices, aerosol cans, selfie sticks, hover boards, and Segways; prohibited items placed in amnesty boxes at the gates are not returned. Re-entry is permitted (digital ticket scanned out and back in), but on select giveaway days re-entry is not applicable until promotional items are exhausted or the completion of the 3rd inning, and re-entry is prohibited once the game or event has concluded. Video surveillance operates at all entry gates 24 hours a day.
outsideFoodRules: Guests may bring food intended for individual consumption (no bulk packaging, pans, or pizza boxes), to be consumed in one's seat; outside food cannot be brought into any ballpark restaurant, club lounge, or suite. Items must be individually wrapped, bagged, or in a single-serve container; projectile foods (oranges, apples, other fruit) must be sliced or sectioned; and food containers must be soft-sided and comply with the bag policy. One factory-sealed, still, clear, unflavored plastic water bottle of one liter or less is allowed, as are soft-sided single juice or milk containers and ADA-required liquids in a sealed container; one-liter reusable water bottles (no glass) are permitted but must be empty upon entry. Outside alcohol is prohibited under California liquor regulations.
food: Petco Park offers a wide variety of food and drink options with all concessions open for in-person pickup, and in-seat delivery available for Dugout Seats in sections 109, 111, 113, 110 and 112 and the entire Terrace Level. A Food and Beverage Finder is available through the contact page and the MLB Ballpark app chatbot to locate offerings nearest a guest's section.

gatesOpen.ruleText: All entry gates open to guests 90 minutes prior to first pitch. Season Ticket Members may enter 2 hours prior to first pitch at two designated gates (Park Boulevard Gate and Home Plate Gate).

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Gate times are subject to change for special events, including Opening Day, select promotions, and Postseason play.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Infant and medical bags are exempt from the bag prohibition; clutches and purses no larger than 5" x 7" are also permitted alongside single-compartment clear plastic bags up to 12" x 6" x 12".

parkingLots.notes: Recommended for fans coming from the south, west or east; over 20,000 downtown spaces plus ~50 other lots/garages. About a five-minute walk over the Andy Warhol (7th Street) Bridge; the First Avenue garage connects to the First Avenue 'T' station.

publicTransit.notes: Pirates encourage fans to park in the Golden Triangle in one of the eight Pittsburgh Parking Authority garages downtown and take the free 'T' service or walk across the Roberto Clemente Bridge. The First Avenue garage connects to the First Avenue 'T' station; fans can ride free to Wood Street Station and walk across the Andy Warhol (7th Street) Bridge to PNC Park. Dedicated Bus Service and Light Rail info pages are linked from the transportation index.

accessibility: Accessible parking is available first-come, first-served in lots surrounding PNC Park (ALCO Parking Corporation, 412-323-4455). Drop-off zones with curb cuts are along Mazeroski Way and West General Robinson Street. Elevators serve Right Field (Sec 101), Right Suite Entrance (Sec 113), Press Entrance (Sec 117), Left Suite Entrance (Sec 125) and the Left Field Lounge; two escalator sets serve the Home Plate entrance and Stargell Gate. Accessible seating is throughout the ballpark, with wheelchairs, assisted-listening and noise-cancelling headphones, sensory bags/room, and a quiet room available at Main Guest Relations at the bottom of the Home Plate Rotunda. Service animals are permitted.
bagPolicyNotes: Each guest is permitted to bring one soft-sided bag into the ballpark, including purses, fanny packs and backpacks, no larger than 16 x 16 x 8 inches. Bags exceeding these dimensions are not permitted, and all bags are subject to search. Diaper bags for young children and bags carried for medical reasons are permitted after a security search.
venueAccessRestrictions: All guests and bags are subject to search on entry and within the ballpark by walk-through metal detection, bag checks, pat-down or otherwise. Prohibited/hazardous items include Bluetooth speakers, inflatable balls, hoverboards, balloons, motorcycle helmets, frisbee discs, drones, laser pointers, fireworks and footballs; weapons and other dangerous or hazardous items are not permitted. Prohibited beverages include alcoholic beverages, carbonated beverages, sports drinks, cans, glass bottles and thermoses.
outsideFoodRules: Guests may bring bottled water and food. Water bottles must not exceed 24 oz and must be clear, plastic, sealed and disposable. Children's juice boxes and items necessary for medical purposes are permitted. Alcoholic beverages, carbonated beverages, sports drinks, cans, glass bottles and thermoses are not allowed. Outside food and beverage is not permitted into the Home Plate Club, Suite Level, or Left Field Lounge areas.

bagPolicyNotes: Medical bags and diaper bags are permitted and must pass through x-ray machines; items that do not pass security must be returned to vehicles. All items are subject to searches upon entrance.
