accessibility: ADA seating issued first-come, first-served (call 1-877-AT-UCONN); all parking lots, entrance gates, concession stands and restrooms are ADA accessible; ADA parking requires a state placard or license plate in the vehicle; service animals and service animals in training welcome
bagPolicyNotes: Diaper bags are permitted in the company of a small child and subject to inspection at all entrances. Bags carrying medical needs are also permitted and are subject to inspection at all entrances.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is permitted on stadium grounds; see the UConn Tailgating Policies page for full rules
tailgating.timeWindow: Parking lots open 5 hours prior to game time for season parking pass holders and 4 hours prior for single-game parking pass holders
tailgating.rvPolicy: RV parking available in Lot 9; season RV passes $155, single-game passes $50

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Any outside alcoholic beverages, Animals (except service animals or service animals in training), Any outside food and beverage, Artificial noisemakers, Audio and video recording equipment, Bags larger than 12" x 6" x 12" (height x width x depth) and backpacks (diaper bags are permitted in the company of a small child), Balloons, Coolers, Cans, Glass Bottles or Flasks, Drones, Drugs, Laptops, Laser pointers, Promotional items with commercial identification not approved by UConn, Seatbacks larger than 16" x 16" x 12" (height x width x depth), Umbrellas, Weapons of any kind (including concealed carry). No re-entry permitted at the stadium. Walk-through metal detectors at each gate entrance. Guests do not need to remove belts, shoes or jackets. Guests do need to remove cell phones, cameras, headwear, keys and other large metal objects.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverage is a prohibited item; coolers, cans, glass bottles and flasks are also prohibited
food: Full-service and satellite concession stands throughout the concourse accept all major credit/debit cards only (no cash); alcohol available for purchase for guests 21 and older

gatesOpen.ruleText: Pratt & Whitney Stadium gates open 90 minutes prior to game time. Executive Suite and Indoor Club Level premium hospitality areas open 2 hours prior to game time.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Executive Suite and Indoor Club Level premium hospitality areas open 2 hours prior to game time
tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Parking lots open 5 hours prior to game time for season parking pass holders and 4 hours prior for single-game parking pass holders

name: Progressive Field

parkingLots.name: Great Day Improvements Garage
parkingLots.notes: Located between Progressive Field and Rocket Mortgage Fieldhouse; enter off Huron Road, Eagle Avenue off Ontario Street, or Bolivar Road off East 9th Street. Operated by Standard Parking. Opens to fans holding a pre-purchased pass 3 hours prior to first pitch. Accessible spaces available first-come, first-served.

parkingLots.name: Gateway East Garage (650 Huron)
parkingLots.notes: Nearest garage, managed by the City of Cleveland, located adjacent to Progressive Field and Rocket Mortgage Field House. Offers accessible spaces for vehicles with an accessible placard plus a parking pass (purchased in advance or day-of when available).

publicTransit.notes: RTA bus and Rapid Transit rail service the ballpark. Rail riders can reach the park via RTA's enclosed walkway from Tower City Center, which exits onto Ontario Street adjacent to the ballpark. The walkway opens no later than 5:30pm for M-F 7:05pm games and 5pm for Saturday 7:05pm games; for Sunday 1:05pm games it opens at 11am and stays open 90 minutes after the game. RTAnswerline: 216-621-9500.

rideshareDropoff: Guests may drop off and pick up along the curb lane off of Ontario Street.
accessibility: Progressive Field complies with the ADA; all entrances/exits are accessible. Accessible parking is available at the Gateway East Garage (with accessible placard plus pass) and nearby surface lots/garages. Accessible seating is located on every level of the ballpark, plus end-of-row seats without an armrest and seats behind the screened area for guests with visual impairments. Wheelchairs are available at all gates on a first-come, first-served basis for transportation only. Service dogs (and miniature ponies) are permitted; comfort dogs are not. KultureCity sensory bags and noise-cancelling headphones can be checked out at Fan Services (section 153) and the Kids Clubhouse. Metal detection screening is required, with a physical pat-down offered as an alternative.
bagPolicyNotes: Fans may bring manufactured diaper bags, medical bags, fanny packs, clutches, and small bags not exceeding 16"x16"x8". Bags exceeding the 16x16x8-inch maximum, large bags, and hard-sided coolers are prohibited; soft-sided coolers are permitted subject to inspection. All bags are inspected by security upon entry.
venueAccessRestrictions: All fans are screened by walk-through metal detectors (per MLB Security Standards); guests who do not comply are offered a physical pat-down alternative. All bags are inspected for prohibited items. Prohibited items include weapons/firearms (including for concealed-carry permit holders), cans/glass/squeeze bottles/thermos bottles, hard-sided coolers and large bags, aerosol cans, outside alcohol, noisemakers, laser pointers, stainless-steel tumblers, and action sports equipment. Re-entry is allowed only through a dedicated gate at the Left Field Gate, where the ticket/seat locator is scanned on exit and re-scanned on return.
outsideFoodRules: Fans may bring outside food, subject to inspection by Security Staff prior to entry. Food items are prohibited from entry into Premium Seating areas (Suites, the Discount Drug Mart Champions Club, and the Victory Club). Soft-sided coolers are permitted subject to inspection; hard-sided coolers are not permitted. Fans may also bring a single factory-sealed bottle of water 20oz or less and small single-serving juice boxes.
food: Delaware North Companies is the exclusive concessionaire, providing a diverse menu throughout the ballpark. Signature destinations include the two-story Corner Bar with nearly 40 local and craft beers on tap, the Fat Heads Beer Garden and Home Plate Club in the Infield District, and a dozen local eats across the Infield District.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Sunday-Thursday: all gates open 1 hour prior to first pitch. Friday and Saturday games in April, May and September: gates open 1.5 hours prior. Friday and Saturday games May 29-August 29: gates open 2 hours prior. All gate times subject to change.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Friday/Saturday games open earlier than the standard 1 hour: 1.5 hours prior (April, May, September) or 2 hours prior (May 29-August 29).
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Manufactured diaper bags, medical bags, fanny packs, and small handheld clutches (or clutches with a strap) are permitted despite the general bag restrictions.

name: Providence Park
rideshareDropoff: Designated Lyft and Uber pick up and drop off locations: the corner of SW Alder & 19th; SW Salmon in front of Lincoln High School; and SW Morrison & 20th Place.
accessibility: A closed-captioned feed of the Providence Park scoreboard is available during Portland Timbers matches (viewable via the stadium closed captioning page).
venueAccessRestrictions: All guests entering Providence Park are subject to enhanced security screening including walkthrough metal detector (magnetometer) screening prior to admittance; all five gates have magnetometers. Guests who decline the magnetometer are subject to hand-held wand screening or a full-body pat-down; those with metal implants may require supplemental screening.
food: Park Provisions is the official food and beverage concessionaire and hospitality partner at Providence Park, offering gameday classics and locally sourced regional fare through partnerships with local purveyors.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates open 90 minutes before kickoff. Gate A near SW 18th and Taylor is the premium entrance.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: The 90-minute gate-open time is stated on the adiClub premium matchday info page (in the context of the premium Gate A entrance). No separate general-admission gate-open time was affirmatively stated on the scraped pages.

name: Prudential Center
rideshareDropoff: On the corner of Mulberry St. and Clinton St., east of Citizens Tower.
bagPolicyNotes: Bags larger than 14 by 12 by 6 inches, backpacks of any size, large duffel bags, coolers and hard sided bags are prohibited. Smaller bags must pass hand-screening or x-ray screening at entry gates. Parenting bags and medically necessary bags may be exempted from size requirements but must be x-ray screened. Dedicated x-ray screening lines are available at three main entry gates. A secure locker truck is available outside the venue to store oversized bags and prohibited items.

bagPolicyNotes: Q2 Stadium prohibits all bags, backpacks, and other carriers, including clear bags. After security screening, exemptions are considered for: clutch-size purses or bags equal to or smaller than the size of your hand (approximately 8 in x 5 in x 1 in), medical bags, childcare bags (e.g. diaper bags) when accompanied by a child, and cultural bags. Bag check lockers are available for a fee ($10) on a first-come, first-serve basis at the Northwest and Southwest Gates; they open 45 minutes prior to gates and remain open for one hour after the event.
venueAccessRestrictions: Q2 Stadium is a cashless facility; all transactions are cashless. To exchange cash for ATXFC Cash, visit the Guest Services Center on the Main Concourse (100) behind Section 124.
outsideFoodRules: Empty 30-ounce or smaller reusable drink vessels are allowed into the stadium. YETI water stations are located in the Southeast and Northwest corners plus other stations throughout the venue.
food: Concessions are operated by 512 Food Co. Club menus are available in the Lexus Club, East Club, and Q2 Stadium Field Club. The Beer Hall is located on the 200 Level at the stadium's north end. Mobile ordering lets guests order food, beverage, or merchandise from their seat.

tailgating.rules: Tailgate only directly behind your own vehicle within one 10'x24' space; no saving spaces; do not block other spots, walkways, or aisles with tents, trailers, chairs, coolers, or barbeques; tents over 10'x10' need prior approval/permit and cannot be combined; kegs and large vessels prohibited; amplified sound prohibited; drive lanes kept clear

tailgating.grillRules: Barbeques permitted but must not block other spots, walkways, or aisles
tailgating.rvPolicy: Campers/RVs over 24 ft or buses park in GEICO Lot for Bucs games (Lot 8 for other events); campers under 24 ft may park in season-pass lots (with pass) or general lots; overnight parking prohibited

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Aerosol or spray bottles of sunscreen, Any item that could be used as a missile, Backpacks, duffel bags or large bags, Bags not approved in accordance with the clear bag policy, Cameras longer than 12 inches (includes body, lens and filter) — policies may vary per event, Camera bags or binocular cases, Cans or bottles, Coolers, Fanny packs, Fireworks, Food or drinks, Glass, Horns, lasers, or artificial noisemakers, Illegal drugs, Pets (except trained service animals per ADA; emotional support animals not permitted), Recreational balls, Seat cushions, Smoking or tobacco products (including e-cigarettes and vaporizers), Sticks, poles, camera or "selfie" sticks, gimbals or extenders, Strollers; Umbrellas; Video cameras or GoPros; Weapons, Unmanned aircraft systems & drones (strictly prohibited on stadium property).
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and drinks, cans/bottles, glass, and coolers are prohibited inside the stadium
food: Cashless concessions throughout; locally sourced chef-driven menu, Tampa Bay Chef Series, and in-seat delivery (Bucs Drop) for Hyundai/Stadium Club guests; specials include $6 domestic beer cans and $20 gameday combo

gatesOpen.ruleText: Main stadium gates open 1.5 hours before kickoff; Stadium Club gates open 2.5 hours before; parking lots open 3.5 hours before kickoff

publicTransit.notes: From NY Penn Station to Newark Penn Station, take the NJ Transit Northeast Corridor Line or North Jersey Coast Line. From NY Penn Station to Newark Broad Street, take the Montclair-Boonton Line or Morris & Essex Line. PATH also serves the area. The club notes there is no shuttle service.

rideshareDropoff: For Rideshare, Uber, or Lyft, direct the driver to follow signs for VIP/Valet Parking toward Pete Higgins Blvd; drop-off is nearest the Toyota Gate. For pickup, riders are directed over the Jackson Street Bridge or north up Frank E. Rodgers Blvd near the 280 Overpass.
accessibility: Accessible seating options are available in all price categories and various locations, including Club Seats and Suites. Accessible parking, mobility assistance, and closed captioning information are covered on the Guests with Disabilities (ADA) page. A TTY/Hearing Impaired line is available at 973.482.8908.
bagPolicyNotes: Bags sized 14 by 14 by 6 inches or smaller are permitted. Backpacks of any kind or bags larger than 14 by 14 by 6 inches are not permitted. Medical and Baby bags are an exception but are subject to an X-Ray search located at Gate B1. A limited number of secure bag lockers are available for rent for $5, located next to Gate B1.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is not permitted in the Harrison Public Parking lots.

venueAccessRestrictions: Exit and reentry to the stadium is prohibited. All guests are subject to a contactless screening through a walkthrough magnetometer upon entry, and all bags and vehicles parking on stadium property are subject to search; refusal may be grounds to deny admission. No firearms or weapons of any kind are permitted, including for off-duty or retired law enforcement or military personnel.
outsideFoodRules: No outside food or beverages will be permitted.
food: There are nine concession stands located on the concourse atop the 100 Level and one concession stand on the 200 Level of the East Side of the building. Concessions open on matchdays may vary due to attendance.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates open at least 60 minutes prior to the start of the match for General Admission. VIP Entries typically open 90 minutes prior to the announced event time.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Non-MLS matches may have different entry times.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Medical and Baby bags are an exception to the 14 by 14 by 6 inch bag limit but are subject to an X-Ray search located at Gate B1.

parkingLots.notes: Rogers Centre parking zone associated with Gate 3 (Star/Green Zone in Parking); Gate 3 elevator serves Stall 164.

parkingLots.name: Cloud Zone (Blue)
parkingLots.notes: Rogers Centre parking zone associated with Gate 7 (Cloud/Blue Zone in Parking); Gate 7 elevator serves Stall 266. Entry from parking level via Cloud/Blue Zone elevators is fully accessible only through the Loading Dock area.

parkingLots.notes: Rogers Centre parking zone associated with Gate 9 (Sun/Orange Zone in Parking); Gate 9 elevator serves Stall 249.

parkingLots.name: Moon Zone (Yellow)
parkingLots.notes: Rogers Centre parking zone associated with Gate 13 (Moon/Yellow Zone in Parking); Gate 13 elevator serves Stall 210.

publicTransit.notes: Rogers Centre is in downtown Toronto and is accessible on foot, by personal vehicle via major highways (e.g. Highway 407 ETR), by bike, or by public transit including TTC, GO Train, Via Rail, and UP Express.

accessibility: Designated accessible entrance is Gate 7 (south side of the building, close to Bremner Boulevard); elevators are also available at Gates 3, 9 and 13 (eight elevators total). A limited number of accessible parking spaces are available by reservation (416-341-1000; sales end 5:00 p.m. the day prior). Two accessible drop-off/pick-up zones: Gate 7 on Bremner Blvd and Gate 13 at the Marriott City Centre Hotel roundabout off Blue Jays Way. Rogers Centre is Sensory Inclusive Certified by KultureCity with sensory bags at Fan Services and a Sensory Room at Section 212. Wheelchair escorts (but no wheelchair rentals) are available at Gate 7. Fans with standard tickets needing accessible seating must exchange prior to arriving.
bagPolicyNotes: Bags are discouraged and will be subject to a security search prior to entry. Only bags smaller than 16" x 16" x 8" are permitted into the ballpark; large handbags/knapsacks exceeding those dimensions are prohibited. Bag restrictions and prohibited items for concerts may differ from Blue Jays games.
venueAccessRestrictions: All workers and guests are subject to a security inspection upon entry at all gates. Prohibited items include: stools or folding/collapsible chairs; bags exceeding 16" x 16" x 8"; hard-sided coolers; cameras with detachable lenses and/or larger than 3"; alcohol, illegal drugs and noxious substances; sticks (including signs on a stick), golf ball retrievers, brooms; selfie-sticks and retractable poles; laser pointers; pressurized air horns or noisemakers; glass bottles and stainless steel water bottles (e.g. Hydroflasks); plastic bottles or cans larger than 600ml; frisbees, beach balls and inflatables including helium balloons; firearms, weapons, knives and pocket knives; fireworks and incendiary devices; squirt guns; umbrellas larger than 12 inches; full/costume face masks that conceal a person's face; oversized costumes and mascot apparel; and any animal except documented Service Animals.
outsideFoodRules: Fans may bring outside food as long as items are wrapped, bagged, or in a container to avoid spillage; food containers must comply with the bag policy (soft-sided and small enough to fit under the seat). Plastic bottles or cans holding 600ml or less of non-alcoholic beverages are permitted; glass or metal bottles are not permitted. Outside alcohol is strictly prohibited. Fans will be asked to remove tops from bottles or open cans prior to entry.
food: Concessions are available throughout the ballpark with mobile ordering for pickup at 6 concession locations, and the Outfield District offers differentiated food and beverage experiences by neighbourhood; dietary-need options are available. Rogers Centre is cashless-payment only.

parkingLots.name: ICE District Central Parkade
parkingLots.notes: Located on the north side of 103 Ave just west of 103 St with 6'10" (2.08 m) clearance and quick indoor access to Rogers Place via the P1 elevator or through the Stantec Tower Level Two pedway.

rideshareDropoff: Vehicles for Hire drop-off and pick-up are located in the designated area north of Rogers Place on 102 St north of 105 Ave.

parkingLots.notes: UCLA Football Fan Zone located here, just outside Gates A & B along Rosemont Ave and Arroyo Blvd

publicTransit.notes: Take the Metro A Line and exit at Memorial Park Station in Pasadena; from there walk approximately 2.4 miles to the stadium or purchase a Rose Bowl Shuttle pass. Metrolink trains arrive into Union Station where passengers transfer to the Metro A Line.
lines: Metro A Line (exit at Memorial Park Station, Pasadena)
Metrolink (arrives Union Station; transfer to Metro A Line)

rideshareDropoff: Rideshare is not allowed at the Rose Bowl Stadium during UCLA Football games. Guests may take rideshare to the Parsons shuttle lot in Old Town Pasadena and ride the shuttle to and from the stadium.
accessibility: Accessible seating available (order online in Row 28 or call (310) 825-2946); standard-seat ticket holders may exchange for accessible seats on game day at the Customer Service Window outside Gate B or inside at Tunnel 28. Assistive listening devices available at the Rose Bowl Administration Office at Tunnel 28. Wheelchair assistance available inside the stadium via guest services (not provided outside the gates). See rosebowlstadium.com/plan-your-visit/accessible-services.
bagPolicyNotes: Approved: 12" x 6" x 12" Clear Plastic Bag; 1 Gallon Plastic Freezer Bag; Clutch with Shoulder Strap or Clutch with Wrist Strap (clutch may not be larger than 4.5" X 6.5"); Diaper Bag, as long as accompanied by a child. Non-Approved: Backpacks, Camera Case, Mesh Bag, Purse, Tinted Plastic Bag, Oversized Tote Bag, Printed Pattern Plastic Bag, Fanny Pack, Binoculars Case. Fans can check non-compliant bags at complementary bag checks located outside the Fan Zone at Gate A and Gate D. Any medically necessary items or equipment not able to fit within the bag policy requirements should be taken for screening to the Public Safety Building, located between Gates A and B.

tailgating.rules: No in-and-out privileges for vehicles. Parking is first come, first served; no saving of spaces (groups should caravan in together). Guests must tailgate only in front of or behind their vehicle. Tents 10'x10' or smaller may be pitched in front of or behind the vehicle, and tent setup is only allowed in grass lots. Roadways, aisles and parking areas must be kept clear for vehicles and emergency personnel. No selling of items or soliciting/marketing. No box trucks, trailers, grill-in-tow, or outside catering services in parking lots. No glass containers. No consumption of alcohol in tailgating areas after kickoff. No drinking games or alcohol-related paraphernalia (e.g., beer bongs, beer pong). No amplified music and no music with inappropriate language. Report problems by texting (626) 400-5119.
tailgating.timeWindow: All parking lots open 6 hours prior to game time and close 90 minutes following the conclusion of the game.
tailgating.grillRules: No open flames permitted in any tailgate or parking area. No charcoal grills in the RV parking area (West Drive). All barbecue grills must be raised off the ground. Dispose of charcoal in designated bins. Charcoal grills are permitted in most tailgate areas.
tailgating.rvPolicy: RV / oversized-vehicle parking is located on West Drive and all RV/oversized vehicles must enter from the west side of the bowl; RV parking is $128 in advance and $154 day of. No overnight RV parking is available.

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Animals, Bags that violate the Bag Policy (See Bag Policy), Balls, toys or sports equipment, Banners, signs, flags, poles or sticks, Beverage Containers larger than 32 oz./1 liter (factory-sealed plastic bottles and empty reusable bottes are allowed; limit 2 per person), Boxes or wrapped packages, Cans, glass bottles or alcoholic beverages, Coolers, Drones, Helium balloons, Laser pointers, Noisemakers including thunder sticks, musical instruments, whistles, air horns and boom boxes, Outside Food (only for non-UCLA games), Skates, skateboards, hoverboards, scooters or bicycles, Stadium seat cushion with metal frame, Umbrellas, Unauthorized cameras with lenses longer than 3.5 inches, interchangeable or telephoto lenses, Unauthorized video cameras, monopods, tripods or selfie sticks, Weapons or projectiles. There is no re-entry allowed at the Rose Bowl Stadium. Once you exit the stadium, you may not re-enter.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food is prohibited only for non-UCLA games; it is permitted at UCLA football games. Coolers are prohibited.
food: Levy Restaurants operates concession stands throughout the Rose Bowl on the spectator concourse; beer, wine, and seltzers are available for purchase at UCLA Football games. Hawkers vend beverages in the seating areas. All concession stands are cashless (use a reverse ATM to obtain a debit card).

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates open 90 minutes prior to the announced kickoff time.

tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: All parking lots open 6 hours prior to kickoff and close 90 minutes after the game. The UCLA Football Fan Zone (Lot H) is open to all fans 4 hours and 15 minutes prior to kickoff and closes 15 minutes before kickoff.

name: Ross–Ade Stadium

parkingLots.name: RV1
parkingLots.notes: John Purdue Club members only; 5th wheels not permitted (redirected to RV2/RV4); requires additional parking pass for attached car

parkingLots.name: RV2
parkingLots.notes: Available for season passes or day-of-game via credit card; $100 presale / $120 day-of; parking pass includes attached car

parkingLots.name: RV3
parkingLots.notes: John Purdue Club members only; 5th wheels not permitted (redirected to RV2/RV4); requires additional parking pass for attached car

parkingLots.name: RV4
parkingLots.notes: Available day-of-game via credit card; $100 presale / $120 day-of; parking pass includes attached car

publicTransit.notes: Purdue Athletics operates a complimentary gameday shuttle service near the RV2, RV3 and RV4 lots, beginning three hours prior to game time and ending approximately one hour postgame; ADA lots have an ADA-accessible shuttle bus. See shuttle map at purduesports.com/fb-shuttles.

accessibility: Gates A, GG, and EE are General Public ADA entrances. Only restrooms on the exterior side of the concourse are ADA accessible. Fans requiring special assistance should arrange ticketing through the Hayes Family Athletics Ticket Office (765.494.3194 / 800.49.SPORT). ADA lots have an ADA-accessible shuttle bus. Family restrooms are located by Sections 102, 108, 111, 119, 125 and near Gates EE and GG; a nursing pod is on the concourse near Section 126. A KultureCity sensory quiet zone is near Section 125/Pavilion Lobby, with sensory bags available at Guest Services.
bagPolicyNotes: Also permissible is one small clutch bag (no larger than 4.5 inches by 6.5 inches) - approximately the size of a hand - with or without a handle or strap. Exceptions will be made for ticket holders with medically necessary items and/or diaper bags (with a child/children present).

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is permitted directly behind your vehicle and cannot occupy an additional parking space or impede traffic flow within the lot. Saving spaces is not permitted; parking is first-come, first-served, one spot per vehicle. Glass containers, kegs, and fireworks are prohibited. Stand-alone/excessively loud/amplified speakers, live bands, and DJs are prohibited. Drones/remote-controlled equipment are prohibited on campus. Golf carts, mopeds, scooters, ATVs, and hoverboards are not permitted. Recreational fires are allowed only in a commercially manufactured portable outdoor fireplace with a screen, not within 25 feet of a structure, constantly attended.
tailgating.timeWindow: Lots open eight (8) hours prior to kickoff but not earlier than 8 a.m. (subject to change on weekday/Friday games); lots close two (2) hours after the game or midnight, whichever comes first.
tailgating.grillRules: Only propane grills may be used; charcoal grills and deep fryers are prohibited on University property. Maximum accepted propane cylinder size is 20 lbs. Grilling in parking structures is prohibited. Wood-burning/charcoal fires are not permitted in golf course lots.
tailgating.rvPolicy: RV lots are RV1-RV4 (RV1/RV3 are for John Purdue Club members; RV2/RV4 are available to the public). All RV lots open at 6 p.m. the day prior to a home game; RVs may not stage before then, and all RVs must be removed by 10 a.m. the day after the game. Each RV must be confined to one space; 5th wheels must detach the tow vehicle after parking. Tent camping or camping in tow vehicles/pickups is prohibited. Vehicles that will not fit inside a 9'x20' parking space are relocated to RV2 or RV4.

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Weapons, Alcoholic beverages, Tobacco products and E-cigarettes, Umbrellas, Strollers, Noisemakers and irritants, Camera lenses longer than 6 inches, Backpacks, binocular cases, camera bags, diaper bags, drawstring bags, fanny packs, oversized totes, purses, Seat backs and seat cushions with metal or storage slots, Objects that interfere with the comfort or block the view of other patrons, Cans, Glass bottles, Food, Drinks, cups or coolers, Shakers or strobe lights, Large Signs, Flags or Banners, Pets (except registered service animals). Guests are NOT permitted to re-enter Ross-Ade Stadium once they leave. Guests are subject to visual inspection of person, parcel, bags and clothing capable of concealing prohibited items. Guests may refuse inspections but management reserves the right to refuse entry.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food, drinks, cups, cans, coolers, and glass bottles are prohibited items. For outdoor athletic events only, one sealed, disposable water bottle 20 ounces in size or less is permitted to enter the stadium.
food: Concession stands managed by Boilermaker Hospitality offer a wide variety of options. The stadium is cashless: concessions and merchandise stands do not accept cash (credit cards only), and alcohol sales end at the end of the third quarter.

gatesOpen.ruleText: All Entry Gates Open to the Public: General fans can enter Ross-Ade stadium as early as 1 hour and 30 minutes before kickoff.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: The Pavilion opens 120 minutes before kickoff; Gate B (Ross-Ade Brigade only) opens 105 minutes before kickoff; all other gates open 90 minutes before kickoff.
tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Lots open eight (8) hours prior to kickoff but not earlier than 8 a.m. (subject to change on Friday games); lots close two (2) hours after the game or midnight, whichever comes first.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Exceptions to the clear-bag requirement: a 1-gallon clear Ziploc bag or a non-clear clutch purse no larger than 4.5"x6.5" is allowed; medically necessary bags marked with a medical bag tag may enter through gates A, EE, GG, and the Pavilion.

parkingLots.notes: Public disability parking (currently a waitlist); no shuttle service due to proximity, but courtesy golf cart shuttles run from the northwest corner of the deck to the southeast corner of Bryant-Denny Stadium from 3 hours before kickoff to 30 minutes postgame

parkingLots.notes: East campus parking area serviced by the free Crimson Ride shuttle to the Quad

parkingLots.notes: East campus parking area serviced by the free Crimson Ride shuttle

parkingLots.notes: Parking lots along Peter Bryce Blvd serviced by the free Crimson Ride shuttle; reserved on-campus lots open at 7 a.m. on game days

publicTransit.notes: Free Crimson Ride shuttle service to the Quad begins at 6 a.m. (11 a.m. kickoff only) on game days and concludes 1.5 hours postgame, servicing east campus parking areas (East Campus RV lot, Lot A, Peter Bryce Blvd lots). Off-campus shuttles run from downtown, University Mall and Birmingham (uagameday.com/shuttles).

rideshareDropoff: Rideshare (Uber, Lyft, Joyride, etc.) pickup and drop-off locations are listed under "Rideshare" at uagameday.com/parking.
accessibility: Accessible seating in Lower East Sideline (Section ADA-E), Upper North End Zone (NN-1–NN-14), Upper South End Zone (SS-1–SS-14) and Upper East Sideline (U4-BB–U4-RR). Accessible security checkpoints outside Gates 7, 30, 39, 45 and 60. Public elevators at Gates 28, 41 and 55 (priority to guests with disabilities/mobility challenges); lower level accessed by internal ramps. Complimentary wheelchair escorts (call 205-348-3703 or First Aid at Section N inside Gate 13). ADA parking in the Tutwiler Parking Deck; ADA ticket exchange at East Will Call near Gate 44. Closed captioning above videoboards in the NW/SE corners; family restrooms and nursing stations on lower and upper levels.
bagPolicyNotes: Small clutch bags that are 4.5" x 6.5" or smaller with or without a handle or strap, may be carried into the stadium along with one of the clear bag options.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is permitted in the Quad, on campus, and in parking lots; the clear bag policy does not restrict tailgating. Both reserved and free tailgating are offered; rules and regulations are posted at uagameday.com/tailgating.
tailgating.rvPolicy: An East Campus RV lot is available and is serviced by the free Crimson Ride shuttle to the Quad.

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Animals (service animals are permitted), Artificial noisemakers (bells, horns, whistles, cow bells, etc.), Banners/Flags/Signs commercial, political, or offensive in nature, Cameras with telephoto lenses over 6" long, Cans/glass bottles (empty plastic/metallic cups or bottles are permitted), Seat backs larger than a single seat (16" wide), Clear bags over 12" x 6" x 12" & Non-clear bags over 4 1/2" x 6 1/2", including coolers, Outside food and/or drink, including alcohol (Exceptions will be made for those with medical requirements and/or special needs.), Large electronics, Selfie Sticks/Tripods/Poles, Strollers/Carseats/Non-ADA compliant mobility devices, Umbrellas, Weapons and firearms &/or any other item deemed dangerous, unnecessary, inappropriate or suspicious in nature. once admitted to the stadium, no ticket holder shall be permitted to leave and re-enter the facility on that ticket. All guests will be subject to security screening prior to entry inside Saban Field at Bryant-Denny Stadium along with inspection of all approved clear bags and carry-in items. Security staff will utilize walk-through magnetometers, handheld metal detectors and/or a physical pat-down to screen all guests at security checkpoints.
outsideFoodRules: Food and drink are not allowed to be brought into the stadium; fans should leave items in their vehicle or dispose of them at the security checkpoint. Empty, non-glass bottles/cups are permitted (refillable at water stations). Exceptions are made for approved medically necessary snack items.
food: Levy Restaurants is the concessionaire for Saban Field at Bryant-Denny Stadium, which is a cashless facility. Gluten-free options (nachos, chips, fries, wings, popcorn, frozen lemonade, Dippin' Dots) and vegetarian/vegan options are offered. Alcohol is sold inside the stadium (alcoholic beverages may not be carried out). Concession stands and retail accept MasterCard, Visa, American Express and Discover.

gatesOpen.ruleText: All gates open 2 hours before kickoff.

name: Sutter Health Park

parkingLots.name: VIP Green Lot
parkingLots.notes: Premium paved surface lot; entrance on 5th Street. Available only for Athletics Season Ticket Member season pass pre-purchase. Primary ADA parking.

parkingLots.name: Gold Lot
parkingLots.notes: Gravel surface lot; entrance at Ballpark Drive and Riverfront Street. Available only for Athletics Season Ticket Member season pass pre-purchase.

parkingLots.name: Main Lot
parkingLots.notes: Large gravel surface lot with multiple entrances off 5th Street and Riverfront Street. Available for STM season pass, single-game pre-purchase, and day-of-game purchase (subject to availability). Overflow ADA parking.

parkingLots.name: Black Lot
parkingLots.notes: Dirt lot; entrance from 5th Street. Available for single-game pass pre-purchase and day-of-game purchase, subject to availability.

parkingLots.name: Ziggurat Garage
parkingLots.notes: Garage; entrance on 3rd Street. Available for single-game pre-purchase and day-of-game purchase. Opens 2 hours prior and closes 60 minutes after the event.

publicTransit.notes: Yolo County Yolobus stops near the ballpark; SacRT light rail into downtown Sacramento; Capitol Corridor train between the Bay Area and Sacramento, and Gold Runner train through the Central Valley to Sacramento.

rideshareDropoff: Rideshare drop-off and pick-up are at the Rideshare Zone at 7th Street and Cabaldon Parkway, west of Sutter Health Park.
accessibility: The ballpark meets all ADA structural and service requirements. A drop-off zone is located at 7th Street and Cabaldon Parkway. Limited on-site disabled parking (valid ADA placard required) is in the VIP Green Lot (primary) and Main Lot (overflow), first-come first-served. Wheelchair and companion seating is offered on every level, every section is wheelchair-accessible, and an elevator is located at Section 112. Guest Services Escorts meet guests at the drop-off area.
bagPolicyNotes: All bags must adhere to the ballpark's Clear Bag Policy and are subject to search upon entry and within the ballpark. Guests are asked to place all belongings in a clear plastic bag. Clear bags are permitted, and non-clear diaper bags are permitted subject to search.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is permitted in parking lots as long as it is confined to your parking space and does not interfere with parking procedures. Per West Sacramento City Ordinance, guests may not consume alcohol or possess an open container of alcohol in the lots or in vehicles. Tailgating is not allowed in non-Sutter Health Park Preferred Lots, and policies may vary by event.

venueAccessRestrictions: Guests are subject to metal-detection screening at entry and must allow bag searches. Re-entry to the ballpark is not permitted. Weapons are prohibited and no weapon lockers/checking are provided. A full prohibited-items list is on the ballpark security page.
outsideFoodRules: No outside food or beverage is permitted, with the exception of reasonably sized bags of peanuts and/or sunflower seeds. Permitted beverage exceptions include unopened soft-sided containers such as water, small milk cartons, juice boxes/pouches, baby formula/bottles/baby food, and medications; empty reusable beverage containers are also permitted.
food: Legends Hospitality manages all concession stands, featuring traditional ballpark favorites plus unique local options with gluten-free and vegan items marked, along with a varied selection of local microbrew, import, and domestic beer (alcohol sold until the first pitch of the eighth inning).

gatesOpen.ruleText: General Ballpark Gates open 1.5 hours prior to game time (2 hours prior for Season Ticket Members). Gate times are subject to change.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Gates open 2 hours prior to game time for Season Ticket Members; Premium Seating ticket holders may enter through the premium entrance to the left of the box office.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Non-clear diaper bags are permitted and subject to search; medications and baby formula/bottles/baby food are permitted.

bagPolicyNotes: Bags of 5 inches by 9 inches by 2 inches or smaller are recommended to expedite entry. Bags larger than 5 by 9 by 2 inches are subject to X-Ray inspection and result in longer wait times. Bags larger than 20 by 14 by 11 inches are not permitted. Bag check and onsite storage lockers are no longer available.

accessibility: UVA provides accommodations for guests with disabilities at all athletics facilities. Accessible seating (wheelchair spaces + companion seats) is at the top of the lower bowl and bottom of the upper bowl in rows WC. ADA elevators accessing all floors are in the South endzone. Advance ADA tickets via (434) 924-UVA1 or uvatickets@virginia.edu; on game day, available ADA tickets can be purchased beginning 2 hours before kickoff at the East and West Ticket Services windows. All free game-day parking lots offer ADA-accessible parking and ADA-accessible shuttles. Visually impaired fans can access a delay-free audio stream via the AudioFetch app on UVA Wireless-ADA
bagPolicyNotes: Small clutch bags/wallets no larger than 4.5″ x 6.5″ (with or without a handle or strap) can be taken into the stadium or arena and will be subject to search. An exception will be made for items necessary for medical reasons after proper inspections at a gate designated for this purpose. Prohibited bags include, but are not limited to: purses, wallets or clutches larger than 4.5″ x 6.5″, coolers, briefcases, backpacks, fanny packs, cinch bags, diaper bags, luggage of any kind, computer bags and camera bags or any bag larger than the permissible size. Seat cushions and seat backs are permitted as long as they are not in a carrying bag.

tailgating.rules: Fans asked not to block traffic lanes within parking lots so an unobstructed emergency path remains; tailgate setups not in the grass/pavement/mulch area must remain within the immediate footprint of the vehicle, allowing traffic flow through the middle lane at all times. In the free lots (JPJ Arena, North Grounds, Fontaine Research Park) fans asked not to take up multiple spaces (free parking reduced for 2025 due to construction). Premium full-service tailgate packages available via REVELXP on the green space next to Observatory Hill Dining Hall (525 McCormick Rd)
tailgating.grillRules: Propane grills permitted; charcoal grills are not allowed; grilling of any kind is not allowed in or on any parking garage

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Artificial noisemakers, Balls, Frisbees, lacrosse sticks, and similar items, Containers (including plastic or glass bottles, cups, cans, coolers, or flasks), Outside Food and Beverages, Strollers (except umbrella strollers), Umbrellas, Weapons of any kind, including those carried with a permit, as defined in SEC-030: Regulations of Weapons, Fireworks and Explosives, Folding Chairs, Drones or unmanned aircraft systems, Animals (with the exception of trained service animals on leashes for our guests with disabilities). Screening procedures will be in use at all entry gates. Walk-through and hand wand metal detectors will be the primary means of screening. For guests who are unable to utilize a walk-through metal detector for medical reasons, hand-held metal detectors will be used. Any person who does not consent to screening will be denied entry into the stadium.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverages (including empty bottles) are prohibited. Containers of any kind — plastic or glass bottles, cups, cans, coolers, flasks — are prohibited. Outside alcoholic beverages/containers are not permitted
food: Cashless venue (card only). Concession stands include UVA Classics (hot dogs, nachos, pretzels, popcorn, peanuts), 'Hoos Homestand, BBQ Alley (BBQ/brisket/andouille), Papa Johns pizza, Hamburger House (burgers, chicken fingers, fries), Eat Drink Taco, Eat Drink Nacho, Wahoo Water (Celsius, bubly), and a free-refill Refill Station. Alcohol available for 21+ at all regular stands plus dedicated alcohol-only locations and East/West concourse wine bars; limit two drinks per transaction

publicTransit.notes: Quickbus is Shuttle-UM's free service that transports you from your parking lot or the College Park Metro Station to Maryland Stadium. Quickbus operates from three hours prior to kickoff until one hour after the final whistle. All loops drop off and pick up at Cumberland Hall circle, which is a 7-minute (0.3 mile) walk to the stadium, and buses are available at this location during the game and after the game for your return trip. Buses on each loop are a mixture of ADA accessible and non-ADA accessible vehicles; paratransit service is offered to accommodate all guests.

accessibility: SECU Stadium is designed with accessible parking, restrooms, concessions, water fountains, ATMs, closed captioning and seating for guests with disabilities. Accessible seating is available at five locations: top of Section 2 (Concourse/1st level, visiting-team section), top of Section 9 (Concourse level, students only), top of Section 28 (Concourse level), the aisle between rows H and S on the Club (2nd) level, and the aisle between rows F and G on the View (3rd) level; each location permits one companion. All entrances except Gate A are accessible. The most convenient accessible parking is the Stadium Drive Garage adjacent to the stadium; on game day, non-permit accessible parking is first-come, first-served and requires a valid state-issued accessible tag. Elevator between all three levels is behind Section 6 on the north side; ramps are inside Gates E and B.
bagPolicyNotes: Only clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12" x 6" x 12", a one-gallon clear plastic freezer bag, or a small clutch bag measuring 4.5" x 6.5" are allowed, all subject to search. All other bags will not be permitted, including purses, backpacks, drawstring bags that are not clear, briefcases, coolers, fanny packs, luggage, computer bags, camera bags, binocular cases and diaper bags. Diaper bags are allowed only in those same sizes and styles.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is limited to the number of parking spaces for which one has a permit, and parking permits must be displayed at all times. Individuals not complying are subject to a fine from the Department of Transportation Services and/or revocation of Terrapin Club parking privileges. Tailgate restrooms are available at Ludwig, XFINITY and portable locations throughout the parking lots.
tailgating.timeWindow: All parking lots open six (6) hours prior to kickoff.
tailgating.grillRules: You may not grill with an open flame when tailgating in parking garages.
tailgating.rvPolicy: Parking on campus for buses and RVs on football game days is no longer available. Alternate RV/bus parking is at Cherry Hill Park, about 10 minutes from campus (unaffiliated with the University; reservations required online). Buses can use the bus depot at Regents Drive Garage to drop fans off and stage off campus in Lot V.

venueAccessRestrictions: No re-entry. Guests may not exit and re-enter the stadium using the same ticket. In case of an emergency, a guest may receive a signature on their ticket from a gate supervisor, which will permit re-entry at the same gate.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food or drink of any kind is prohibited; exceptions will be made for those with medical requirements and/or special needs. Glass water bottles, cans and other beverage containers are prohibited, as are full water bottles; empty plastic or metal water bottles are allowed.
food: Concession stands are located throughout all three levels of SECU Stadium and accept MasterCard, Visa, American Express and Discover. Maryland craft and national-brand beers, plus wine and canned cocktails, are sold at stands and kiosks; limit two alcoholic beverages per person per transaction, ID required for anyone appearing under 40, and alcohol sales stop at the end of the third quarter.

publicTransit.notes: The METRORail stops at the north side of Shell Energy Stadium. For public transportation information visit the METRO website (ridemetro.org).

rideshareDropoff: Shell Energy Stadium recommends all rideshare drop-off and pick-up take place at the corner of Walker St. and Hutchins St.
accessibility: Shell Energy Stadium is an inclusive, fan-friendly venue with closed captioning services (via smartphone), a sensory room near Section 220, complimentary wheelchair escorts available at any entry point, and accessible seating available in all areas of the stadium. All restrooms have baby changing stations and are wheelchair accessible. KultureCity sensory bags are available at the Guest Services Office by Section 118. Questions can be emailed to guestservices@houstondynamo.com.
bagPolicyNotes: In accordance with MLS Best Practices and stadium security guidelines, only clear bags measuring 12 in x 12 in x 6 in or smaller are permitted after a thorough security inspection. Camera bags are not allowed into the venue. All glass and metal containers of any kind are prohibited. One empty, clear plastic water bottle 34oz or less is permitted.
venueAccessRestrictions: All entrances have a no re-entry policy during events. Both handheld and walk-through metal detectors are used at all gates and screening is a condition of entry. Shell Energy Stadium is a cashless venue (credit, debit, gift cards, and mobile pay accepted). The venue is completely Tobacco-Free and Smoke-Free.
outsideFoodRules: Guests may not bring outside food or beverage into the stadium. Food or beverages deemed necessary due to a special dietary need, religious requirement, or medical condition may be approved in advance by the Guest Services Department. One empty, clear plastic bottle 34oz or less is permitted. No alcohol may be brought into the stadium.
food: Shell Energy Stadium offers a variety of food and beverage options including a $5 Value Menu at select locations. Value items include cheese nachos, a hot dog, popcorn, bottled water, a 16oz soft drink, and a 12oz beer. The value menu is available for Dynamo and Dash matches as well as Houston Gamblers football games.

gatesOpen.ruleText: For Houston Dynamo FC soccer matches all gates open 90 minutes prior to match start.

lines: NJ Transit Northeast Corridor (New Brunswick Station)
publicTransit.notes: Fans traveling by train via NJ Transit (from NY or Philadelphia) take the Northeast Corridor train to the New Brunswick Station. FREE shuttle service from Downtown New Brunswick departs regularly beginning three hours prior to kick-off from the New Brunswick Train Station Albany Street Bus Stop (next to the taxi cab waiting area) and returns up to three hours after the game.

rideshareDropoff: Rideshare drop-off is located in the back of the Silver Lot; rideshare pick-up is on Allison Road at the Allison Road Classroom Building.
accessibility: ADA parking designated spaces are available in the Scarlet, White and Jersey Mike's Arena Lots for season ticket holders; limited single-game ADA spaces are available in the Jersey Mike's Arena Lots. For more information on ADA parking, call the Rutgers Ticket Office at 866-445-GORU (4678).
bagPolicyNotes: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags approximately 12" x 6" x 12", one-gallon clear plastic bags or similar, and small clutch bags approximately the size of a hand can be taken into athletic venues. Exceptions will be made for medically necessary items after proper inspection. Sticks of all types, including selfie sticks, are strictly prohibited inside the stadium.

tailgating.rules: Parking spaces are limited and tailgating must be confined to a small area around your vehicle. Traffic aisles and parking spaces cannot be blocked at any time. Spectators wishing to park together must enter lots at the same time, displaying matching passes. All stadium parking lots are reserved for those attending the game; if you do not attend, you will be asked to leave at kickoff time. Kegs, beer balls, and tents/canopies larger than 10'x10' are prohibited and are not permitted in the parking lots/adjacent areas at any time. University regulations and state statutes on drug and alcohol consumption are strictly enforced. Please recycle and put all trash in proper receptacles.
tailgating.timeWindow: Parking lots are open five (5) hours prior to kickoff and close at dusk; Johnson Park also opens five hours prior to kickoff.
tailgating.grillRules: Open flames other than approved grills are not permitted. Camp fires/bonfires are prohibited. For safety purposes, charcoal should be discarded in specially marked yellow barrels located throughout the parking lots. No open flame under solar panels.
tailgating.rvPolicy: Gameday parking for oversized vehicles, including RVs and buses, is $100 per game, only at Jersey Mike's Arena, on a first-come, first-served basis; free shuttle bus service to SHI Stadium is provided. RVs and buses are not permitted to park in Johnson Park, and cars in tow are subject to an additional $25 fee.

venueAccessRestrictions: outside food and beverages, bottles, cans, alcoholic beverages, coolers, umbrellas, strollers, noisemaking devices, balloons, laser pointers, pets (with the exception of service dogs), balls, weapons, sticks/poles, containers, fireworks, clothing/costumes deemed inappropriate and any other items deemed dangerous or inappropriate. There is no re-entry into SHI Stadium. No pass outs allowed.
nearby: Near the Jersey Mike's Arena (Livingston campus) RV/overnight parking, amenities within walking distance include restaurants, groceries, and a movie theater; the lot is easily accessible to Rutgers bus transportation to downtown New Brunswick.
outsideFoodRules: Due to Homeland Security guidelines, no outside food and beverage will be permitted into the stadium. An exception will be made for medically necessary items after proper inspection at the Guest Services gates designated for this purpose.
food: Sales at merchandise and concession stands are cashless (credit/debit, Apple Pay/Google Pay); cash-to-card kiosks are available behind sections 104 and 123. 'The Red Zone' behind section 128 (east side) uses Just-Walk-Out technology. The Rutgers Boardwalk on Scarlet Knight Way (opens four hours before kickoff) features food trucks.

publicTransit.notes: The MTS Green Line drops riders right at the stadium entrance. Pre-event Green Line trolleys depart stations starting at 4:14 PM every 15 minutes or better, with additional trips from Downtown San Diego. Post-event trolleys depart Stadium Station starting at 8:37 PM every 15 minutes or better in both directions. MTS increases Green Line frequency for matches. Family Weekend promo: on Saturdays and Sundays up to two kids (12 and under) ride free with a fare-paying adult on all MTS routes.

rideshareDropoff: Rideshare drop-off is available at any part of the stadium; fans are encouraged to arrive early to reduce traffic time. Rideshare pick-up is only in the Purple Lot on the northeast side of the stadium.
accessibility: Snapdragon Stadium is compliant with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). Seven passenger elevators serve all levels and wheelchair lifts are available in sections C-125 and C-131. Assisted Listening Devices are available for free check-out at Guest Services (behind Sections 101, 114, 135 and 328). Adult changing stations and gender-neutral family restrooms are available throughout the stadium. A dedicated Accessibility page is referenced for further information.

tailgating.rules: Parking lots open 3 hours before kickoff. No tailgating is allowed in adjacent parking spots; fans may tailgate in the area directly behind their vehicle provided it does not interrupt traffic flow or cause crowd management issues. Fans can also purchase a Designated Tailgate spot. Only temporary pop-up tents are permitted and nothing may be attached or affixed to the grounds or premises; temporary tents are not permitted in the Green Lot. All fire lanes, drive aisles, sidewalks, and pedestrian walkways must remain clear. No glass bottles or containers are allowed; all drinks must be in plastic or other non-breakable cups or cans. Unauthorized sale of food or beverage is prohibited; fans may bring and prepare food for family and friends only.
tailgating.rvPolicy: Oversized vehicles (exceeding 8.5 feet by 14 feet) are not allowed unless an XL parking pass was purchased. Bus and RV tailgating spots are available in the Orange and Yellow Lots; these spots are limited and should be purchased in advance.
tailgating.grillRules: No charcoal grills permitted.
tailgating.timeWindow: Parking lots open 3 hours before kickoff.

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: large purses, coolers, briefcases, backpacks, luggage of any kind, computer bags, any bag larger than the permissible size.
nearby: San Diego International Airport (SAN) is approximately 5 miles southwest of Snapdragon Stadium.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food is not permitted (stated for certain matches including the SDFC vs. LA Galaxy match). Exceptions are made for those with medical requirements or special needs, and guests with food allergies are permitted to bring food intended for individual consumption after informing staff at the gates. Items needed to care for a baby are allowed under security supervisor discretion and subject to search.
food: Snapdragon Stadium is a cashless facility; concessions accept credit, debit, or gift card only. Reverse ATMs are available at the southeast and northeast entries to load cash onto a prepaid debit card. Alcohol is served at most matches; alcohol sales are not permitted after the 75th minute.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Stadium entry gates will open 2 hours prior to kickoff for all home Aztec Football games.

accessibility: Wheelchair and companion seating on every level (purchase via Ticketmaster); free assistive listening devices, noise-reducing headphones, and Easterseals sensory kits at Guest Services Centers; two sensory-inclusive rooms on Level 3 (NE and SW); service animals (dogs/mini-horses) welcome; event-day assistance via text (424) 541-9222.
bagPolicyNotes: Permitted bags must be completely clear plastic/vinyl/PVC, max 12x6x12 in; also allowed: one-gallon clear freezer bag or a small non-clear clutch max 4.5x6.5 in. NFL events follow the NFL Clear Bag Policy. Oversize bags can be checked at bag valet (NW/NE/SW corners) for a fee.

tailgating.rules: Permitted only in the Hyundai Pink Zone with an advance Pink Zone parking pass; all guests on campus must hold a valid game ticket; no reserved spaces or space-saving; no purchasing extra passes to expand footprint; tents allowed if not encroaching the 12ft fire lane within the 24ft drive aisle; no ground stakes; glass containers, food/beverage sales, and private catering prohibited.
tailgating.timeWindow: Designated Hyundai Pink Zone tailgating areas open 4 hours before kickoff; all tailgating activities cease at kickoff.
tailgating.grillRules: Natural gas and propane grills only; charcoal grills, wood stoves, oil fryers, and open-pit fires prohibited.
tailgating.rvPolicy: NFL games: oversize vehicles (RVs, buses, 16+ seats) park in Hyundai Pink Zone Lot P with a Pink Zone Oversized Vehicle pass; non-NFL events use the Red Zone oversized pass.

venueAccessRestrictions: All guests must have a valid parking pass or be turned away to offsite options; onsite NFL parking inventory is extremely limited; guests must enter via the gate matching their assigned parking zone (passes cannot access other zones); no in-and-out privileges; no street/residential parking permitted.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverages prohibited inside the stadium except medically required items in sealed containers; one factory-sealed water bottle 20 oz or less per person; empty clear/soft-sided reusable water bottles 20 oz or less allowed; hard/soft coolers only in designated tailgate lots during the approved window.
food: Concessions available for purchase in all areas/sections throughout the stadium; hydration/water-refill stations located on Levels 3, 4, 6, and 8 and in premium clubs.

tailgating.rules: Permitted in designated stadium-controlled lots pre-game for ticketed guests; tailgate limited to 8 ft behind each parking space; no tents; prohibited during the game and after night games.
tailgating.timeWindow: Tailgating prohibited during the game and after night games.
tailgating.grillRules: No open flame in enclosed lots (North Garage, lower Waldron Garage); firepits/open fires banned in all lots; no deep fryers or oil-based cooking; no open-flame, infrared or propane heaters; propane tanks over 19 lb not allowed on campus.
tailgating.rvPolicy: No overnight parking in any Museum Campus lot.

venueAccessRestrictions: No re-entry (no re-entry passes issued); cashless venue; taxis, limos and buses barred from entering the campus starting 90 minutes after kickoff until 1 hour after the event ends.

gatesOpen.ruleText: All remaining gates open 90 minutes before kickoff. (Gate 0 opens two hours before kick for fan activations and entertainment.)

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Gate 0 opens two hours before kickoff for fan activations and entertainment; all other gates open 90 minutes before kickoff.

rideshareDropoff: Designated rideshare pick-up and drop-off is on University Drive in front of the University Student Center South, about a 10-minute walk down Cullen Boulevard to Cougar Alley at Gate 1.
accessibility: Stadium is designed with accessible parking, restrooms, concessions and seating. ADA-accessible parking is available in game-day lots and garages for qualified Cougar Pride donors and in UH pay-by-phone lots and garages (game-day rates apply). Elevators serve the 200/300 levels, and all shuttle buses are ADA accessible. Ticket office 713-462-6647.
bagPolicyNotes: At Space City Financial Stadium, permitted bags must be clear plastic, vinyl or PVC. A small clutch purse no larger than 4.5" x 6.5", with or without a handle or strap, is also permitted and is subject to search. An exception will be made for medically necessary items after proper inspection at the gate. Confirm the maximum bag size with the venue before you travel.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is permitted for all University of Houston home football games (see the tailgating policy page). No items may be distributed in or around the stadium, including tailgate areas, without prior UH Athletics/LEARFIELD consent. The Cougar Alley pregame zone is on the east and north end near Gates 1, 2 and 4; Shasta's Kids Zone opens four hours prior to kickoff.
tailgating.grillRules: Grilling of any kind is not allowed in any of the parking garages.
tailgating.rvPolicy: Cougar Pride donor RVs and oversize vehicles tailgate in the Brown Lot (15C) via Holman Street (Directors Circle $6,000+ and above; $1,500 per vehicle, seasonal). Non-donors with oversized vehicles or RVs are directed to the Green Lot at the SE corner of Cullen Blvd and Wheeler Ave; $100 pre-paid or $125 on game day.

venueAccessRestrictions: Re-entry into TDECU Stadium is prohibited. Screening procedures will be in use at all entry gates. Walk-through and hand wand metal detectors will be the primary means of screening. Any person who does not consent to screening will be denied entry into the stadium.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverage is prohibited inside the stadium and glass containers are strictly prohibited.
food: Concession stands and portable carts are located throughout the concourse level and are all cashless. Beer, wine and liquor are sold at select concession and portable stands; alcohol sales conclude at the beginning of the fourth quarter.

accessibility: The ramp in the southwest corner of the stadium is handicap accessible. No ticket holders without suite or Spartan Club tickets will be allowed in the elevator.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is permitted in all public parking areas on campus. Park in designated areas only, dispose of trash properly and follow campus ordinances. MSU's campus is tobacco free; no tobacco products can be used on campus at any time, including game days.
tailgating.timeWindow: All parking locations open at 7 a.m. for games that kick off before 6 p.m., and 11 a.m. for kickoffs at or after 6 p.m.
tailgating.rvPolicy: RV parking ($60) is available at Lot 203 (MSU Pavilion) on a first-come, first-served basis.

venueAccessRestrictions: For security reasons, once you exit the stadium you may not re-enter.
outsideFoodRules: Food of any kind is a prohibited item inside the stadium, as are coolers, thermoses, cups, bottles, cans, flasks and open bottled water. One factory sealed 20-oz. bottled water per person is permitted.
food: Concessions provided by Levy. Spartan Stadium is a cashless venue, including all concessions and the 50-50 raffle. Expanded alcohol availability at most concession stands, portables and bar locations; alcohol sales conclude at the start of the fourth quarter.

accessibility: ADA shuttle service via Dis-GO on game days picks up fans on motorized carts at select locations near the stadium, with a primary drop-off at Gate 4, starting 30 minutes before gates open (carts return to Gate 4 after the game). Stanford Stadium provides wheelchair and companion seating; game-day relocations into ADA seats are limited and first-come, first-served.
bagPolicyNotes: Bag Drop is at Sunken Diamond at the north end of Stanford Stadium near Gate 10; it opens 30 minutes before stadium gates open and stays open until 1 hour after the game ends.

tailgating.rules: Patrons may park and tailgate in any of the designated football parking lots around Stanford Stadium (shaded groves and lawns, including the Chuck Taylor Grove tailgating tradition). Reserved full-service group tailgate packages are available through RevelXP on Maloney Field and Avery Plaza.
tailgating.timeWindow: All parking lots open five (5) hours prior to kickoff, except Lot #2/El Camino Grove which opens at 6:00 AM PT on gameday; Lot #2 overnight pass-holders may arrive at 3:00 PM PT the Thursday before a Saturday home game.

venueAccessRestrictions: All guests are subject to search before being admitted into any athletic event.
food: Concessions inside Stanford Stadium are cashless. Vendors include Chick-fil-A (Sec. 235), Silva Sausage Co. (Sec. 103 & 232), Blue Line Pizza (Sec. 115 & 128), plus Rita's Italian Ice, Kikka Sushi, and Wetzel's Pretzels. Beer, wine, and ready-to-drink cocktails are sold in-venue (ID/wristband required); alcohol sales conclude at the end of the third quarter and cannot leave the stadium.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates to Stanford Stadium open an hour and a half (1.5 hours) before kickoff on Saturday; fans may enter through Gates 2, 4, 5, 10, and 12.

tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Parking lots open five hours prior to kickoff, except Lot #2/El Camino Grove which opens 6:00 AM PT on gameday (Lot #2 overnight pass-holders from 3:00 PM PT the Thursday before a Saturday home game).
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Bag Drop for non-compliant bags is located at Sunken Diamond at the north end of Stanford Stadium near Gate 10; it opens 30 minutes before gates open and remains open until 1 hour after the game concludes.

parkingLots.name: State Farm Drive
parkingLots.notes: The best parking, just steps from the entrance. Under 1-minute walk. 1 State Farm Dr., Atlanta, GA 30303. Reserve via ParkMobile.

parkingLots.name: Diamond Deck
parkingLots.notes: VIP parking with exclusive Player/Artist entrance. Under 1-minute walk. 100 Lower Andrew Young International Dr., Atlanta, GA 30303. Reserve via ParkMobile.

parkingLots.notes: Easy and convenient arena access. Under 3-minute walk. 199 Alabama St. SW, Atlanta, GA 30303. Reserve via ParkMobile.

parkingLots.name: Sapphire Deck
parkingLots.notes: Prime location across the street. Under 5-minute walk. 127 Centennial Olympic Park Dr. NW, Atlanta, GA 30303. Reserve via ParkMobile.

publicTransit.notes: State Farm Arena is easily accessible via MARTA, with a stop just steps from the arena entrance; take the train to the SEC District Station. To leave faster, guests can also use SEC District Station (Blue/Green lines) or Five Points Station (Red/Gold/Blue/Green lines). Fare is $2.50 each way plus a one-time $2 Breeze Card purchase.

rideshareDropoff: Rideshare service is presented by Gentleman Jack / Jack Daniels. After the event, guests open their rideshare app to request a ride.
accessibility: Accessible parking is available in all parking decks (Ruby Lot, Diamond Deck, Sapphire Deck, State Farm Drive) on a first-come, first-serve basis. Many accessible seating options are available in all price ranges; companion seats available with purchase of an accessible seat. Assistive Listening Devices are free at the Guest Service Center inside Gate 1 (ID or credit card held as deposit). Elevators are located inside Gate 4, Gate 5, the North VIP Entrance, and Gate 7. Sign language interpreters available with 30 days advance notice. A Mother's/Nursing Room is inside Gate 1. OneCourt tactile broadcast devices for Blind and Low Vision fans are available at Hawks home games. Sensory Room, sensory bags, and weighted lap pads available via Guest Services. Certified, leashed service animals welcome. Guest Services at 404-878-3000.
bagPolicyNotes: Bags must be 14 in x 14 in x 6 in or smaller. State Farm Arena generally does not enforce a clear bag policy, though specific event organizers may choose to require one (e.g. a clear-bag-only policy was enforced for the Ariana Grande shows on July 6, 8, and 9, 2026); check the specific event listing. Allowed: single-compartment drawstring bags, purses, or fashion backpacks smaller than 14x14x6. Prohibited: all bags larger than 14x14x6 (briefcases, purses, luggage) and backpacks and hard-sided bags of any size. Medical bags and diaper bags accompanying a child are exempt from the size requirement but subject to search. For a fee, guests with non-complying bags can use the Bag Valet by Gate 2 off Centennial Olympic Park Dr., available 1 hour 30 minutes before event start through one hour after the event.
venueAccessRestrictions: Re-entry to the arena is prohibited. State Farm Arena is a cashless environment; card payment is required at all ticket, food and beverage, and retail locations (no cash accepted). All guests must have a valid event ticket; children under two do not need a ticket if sitting in a lap. The arena has seven gates (Gate 6 is not open for Hawks games; Gate 7 is a CLEAR-app entrance).
nearby: State Farm Arena is in the heart of downtown Atlanta's Centennial Park District, a collection of hotels, attractions, and restaurants within walking distance. Several hotel options surround the arena, including the Omni Hotel (accessed via Gate 7, west on Andrew Young International Blvd NW).
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and drinks are not allowed. Fans should leave food or beverage in their vehicle or dispose of it at the security checkpoint. Exceptions: parents with small children may bring plastic bottles of formula or milk into the arena, and approved medically necessary snacks are permitted (call 404-878-3000 for approval).

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates will generally open 60 minutes prior to the event starting. This is subject to change depending on the type of event; an event's door time can be found on the event detail page.
For Hawks games, gates open 60 minutes prior to tip-off. Hawks Members can enter the arena 75 minutes prior to tip-off.

outsideFoodRules: No outside food except for children under 2; one factory-sealed, non-frozen 500 mL (16.9 oz) plain water bottle allowed per guest (no soda, sports drinks, or flavored water); formula/milk permitted for small children
food: Full concessions (cashless venue): beer, wine, and cocktails plus local vendors including Someburros, Barrio Queen, Spinato's Pizzeria, Cold Beers & Cheeseburgers, and Honey Bear's BBQ

publicTransit.notes: Take the SEPTA Wilmington/Newark Regional Rail line to the Chester Transportation Center. A free shuttle runs to Subaru Park every 20 minutes, picking up at the corner of Seaport Drive and Reaney Street (across from Lot D). Additional details in the packet (service beginning four hours prior to game time, Philadelphia Union matches only, show a SEPTA ticket to board, returning shuttles along Seaport Drive on the north side of the stadium) appear on the guide and directions pages rather than the cited transportation page.

accessibility: All public entrances are ADA accessible. ADA parking is in Lot F ($30 tax included per game in 2026, first-come first-serve; state-issued disabled parking ID required). ADA seating is available on all levels (in front of Sections 114, 115, 119, 120, 122, 123, 124, 130, 131, 132 and top of Sections 114 and 120). Three elevators are located behind Section 117, Section 107/108 and Section 122. Family restrooms (accessible, with baby changing tables) are behind Sections 124, 106 and on the Suite Level outside Suites 331 and 313. Personal Care Attendants accommodated; contact Fan Services at 1-877-21-UNION.
bagPolicyNotes: All bags must be clear and smaller than 14 in x 14 in x 6 in to be permitted into Subaru Park. All carry-ins are subject to inspection upon entry. Bags that are not clear, backpacks, briefcases, camera bags, computer bags and luggage of any kind are prohibited. Special considerations will be made for guests with special medical needs and parents caring for infants. Credentialed media enter through designated entrances but all media bags are searched upon entry.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is permitted within two (2) feet of the back bumper of your vehicle. Tailgating in empty stalls is prohibited. Fans may also tailgate on the grass area of Subaru Plaza only (not on the concrete vendor area). Space is very limited as cars are parked next to each other on arrival. A parking permit is valid for one space only; spots cannot be reserved or saved.
tailgating.grillRules: Glass containers and charcoal grills are not permitted in Subaru Park parking lots.
tailgating.rvPolicy: Trailers of any kind are not permitted in Subaru Park lots. Oversized vehicles such as campers or trailers must park in Lot C.
tailgating.timeWindow: On-site lots open 5 hours prior to kickoff.

venueAccessRestrictions: No re-entry: guests may not exit and re-enter the stadium using the same ticket (except in an emergency with a gate supervisor's signature on the ticket stub). Smoking is not allowed at Subaru Park. All guests are security screened via Evolv Express systems and subject to bag search on entry. There are four public entrances: the IBX Gate (northeast), the Subaru Gate (northwest), the Supporter's Gate (southwest), and the Club and Suite Entrance (north side).
outsideFoodRules: Carry-in items are not allowed in the stadium, including food, drinks, cans, glass containers and alcohol. Food and beverage are on the prohibited items list. Fans may bring tailgating items, food and beverage to the grass area of Subaru Plaza, but these are not allowed in the vendor area on the concrete plaza section or inside Subaru Park.
food: There are 15 concession stands and 25 portable carts located throughout the stadium serving a variety of food and drinks.

gatesOpen.ruleText: General Admission gates open one (1) hour prior to Union game time. Clubs & Suites and the Subaru Gate open 90 minutes prior to game time; the Heineken Deck opens 90 minutes prior. Fans can also enter through the Supporters Gate and walk up the staircase behind Section 102.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Subaru Plaza opens 2 hours before kickoff; Clubs & Suites, the Subaru Gate and the Heineken Deck open 90 minutes before; General Admission opens 1 hour before Union game time.
tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: On-site lots open 5 hours prior to kickoff.

parkingLots.notes: Reserved event parking location available for pre-payment. Uber and rideshare drop-off is at the ground level of the NYNY parking garage.

parkingLots.notes: Reserved event parking location available for pre-payment.

rideshareDropoff: Drop-off is at the ground level of the NYNY parking garage. Pick-up is located at the nearest casino property (NYNY or Park MGM).
bagPolicyNotes: Bags do not need to be transparent. Fanny packs, crossbody bags, and clear stadium bags are permitted within size limits. Straps on bags are not part of the measurements. Bag check service is available at Binbox Lockers on Toshiba Plaza for $20 per bag (cashless payment). Bags checked during events are not accessible until after the event, and unclaimed bags are returned to Lost & Found. Artist tours, promoters, and building management reserve the right to change the policy.

name: T-Mobile Park

parkingLots.name: Mariners Parking Garage
parkingLots.notes: Not available for pre-purchase; a limited number of first-come, first-served spots sold on game days. Cashless (debit/credit or mobile payment only). Accommodates vehicles 7' or less in height. Limited day-of-game accessible spaces for vehicles with state-issued disabled plates/permits.

publicTransit.notes: King County Metro offers a variety of accessible services, but no regular-route stops are located adjacent to the ballpark. Metro's ACCESS service and paratransit vans load/unload along the east curb of Occidental Avenue S. next to the parking plaza. More options at Mariners.com/Transportation.

rideshareDropoff: Guests using rideshare services such as Lyft or Uber should use the designated rideshare lot located southeast of the ballpark, a short walk (less than five minutes) from most gates. A taxi stand is at the northwest corner of First Avenue South and South Royal Brougham Way (in front of Silver Cloud Hotel), operating before, during and after events.
accessibility: T-Mobile Park was designed to meet all structural and service requirements of the ADA; all restrooms, ticket windows, drinking fountains and counters at points of service are accessible, and all entrances are accessible. Accessible and companion seating is available at a range of price levels. Elevators and ramps (SEC 114 and 143) reach all levels. Accessible parking is available day-of-game at the Mariners Garage for vehicles with state-issued disabled plates/permits, with ADA drop-off/pick-up areas around the ballpark. Assistive listening devices, wheelchair escorts/storage, sensory room and sensory bags are available. Reasonable-modification requests handled case-by-case via adaservices@mariners.com.
bagPolicyNotes: Clear bags no larger than 12" x 6" x 12" are permitted, as are one-gallon clear plastic zip-top bags; security must be able to see contents to the bottom of the bag and bags that obscure contents are not allowed. Small clutch bags (including fanny packs) no larger than 4.5" x 6.5" are permitted. Backpacks, multi-compartment bags, duffle bags and purses larger than 4.5" x 6.5" are not permitted. Exceptions are made for medically necessary items or single-compartment diaper bags (child must be present). Bags larger than 16" x 16" x 8" are not permitted, and the Mariners do not offer bag/coat storage.
venueAccessRestrictions: All guests entering are screened for prohibited items by walk-through or hand-held metal detector (cell phones, car keys and coins no longer need to be removed). Guests are not permitted to re-enter the ballpark once they leave; in an emergency, re-entry may be granted only by a Shift Captain or Zone Supervisor and re-entrants are subject to security re-inspection. An extensive prohibited-items list applies, including weapons, aerosols, outside alcoholic beverages, aluminum/metal and glass containers, hard-sided and Styrofoam coolers, drones, selfie sticks, laser pointers, luggage/duffle bags and wrapped packages.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food is permitted in single-serving sizes. Sealed, clear plastic water bottles up to 32oz, baby bottles, beverages related to medical needs, and unopened soft-sided single-serve containers like juice boxes are permitted; guests may also bring one empty plastic reusable bottle 32 ounces or smaller. Soda, coffee or other beverages are not allowed, and no outside alcoholic beverages may enter.
food: Concessions include ballpark favorites like hot dogs and pizza, plus limited selections at Ivar's and The Natural featuring gluten-friendly, vegetarian, vegan and plant-based menu items. Beverages include coffee, soda, water, beer, wine and other alcoholic drinks. All concession stands are cashless.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates to the T-Mobile 'Pen, including Center Field Gate and the T-Mobile Member Gate, open 2 hours prior to first pitch. All other gates open 90 minutes prior to first pitch.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: T-Mobile 'Pen gates (Center Field Gate and T-Mobile Member Gate) open 2 hours before first pitch; all other gates open 90 minutes before. Parking-garage skybridge entries (Terrace/Suite Level, Diamond Club, Press Club, Premier Seats, Hit it Here Café) also open 90 minutes prior. Gate times may vary for special events such as Opening Day, promotions, the Postseason and large non-baseball events including concerts.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Exceptions to the bag policy are made for medically necessary items or single-compartment diaper bags (child must be present); per security inspection, the only bag exceptions are small clutch purses (4.5" x 6.5") or single-compartment diaper bags no larger than 16" x 16" x 8".
