parkingLots.notes: Referenced in driving directions to the arena.

parkingLots.name: Mayo Clinic Square Ramp
parkingLots.notes: Skyway-connected to Target Center.

accessibility: Target Center is fully ADA compliant with a drop-off lane on 1st Avenue in front of the building, elevators to all arena levels, designated disability seating, and wheelchair accessibility. The official ADA drop-off and pick-up is on 1st Avenue in front of the building. Guests who require an elevator should park in Ramp A or B and enter on the skyway level. Guest Services near sections 116 and 216 offer assisted listening devices, complimentary ear plugs, a sensory-friendly room and sensory bags, and text-to-assist at 952-592-5520. ASL interpreters and Deaf/Hard-of-Hearing seating (section 106) are available on request at least 10 business days in advance. A limited number of loaner wheelchairs are available on site but cannot be left with the guest; Target Center cannot provide wheelchair transportation outside the arena. Trained service animals are welcome.
bagPolicyNotes: Permitted items include bags no larger than 5 inches x 9 inches, plus diaper bags and medical bags (all subject to search upon entry). Strollers, backpacks, coolers, suitcases, and purses larger than 5 inches x 9 inches are not permitted inside Target Center.
venueAccessRestrictions: No re-entry: if you exit the building during an event you will not be permitted to return for any reason. Target Center is a completely smoke-free facility (including vapes and electronic cigarettes), and guests may not leave to smoke. Security screening may include metal detectors and searches of bags, clothing, and other items. Target Center does not offer an item check.
nearby: Target Center sits in the Warehouse and Entertainment district on the northwest side of downtown Minneapolis, between 6th and 7th Streets. It is connected by skyway to several downtown hotels, hundreds of restaurants and shops, and parking including Ramps A & B and the Mayo Clinic Square Ramp.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverage are not allowed into Target Center. Limited exceptions: foods or juices necessary for medical reasons, and milk or baby formula for infants, are permitted. Limited snacks for children (one small bag snack per child, cardboard juice boxes or foil juice bags) may be allowed on a case-by-case basis, including for school groups, except at specific shows where no outside food is allowed. Guests with a medical need should contact Guest Services at 612-673-1380 in advance.
food: Concessions are operated by Levy Restaurants and include vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options. All concessions, ticketing, and merchandise stands are cashless; concession stands accept Apple Pay and Google Pay.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Doors will open to ticketed guests 60 minutes prior to game start.

tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Diaper bags and medical bags are exempt from the no-bag policy (bags no larger than 5"x9"), subject to search upon entry.

name: Target Field

parkingLots.name: Ramp A
parkingLots.notes: Preferred game day parking with enhanced security. Connects directly to the ballpark by walkway or skyway and to the Minneapolis skyway system. Has accessible parking spaces. Parking is pay-at-entry for events from March 28; spots can also be reserved in advance.

parkingLots.name: Ramp B
parkingLots.notes: Preferred game day parking with enhanced security. Connects directly to the ballpark by walkway or skyway and to the Minneapolis skyway system. Has accessible parking spaces. Parking is pay-at-entry for events from March 28; spots can also be reserved in advance.

parkingLots.notes: Preferred game day parking with enhanced security. Parking is pay-at-entry for events from March 28; spots can also be reserved in advance.

parkingLots.notes: Preferred game day parking with enhanced security, provided with MPLS Parking and the City of Minneapolis for the 2026 season. Parking is pay-at-entry for events from March 28; spots can also be reserved in advance.

publicTransit.notes: The METRO Blue and Green Line light rail lines have accessible stops at Target Field Station, and several Metro Transit bus routes stop within one block of the ballpark. Target Field Station connects to hundreds of trains daily via the METRO Blue and Green lines.

accessibility: Accessible seating is available on all levels and all five gates are wheelchair-accessible. There are nearly 8,000 spaces in the A, B & C Ramps (A and B connect directly to the ballpark via walkway/skyway). Guests with mobility issues may use the Drop-Off Zones along 7th Street near the New Era Team Store and Gate 14 (no accessible-parking permit required). The ballpark offers assistive listening devices, wheelchair service and storage at Guest Service Centers, an electrically height-adjustable adult changing table near the 3rd Base Dugout Lounge, 13 public elevators, captioning ribbon boards, service-animal access, and a UnitedHealthcare Sensory Suite with checkout sensory kits.
bagPolicyNotes: Single-compartment bags (maximum size 16"x16"x8") are allowed, including purses, clutch purses, single-compartment tote bags, clear bags, drawstring bags, diaper bags, single-compartment soft-sided coolers, fanny packs and bags containing medically necessary items. Backpacks, multi-compartment laptop bags, duffel bags, hard-sided coolers, and any bags over the size requirement are not allowed. Prohibited bags may be stored free of charge near Gate 6 and Target Field Station.
venueAccessRestrictions: All gates use Evolv Express walk-through screening (guests keep belongings in pockets and hold approved bags). Prohibited items include ball retrievers, balloons, bats, beach balls, boom boxes, brooms, fireworks, flasks, Frisbees, coolers, inflatables, laser pointers, lawn chairs, noise-making devices, weapons, wooden sticks or rods (small whiskbrooms and small souvenir bats are permitted); aerosols and self-defense sprays may not be carried in but can be stored free at any gate. Firearms are prohibited even with conceal-and-carry permits, and knives with blades longer than 3 inches are prohibited. There is no re-entry once a guest has entered the facility.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food is allowed, but hard-sided containers (Tupperware, hard-sided coolers, Thermos) are not, and no outside food may be brought into any bar, restaurant, or suite area. For beverages, only sealed bottled water 32 oz. or less and soft-sided single juice or milk containers for children are permitted; flavored water and performance beverages (Gatorade, Powerade, etc.) are not. Guests may bring liquids required for legitimate medical purposes.
food: The Twins and Delaware North - Sportservice offer an extensive menu with gluten-free, vegan, and vegetarian options across concessions foul pole to foul pole. Signature venues include Hrbek's pub, the Cutwater Cocktail Bar at Minnie & Paul's (Pizza Luce pizza and Red Cow burgers), Keeper's Heart Town Ball Tavern, Pryes Homeplate Taproom, and Family Value Stands with discounted food and drinks.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Target Field gates open for admittance 1 hour before scheduled first pitch for all Monday-Thursday evening games, 1.5 hours before scheduled first pitch for weekday afternoon games, and 2 hours before scheduled first pitch for all Friday-Sunday games.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Gates open 1 hour before first pitch for Monday-Thursday evening games, 1.5 hours before for weekday afternoon games, and 2 hours before for Friday-Sunday games.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Multi-compartment backpacks used primarily as diaper, child-care, or medical equipment/supply bags are permitted provided they meet the overall 16"x16"x8" size restriction; bags containing medically necessary items are allowed, and guests may bring liquids required for legitimate medical purposes.

name: TD Garden

parkingLots.name: North Station Garage
parkingLots.notes: Located directly underneath TD Garden; open daily from 5:00 AM – 1:00 AM.

publicTransit.notes: Green and Orange Lines: take either line to the North Station stop. Commuter Rail: North Station (TD Garden at the same location). From Back Bay, take the Orange Line to North Station.

rideshareDropoff: Ride share pick-up and drop-off services are located on Merrimac Street from 7 p.m. to 2 a.m daily, beginning May 1, 2025.
bagPolicyNotes: TD Garden strongly discourages guests from bringing bags to events. Small bags, clutches, crossbodies and wristlets are permitted. Bags, including clear bags, should not exceed 6in x 4in x 1.5in. Exceptions will be made for diaper bags, breast pump bags, bags needed for medical purposes, and bags provided at purchase from Boston Proshop powered by ‘47. All permitted bags are subject to visual or x-ray screening upon entry. Oversized bags (over 6x4x1.5in) can now be stored on-site at the new Event Bag Check, located next to the TD Garden and Boston Garden Society Box Office on Level 1, east side of North Station. Bags can be checked at a fee of $15.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Bruins - Member Doors open two hours prior to game time. General doors open one hour prior to game time.

accessibility: Paid ADA parking is available on the first floor of the Nicholson Garage (passes must be purchased in advance). Free ADA parking is located in Lot 406 off Skip Bertman Drive, with shuttles running from the free ADA lot and drop-off near Torchy's off Nicholson Drive. Fans with medical-needs bags/items must enter at Gate 10 or the Southwest Roll Gate.
bagPolicyNotes: Clear & non-clear handheld clutches/wristlets measuring smaller than 4.5” X 6.5” are also permissible. 1-gallon clear plastic freezer bags are permissible following inspection. Exceptions will only be made for those with approved medical needs. Diaper bags that do not meet the clear bag policy guidelines will not be admitted. Camera bags are NOT permitted. Fans cannot store prohibited bags & items near stadium entrances. All unattended items will be removed & discarded.

tailgating.rules: Tents and tailgate set-ups are allowed under the oaks, but trailers and vehicles may not park on the mulch or root zones around the historic oak trees (violators will be asked to move or towed). Tailgating remains permitted at the Old Front Nine Lots.
tailgating.timeWindow: Most reserved parking lots open at 7 a.m. on game day (the Old Front Nine Lot opens at 7 a.m.); most Motor Home/RV lots open at 6 p.m. on the Friday prior to game day.
tailgating.rvPolicy: Most Motor Home/RV lots open at 6 p.m. on the Friday prior to game day. Due to an LSU Housing project in Touchdown Village 2, RVs previously parked there have been relocated to the Alex Box Hall of Fame Lot and Bullpen Lots 408 and 409.

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Animals of any kind except documented service animals, Artificial noise makers, Containers of any kind – coolers, ice chests, bottles, cans, cups, flasks, etc., Food & beverages – brought from outside the stadium gates, Oversized stadium seats (no pockets/zippers/compartments & no wider than 16”), Projectiles of any variety – banners, flags, poles, brooms, etc., Video recording devices & equipment (including stands), Umbrellas, Weapons of any variety – firearms, knives, pocket knives, multi-function tools, etc. All persons and items entering are subject to inspection. All bags are subject to search and inspection.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and containers of any kind (coolers, ice chests, bottles, cans, cups, flasks, etc.) are not permitted. Exception: one factory-sealed water bottle up to 32 ounces / 1 liter is allowed per fan. Fans with a medical need for other items must enter at the medical check points at Gate 10 or the Southwest Roll Gate.
food: Tiger Stadium is a cashless venue with cash-to-card machines located throughout; there are over 20 water re-filling stations inside the stadium.

accessibility: Toyota Stadium meets all ADA requirements. Guests are asked to contact the stadium ahead of time for special accommodations. All ADA seats are located at the top of the seating bowl in sections 105-132, row 31. Guests requiring a medical or childcare bag must enter at the ADA/VIP Gate on the West Side of the stadium (just north of the main West Gate). Diaper changing stations are located in all men's, women's, and family restrooms.
bagPolicyNotes: FC Dallas has instituted a clear bag and purse policy for all ticketed events including concerts. Approved bags: clear plastic bags not exceeding 14 x 6 x 14 inches; small clutches 5.5 x 8.5 inches; small cross body bags 5.5 x 8.5 inches; clear cinch bags smaller than 14 x 16; fanny packs smaller than 14 x 16; one-gallon clear plastic freezer bags. Each guest may enter with one large clear bag or one small clutch. Prohibited: backpacks, briefcases, camera bags, cinch bags, large clutches, computer cases, coolers, luggage, purses, oversized tote/mesh bags, seat cushions with backs, and tinted or printed pattern plastic bags. Exemptions for medical bags and childcare/diaper bags (tote style only, no backpacks) when accompanied by a child; those guests must enter at the ADA/VIP Gate on the West Side where security will check and tag the bag.

tailgating.timeWindow: Pre-match; parking lots open 3 hours prior to kickoff
tailgating.rules: Pre-event tailgating is permitted if conducted in a safe and respectful manner and does not disrupt other fans, interfere with normal parking procedures, or extend into additional spaces. Outside food companies are not permitted to deliver catering orders for tailgate activities.
tailgating.grillRules: No open flame grills allowed. Propane tanks are permitted on Toyota Stadium grounds, but charcoal and lighter fluid are not permitted.
tailgating.rvPolicy: RV and camper parking is available only for selected shows as determined by the organization, with a maximum of four marked parking spots. No RV hookups, electrical, or plumbing available. RVs and campers must be removed no later than the day after the event, there is no re-entry once parked, and there is absolutely no dumping of gray or black water on stadium grounds.

venueAccessRestrictions: In 2026 the East Side of Toyota Stadium is closed for a $182 million renovation. No access to any areas on the east side, including concourses, concessions, and seating; the entire East Concourse is closed for the first half of 2026. Fans enter through the Southwest Gate, West Gate, UMB Bank VIP West Gate, and Northwest Gate. The Northeast Gate and East Gate are closed due to renovations.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverage of any kind is a prohibited item. Alcohol may not be brought in or out of Toyota Stadium.
food: Concessions are available and all purchases are cashless/contactless. Open concession stands in 2026 include The Corner Kick (behind Section 103/104), Tex Mex Q (behind Section 109), Burgers & More / Chef's Kitchen (behind Section 112/113), and Burgers & More (behind Section 105). Additional food and beverage on the North Concourse includes the Southwest Terrace, The Winners Club presented by WinStar World Casino & Resort, Red Star Bar, and The Gallagher Club. East side concession stands are closed for the season. All-You-Can-Eat wristbands are available for Season Ticket Members inside the Gallagher Club at the National Soccer Hall of Fame. Alcohol sales are limited to two per customer per purchase and cease in the 75th minute of play.

gatesOpen.ruleText: For FC Dallas regular season matches, gates open 90 minutes prior to the event's start time for ticket holders.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Gates open at various times for non-FC Dallas events such as concerts and football games.
tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Pre-match tailgating permitted; parking lots open 3 hours prior to kickoff
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Exemptions for medical bags and childcare/diaper bags (tote style only, no backpacks) when accompanied by a child; those guests must enter at the ADA/VIP Gate on the West Side of the stadium.

rideshareDropoff: Rideshare pick-up and drop-off zones are marked on the interactive map at Ezzard Charles Drive, Central Avenue, and 14th Street.
bagPolicyNotes: For FC Cincinnati matches each fan may bring one of: a clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bag not exceeding 12 in x 6 in x 12 in; a one-gallon resealable clear freezer bag; or a small clutch bag or pack no larger than 6 in x 9 in with or without a handle or strap. Clear bags may not have colored tinting or obstructive patterns; simple logos are permitted. Exceptions are made for medically necessary bags or items after proper inspection and Stadium Management approval.
food: Concession stands, grab-and-go markets, and portable carts serving a variety of food and drinks.

name: Tropicana Field

parkingLots.name: Lot 1
parkingLots.notes: Prepaid single-game parking (subject to availability); ADA/wheelchair-accessible parking (van-accessible); EV charging stations; Season Member discounted parking. Located across from the Gate 4 drop-off on 16th St. S.

parkingLots.name: Lot 2
parkingLots.notes: Prepaid single-game parking; Season Member discounted parking (subject to availability).

parkingLots.name: Lot 5
parkingLots.notes: Prepaid single-game parking; EV charging stations; Season Member discounted parking (subject to availability).

parkingLots.name: Lot 6
parkingLots.notes: Prepaid single-game parking; Season Member discounted parking (subject to availability).

parkingLots.name: Lot 7
parkingLots.notes: Prepaid single-game parking; ADA/wheelchair-accessible parking (majority of accessible, van-accessible spaces here, enter from 3rd Ave S or 4th Ave S); EV charging stations.

parkingLots.name: Lot 8
parkingLots.notes: Rideshare pick-up/drop-off location for guests accessing Gate 1 (2026 season).

publicTransit.notes: The SunRunner bus rapid transit route has a stop on the north side of Tropicana Field, running every 15 minutes from 6 a.m. to 8 p.m. and every 30 minutes from 8 p.m. to midnight. The Baseball Looper Trolley Baseball Shuttle operates during the season. Charter buses may drop off passengers on 4th Ave S near Gate 3.

rideshareDropoff: Two rideshare options for 2026: guests accessing Gate 1 are dropped off at the rideshare location in Lot 8; guests with ADA drop-off and guests entering through Gates 4 & 5 are dropped off on Tropicana Drive on 16th Street.
accessibility: Wheelchair-accessible parking is offered in Lots 1 and 7 (majority in Lot 7), all van-accessible; enter Lot 7 from 3rd Ave S or 4th Ave S. An ADA drop-off area is in front of Gate 4, directly across from Lot 1 on 16th St. S. All gates are wheelchair accessible. Rolling Rays wheelchair transport service is available at Gates 1 and 5 on a first-come, first-served basis (gate-to-seat, not outside the gates; no rentals). All levels have accessible restrooms, all-gender restrooms, and changing stations. Guest Services (Gates 1, 3, 4, and MaintenX SkyDeck) offers sensory bags, plus a dedicated Sensory Room and Nursing Room.
bagPolicyNotes: Only clear bags are permitted. Fans may bring one (1) single-compartment clear bag (plastic, vinyl, or PVC) no larger than 12" x 12" x 6" and/or one (1) non-clear small fanny pack or clutch no larger than 5" x 7". Backpacks, non-transparent bags, and oversized bags are not permitted. Exceptions are made for diaper bags accompanying a young child and medical device bags.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is allowed once the lots are open for that event. Structures (sunshades, folding chairs, etc.) may not block parking aisles or other spaces. No big tents, no open flames (fire pits), no charcoal grills, and no large commercial grills are allowed. Alcohol is permitted in your tailgating area but may never be carried inside the ballpark.

venueAccessRestrictions: Security screening is conducted before entry using the Evolv Express screening system (walk through at normal pace carrying phones and clear bags). There is a no-reentry policy at all gates. Prohibited items include: non-transparent bags or bags not complying with the clear-bag policy; hard-sided coolers, boxes or cases of any size; alcoholic beverages; outside food or drinks (except one sealed water bottle 20 oz or less per fan); metal/ceramic/glass bottles; weapons of any kind (firearms, knives, chemical sprays over .6 oz); fireworks; projectiles; cameras with lenses longer than 12"; bullhorns/air horns/whistles and loud noisemakers (small cowbells remain allowed); bicycles/skateboards/hoverboards; sticks, poles, selfie sticks; aerosol cans; drones; lasers; audio speakers; bats; brooms over 36"; wrapped packages; footwear with wheels; and pets except service animals. Prohibited items will not be stored.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food or beverage is not permitted, with the exception of one sealed, personal-sized bottle of water (20 ounces or less) per ticketed fan. Exceptions can be made for food specifically needed for medical reasons or childcare.
food: Food destinations include the Budweiser Porch in center field, an open-air patio featuring local favorites from popular St. Pete restaurants with a full-service bar serving Budweiser and local Bay Area craft beers, plus the First Base and Third Base Food Halls and the all-inclusive MaintenX SkyDeck (ballpark fare, beer, wine, and soft drinks). Tropicana Field is a cash-free facility.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates open 90 minutes before first pitch for Monday-Friday Rays home games and two hours before first pitch on Opening Day and Saturday-Sunday Rays home games.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: 90 minutes before first pitch Monday-Friday; two hours before first pitch on Opening Day and Saturday-Sunday home games.
tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Tailgating is allowed once the lots are open for that event.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Exceptions to the clear-bag policy are made for diaper bags accompanying a young child and medical device bags.

parkingLots.notes: Shuttle services available from this lot on weekday day games only

publicTransit.notes: CobbLinc Bus 10 departs the MARTA Arts Center Station with a stop at Cobb Parkway & Windy Ridge Parkway; CobbLinc 10 does not run on Sundays. From MARTA, board Bus 12 at the Midtown MARTA Station to Cumberland Mall, then take the Cumberland Circular Shuttle (blue or green route) to The Battery Atlanta and Truist Park.

rideshareDropoff: One rideshare zone serves The Battery Atlanta, located along Windy Ridge Parkway for pick-up and drop-off access.
accessibility: Truist Park was designed to be universally accessible (accessible parking, elevators/escalators, courtesy rides, accessible seating and restrooms, lowered concession counters, and an accessible seating concierge). Accessible parking is in Lot 29 and the Red Deck. Accessible shuttles run from Lot N29 and complimentary golf-cart service is available from the Red, Orange, Purple, Yellow, Silver, Green and Delta Decks plus Braves 9 and Braves 11; shuttle services begin 2.5 hours before first pitch. Complimentary wheelchair escort service is available at the gates, requestable in the Ballpark app beginning 2 hours before first pitch.
bagPolicyNotes: Bags are not allowed to enter Truist Park for the 2026 season. Exceptions may be made for medical bags, breast pumps for nursing mothers, diaper bags for guests with infants/toddlers, bags required for guests with ADA needs, and small single-compartment clutches or clear bags no larger than 5 x 9 inches (opaque clutches are permitted, so clear bags are not strictly required). A first-come, first-served mobile locker bag storage between the Orange and Truist Tower parking decks accepts oversized bags; it opens two hours before first pitch through one hour after last out, starting at $12 per bag for baseball games.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is only permitted in Lot 29. Grilling is allowed in the grassy area only and you must have something to extinguish the coals. Tents of any kind cannot be set up in any Braves parking lot. Parking may be purchased for vehicles only, and proof of authorized parking for multiple spaces is required at entry to Lot 29. Loud/amplified music, personal restrooms, firearms and illegal drugs are prohibited.

venueAccessRestrictions: As a condition of entry, all fans consent to screening via metal detection (walk-through and/or handheld) at all gates. Prohibited items include weapons, aluminum cans (including sunscreen spray), glass bottles, baseball bats, outside alcohol, ice chests/hard-sided coolers, hard-sided containers/metal water bottles, camera lenses over 5 inches, tripods/monopods, drones, and bags/backpacks/clutches exceeding 5x9 inches. No re-entry: guests may not leave and return on the same ticket (except emergencies granted by a Guest Services/Security Supervisor), and all re-entering guests are subject to security re-inspection; no re-entry is allowed for any Braves parking lots.
nearby: The Battery Atlanta, a 2.25-million-square-foot mixed-use lifestyle and entertainment district anchored by Truist Park, offers hotels, retailers, restaurants, bars, live music and family-friendly events year-round.
outsideFoodRules: Fans may bring food as long as it fits inside a clear, gallon-sized plastic bag, plus one sealed plastic bottle of water; one bag of food and one bottle of water are permitted per ticket. Additional considerations are made for those with dietary concerns and infants, and all bags of food are subject to additional inspection at security gates. Ice chests and hard-sided coolers are not allowed; soft-sided coolers without the plastic liner are permitted only for guests with medical needs.
food: A variety of food and beverages is available throughout the ballpark via permanent locations and portable stands, offering classic ballpark fare alongside options showcasing the flavors of Atlanta Braves country. The Coors Light Chop House in right field (Section 156) offers casual dining open to all guests, and gluten-free items are available at the Centerfield Market in Section 149.

gatesOpen.ruleText: For each game, gates open two hours prior to first pitch (on weekday day games all gates open 80 minutes before first pitch).

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Weekday day games: all gates open 80 minutes before first pitch. Giveaway dates: gates may open earlier depending on crowd size. The 1st Base Gate opens at 4:30 p.m. for Batting Practice.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Bag-ban exceptions: medical bags no larger than needed for necessary medical equipment, breast pumps for nursing mothers, diaper bags for guests with infants/toddlers, bags required for guests with ADA needs, and small single-compartment clutches or clear bags no larger than 5 x 9 inches.

No overnight parking unless related to event activities and approved in advance. No tailgating or similar activities.

lines: CTA buses #9 Ashland, #20 Madison, #50 Damen, #126 Jackson
publicTransit.notes: The arena is two blocks south and one block east of the Damen stop on the Green Line, and two blocks south and three blocks west of the Ashland/Lake stop on the Green and Pink Lines. The arena is also just a few blocks north of the Illinois Medical District stop on the CTA Blue Line. Bus routes #9 Ashland, #20 Madison, #50 Damen, and #126 Jackson get you right in front of or within a few blocks of the arena.

rideshareDropoff: The Uber Zone is located at the corner of Madison Street and Wood Street (Lot E).
bagPolicyNotes: Guests are able to enter the arena with a small purse or personal bag up to 10x6x2. No backpacks or other bags are allowed. Exceptions for guests with required medical equipment will be provided.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Doors for Chicago Bulls and Chicago Blackhawks games open 90 minutes prior to the event start time, and vary for concerts, family shows and other sports events.

name: U.S. Bank Stadium

parkingLots.name: Factory Motor Parts Parking Garage
parkingLots.notes: Connected to the stadium via skyway; stadium does not directly manage any public parking. Over 20,000 spaces exist between the stadium and Hennepin Ave within a 20-min walk. Lots typically open 6 hrs before and close 2 hrs after an event.

publicTransit.notes: Light rail runs directly to the U.S. Bank Stadium Station; 123+ Metro Transit bus routes serve downtown Minneapolis.

rideshareDropoff: Uber/Lyft pickup at two locations: 9th Ave S between 6th St S and 7th St S, and 3rd St between Park Ave and Portland Ave.
accessibility: ADA-compliant; accessible parking in all lots/ramps; dedicated accessible drop-off/pick-up on 10th Ave S between 6th St S and 7th St S (across from Pentair Gate); complimentary wheelchair escorts; assistive listening devices; Mobility Services Hotline 612-777-8761.
bagPolicyNotes: Permitted: clear plastic/vinyl/PVC bag not exceeding 12x6x12 in, one-gallon clear freezer bag, or small clutch 4.5x6.5 in; medically necessary items allowed after inspection. Bag policy varies for non-Vikings events.
venueAccessRestrictions: No re-entry: guests who exit may not re-enter on the same ticket. All guests searched and screened via walk-through or hand-held metal detectors.
nearby: In the East Town neighborhood near Elliot Park, downtown Minneapolis; connected to the Minneapolis Skyway system.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverage prohibited except medically necessary items. Vikings games: one 32 oz factory-sealed plastic water bottle or one 32 oz empty reusable bottle (no metal/glass) per person; other events: one 20 oz factory-sealed plastic water bottle per person.
food: Aramark-operated concessions; fully cashless venue (credit/debit/contactless only, no cash accepted).

gatesOpen.ruleText: For NFL games, the gates to the stadium open two hours prior to the event.

tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: One 32 oz factory-sealed plastic water bottle or one 32 oz empty reusable bottle (no metal/glass) per person permitted for Vikings games; medically necessary items exception at a designated gate.

name: Valley Children's Stadium

parkingLots.name: Blue Lot
parkingLots.notes: General auto parking (passenger vehicles only); tailgating permitted during the game; limited accessible stalls open 4 hours before kickoff

parkingLots.name: Red Lot
parkingLots.notes: General auto parking (passenger vehicles only); tailgating permitted during the game; limited accessible stalls open 4 hours before kickoff

parkingLots.name: White Lot
parkingLots.notes: General auto parking (passenger vehicles only); tailgating permitted during the game; limited accessible stalls open 4 hours before kickoff; Northwest and Southwest gates accessible off Millbrook

parkingLots.name: Purple Lot
parkingLots.notes: Tailgating concludes at kickoff; picnic-pass overflow parking in P20, P23, P24

parkingLots.name: Green Lot
parkingLots.notes: Free game-day shuttle service to the stadium; tailgating concludes at kickoff

parkingLots.name: Yellow Lot
parkingLots.notes: Alcohol may not be consumed in the Yellow Parking Lots

parkingLots.name: Lot P1
parkingLots.notes: Campus lot with additional accessible stalls and general overflow; drop-off area and courtesy golf cart at the Lot P1 entrance

publicTransit.notes: Free game-day shuttle for fans parking in the Green Lots begins 3 hours before kickoff and runs through the end of the 1st quarter; bus stops along Barstow Ave, Woodrow Ave, and the Maple Roundabout, dropping off at the North entrance; return service begins at the end of the 3rd quarter.

accessibility: Limited accessible stalls in the Red, White, and Blue Lots open 4 hours before kickoff ($20, valid ADA placard required, first-come first-served); additional accessible stalls in campus Lot P1 with a drop-off area and courtesy golf cart at the P1 entrance. A wheelchair-equipped shuttle picks up at the Maple Roundabout. Accessible and companion seating at the top of sections 7, 8, 14, 15, 28, and 34 and the bottom of sections 28-33; free golf-cart shuttles inside the stadium to seating sections. In-stadium assistance via text (text BADDOG to 69050); ADA seating info line 559-278-3647; ADA seating map available.
bagPolicyNotes: Small clutch bags, 4.5” x 6.5” x 2” can be taken into the stadium in addition to one of the approved clear bags described above. An exception will be made for any necessary medical items and diaper bags, but all such items are subject to inspection prior to entry into Valley Children's Stadium.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is limited to the space directly behind each vehicle and is not permitted within any parking stall. Tents, tables, chairs, and grills may not block driveways, firelanes, or occupy stalls, and aisleways must remain clear. No staking is permitted in grass lots; 10x10 pop-up tents must be weighted with sandbags or concrete blocks per the fire marshal and may not be affixed to trees or fences. Alcohol may not be sold; no one under 21 may consume alcohol; kegs and party balls are prohibited. Music is allowed but must avoid vulgarity and stay at a reasonable volume. Tailgaters must clean up all trash.
tailgating.timeWindow: Lots open 6 hours before kickoff and vehicles may remain up to 2 hours after the game. Tailgating in the Red, White, and Blue Lots is permitted during the game; tailgating in the Purple and Green Lots concludes at kickoff.
tailgating.grillRules: Glass containers, charcoal and woodchip grills, deep fryers, and open-flame BBQs are not permitted in the general parking areas of the Red, White, Blue, Purple, and Green Lots; propane cooking devices are permissible.
tailgating.rvPolicy: Auto passes in all lots (Blue, Red, White, Purple, Green) are for passenger vehicles only; limos, trailers, and RVs are not permitted in the general parking areas.

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Alcohol, Artificial Noisemakers, Backpacks, Balls of any kind, Unauthorized Banners, Bottles, Confetti, Coolers, Fireworks, Food, Laser Pointers, Lawn Chairs, Illegal Drugs and Paraphernalia, Plastic Cups, Pets or Non-Service Animals, Sticks or Poles, Strollers, Tripods, Umbrellas, Video Cameras, Weapons of any kind, Any item deemed a safety hazard. Electronic metal detection devices will be in use at all of the entrance gates to Valley Children's Stadium. All bags and persons are subject to search upon entry, and only clear bags will be permitted inside Valley Children's Stadium.
nearby: Bulldog BLVD, the official pregame fan fest, is located in the plaza between Valley Children's Stadium, the Bulldog Soccer Stadium, and Bob Bennett Stadium; it opens 3 hours before kickoff, is free to enter, and features a pregame show, music, food trucks, and Fresno Street Eats. A 300 sq ft Bulldog Shop container store operates on game day.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food, coolers, and bottles are prohibited inside the stadium; fans may bring one factory-sealed water bottle under 24 ounces.
food: Concessions and concourse stands sell food along with beer and wine; a game-day concessions map is provided. Food trucks and Fresno Street Eats are available at the Bulldog BLVD fan fest.

name: Vaught–Hemingway Stadium

parkingLots.name: South Lot (Lot E)
parkingLots.notes: Reserved on-campus lot requiring an OMAF parking pass; rideshare drop-off/pick-up is here, east of Old Taylor Road; served by ADA golf cart shuttle to/from the stadium

parkingLots.name: Tad Smith Coliseum
parkingLots.notes: ADA golf cart shuttle stop to/from the stadium

parkingLots.name: Jackson Avenue Center
parkingLots.notes: Off-campus park and ride with shuttle service

rideshareDropoff: Rideshare (Uber, Lyft, etc.) drop-off and pick-up is in the South Lot east of Old Taylor Road.
accessibility: ADA seating requires a reserved ADA-designated ticket (contact the Ole Miss Ticket Office at 888-REB-TKTS). ADA elevators are on the east side near gates 13-14 (ADA access elevator at gate 15). ADA restrooms are located nearest wheelchair-accessible seating (North Endzone, Upper East, and Lower East near Section K). ADA parking requires both a valid gameday parking pass and a state-issued ADA credential. On-campus ADA golf cart shuttles run from 7 AM until one hour post-game (stops outside the northeast/northwest/southeast corners of the stadium). Only certified service animals are permitted and must remain on a leash or harness.
bagPolicyNotes: Bags that do not meet the SEC Clear Bag Policy are prohibited.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating takes place in The Grove and The Circle; on gamedays the Walk of Champions procession begins about two hours and 15 minutes before kickoff.
tailgating.timeWindow: The Grove and The Circle close Friday nights at 6:30 p.m. and reopen at 7 p.m. for tailgate set-up.

venueAccessRestrictions: No one may exit and re-enter Vaught-Hemingway Stadium unless he or she possesses a valid, un-scanned ticket. All bags will be checked upon entry.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food, beverages, coolers and containers are prohibited, except one sealed water bottle or empty drink container that does not exceed 20 oz.
food: Concessions are 100% cashless (major credit/debit cards and mobile payment only). Alcohol is sold to guests 21+, limited to two drinks per transaction, with sales starting when gates open and ending at the conclusion of the 3rd quarter; age-verification stations are on each concourse.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Stadium gates open 2 hours prior to kickoff

tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: The Grove and The Circle close Friday nights at 6:30 p.m. and reopen at 7 p.m. for tailgate set-up.

name: Wallace Wade Stadium

parkingLots.name: Blue Zone B-7 and B-4 lots
parkingLots.notes: ADA/accessible parking located outside the Wilson Gate; one placard per vehicle required

parkingLots.name: Science Drive Garage
parkingLots.notes: Overflow parking directed here, located off N.C. 751/Cameron Boulevard

accessibility: Accessible entry lanes are available at all stadium entrances; guests with medical devices are assisted through screening. ADA parking is outside the Wilson Gate in Blue Zone B-7 and B-4 lots (one placard per vehicle), with overflow at the Science Drive Garage off N.C. 751/Cameron Boulevard. Accessible lift-equipped vans run from all game day parking lots (pickup at Blue Zone, Whitford Drive Circle and Grounds Lot bus stop). Accessible/gender-neutral family restrooms behind Sections 9, 18 and 26, on field level and in Blue Devil Tower; adult changing table behind Section 18. Assistive listening devices at the Bostock Gate and Club Level guest services desks; closed captioning below the video board and on concourse TVs; sensory bags and quiet areas (behind Section 9, near Section 30, near Section 32). Wheelchair assistance from gates to seats. Assistance via DUACCESS text line (text 'DUACCESS' with request and location to 919-808-5576, beginning three hours before kickoff) or Duke Access and Accommodation Services at 919-668-1267.
bagPolicyNotes: Also permitted alongside the clear bag: small clutches or wallets, with or without a strap, that fit in the palm of the hand and are no larger than 8 x 5 x 1 inches; one-gallon clear plastic storage bags; and Duke Stores merchandise bags, provided you have a receipt showing a game day purchase. All standard prohibited item rules still apply, including restrictions on noisemakers, drink containers, laser pointers and selfie sticks, even for items purchased at Duke Stores.
venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Alcoholic beverages, Artificial noisemakers, Bags larger than 12 x 12 x 6 inches, Balloons, balls and frisbees, Cameras with lenses over four inches, Coolers, ice chests and similar containers, Cups, bottles, thermoses and drink containers, Drones or unmanned aircraft systems, Hazardous materials, Laser pointers and selfie sticks, Outside food and beverages (exceptions for medical or childcare needs), Outside chairs, including folding and tailgate chairs, Pets (except service animals), Video cameras, Weapons of any kind, including pocket knives, Wheelie shoes. All fans, students and staff are subject to screening before entering the venue. Walk-through metal detectors are the primary screening method. If needed, hand-held metal detectors and physical pat-downs may be used. Guests who do not consent to screening will not be permitted to enter.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverage are not permitted within the stadium; reasonable exceptions are made for medical necessities and childcare-related needs.
food: Concessions are provided by Proof of the Pudding, serving various options along with Coca-Cola products, located throughout the stadium concourse (no concessions on the field level). All concession stands are cashless (credit/debit cards and mobile pay apps); Duke students can use their Flex account with a physical DukeCard. Alcohol (beer, seltzer and canned cocktails) is sold to guests 21+, with sales concluding at the end of the third quarter (max two beers/seltzers or one canned cocktail per valid ID per transaction).

name: Williams–Brice Stadium
accessibility: Wheelchair spaces and accessible seating available (contact Ticket Office at 803-777-4274 or 1-800-4SCFANS; gameday exchanges at the Bignon Gameday Center); elevators located throughout the stadium for individuals with disabilities; deaf or hard-of-hearing guests can use open captioning on the North endzone video board.
bagPolicyNotes: Each ticketed guest can carry one large clear bag — either a one-gallon Ziploc-style bag or the 12″ x 6″ x 12″ clear bag — plus a small clutch purse (4.5″ x 6.5″). The small clutch must be carried into the venue outside the clear bag and is subject to search.
venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Artificial noisemakers, Purses larger than a clutch bag (4.5" x 6.5"), briefcases, backpacks, cinch bags of any kind, fanny packs, luggage of any kind, computer bags/cases, camera bags/cases, binocular bags/cases, or any bag larger than 12" x 6" x 12" or that does not meet clear bag standards, Coolers, thermoses, cups, glass bottles, cans, flasks (exception: 1 sealed or 1 empty clear plastic disposable water bottle per person), Food of any kind, Video cameras, tripods, recording devices, detachable camera lenses over 6", selfie sticks, Weapons/concealed weapons, Alcoholic beverages, Containers of any kind, Aerosol and spray cans, Umbrellas, Mace/pepper spray, Animals (except service animals), Laser lights, strobe lights and pointers, Irritants such as artificial noisemakers, Fireworks/explosives, Inflatables (beach balls, etc.), Flags and flagpoles, unauthorized banners or posters, Pom-Poms/Shakers with stick handles, Strollers, Illegal drugs, Seat cushions that include pockets, zippers, compartments or covers, Personal seatbacks with armrests, Non-approved face coverings, Drones, Other items that in the judgement of stadium management pose a safety hazard or diminish the enjoyment of an event by other patrons. Williams-Brice Stadium has a no-re-entry policy; tickets can only be scanned for use once. All fans go through security screening before entering. Fans do not need to remove items from their pockets or bags and move through metal detectors; fans with bags proceed to the closest bag check area. Tickets are scanned at the gate entrance.
outsideFoodRules: Food of any kind is a prohibited item inside Williams-Brice Stadium. Coolers, thermoses, cups, glass bottles, cans, flasks and containers of any kind are also prohibited; exception: one (1) sealed OR one (1) empty clear plastic disposable water bottle per person is permitted.

gatesOpen.ruleText: All other gates will open 1.5 hours prior to kick off.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Early Gates (Gates 5, 20, 38, 45, 56, 83, 95) open 2 hours (120 min) before kickoff; Gate 45 opens 3 hours (180 min) before kickoff for Cockaboose Club ticket holders; all other gates open 1.5 hours (90 min) before.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Medically necessary bags/equipment are permitted and must be inspected and tagged by security at the football medical gates — West Premium Gate 20/21 and East Gate 81.

name: Williams Stadium

parkingLots.name: Academic Commons Garage
parkingLots.notes: Suggested for West Side seating; located by Kamphuis Field at Liberty Softball Stadium, a short walk from Williams Stadium

parkingLots.name: Thomas Road Baptist Church (TRBC) parking lot
parkingLots.notes: Suggested for East Side seating

parkingLots.name: North Campus Garage
parkingLots.notes: ADA accessible parking on the third level (placard required); shuttles run from the third-floor bridge to Gate 1 starting at 8:00 AM

parkingLots.name: Football East parking lot
parkingLots.notes: Free 15-minute parking for the ticket office, in front of Williams Stadium

accessibility: ADA accessible parking on the third level of the North Campus Garage (placard required); ADA shuttles run from the third-floor bridge to Gate 1 starting at 8:00 AM; reserved handicap seating on the lower level of both the East and West sides (assigned ticket required); elevators in Carter Tower are for suite holders, club-level members, and credentialed game-day workers only.

tailgating.rules: One car per space; aisles may be used for tailgate parties in designated areas. Parking or driving on green reserved spaces or sidewalks is prohibited. Tents/canopies must not obstruct sidewalks, driving lanes, or walkways and must be secured by sandbags, water buckets, or stakes no longer than one foot. Equipment (furniture, grills, games, generators, satellite dishes) must not obstruct walkways. Open flames other than grills are prohibited. All trash must be bagged and removed. Generators must have a noise-reducing device (manufacturer cover or muffler). Pets are not permitted in tailgating areas. Alcohol is prohibited on campus.
tailgating.timeWindow: All tailgating lots must be vacated within three hours of the conclusion of the game; no overnight occupancy is permitted.
tailgating.grillRules: Open flames other than grills are prohibited. Hot coals must be placed in metal containers and removed from campus, or left on a concrete area for disposal by the Liberty Grounds team; disposal of grease or hot coals into the ground or storm drains is prohibited.
tailgating.rvPolicy: Motorized recreational vehicles, including four-wheelers, golf carts, mules, gators, scooters, and motorized skateboards, are prohibited.

venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Coolers - unless containing medical supplies, Fireworks or explosives, Outside food or beverages (Exception - One [1] Unopened Bottled of Water), Umbrellas, Pets - excluding service animals, Weapons (except as allowed by LU Weapons Policy). Re-entry is allowed at Williams Stadium if your ticket is properly scanned out upon exit. Customers that do not have their ticket or student Flames Pass scanned out upon exit will not be allowed re-entry. Exit and re-entry are allowed through clearly marked areas at Gates 1, 4, and 5 only, while students must exit through Gate 5 and re-enter through Gate 6 only. Guests are subject to inspection and search for prohibited items. All guests entering any gate at Williams Stadium on game day will be required to pass through a magnetometer.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverages are prohibited, except one unopened 1-liter plastic bottle of water per guest. Coolers are prohibited unless containing medical supplies.
food: Concessions stands are located on both sides of the stadium with additional vendors along the south end; credit cards are accepted at all concessions stands.

gatesOpen.ruleText: All gates open 90 minutes prior to kickoff.

name: Wintrust Arena

parkingLots.name: McCormick Place Parking Lot A (2301 South Prairie Avenue)
parkingLots.notes: Closest to Wintrust Arena with pedestrian bridge access. Six-level garage, 2,100 spaces, 8' height clearance, on Martin Luther King Drive adjacent to the West Building. Rate $27 for up to 16 hours and $40 for 16 to 24 hours. No in-and-out privileges. Overnight parking available in Lot A only; lost tickets pay the $40 overnight fee per day. Credit cards accepted. Accessible parking available here.

parkingLots.name: McCormick Place Parking Lot B (31st Street Lot, 3050 South Moe Drive)
parkingLots.notes: Outdoor surface lot at 31st Street near Lake Shore Drive South and Moe Drive, holds over 1,800 vehicles. Flat fee $18 per day, no in-and-out privileges. Open throughout event hours. No overnight parking. Credit cards accepted.

parkingLots.name: McCormick Place Parking Lot C (2227 Fort Dearborn Drive)
parkingLots.notes: Underground garage with 1,900 spaces, 6'4" height clearance, on Ft. Dearborn Drive adjacent to the Lakeside Center. Flat fee $27 per day, no in-and-out privileges. Open throughout event hours. No overnight parking. Credit cards accepted.

lines: CTA #3 King Drive bus (stop at Michigan Avenue and Cermak Road)
CTA #21 Cermak Road bus (stop at Michigan Avenue and Cermak Road)
CTA #4 Cottage Grove bus (stop at Michigan Avenue and Cermak Road)
CTA Green Line - Cermak-McCormick Place Station (Cermak Road and State Street, 0.15 miles west)
CTA Red Line - Cermak-Chinatown Station (0.5 miles west)
Metra Electric Line (Grand Concourse Level 2.5, South Building; direct service to downtown in about seven minutes)
publicTransit.notes: Fares paid by cash or Ventra Card; a Ventra Transit Card must be used to pay elevated train fares and can be bought at any train or elevated station, or via the Ventra App. Divvy bike sharing station located in McCormick Square at 2301 S. Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, plus a station at Cermak and Wabash near the Cermak-McCormick Place Green Line Station. Lyft and Uber are licensed TNP companies in Chicago; CHICABS e-hail taxis via the Arro app.

accessibility: Wintrust Arena welcomes guests with disabilities. Request reasonable accommodations at least five working days prior to an event; accessible seats are first-come, first-served. Guests may bring their own mobility devices (wheelchairs, scooters, walkers); elevators serve each concourse. Accessible parking stalls are available inside Lot A across Cermak on a first-come basis; a state-issued placard or plate must be displayed and out-of-state placards are honored. Accessible seating is available on each level, reached via escalator or elevator from the first floor/lobby, with floor-level seating accessible through the main entrance to the arena bowl; up to three companion tickets may be exchanged with each accessible ticket. ADA and Access Vehicle drop-off and pick-up is on the 200 East Cermak Road side of the arena. All doors are ADA-accessible; all restrooms are accessible with five including a companion/family section. Service animals are permitted in all areas where attendees are generally allowed. Sign language interpretation is available free of charge on at least 10 working days notice (contact@wintrustarena.com). Water fountains with bottle-refilling stations are located next to restrooms on each floor. KultureCity partnership provides sensory-inclusive accommodations (headphones, fidget items, feeling thermometer, KCVIP lanyard) via Guest Services on the second-floor concourse. General accessibility line: (312) 791-6900.
bagPolicyNotes: Wintrust Arena uses metal detectors and limits the size and style of bags. Permitted: all clear bags (plastic, vinyl or PVC) not exceeding 12" x 6" x 12", which may be hand-carried or have a shoulder strap and includes fanny packs, backpacks or sling bags; non-clear purses or bags no larger than 10" x 6" x 2"; and one one-gallon clear plastic freezer (Ziploc) bag. Prohibited bags include camera bags, briefcases, computer bags, non-clear backpacks larger than 10" x 6" x 2", coolers (including thermos), and luggage of any kind. An exception is made for medically necessary items and diaper bags after proper inspection at the entrance.
venueAccessRestrictions: Wintrust Arena utilizes metal detectors at entry. For the protection of all guests, ALL patrons are subject to search as a condition of admission; refusal to submit to such search may prevent admission to the arena. Smoking (including tobacco, marijuana, e-cigarettes and vaporizers) is prohibited inside the arena. Possession of prohibited items is grounds for ejection.
nearby: Wintrust Arena is part of the McCormick Square Campus with skybridge access to the McCormick Place Convention Center, the Marriott Marquis Chicago hotel and the Hyatt Regency McCormick Place hotel. It sits at the corner of East Cermak Road and Indiana Ave.
outsideFoodRules: Food or beverage is a prohibited item, as are cans, bottles, coolers or other similar containers.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Doors open to the public 60 minutes prior to tip-off.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Skyrider members (Chicago Sky full season ticket members) can enter 90 minutes prior to tip-off through the Skyrider Entrance only, located off Cermak on the ground level of the arena.

name: Wrigley Field

parkingLots.name: Toyota Camry Lot
parkingLots.notes: Season Parking Holders, Event Day. 1126 W. Grace St., Chicago, IL 60613. Also the designated lot for accessible/disability parking (game-by-game, paid) and for expecting mothers.

parkingLots.name: Toyota RAV4 Lot
parkingLots.notes: Season Parking Holders, Event Day. 1140 W. Eddy St., Chicago, IL 60613.

parkingLots.name: Irving Park Lot
parkingLots.notes: Season Parking Holders, Event Day. 1052 Irving Park Rd., Chicago, IL 60613.

parkingLots.name: Remote Parking Lot
parkingLots.notes: Free remote parking for night and weekend games at 4650 N. Clarendon Ave., Chicago, IL 60640, a new location in 2026, with a free shuttle to and from Wrigley Field. Shuttles begin two hours before first pitch and run approximately 90 minutes after the end of the game, dropping off and picking up on Irving Park Road between Clark Street and Seminary Avenue.

publicTransit.notes: Public transportation is the recommended way to get to Wrigley Field. The CTA Red Line stops directly at the Wrigley Field Addison station. CTA Bus #152 (Addison) and CTA Bus #22 (Clark) both stop at the intersection of Clark & Addison streets.
lines: CTA Blue Line (from O'Hare, transfer to #152 bus)
CTA Yellow Line / Skokie Swift (from northern suburbs)

rideshareDropoff: Rideshare services (Uber, Lyft) operate within a geo-fence for pick-up and drop-off around Wrigley Field on game and event days. Pick-up locations are on Addison Street between Broadway and Halsted Street, and on Irving Park Road between Clark Street and Seminary Avenue.
accessibility: Accessible parking is available game-by-game in the Toyota Camry Lot (1126 W. Grace St.); paid, subject to availability, reserve in advance via the Wrigley Field Ticket Office (800-THE-CUBS) or fanservices@cubs.com. Accessible seating sections are located throughout the ballpark near an elevator, lift and/or ramp. Assistive listening devices are available free of charge from the Fan Services Booth on the main concourse behind home plate. Complimentary gate-to-seat wheelchair service is provided first-come, first-served. See the Wrigley Field Accessibility Guide for full details.
bagPolicyNotes: Backpacks (including clear backpacks), hard-sided coolers (regardless of size) and bags larger than 16 x 16 x 8 inches are NOT permitted. Other bags such as wallets, purses, drawstring bags, fanny packs, lunch bags, briefcases and soft-sided coolers smaller than 16 x 16 x 8 inches are permitted. Exceptions are made for medical bags and diaper bags accompanying guests with young children. Bags are subject to inspection. No bag or luggage storage is offered.

tailgating.rules: Tailgating is not allowed in any of the Chicago Cubs operated parking lots. The Chicago Police Department strictly enforces open alcohol container laws.

venueAccessRestrictions: All guests, staff and media are screened prior to entry via a touchless metal-detector process (no need to remove phones, wallets or keys); mobile tickets must be scanned at self-scanning ticket pedestals. Guests may not exit and re-enter the ballpark (Gallagher Way access excepted, with re-entry closing at the bottom of the eighth inning). Prohibited items include firearms/knives/weapons, hard-sided coolers, professional-grade cameras and equipment, drones, selfie sticks, alcohol, marijuana, glass/metal/aluminum containers, and umbrellas with metal tips or larger than 10 inches. All bags and items are subject to inspection.
nearby: Wrigley Field sits in the Wrigleyville neighborhood, surrounded by popular bars and restaurants including Murphy's Bleachers (3655 N Sheffield Ave), The Dugout, Rizzo's Bar and Inn, Nisei Lounge, Sluggers Bar & Grill, Tin Roof, Stolen Saddle, Cheesie's Pub and Dimo's Pizza. Gallagher Way, an open-air space adjacent to the ballpark on Clark Street, is accessible to ticket holders before, during and after the ticketed game.
outsideFoodRules: A personal amount of food may be brought into the ballpark in a small, disposable bag; factory-sealed plastic bottles are also permitted. Guests with dietary restrictions are welcome to bring food prepared at home in clear bags or containers. No glass bottles, cans, alcoholic beverages, thermoses or hard-sided coolers of any kind may be brought in.
food: Signature concessions include the North Side Twist Pretzel (a two-pound pretzel served with three dips), Garrett Popcorn, Hot Doug's player-inspired sausages in the bleachers, and Vienna Beef Chicago-style hot dogs (the official hot dog of Wrigley Field). New for 2026: chicken & churros, a tostada stack, and the 'bow wow dog' (a chargrilled Vienna hot dog on a bao bun).

gatesOpen.ruleText: For most games, gates open 90 minutes prior to first pitch. Gates open two hours before first pitch for Opening Day, Saturday games and special occasions, unless otherwise specified.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Gates open two hours before first pitch for Opening Day, Saturday games and special occasions (versus the usual 90 minutes), unless otherwise specified.
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: Exceptions to the 16 x 16 x 8 inch bag limit are made for medical bags and diaper bags that accompany guests with young children.

name: Grand Casino Arena

parkingLots.name: RiverCentre Parking Ramp
parkingLots.notes: 150 West Kellogg Blvd, Saint Paul. Directly connected to the arena complex, with skyway access to the arena and accessible parking. License plate reader entry with no paper ticket; pay in the parking app, by scanning a QR code in the ramp, or at a pay station.

parkingLots.name: Kellogg Parking Ramp
parkingLots.notes: 129 West Kellogg Blvd, Saint Paul. Underground ramp beneath Saint Paul RiverCentre, directly connected to the arena complex. 7-foot vehicle height clearance.

rideshareDropoff: Gate 4, at the northeast corner of Grand Casino Arena on 5th Street, is the official pick-up and drop-off location for Minnesota Wild games and Grand Casino Arena events.
bagPolicyNotes: Guests are strongly discouraged from bringing bags. Purses up to 12 x 12 x 6 inches, clear or not, are allowed at the designated X-ray entry points. Wristlets, clutches and wallets up to 4 x 6 x 1.5 inches are allowed at all entrances and are subject to inspection. Medical and parenting bags are permitted and go through X-ray screening. Backpacks, coolers and large totes are prohibited.

name: Yankee Stadium

parkingLots.name: 164th Street Garage
parkingLots.notes: Premium Parking; expected to reach capacity quickly for postseason games. Lots/garages are operated by City Parking, not the Yankees.

parkingLots.name: Ruppert Plaza Garage
parkingLots.notes: 1 Macombs Dam Park; accepts Premium Parking Pass

parkingLots.name: 161st Street Garage
parkingLots.notes: 20 East 161st Street; accepts Premium Parking Pass

parkingLots.name: River Avenue Garage
parkingLots.notes: 950 River Avenue; accepts Premium Parking Pass

publicTransit.notes: The No. 4 and D trains make stops at the 161st Street/Yankee Stadium subway station (East 161st Street and River Avenue); B train service is available weekdays only. NYC bus lines Bx6, Bx13, Bx1, Bx2 and BxM4 serve the stadium, and Metro-North offers train service. Info via mta.info or MTA 511.

rideshareDropoff: Car service dispatch is available outside Gate 2.
accessibility: Sixteen public elevators serve guests with disabilities across Gate 2, the Suite Entrance adjacent to Gate 4, the Great Hall, Gate 6 and Gate 8. Two ramps (adjacent to Gate 2 on the left-field side and Gate 6 on the right-field side) are accessible for guests who use wheelchairs or scooters. Accessible restrooms are on all levels. See the Guide for Guests with Disabilities.
bagPolicyNotes: One soft-sided MLB-compliant bag no larger than 16 x 16 x 8 inches plus one smaller soft-sided personal item such as a handbag, clutch, tote or plastic grocery bag is permitted per guest at Yankees games. Hard-sided bags and containers of any size are prohibited. All bags and personal items are visually inspected at entry and must fit bag-size bins without adjustment. There is no storage area at the stadium. Different restrictions may apply for non-Yankees events.
venueAccessRestrictions: All guests are required to be screened via metal detectors before entering (part of MLB's initiative to standardize security at all 30 parks). No re-entry: guests are not permitted to leave and return on the same ticket, except in the case of an emergency. Prohibited items include cans and glass bottles, outside alcohol, selfie sticks, mono/tripods and other professional camera/video equipment, and large or golf umbrellas.
outsideFoodRules: Guests may bring food into the stadium for individual consumption; items such as apples and oranges must be sliced or sectioned. Empty, reusable, non-glass water bottles up to 24 oz and clear factory-sealed plastic water bottles 1 liter or smaller are permitted; cans and glass bottles are prohibited (exceptions for guests with medical needs and for glass baby bottles at management's discretion).
food: Legends Hospitality is the exclusive concessions and catering provider. On-site dining includes Yankees Steakhouse (USDA prime beef, fresh seafood, premium wines) above Hard Rock Cafe inside Gate 6, and Hard Rock Cafe Yankee Stadium (burgers, salads, barbecue). Mobile ordering and pickup through Uber Eats are available at select stands on the Field, Main and Terrace Levels.

gatesOpen.ruleText: For Yankees home games, all gates open 90 minutes prior to the scheduled start time of the game.

tenantOverlays.gateVariance: Gate openings are subject to change during inclement weather and for special events, doubleheaders, Opening Day, the Old-Timers' Day game and postseason play or at Yankee Stadium management's discretion.

name: Yulman Stadium

parkingLots.name: Diboll Garage
parkingLots.notes: On-campus garage; ADA parking available (call (504) 861-WAVE to purchase permit in advance)

parkingLots.name: Tailgate Village Lot
parkingLots.notes: Complimentary shuttles run to Yulman Stadium beginning 4.0 hours prior to kickoff

parkingLots.name: Loyola Garages
parkingLots.notes: No shuttle service from the Loyola Garages

parkingLots.name: Ursuline Academy
parkingLots.notes: Designated ADA lot; complimentary shuttle to/from Yulman Stadium beginning 5.0 hours prior to kickoff (adjustments for weeknight and 11:00 a.m. Saturday kickoffs)

parkingLots.name: St. Rita Catholic School
parkingLots.notes: Only available for parking passes purchased in advance

accessibility: Yulman Stadium provides ADA accommodations: a designated ADA drop-off area on S. Claiborne Ave. with golf cart shuttles; ADA parking in the Diboll Parking Garage and at Ursuline Academy (the designated ADA lot, with shuttle beginning ~5 hours before kickoff, purchase permit in advance at (504) 861-WAVE); three ADA drop-off/shuttle pickup sites (Tailgate Village at Newcomb Pl/Drill Rd, Claiborne Lot exit to Ben Weiner, Diboll Garage exit on Janet Yulman side); public elevators E1/E2 (east side, Party on the Plaza) and E3 (west side); accessible restrooms near accessible seating; wheelchair and companion seating; a wheelchair dispatch/loan program at Guest Service Desks (sections 105 or 120); certified service animals welcome; all ADA amenities marked with signage and Braille.
bagPolicyNotes: Fans are also allowed to bring in a 1 gallon re-sealable plastic storage bag or small clutch purses no larger than 4.5” by 6.5”.
venueAccessRestrictions: Prohibited: Alcohol (purchased outside of the stadium), Artificial noise makers (Thunder sticks are permitted), Backpacks, book bags, knapsacks (Note –diaper bags may be brought in if accompanied by an infant), Banners or other signage including posters, Contraband, Open containers of any kind, thermos bottle, bottles and cans, Coolers, Drones, Flags, Fireworks, Flammables, Footballs or throwing objects, Glass, Large bags -maximum size 12” x 12”x 6”, Laser pointers, Outside food and beverage, Projectiles, Seatback chairs, Stickers, Sticks, bats, poles and clubs, Strollers – (umbrella strollers that will collapse and be placed under guest seats are permitted), Video cameras are not permitted at Tulane football games - (handheld still cameras are permitted), Weapons, even with concealed weapons permit, Umbrellas, Unmanned Aircraft Systems (Drones), Any other item(s) deemed unacceptable by Tulane University or Stadium management. Once patrons exit the stadium, re-entry is not permitted.
outsideFoodRules: Outside food and beverage are prohibited inside Yulman Stadium (listed among prohibited items). Alcoholic beverages purchased outside the stadium are not allowed inside.
food: Aramark is the food & beverage provider. Concessions throughout the stadium include Dook's Burgers and Dook's Tackle Box (section 125), The Frozen Wave by Fat Tuesday (125), UPTOWN Tenders (118), Reginelli's Pizza (sections 103 and 111), Superior Margaritas (throughout), Dat Dog (sections 101 and 118), Blue Oak BBQ (Westfeldt Terrace), and Plum St. Sno Balls and Meyers Lemonade (section 104). Markets located at section 101 by Gate C, sections 105 and 206, and the Hullabaloo Market (Craft & Draft, Fan Favorites, Roberts Jambalaya, Muffulettas). Over 20 additional portable locations (Walk Thru Brews, Green Wave Classics Express, Craft & Draft carts). Alcoholic beverages sold inside during all games; sales cut off at the end of the 3rd quarter.

gatesOpen.ruleText: Gates at Yulman Stadium open 90 minutes prior to kick-off.

tenantOverlays.tailgateWindow: Tailgating begins four hours before kickoff and ends 30 minutes before kickoff (no tailgating during the game; weeknight games have different hours).
tenantOverlays.bagPolicyException: In addition to a clear bag (max 12x12x6 in), fans may bring a 1-gallon re-sealable plastic storage bag or a small clutch purse no larger than 4.5" x 6.5"; diaper bags allowed if accompanied by an infant.
